concepts.description: A house is a building or structure that has the ability to be occupied for habitation by humans or other creatures (source: Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia, see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/House).

concepts.label: HowTo
concepts.description: Instructions that explain how to achieve a result by performing a sequence of steps.

concepts.label: HowToDirection
concepts.description: A direction indicating a single action to do in the instructions for how to achieve a result.

concepts.label: HowToItem
concepts.description: An item used as either a tool or supply when performing the instructions for how to achieve a result.

concepts.label: HowToSection
concepts.description: A sub-grouping of steps in the instructions for how to achieve a result (e.g. steps for making a pie crust within a pie recipe).

concepts.label: HowToStep
concepts.description: A step in the instructions for how to achieve a result. It is an ordered list with HowToDirection and/or HowToTip items.

concepts.label: HowToSupply
concepts.description: A supply consumed when performing the instructions for how to achieve a result.

concepts.label: HowToTip
concepts.description: An explanation in the instructions for how to achieve a result. It provides supplementary information about a technique, supply, author's preference, etc. It can explain what could be done, or what should not be done, but doesn't specify what should be done (see HowToDirection).

concepts.label: HowToTool
concepts.description: A tool used (but not consumed) when performing instructions for how to achieve a result.

concepts.label: HyperToc
concepts.description: A HyperToc represents a hypertext table of contents for complex media objects, such as [[VideoObject]], [[AudioObject]]. Items in the table of contents are indicated using the [[tocEntry]] property, and typed [[HyperTocEntry]]. For cases where the same larger work is split into multiple files, [[...

concepts.label: HyperTocEntry
concepts.description: A HyperToEntry is an item within a [[HyperToc]], which represents a hypertext table of contents for complex media objects, such as [[VideoObject]], [[AudioObject]]. The media object itself is indicated using [[associatedMedia]]. Each section of interest within that content can be described with a...

concepts.label: IPTCDigitalSourceEnumeration
concepts.description: IPTC "Digital Source" codes for use with the [[digitalSourceType]] property, providing information about the source for a digital media object. In general these codes are not declared here to be mutually exclusive, although some combinations would be contradict...

concepts.label: ITNonprofitType
concepts.description: ITNonprofitType: Non-profit organization type originating from Italy. Most categories are drawn from the Italian Third Sector Code (Legislative Decree No. 117 of 3 July 2017), although some Italian non-profit entities, such as amateur sports entities, are primarily governed by other legislation.

concepts.label: IgnoreAction
concepts.description: The act of intentionally disregarding the object. An agent ignores an object.

concepts.label: ImageGallery
concepts.description: Web page type: Image gallery page.

concepts.label: ImageObjectSnapshot
concepts.description: A specific and exact (byte-for-byte) version of an [[ImageObject]]. Two byte-for-byte identical files, for the purposes of this type, considered identical. If they have different embedded metadata (e.g. XMP, EXIF) the files will differ. Different external facts about the files, e.g. creator or da...

concepts.label: ImagingTest
concepts.description: Any medical imaging modality typically used for diagnostic purposes.

concepts.label: IncentiveQualifiedExpenseType
concepts.description: The types of expenses that are covered by the incentive. For example some incentives are only for the goods (tangible items) but the services (labor) are excluded.

concepts.label: IncentiveStatus
concepts.description: Enumerates a status for an incentive, such as whether it is active.

concepts.label: IncentiveType
concepts.description: Enumerates common financial incentives for products, including tax credits, tax deductions, rebates and subsidies, etc.

concepts.label: IndividualPhysician
concepts.description: An individual medical practitioner. For their official address use [[address]], for affiliations to hospitals use [[hospitalAffiliation]]. The [[practicesAt]] property can be used to indicate [[MedicalOrganization]] hospitals, clinics, pharmacies etc. where this physician practices.

concepts.label: IndividualProduct
concepts.description: A single, identifiable product instance (e.g. a laptop with a particular serial number).

concepts.label: InfectiousAgentClass
concepts.description: Classes of agents or pathogens that transmit infectious diseases. Enumerated type.

concepts.label: InfectiousDisease
concepts.description: An infectious disease is a clinically evident human disease resulting from the presence of pathogenic microbial agents, like pathogenic viruses, pathogenic bacteria, fungi, protozoa, multicellular parasites, and prions. To be considered an infectious disease, such pathogens are known to be able t...

concepts.label: InformAction
concepts.description: The act of notifying someone of information pertinent to them, with no expectation of a response.

concepts.label: InsertAction
concepts.description: The act of adding at a specific location in an ordered collection.

concepts.label: InstallAction
concepts.description: The act of installing an application.

concepts.label: Intangible
concepts.description: A utility class that serves as the umbrella for a number of 'intangible' things such as quantities, structured values, etc.

concepts.label: InteractAction
concepts.description: The act of interacting with another person or organization.

concepts.label: InteractionCounter
concepts.description: A summary of how users have interacted with this CreativeWork. In most cases, authors will use a subtype to specify the specific type of interaction.

concepts.label: InvestmentFund
concepts.description: A company or fund that gathers capital from a number of investors to create a pool of money that is then re-invested into stocks, bonds and other assets.

concepts.label: InvestmentOrDeposit
concepts.description: A type of financial product that typically requires the client to transfer funds to a financial service in return for potential beneficial financial return.

concepts.label: InviteAction
concepts.description: The act of asking someone to attend an event. Reciprocal of RsvpAction.

concepts.label: Invoice
concepts.description: A statement of the money due for goods or services; a bill.

concepts.label: ItemAvailability
concepts.description: A list of possible product availability options.

concepts.label: ItemList
concepts.description: A list of items of any sort—for example, Top 10 Movies About Weathermen, or Top 100 Party Songs. Not to be confused with HTML lists, which are often used only for formatting.

concepts.label: ItemListOrderType
concepts.description: Enumerated for values for itemListOrder for indicating how an ordered ItemList is organized.

concepts.label: ItemPage
concepts.description: A page devoted to a single item, such as a particular product or hotel.

concepts.label: JobPosting
concepts.description: A listing that describes a job opening in a certain organization.

concepts.label: JoinAction
concepts.description:
An agent joins an event/group with participants/friends at a location.

Related actions:

* [[RegisterAction]]: Unlike RegisterAction, JoinAction refers to joining a group/team of people.
* [[SubscribeAction]]: Unlike SubscribeAction, JoinAction does not imply that you'll be receiving update...

concepts.label: Joint
concepts.description: The anatomical location at which two or more bones make contact.

concepts.label: Landform
concepts.description: A landform or physical feature.  Landform elements include mountains, plains, lakes, rivers, seascape and oceanic waterbody interface features such as bays, peninsulas, seas and so forth, including sub-aqueous terrain features such as submersed mountain ranges, volcanoes, and the great ocean basins.

concepts.label: Language
concepts.description: Natural languages such as Spanish, Tamil, Hindi, English, etc. Formal language code tags expressed in [BCP 47](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IETF_language_tag) can be used via the [[alternateName]] property. The Language type previously also covered programming languages such as Scheme and Lisp, ...

concepts.label: LearningResource
concepts.description: The LearningResource type can be used to indicate [[CreativeWork]]s (whether physical or digital) that have a particular and explicit orientation towards learning, education, skill acquisition, and other educational purposes. [[LearningResource]] is expected to be used as an addition to a primary...

concepts.label: LeaveAction
concepts.description:
An agent leaves an event / group with participants/friends at a location.

Related actions:

* [[JoinAction]]: The antonym of LeaveAction.
* [[UnRegisterAction]]: Unlike UnRegisterAction, LeaveAction implies leaving a group/team of people rather than a service.

concepts.label: LegalForceStatus
concepts.description: A list of possible statuses for the legal force of a legislation.

concepts.label: LegalService
concepts.description: A LegalService is a business that provides legally-oriented services, advice and representation, e.g. law firms.\n\nAs a [[LocalBusiness]] it can be described as a [[provider]] of one or more [[Service]]\(s).

concepts.label: LegalValueLevel
concepts.description: A list of possible levels for the legal validity of a legislation.

concepts.label: Legislation
concepts.description: A legal document such as an act, decree, bill, etc. (enforceable or not) or a component of a legal act (like an article).

concepts.label: LegislationObject
concepts.description: A specific object or file containing a Legislation. Note that the same Legislation can be published in multiple files. For example, a digitally signed PDF, a plain PDF and an HTML version.

concepts.label: LegislativeBuilding
concepts.description: A legislative building—for example, the state capitol.

concepts.label: LendAction
concepts.description:
The act of providing an object under an agreement that it will be returned at a later date. Reciprocal of BorrowAction.

Related actions:

* [[BorrowAction]]: Reciprocal of LendAction.

concepts.label: LibrarySystem
concepts.description: A [[LibrarySystem]] is a collaborative system amongst several libraries.

concepts.label: LifestyleModification
concepts.description: A process of care involving exercise, changes to diet, fitness routines, and other lifestyle changes aimed at improving a health condition.

concepts.label: Ligament
concepts.description: A short band of tough, flexible, fibrous connective tissue that functions to connect multiple bones, cartilages, and structurally support joints.

concepts.label: LikeAction
concepts.description: The act of expressing a positive sentiment about the object. An agent likes an object (a proposition, topic or theme) with participants.

concepts.label: LinkRole
concepts.description: A Role that represents a Web link, e.g. as expressed via the 'url' property. Its linkRelationship property can indicate URL-based and plain textual link types, e.g. those in IANA link registry or others such as 'amphtml'. This structure provides a placeholder where details from HTML's link elemen...

concepts.label: LiquorStore
concepts.description: A shop that sells alcoholic drinks such as wine, beer, whisky and other spirits.

concepts.label: ListItem
concepts.description: An list item, e.g. a step in a checklist or how-to description.

concepts.label: ListenAction
concepts.description: The act of consuming audio content.

concepts.label: LiveBlogPosting
concepts.description: A [[LiveBlogPosting]] is a [[BlogPosting]] intended to provide a rolling textual coverage of an ongoing event through continuous updates.

concepts.label: LoanOrCredit
concepts.description: A financial product for the loaning of an amount of money, or line of credit, under agreed terms and charges.

concepts.label: LocalBusiness
concepts.description: A particular physical business or branch of an organization. Examples of LocalBusiness include a restaurant, a particular branch of a restaurant chain, a branch of a bank, a medical practice, a club, a bowling alley, etc.

concepts.label: LocationFeatureSpecification
concepts.description: Specifies a location feature by providing a structured value representing a feature of an accommodation as a property-value pair of varying degrees of formality.

concepts.label: LodgingBusiness
concepts.description: A lodging business, such as a motel, hotel, or inn.

concepts.label: LodgingReservation
concepts.description: A reservation for lodging at a hotel, motel, inn, etc.\n\nNote: This type is for information about actual reservations, e.g. in confirmation emails or HTML pages with individual confirmations of reservations.

concepts.label: LoginAction
concepts.description: The action of logging into a device or application.

concepts.label: LoseAction
concepts.description: The act of being defeated in a competitive activity.

concepts.label: LymphaticVessel
concepts.description: A type of blood vessel that specifically carries lymph fluid unidirectionally toward the heart.

concepts.label: Manuscript
concepts.description: A book, document, or piece of music written by hand rather than typed or printed.

concepts.label: MapCategoryType
concepts.description: An enumeration of several kinds of Map.

concepts.label: MarryAction
concepts.description: The act of marrying a person.

concepts.label: Mass
concepts.description: Properties that take Mass as values are of the form '<Number> <Mass unit of measure>'. E.g., '7 kg'.

concepts.label: MathSolver
concepts.description: A math solver which is capable of solving a subset of mathematical problems.

concepts.label: MaximumDoseSchedule
concepts.description: The maximum dosing schedule considered safe for a drug or supplement as recommended by an authority or by the drug/supplement's manufacturer. Capture the recommending authority in the recognizingAuthority property of MedicalEntity.

concepts.label: MeasurementTypeEnumeration
concepts.description: Enumeration of common measurement types (or dimensions), for example "chest" for a person, "inseam" for pants, "gauge" for screws, or "wheel" for bicycles.

concepts.label: MediaEnumeration
concepts.description: MediaEnumeration enumerations are lists of codes, labels etc. useful for describing media objects. They may be reflections of externally developed lists, or created at schema.org, or a combination.

concepts.label: MediaGallery
concepts.description: Web page type: Media gallery page. A mixed-media page that can contain media such as images, videos, and other multimedia.

concepts.label: MediaManipulationRatingEnumeration
concepts.description: Codes for use with the [[mediaAuthenticityCategory]] property, indicating the authenticity of a media object (in the context of how it was published or shared). In general these codes are not mutually exclusive, although some combinations (such as 'original' versus 'transformed', 'edited' and 'st...

concepts.label: MediaObject
concepts.description: A media object, such as an image, video, audio, or text object embedded in a web page or a downloadable dataset i.e. DataDownload. Note that a creative work may have many media objects associated with it on the same web page. For example, a page about a single song (MusicRecording) may have a mus...

concepts.label: MediaReview
concepts.description: A [[MediaReview]] is a more specialized form of Review dedicated to the evaluation of media content online, typically in the context of fact-checking and misinformation. For more general reviews of media in the broader sense, use [[UserReview]], [[CriticReview]] or other [[Review]] types. This de...

concepts.label: MediaReviewItem
concepts.description: Represents an item or group of closely related items treated as a unit for the sake of evaluation in a [[MediaReview]]. Authorship etc. apply to the items rather than to the curation/grouping or reviewing party.

concepts.label: MediaSubscription
concepts.description: A subscription which allows a user to access media including audio, video, books, etc.

concepts.label: MedicalAudience
concepts.description: Target audiences for medical web pages.

concepts.label: MedicalAudienceType
concepts.description: Target audiences types for medical web pages. Enumerated type.

concepts.label: MedicalBusiness
concepts.description: A particular physical or virtual business of an organization for medical purposes. Examples of MedicalBusiness include different businesses run by health professionals.

concepts.label: MedicalCause
concepts.description: The causative agent(s) that are responsible for the pathophysiologic process that eventually results in a medical condition, symptom or sign. In this schema, unless otherwise specified this is meant to be the proximate cause of the medical condition, symptom or sign. The proximate cause is define...

concepts.label: MedicalClinic
concepts.description: A facility, often associated with a hospital or medical school, that is devoted to the specific diagnosis and/or healthcare. Previously limited to outpatients but with evolution it may be open to inpatients as well.

concepts.label: MedicalCode
concepts.description: A code for a medical entity.

concepts.label: MedicalCondition
concepts.description: Any condition of the human body that affects the normal functioning of a person, whether physically or mentally. Includes diseases, injuries, disabilities, disorders, syndromes, etc.

concepts.label: MedicalConditionStage
concepts.description: A stage of a medical condition, such as 'Stage IIIa'.

concepts.label: MedicalContraindication
concepts.description: A condition or factor that serves as a reason to withhold a certain medical therapy. Contraindications can be absolute (there are no reasonable circumstances for undertaking a course of action) or relative (the patient is at higher risk of complications, but these risks may be outweighed by other...

concepts.label: MedicalDevice
concepts.description: Any object used in a medical capacity, such as to diagnose or treat a patient.

concepts.label: MedicalDevicePurpose
concepts.description: Categories of medical devices, organized by the purpose or intended use of the device.

concepts.label: MedicalEntity
concepts.description: The most generic type of entity related to health and the practice of medicine.

concepts.label: MedicalEnumeration
concepts.description: Enumerations related to health and the practice of medicine: A concept that is used to attribute a quality to another concept, as a qualifier, a collection of items or a listing of all of the elements of a set in medicine practice.

concepts.label: MedicalEvidenceLevel
concepts.description: Level of evidence for a medical guideline. Enumerated type.

concepts.label: MedicalGuideline
concepts.description: Any recommendation made by a standard society (e.g. ACC/AHA) or consensus statement that denotes how to diagnose and treat a particular condition. Note: this type should be used to tag the actual guideline recommendation; if the guideline recommendation occurs in a larger scholarly article, use M...

concepts.label: MedicalGuidelineContraindication
concepts.description: A guideline contraindication that designates a process as harmful and where quality of the data supporting the contraindication is sound.

concepts.label: MedicalGuidelineRecommendation
concepts.description: A guideline recommendation that is regarded as efficacious and where quality of the data supporting the recommendation is sound.

concepts.label: MedicalImagingTechnique
concepts.description: Any medical imaging modality typically used for diagnostic purposes. Enumerated type.

concepts.label: MedicalIndication
concepts.description: A condition or factor that indicates use of a medical therapy, including signs, symptoms, risk factors, anatomical states, etc.

concepts.label: MedicalIntangible
concepts.description: A utility class that serves as the umbrella for a number of 'intangible' things in the medical space.

concepts.label: MedicalObservationalStudy
concepts.description: An observational study is a type of medical study that attempts to infer the possible effect of a treatment through observation of a cohort of subjects over a period of time. In an observational study, the assignment of subjects into treatment groups versus control groups is outside the control o...

concepts.label: MedicalObservationalStudyDesign
concepts.description: Design models for observational medical studies. Enumerated type.

concepts.label: MedicalOrganization
concepts.description: A medical organization (physical or not), such as hospital, institution or clinic.

concepts.label: MedicalProcedure
concepts.description: A process of care used in either a diagnostic, therapeutic, preventive or palliative capacity that relies on invasive (surgical), non-invasive, or other techniques.

concepts.label: MedicalProcedureType
concepts.description: An enumeration that describes different types of medical procedures.

concepts.label: MedicalRiskCalculator
concepts.description: A complex mathematical calculation requiring an online calculator, used to assess prognosis. Note: use the url property of Thing to record any URLs for online calculators.

concepts.label: MedicalRiskEstimator
concepts.description: Any rule set or interactive tool for estimating the risk of developing a complication or condition.

concepts.label: MedicalRiskFactor
concepts.description: A risk factor is anything that increases a person's likelihood of developing or contracting a disease, medical condition, or complication.

concepts.label: MedicalRiskScore
concepts.description: A simple system that adds up the number of risk factors to yield a score that is associated with prognosis, e.g. CHAD score, TIMI risk score.

concepts.label: MedicalScholarlyArticle
concepts.description: A scholarly article in the medical domain.

concepts.label: MedicalSign
concepts.description: Any physical manifestation of a person's medical condition discoverable by objective diagnostic tests or physical examination.

concepts.label: MedicalSignOrSymptom
concepts.description: Any feature associated or not with a medical condition. In medicine a symptom is generally subjective while a sign is objective.

concepts.label: MedicalSpecialty
concepts.description: Any specific branch of medical science or practice. Medical specialities include clinical specialties that pertain to particular organ systems and their respective disease states, as well as allied health specialties. Enumerated type.

concepts.label: MedicalStudy
concepts.description: A medical study is an umbrella type covering all kinds of research studies relating to human medicine or health, including observational studies and interventional trials and registries, randomized, controlled or not. When the specific type of study is known, use one of the extensions of this typ...

concepts.label: MedicalStudyStatus
concepts.description: The status of a medical study. Enumerated type.

concepts.label: MedicalSymptom
concepts.description: Any complaint sensed and expressed by the patient (therefore defined as subjective)  like stomachache, lower-back pain, or fatigue.

concepts.label: MedicalTest
concepts.description: Any medical test, typically performed for diagnostic purposes.

concepts.label: MedicalTestPanel
concepts.description: Any collection of tests commonly ordered together.

concepts.label: MedicalTherapy
concepts.description: Any medical intervention designed to prevent, treat, and cure human diseases and medical conditions, including both curative and palliative therapies. Medical therapies are typically processes of care relying upon pharmacotherapy, behavioral therapy, supportive therapy (with fluid or nutrition fo...

concepts.label: MedicalTrial
concepts.description: A medical trial is a type of medical study that uses a scientific process to compare the safety and efficacy of medical therapies or medical procedures. In general, medical trials are controlled and subjects are allocated at random to the different treatment and/or control groups.

concepts.label: MedicalTrialDesign
concepts.description: Design models for medical trials. Enumerated type.

concepts.label: MedicalWebPage
concepts.description: A web page that provides medical information.

concepts.label: MeetingRoom
concepts.description: A meeting room, conference room, or conference hall is a room provided for singular events such as business conferences and meetings (source: Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia, see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conference_hall).

concepts.label: MemberProgram
concepts.description: A MemberProgram defines a loyalty (or membership) program that provides its members with certain benefits, for example better pricing, free shipping or returns, or the ability to earn loyalty points. Member programs may have multiple tiers, for example silver and gold members, each with different...

concepts.label: MemberProgramTier
concepts.description: A MemberProgramTier specifies a tier under a loyalty (member) program, for example "gold".

concepts.label: Menu
concepts.description: A structured representation of food or drink items available from a FoodEstablishment.

concepts.label: MenuItem
concepts.description: A food or drink item listed in a menu or menu section.

concepts.label: MenuSection
concepts.description: A sub-grouping of food or drink items in a menu. E.g. courses (such as 'Dinner', 'Breakfast', etc.), specific type of dishes (such as 'Meat', 'Vegan', 'Drinks', etc.), or some other classification made by the menu provider.

concepts.label: MerchantReturnEnumeration
concepts.description: Enumerates several kinds of product return policies.

concepts.label: MerchantReturnPolicy
concepts.description: A MerchantReturnPolicy provides information about product return policies associated with an [[Organization]], [[Product]], or [[Offer]].

concepts.label: MerchantReturnPolicySeasonalOverride
concepts.description: A seasonal override of a return policy, for example used for holidays.

concepts.label: Message
concepts.description: A single message from a sender to one or more organizations or people.

concepts.label: MiddleSchool
concepts.description: A middle school (typically for children aged around 11-14, although this varies somewhat).

concepts.label: MobileApplication
concepts.description: A software application designed specifically to work well on a mobile device such as a telephone.

concepts.label: MobilePhoneStore
concepts.description: A store that sells mobile phones and related accessories.

concepts.label: MolecularEntity
concepts.description: Any constitutionally or isotopically distinct atom, molecule, ion, ion pair, radical, radical ion, complex, conformer etc., identifiable as a separately distinguishable entity.

concepts.label: MonetaryAmount
concepts.description: A monetary value or range. This type can be used to describe an amount of money such as $50 USD, or a range as in describing a bank account being suitable for a balance between £1,000 and £1,000,000 GBP, or the value of a salary, etc. It is recommended to use [[PriceSpecification]] Types to des...

concepts.label: MonetaryAmountDistribution
concepts.description: A statistical distribution of monetary amounts.

concepts.label: MoneyTransfer
concepts.description: The act of transferring money from one place to another place. This may occur electronically or physically.

concepts.label: MortgageLoan
concepts.description: A loan in which property or real estate is used as collateral. (A loan securitized against some real estate.)

concepts.label: Motel
concepts.description:
A motel.

See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations.

concepts.label: Motorcycle
concepts.description: A motorcycle or motorbike is a single-track, two-wheeled motor vehicle.

concepts.label: MotorizedBicycle
concepts.description: A motorized bicycle is a bicycle with an attached motor used to power the vehicle, or to assist with pedaling.

concepts.label: Mountain
concepts.description: A mountain, like Mount Whitney or Mount Everest.

concepts.label: MoveAction
concepts.description:
The act of an agent relocating to a place.

Related actions:

* [[TransferAction]]: Unlike TransferAction, the subject of the move is a living Person or Organization rather than an inanimate object.

concepts.label: MovieClip
concepts.description: A short segment/part of a movie.

concepts.label: MovieSeries
concepts.description: A series of movies. Included movies can be indicated with the hasPart property.

concepts.label: Muscle
concepts.description: A muscle is an anatomical structure consisting of a contractile form of tissue that animals use to effect movement.

concepts.label: MusicAlbumProductionType
concepts.description: Classification of the album by its type of content: soundtrack, live album, studio album, etc.

concepts.label: MusicAlbumReleaseType
concepts.description: The kind of release which this album is: single, EP or album.

concepts.label: MusicGroup
concepts.description: A musical group, such as a band, an orchestra, or a choir. Can also be a solo musician.

concepts.label: MusicPlaylist
concepts.description: A collection of music tracks in playlist form.

concepts.label: MusicRecording
concepts.description: A music recording (track), usually a single song.

concepts.label: MusicRelease
concepts.description: A MusicRelease is a specific release of a music album.

concepts.label: MusicReleaseFormatType
concepts.description: Format of this release (the type of recording media used, i.e. compact disc, digital media, LP, etc.).

concepts.label: NLNonprofitType
concepts.description: NLNonprofitType: Non-profit organization type originating from the Netherlands.

concepts.label: Nerve
concepts.description: A common pathway for the electrochemical nerve impulses that are transmitted along each of the axons.

concepts.label: NewsArticle
concepts.description: A NewsArticle is an article whose content reports news, or provides background context and supporting materials for understanding the news. A more detailed overview of [schema.org News markup](/docs/news.html) is also available.

concepts.label: NewsMediaOrganization
concepts.description: A News/Media organization such as a newspaper or TV station.

concepts.label: Newspaper
concepts.description: A publication containing information about varied topics that are pertinent to general information, a geographic area, or a specific subject matter (i.e. business, culture, education). Often published daily.

concepts.label: NonprofitType
concepts.description: NonprofitType enumerates several kinds of official non-profit types of which a non-profit organization can be.

concepts.label: NoteDigitalDocument
concepts.description: A file containing a note, primarily for the author.

concepts.label: Number
concepts.description:
Data type: Number.

Usage guidelines:

* Use values from 0123456789 (Unicode 'DIGIT ZERO' (U+0030) to 'DIGIT NINE' (U+0039)) rather than superficially similar Unicode symbols.
* Use '.' (Unicode 'FULL STOP' (U+002E)) rather than ',' to indicate a decimal point. Avoid using these symbols as a...

concepts.label: Observation
concepts.description: Instances of the class [[Observation]] are used to specify observations about an entity at a particular time. The principal properties of an [[Observation]] are [[observationAbout]], [[measuredProperty]], [[statType]], [[value] and [[observationDate]]  and [[measuredProperty]]. Some but not all O...

concepts.label: Occupation
concepts.description: A profession, may involve prolonged training and/or a formal qualification.

concepts.label: OccupationalTherapy
concepts.description: A treatment of people with physical, emotional, or social problems, using purposeful activity to help them overcome or learn to deal with their problems.

concepts.label: Offer
concepts.description: An offer to transfer some rights to an item or to provide a service — for example, an offer to sell tickets to an event, to rent the DVD of a movie, to stream a TV show over the internet, to repair a motorcycle, or to loan a book.\n\nNote: As the [[businessFunction]] property, which identifies ...

concepts.label: OfferCatalog
concepts.description: An OfferCatalog is an ItemList that contains related Offers and/or further OfferCatalogs that are offeredBy the same provider.

concepts.label: OfferForLease
concepts.description: An [[OfferForLease]] in Schema.org represents an [[Offer]] to lease out something, i.e. an [[Offer]] whose [[businessFunction]] is [lease out](http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#LeaseOut.). See [Good Relations](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GoodRelations) for background on the underlying concepts.

concepts.label: OfferForPurchase
concepts.description: An [[OfferForPurchase]] in Schema.org represents an [[Offer]] to sell something, i.e. an [[Offer]] whose [[businessFunction]] is [sell](http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#Sell.). See [Good Relations](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GoodRelations) for background on the underlying concepts.

concepts.label: OfferItemCondition
concepts.description: A list of possible conditions for the item.

concepts.label: OfferShippingDetails
concepts.description: OfferShippingDetails represents information about shipping destinations. Multiple of these entities can be used to represent different shipping rates for different destinations: One entity for Alaska/Hawaii. A different one for continental US. A different one for all France. Multiple of these ent...

concepts.label: OnDemandEvent

concepts.description: An [[OpinionNewsArticle]] is a [[NewsArticle]] that primarily expresses opinions rather than journalistic reporting of news and events. For example, a [[NewsArticle]] consisting of a column or [[Blog]]/[[BlogPosting]] entry in the Opinions section of a news publication.

concepts.label: Optician

concepts.label: OrganizationRole

concepts.label: OrganizeAction

concepts.label: OwnershipInfo
concepts.description: A structured value providing information about when a certain organization or person owned a certain product.

concepts.label: PaintAction

concepts.label: PalliativeProcedure

concepts.label: ParcelDelivery

concepts.label: ParentAudience

concepts.label: ParkingFacility
concepts.description: A parking lot or other parking facility.

concepts.label: PathologyTest
concepts.description: A medical test performed by a laboratory that typically involves examination of a tissue sample by a pathologist.

concepts.label: Patient
concepts.description: A patient is any person recipient of health care services.

concepts.label: PawnShop

concepts.label: PaymentService
concepts.description: A Service to transfer funds from a person or organization to a beneficiary person or organization.

concepts.label: PaymentStatusType
concepts.description: A specific payment status. For example, PaymentDue, PaymentComplete, etc.

concepts.label: PeopleAudience
concepts.description: A set of characteristics belonging to people, e.g. who compose an item's target audience.

concepts.label: PerformAction

concepts.label: PerformingGroup

concepts.label: Permit
concepts.description: A permit issued by an organization, e.g. a parking pass.

concepts.label: PhotographAction
concepts.description: The act of capturing still images of objects using a camera.

concepts.label: Physician

concepts.label: PlaceOfWorship
concepts.description: Place of worship, such as a church, synagogue, or mosque.

concepts.label: PlanAction
concepts.description: The act of planning the execution of an event/task/action/reservation/plan to a future date.

concepts.label: Play
concepts.description: A play is a form of literature, usually consisting of dialogue between characters, intended for theatrical performance rather than just reading. Note: A performance of a Play would be a [[TheaterEvent]] or [[BroadcastEvent]] - the *Play* being the [[workPerformed]].

concepts.label: PodcastEpisode
concepts.description: A single episode of a podcast series.

concepts.label: PodcastSeries
concepts.description: A podcast is an episodic series of digital audio or video files which a user can download and listen to.

concepts.description: Indicates a range of postal codes, usually defined as the set of valid codes between [[postalCodeBegin]] and [[postalCodeEnd]], inclusively.

concepts.label: modified amino acid metabolic process
concepts.description: The chemical reactions and pathways involving compounds derived from amino acids, organic acids containing one or more amino substituents.
synonyms: cellular amino acid derivative metabolic process
cellular modified amino acid metabolic process

concepts.label: lipid metabolic process
concepts.description: The chemical reactions and pathways involving lipids, compounds soluble in an organic solvent but not, or sparingly, in an aqueous solvent. Includes fatty acids; neutral fats, other fatty-acid esters, and soaps; long-chain (fatty) alcohols and waxes; sphingoids and other long-chain bases; glycoli...

concepts.label: vitamin metabolic process
concepts.description: The chemical reactions and pathways involving vitamins. Vitamin is a general term for a number of unrelated organic substances that occur in many foods in small amounts and that are necessary in trace amounts for the normal metabolic functioning of the body. Vitamins may be water-soluble or fat-s...

concepts.label: sulfur compound metabolic process
concepts.description: The chemical reactions and pathways involving the nonmetallic element sulfur or compounds that contain sulfur, such as the amino acids methionine and cysteine or the tripeptide glutathione.

concepts.label: intracellular protein transport
concepts.description: The directed movement of proteins in a cell, including the movement of proteins between specific compartments or structures within a cell, such as organelles of a eukaryotic cell.

concepts.label: nucleocytoplasmic transport
concepts.description: The directed movement of molecules between the nucleus and the cytoplasm.

concepts.label: autophagy
concepts.description: The cellular catabolic process in which cells digest cellular materials, such as organelles and other macromolecular constituents, or non-self materials such as intracellular pathogens. Autophagy serves to provide essential nutrients under conditions of cellular stress; or can remodel intracellul...

concepts.label: inflammatory response
concepts.description: The immediate defensive reaction (by vertebrate tissue) to infection or injury caused by chemical or physical agents. The process is characterized by local vasodilation, extravasation of plasma into intercellular spaces and accumulation of white blood cells and macrophages.

concepts.label: mitochondrion organization
concepts.description: A process that is carried out at the cellular level which results in the assembly, arrangement of constituent parts, or disassembly of a mitochondrion; includes mitochondrial morphogenesis and distribution, and replication of the mitochondrial genome as well as synthesis of new mitochondrial comp...

concepts.label: cytoskeleton organization
concepts.description: A process that is carried out at the cellular level which results in the assembly, arrangement of constituent parts, or disassembly of cytoskeletal structures.

concepts.label: microtubule-based movement
concepts.description: A microtubule-based process that results in the movement of organelles, other microtubules, or other cellular components. Examples include motor-driven movement along microtubules and movement driven by polymerization or depolymerization of microtubules.

concepts.label: peroxisome organization
concepts.description: A process that is carried out at the cellular level which results in the assembly, arrangement of constituent parts, or disassembly of a peroxisome. A peroxisome is a small, membrane-bounded organelle that uses dioxygen (O2) to oxidize organic molecules.

concepts.label: lysosome organization
concepts.description: A process that is carried out at the cellular level which results in the assembly, arrangement of constituent parts, or disassembly of a lysosome. A lysosome is a cytoplasmic, membrane-bounded organelle that is found in most animal cells and that contains a variety of hydrolases.

concepts.label: chromosome segregation
concepts.description: The process in which genetic material, in the form of chromosomes, is organized into specific structures and then physically separated and apportioned to two or more sets. In eukaryotes, chromosome segregation begins with the condensation of chromosomes, includes chromosome separation, and ends w...

concepts.label: cell adhesion
concepts.description: The attachment of a cell, either to another cell or to an underlying substrate such as the extracellular matrix, via cell adhesion molecules.

concepts.label: establishment or maintenance of cell polarity
concepts.description: Any cellular process that results in the specification, formation or maintenance of anisotropic intracellular organization or cell growth patterns.
synonyms: establishment and/or maintenance of cell polarity
establishment and/or maintenance of cell polarization

concepts.label: cytoskeletal protein binding
concepts.description: Binding to a protein component of a cytoskeleton (actin, microtubule, or intermediate filament cytoskeleton).

concepts.label: glycoprotein biosynthetic process
concepts.description: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of glycoproteins, a protein that contains covalently bound glycose (i.e. monosaccharide) residues; the glycose occurs most commonly as oligosaccharide or fairly small polysaccharide but occasionally as monosaccharide.

concepts.label: plastid
concepts.description: Any member of a family of organelles found in the cytoplasm of plants and some protists, which are membrane-bounded and contain DNA. Plant plastids develop from a common type, the proplastid.

concepts.label: thylakoid
concepts.description: A membranous cellular structure that bears the photosynthetic pigments in plants, algae, and cyanobacteria. In cyanobacteria thylakoids are of various shapes and are attached to, or continuous with, the plasma membrane. In eukaryotes they are flattened, membrane-bounded disk-like structures locat...

concepts.label: cyclase activity
concepts.description: Catalysis of a ring closure reaction.

concepts.label: programmed cell death
concepts.description: A process which begins when a cell receives an internal or external signal and activates a series of biochemical events (signaling pathway). The process ends with the death of the cell.

concepts.label: photosynthesis
concepts.description: The synthesis by organisms of organic chemical compounds, especially carbohydrates, from carbon dioxide (CO2) using energy obtained from light rather than from the oxidation of chemical compounds.

concepts.label: mRNA metabolic process
concepts.description: The chemical reactions and pathways involving mRNA, messenger RNA, which is responsible for carrying the coded genetic 'message', transcribed from DNA, to sites of protein assembly at the ribosomes.

concepts.label: snRNA metabolic process
concepts.description: The chemical reactions and pathways involving snRNA, small nuclear RNA, any of various low-molecular-mass RNA molecules found in the eukaryotic nucleus as components of the small nuclear ribonucleoprotein.

concepts.label: vesicle-mediated transport
concepts.description: A cellular transport process in which transported substances are moved in membrane-bounded vesicles; transported substances are enclosed in the vesicle lumen or located in the vesicle membrane. The process begins with a step that directs a substance to the forming vesicle, and includes vesicle bu...

concepts.label: antioxidant activity
concepts.description: Inhibition of the reactions brought about by dioxygen (O2) or peroxides. Usually the antioxidant is effective because it can itself be more easily oxidized than the substance protected. The term is often applied to components that can trap free radicals, thereby breaking the chain reaction that n...

concepts.label: oxidoreductase activity
concepts.description: Catalysis of an oxidation-reduction (redox) reaction, a reversible chemical reaction in which the oxidation state of an atom or atoms within a molecule is altered. One substrate acts as a hydrogen or electron donor and becomes oxidized, while the other acts as hydrogen or electron acceptor and be...

concepts.label: transferase activity
concepts.description: Catalysis of the transfer of a group, e.g. a methyl group, glycosyl group, acyl group, phosphorus-containing, or other groups, from one compound (generally regarded as the donor) to another compound (generally regarded as the acceptor). Transferase is the systematic name for any enzyme of EC clas...

concepts.label: hydrolase activity
concepts.description: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of various bonds, e.g. C-O, C-N, C-C, phosphoric anhydride bonds, etc.

concepts.label: lyase activity
concepts.description: Catalysis of the cleavage of C-C, C-O, C-N and other bonds by other means than by hydrolysis or oxidation, or conversely adding a group to a double bond. They differ from other enzymes in that two substrates are involved in one reaction direction, but only one in the other direction. When acting ...

concepts.label: isomerase activity
concepts.description: Catalysis of the geometric or structural changes within one molecule. Isomerase is the systematic name for any enzyme of EC class 5.

concepts.label: ligase activity
concepts.description: Catalysis of the joining of two molecules, or two groups within a single molecule, using the energy from the hydrolysis of ATP, a similar triphosphate, or a pH gradient.

concepts.label: reproductive process
concepts.description: A biological process that directly contributes to the process of producing new individuals by one or two organisms. The new individuals inherit some proportion of their genetic material from the parent or parents.

concepts.label: digestive system process
concepts.description: A physical, chemical, or biochemical process carried out by living organisms to break down ingested nutrients into components that may be easily absorbed and directed into metabolism.

concepts.label: signaling
concepts.description: The entirety of a process in which information is transmitted within a biological system. This process begins with an active signal and ends when a cellular response has been triggered.

concepts.label: cell differentiation
concepts.description: The cellular developmental process in which a relatively unspecialized cell, e.g. embryonic or regenerative cell, acquires specialized structural and/or functional features that characterize a specific cell. Differentiation includes the processes involved in commitment of a cell to a specific fat...

concepts.label: protein catabolic process
concepts.description: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the breakdown of a protein by the destruction of the native, active configuration, with or without the hydrolysis of peptide bonds.

concepts.label: extracellular matrix organization
concepts.description: A process that is carried out at the cellular level which results in the assembly, arrangement of constituent parts, or disassembly of an extracellular matrix.

concepts.label: external encapsulating structure
concepts.description: A structure that lies outside the plasma membrane and surrounds the entire cell or cells. This does not include the periplasmic space.

concepts.label: extracellular matrix
concepts.description: A structure lying external to one or more cells, which provides structural support, biochemical or biomechanical cues for cells or tissues.

concepts.label: regulatory ncRNA-mediated gene silencing
concepts.description: A process in which an regulatory non-coding RNA molecule reduces expression of target genes. concepts.label: protein tag activity
concepts.description: A molecular function exhibited by a protein that is covalently attached (AKA tagged or conjugated) to another protein where it acts as a marker, recognized by the cellular apparatus to target the tagged protein for some cellular process such as modification, sequestration, transport or degradation.

concepts.label: cytoplasmic vesicle
concepts.description: A vesicle found in the cytoplasm of a cell.

concepts.label: telomere organization
concepts.description: A process that is carried out at the cellular level which results in the assembly, arrangement of constituent parts, or disassembly of telomeres, terminal regions of a linear chromosome that include the telomeric DNA repeats and associated proteins.

concepts.label: cell junction organization
concepts.description: A process that is carried out at the cellular level which results in the assembly, arrangement of constituent parts, or disassembly of a cell junction. A cell junction is a specialized region of connection between two cells or between a cell and the extracellular matrix.

concepts.label: cargo receptor activity
concepts.description: Binding specifically to a substance (cargo) to deliver it to a transport vesicle. concepts.label: wound healing
concepts.description: The series of events that restore integrity to a damaged tissue, following an injury.

concepts.label: ribosome biogenesis
concepts.description: A cellular process that results in the biosynthesis of constituent macromolecules, assembly, and arrangement of constituent parts of ribosome subunits; includes transport to the sites of protein synthesis.

concepts.label: histone binding
concepts.description: Binding to a histone, any of a group of water-soluble proteins found in association with the DNA of eukaryotic or archaeal chromosomes. concepts.label: organelle
concepts.description: Organized structure of distinctive morphology and function. Includes the nucleus, mitochondria, plastids, vacuoles, vesicles, ribosomes and the cytoskeleton, and prokaryotic structures such as anammoxosomes and pirellulosomes. Excludes the plasma membrane.

concepts.label: protein folding chaperone
concepts.description: Binding to a protein or a protein-containing complex to assist the protein folding process.
synonyms: protein binding involved in protein folding

concepts.label: cilium organization
concepts.description: A process that is carried out at the cellular level which results in the assembly, arrangement of constituent parts, or disassembly of a cilium, a specialized eukaryotic organelle that consists of a filiform extrusion of the cell surface. concepts.label: translation regulator activity
concepts.description: Any molecular function involved in the regulation of initiation, activation, perpetuation, repression or termination of polypeptide synthesis at the ribosome.

concepts.label: nutrient reservoir activity
concepts.description: Functions in the storage of nutritious substrates.

concepts.label: receptor ligand activity
concepts.description: The activity of a gene product that interacts with a receptor to effect a change in the activity of the receptor. Ligands may be produced by the same cell that expresses the receptor. Ligands may also be expressed at the plasma membrane of an adjacent cell (e.g. Notch ligands) or be secreted and ...

concepts.label: anatomical structure development
concepts.description: The biological process whose specific outcome is the progression of an anatomical structure from an initial condition to its mature state. This process begins with the formation of the structure and ends with the mature structure, whatever form that may be including its natural destruction. An an...

concepts.label: cell motility
concepts.description: Any process involved in the controlled self-propelled movement of a cell that results in translocation of the cell from one place to another.

concepts.label: nervous system process
concepts.description: An organ system process carried out by any of the organs or tissues of the neurological system.

concepts.label: endocrine process
concepts.description: The process that involves the secretion of or response to endocrine hormones. An endocrine hormone is a hormone released into the circulatory system.

concepts.label: protein maturation
concepts.description: Any process leading to the attainment of the full functional capacity of a protein.

concepts.label: transmembrane transport
concepts.description: The process in which a solute is transported across a lipid bilayer, from one side of a membrane to the other.

concepts.label: nucleobase-containing small molecule metabolic process
concepts.description: The cellular chemical reactions and pathways involving a nucleobase-containing small molecule: a nucleobase, a nucleoside, or a nucleotide.
synonyms: nucleobase, nucleoside and nucleotide metabolic process

concepts.label: molecular transducer activity
concepts.description: A compound molecular function in which an effector function is controlled by one or more regulatory components.

concepts.label: molecular adaptor activity
concepts.description: The binding activity of a molecule that brings together two or more molecules through a selective, non-covalent, often stoichiometric interaction, permitting those molecules to function in a coordinated way.

concepts.label: hepaticobiliary system process
concepts.description: A system process carried out by any of the organs or tissues of the hepaticobiliary system. concepts.label: membrane organization
concepts.description: A process which results in the assembly, arrangement of constituent parts, or disassembly of a membrane. A membrane is a double layer of lipid molecules that encloses all cells, and, in eukaryotes, many organelles; may be a single or double lipid bilayer; also includes associated proteins.

concepts.label: protein-containing complex assembly
concepts.description: The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of macromolecules to form a protein-containing complex.

concepts.label: cell wall organization or biogenesis
concepts.description: A process that results in the biosynthesis of constituent macromolecules, assembly, arrangement of constituent parts, or disassembly of a cell wall.
synonyms: cell wall organization or biogenesis at cellular level
cellular cell wall organisation or biogenesis
cellular cell wall organization or biogenesis

concepts.label: nitrogen cycle metabolic process
concepts.description: A nitrogen compound metabolic process that contributes to the nitrogen cycle. concepts.label: protein localization to plasma membrane
concepts.description: A process in which a protein is transported to, or maintained in, a specific location in the plasma membrane.

concepts.label: toxin activity
concepts.description: Interacting selectively with one or more biological molecules in another (target) organism, initiating pathogenesis (leading to an abnormal, generally detrimental state) in the target organism. The activity should refer to an evolved function of the active gene product, i.e. one that was selected...

concepts.label: defense response to other organism
concepts.description: Reactions triggered in response to the presence of another organism that act to protect the cell or organism from damage caused by that organism.

concepts.label: cell adhesion mediator activity
concepts.description: The binding by a cell-adhesion protein on a cell surface to an adhesion molecule on another cell surface or an external substrate, to mediate adhesion of the cell to the external substrate or to another cell.
synonyms: protein binding involved in cell adhesion

concepts.label: detoxification
concepts.description: Any process that reduces or removes the toxicity of a toxic substance. These may include transport of the toxic substance away from sensitive areas and to compartments or complexes whose purpose is sequestration of the toxic substance.

concepts.label: molecular function regulator activity
concepts.description: A molecular function regulator regulates the activity of its target via non-covalent binding that does not result in covalent modification to the target. Examples of molecular function regulators include regulatory subunits of multimeric enzymes and channels. Mechanisms of regulation include allo...

concepts.label: virus coreceptor activity
concepts.description: Combining with a virus component, and in cooperation with a nearby primary receptor, initiating a change in cell activity.

concepts.label: meiotic nuclear division
concepts.description: One of the two nuclear divisions that occur as part of the meiotic cell cycle.

concepts.label: mitotic nuclear division
concepts.description: A mitotic cell cycle process comprising the steps by which the nucleus of a eukaryotic cell divides; the process involves condensation of chromosomal DNA into a highly compacted form. Canonically, mitosis produces two daughter nuclei whose chromosome complement is identical to that of the mother ...

concepts.description: The process of transcribing and translating the mitochondrial genome (mtDNA) to produce at least a subset of oxidative phosphorylation (OXPHOS) proteins, 2 rRNAs, and mitochondrial tRNAs, which are critical for ATP production. Protein maturation is included when required to form an active form of...

concepts.label: catalytic activity, acting on a protein
concepts.description: Catalytic activity that acts to modify a protein.

concepts.label: catalytic activity, acting on DNA
concepts.description: Catalytic activity that acts to modify DNA.

concepts.label: catalytic activity, acting on RNA
concepts.description: Catalytic activity that acts to modify RNA.

concepts.label: molecular carrier activity
concepts.description: Directly binding to a specific ion or molecule and delivering it either to an acceptor molecule or to a specific location.

concepts.label: transcription regulator activity
concepts.description: A molecular function that controls the rate, timing and/or magnitude of gene transcription. The function of transcriptional regulators is to modulate gene expression at the transcription step so that they are expressed in the right cell at the right time and in the right amount throughout the lif...

concepts.label: general transcription initiation factor activity
concepts.description: A molecular function required for core promoter activity that mediates the assembly of the RNA polymerase holoenzyme at promoter DNA to form the pre-initiation complex (PIC). General transcription factors (GTFs) bind to and open promoter DNA, initiate RNA synthesis and stimulate the escape of the...

concepts.label: molecular sensor activity
concepts.description: Binding to a molecule and eliciting a change in the protein's activity in response to the intracellular level of that molecule.

concepts.label: molecular sequestering activity
concepts.description: Binding to a specific molecule to prevent it from interacting with other partners or to inhibit its localization to the area of the cell or complex where it is active.

concepts.label: ATP-dependent activity
concepts.description: A molecular function characterized by the coupling of ATP hydrolysis to other steps of a reaction mechanism to make the reaction energetically favorable, for example to catalyze a reaction or drive transport against a concentration gradient.

concepts.label: carbohydrate derivative metabolic process
concepts.description: The chemical reactions and pathways involving carbohydrate derivative.

concepts.label: angiosarcoma
concepts.description: A vascular cancer that derives_from the cells that line the walls of blood vessels or lymphatic vessels.

concepts.label: juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia
concepts.description: A myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm that is characterized by the uncontrolled growth of monocytes.

concepts.label: adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma
concepts.description: A T-cell acute leukemia that results_in abnormal increase of lymphocytes, derives_from T-cells, has_material_basis_in human T-cell leukemia virus type 1 (Deltaretrovirus priTlym1), which is transmitted_by sexual contact, transmitted_by contaminated needles used by intravenous-drug users, and tran...

concepts.label: gastrointestinal neuroendocrine tumor
concepts.description: A gastrointestinal system cancer that has_material_basis_in neuroendocrine cells.

concepts.label: mature T-cell and NK-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A T-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma that has_material_basis_in mature T lymphocytes and natural killer cells.
synonyms: mature T-cell and natural killer cell lymphoma

concepts.label: anaplastic large cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A non-Hodgkin lymphoma involving aberrant T-cells.

concepts.label: diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A large B-cell lymphoma that is consisting of medium-sized to large B cells with a diffuse growth pattern.

concepts.label: mantle cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A B-cell lymphocytic neoplasm due to CD5 positive antigen-naive pregerminal center B-cell within the mantle zone that surrounds normal germinal center follicles.

concepts.label: marginal zone lymphoma
concepts.description: A B-cell lymphoma arising from the marginal zone of lymphoid tissues that is characterized by the presence of small to medium sized atypical lymphocytes.

concepts.label: peripheral T-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A mature T-cell and NK-cell lymphoma includes a group of T-cell lymphomas that develop away from the thymus.

concepts.label: T-cell large granular lymphocyte leukemia
concepts.description: A T-cell acute lymphocytic leukemia that exhibits an unexplained, chronic (greater than 6 months) elevation in large granular lymphocytes (LGLs) in the peripheral blood.

concepts.label: pheochromocytoma
concepts.description: An endocrine organ benign neoplasm that arises within the adrenal medulla, releasing epinephrines and norepinephrines hormones that cause either episodic or persistent high blood pressure.

concepts.label: paraganglioma
concepts.description: A pheochromocytoma that arises in extraadrenal sympathetic ganglia.

concepts.label: juvenile polyposis syndrome
concepts.description: A gastrointestinal system disease that is characterized by predisposition to hamartomatous benign polyps in the gastrointestinal tract, specifically in the stomach, small intestine, colon, and rectum.

concepts.label: glioblastoma proneural subtype
concepts.description: A glioblastoma that is characterized by IDH1 and p53 mutations and Platelet Derived Growth Factor A amplification.

concepts.label: colorectal adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A colorectal carcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

concepts.label: oral squamous cell carcinoma
concepts.description: An oral cavity cancer that has_material_basis_in squamous cells.

concepts.label: fibroma
concepts.description: A connective tissue benign neoplasm composed of fibrous or connective tissues that derives_from mesenchymal tissue.

concepts.label: follicular lymphoma
concepts.description: A B-cell lymphoma that is characterized as an indolent non-Hodgkin's lymphoma and has_material_basis_in follicle center B-cells (centrocytes and centroblasts).

concepts.label: adrenal gland pheochromocytoma
concepts.description: A malignant pheochromocytoma that is characterized by overproduction of adrenaline.

concepts.label: ameloblastoma
concepts.description: A cell type benign neoplasm that has_material_basis_in odontogenic epithelium.

concepts.label: bone squamous cell carcinoma
concepts.description: A bone carcinoma that derives_from squamous epithelial cells.

concepts.label: bone chondrosarcoma
concepts.description: A chondrosarcoma that is located_in bone.

concepts.label: brain stem medulloblastoma
concepts.description: A brain stem cancer that begins in the lower part of the brain on the floor of the skull.

concepts.label: sacrum chordoma
concepts.description: A spinal chordoma that is located_in the sacrum.

concepts.label: corpus callosum oligodendroglioma
concepts.description: A brain oligodendroglioma located_in the corpus callosum.

concepts.label: medulloblastoma
concepts.description: An infratentorial cancer that is located_in the lower part of the brain and is a type of primitive neuroectodermal tumor.

concepts.label: parietal lobe ependymoma
concepts.description: A parietal lobe neoplasm that has_material_basis_in cells lining the ventricles of the brain.

concepts.label: salivary gland carcinoma
concepts.description: A salivary gland cancer that has_material_basis_in epithelial cells.

concepts.label: inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor
concepts.description: A mesenchymal cell neoplasm that has_material_basis_in myofibroblastic cells admixed with inflammatory cells.

concepts.label: mixed extragonadal germ cell cancer
concepts.description: A mixed germ cell cancer that is located_in areas of the body other than the ovary or testicle.

concepts.label: myelodysplastic syndrome
concepts.description: A bone marrow cancer that is characterized by under production of white blood cells, red blood cells and platelets.

concepts.label: extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue
concepts.description: A marginal zone B-cell lymphoma that has_material_basis_in mucosal tissue involved in antibody production.

concepts.label: appendix carcinoid tumor
concepts.description: An appendix cancer that has_material_basis_in neurodendocrine cells.

concepts.label: large intestine adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A large intestine cancer that has_material_basis_in epithelial cells of glandular origin.

concepts.label: bronchus mucoepidermoid carcinoma
concepts.description: A mucoepidermoid carcinoma located_in the bronchus.

concepts.label: lung combined type small cell adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A lung combined type small cell carcinoma that has_material_basis_in epithelial tissue of glandular origin.

concepts.label: vaginal carcinoma
concepts.description: A vaginal cancer that has_material_basis_in epithelial cells.

concepts.label: trachea mucoepidermoid carcinoma
concepts.description: A mucoepidermoid carcinoma located_in the trachea.

concepts.label: tonsil squamous cell carcinoma
concepts.description: A tonsil cancer that has_material_basis_in squamous cells.

concepts.label: pharynx squamous cell carcinoma
concepts.description: A pharynx cancer that has_material_basis_in squamous cells.

concepts.label: gastrointestinal carcinoma
concepts.description: A gastrointestinal system cancer that has_material_basis_in epithelial cells.

concepts.label: spindle epithelial tumor with thymus-like differentiation tumor
concepts.description: A thyroid gland carcinoma that has_material_basis_in compact bundles of long spindle epithelial cells that merge with tubulopapillary structures and/or mucinous glands.
synonyms: spindle epithelial tumour with thymus-like differentiation tumour

concepts.label: striated muscle rhabdoid tumor
concepts.description: A muscle cancer that is located_in striated muscle and has_material_basis_in rhabdoid cells which are large cells with eccentrically located nuclei and abundant, eosinophilic cytoplasm.

concepts.label: small intestine carcinoid neuroendocrine tumor
concepts.description: A neuroendocrine tumor that has_material_basis_in cells of the neuroendocrine system and that is located in the small intestine.

concepts.label: jejunal adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A jejunal cancer that is located_in the jejunum and has_material_basis_in epithelial tissue that has glandular origin.

concepts.label: ovarian melanoma
concepts.description: An ovarian cancer that has_material_basis_in melanoctyes.

concepts.label: mucosal melanoma
concepts.description: A melanoma that has_material_basis_in melanocytes located_in mucosal membranes lining the respiratory, gastrointestinal and urogenital tract.

concepts.label: sublingual gland adenoid cystic carcinoma
concepts.description: A sublingual gland cancer that is characterized by a distinctive pattern in which abnormal nests or cords of epithelial cells surround and/or infiltrate ducts or glandular structures within the affected organ.

concepts.label: parotid gland adenoid cystic carcinoma
concepts.description: A parotid gland cancer that is characterized by a distinctive pattern in which abnormal nests or cords of epithelial cells surround and/or infiltrate ducts or glandular structures within the affected organ.

concepts.label: lung mucoepidermoid carcinoma
concepts.description: A lung carcinoma that has_material_basis_in a combination of squamous cells, mucus secreting cells and intermediate cells.

concepts.label: ovarian serous carcinoma
concepts.description: An ovarian carcinoma that has_material_basis_in the lining of the ovary and produces a serum-like fluid.

concepts.label: ovarian clear cell carcinoma
concepts.description: An ovarian carcinoma that has_material_basis_in cells with clear cytoplasm and glycogen secreting hob nail cells.

concepts.label: cervical neuroblastoma
concepts.description: An extracranial neuroblastoma that has_material_basis_in immature nerve cells.

concepts.label: extra-adrenal pheochromocytoma
concepts.description: A malignant pheochromocytoma that originate in the ganglia of the sympathetic nervous system and are named based upon the primary anatomical site of origin.

concepts.label: retroperitoneal neuroblastoma
concepts.description: A retroperitoneal cancer that has_material_basis_in immature nerve cells.

concepts.label: breast lobular carcinoma
concepts.description: A breast carcinoma that derives_from breast lobules (milk glands).

concepts.label: uterine corpus endometrial carcinoma
concepts.description: A uterine corpus cancer that is derives_from the inner lining of the uterus.

concepts.label: endocervical adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An endocervical carcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

concepts.label: lymphoma
concepts.description: A hematologic cancer that affects lymphocytes that reside in the lymphatic system and in blood-forming organs.

concepts.label: non-Hodgkin lymphoma
concepts.description: A lymphoma that is characterized as any kind of lymphoma except Hodgkin's lymphoma.

concepts.label: estrogen receptor-positive breast cancer
concepts.description: A hormone receptor-positive breast cancer that is characterized by the presence of estrogen receptors.

concepts.label: estrogen receptor-negative breast cancer
concepts.description: A hormone receptor-negative breast cancer that is characterized by the absence of estrogen receptors.

concepts.label: HER2 positive breast cancer
concepts.description: A breast cancer that is characterized by excess HER2 (EBBR2) protein.
synonyms: human epidermal growth factor 2 positive breast cancer
human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 positive breast cancer

concepts.label: HER2 negative breast cancer
concepts.description: A breast cancer that is characterized by the absence of HER2 (EBBR2) protein.
synonyms: human epidermal growth factor 2 negative breast cancer
human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 negative breast cancer

concepts.label: triple-negative breast cancer
concepts.description: A breast cancer that is characterized by the absence of estrogen, progresterone and HER2 (EBBR2) receptors.
synonyms: hormone receptor negative/human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 negative breast cancer
human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 negative/hormone receptor negative breast cancer

concepts.label: immune system cancer
