concepts.label: osteoblastoma
concepts.description: A bone benign neoplasm of the bone that is characterized by clinical and histological similarity to osteoid osteomas.

concepts.label: central nervous system embryonal tumor
concepts.description: A central nervous system cancer of children and young adults that develops from neural crest cells located_in cerebrum, has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells derives_from neuroectoderm.
synonyms: central nervous system primitive neuroectodermal neoplasm

concepts.label: cerebellar medulloblastoma
concepts.description: A cerebellum cancer that begins in the lower part of the brain on the floor of the skull.

concepts.label: brain glioma
concepts.description: A brain cancer that has_material_basis_in glial cells.

concepts.label: lymph node adenoid cystic carcinoma
concepts.description: A lymph node carcinoma that is characterized by a distinctive pattern in which abnormal nests or cords of epithelial cells surround and/or infiltrate ducts or glandular structures of the lymph nodes. These structures are typically filled with a mucous-like material or contain abnormal fibrous mem...

concepts.label: acute promyelocytic leukemia
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia characterized by accumulation of promyelocytes in the bone marrow and by a translocation between chromosomes 15 and 17.

concepts.label: NUT midline carcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that is characterized by a BRD4-NUT translocation involving the rearrangement of the bromodomain-containing protein 4 (BRD4) and the gene encoding nuclear protein of the testis (NUT) at 15q14, BRD4-NUT t(15;19)(q14;q13.1) and arises from midline epithelial structures, most commonly th...
synonyms: nuclear protein in testis midline carcinoma

concepts.label: Kabuki syndrome
concepts.description: A syndrome characterized by multiple congenital anomalies and mental retardation. Other characteristics include a peculiar facial gestalt, short stature, skeletal and visceral abnormalities, cardiac anomalies, and immunological defects.

concepts.label: B-cell adult acute lymphocytic leukemia
concepts.description: An adult acute lymphoblastic leukemia occurring in adults and that has_material_basis_in B lymphocytes.

concepts.label: atypical chronic myeloid leukemia, BCR-ABL1 negative
concepts.description: A myelodysplastic myeloproliferative neoplasm characterized by the principal involvement of the neutrophil series with leukocytosis and multilineage dysplasia. The neoplastic cells do not have a Philadelphia chromosome or the BCR/ABL fusion gene.
synonyms: atypical chronic myeloid leukaemia BCR-ABL1 negative
atypical chronic myeloid leukemia BCR-ABL1 negative

concepts.label: transient myeloproliferative syndrome
concepts.description: A myeloproliferative neoplasm characterized by leukocytosis in newborns with Down syndrome.

concepts.label: lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma
concepts.description: A B-cell lymphoma characterized by the accumulation of monoclonal cells in the bone marrow and peripheral lymphoid tissues, and associated with the production of serum immunoglobulin M (IgM) monoclonal protein.

concepts.label: myeloid neoplasm
concepts.description: A bone marrow cancer that is formed of any one of the bone marrow cells belonging to the granulocytic (neutrophil, eosinophil, basophil), monocytic/macrophage, erythroid, megakaryocytic and mast cell lineages.

concepts.label: childhood hepatocellular carcinoma
concepts.description: A hepatocellular carcinoma that occurs in children and is characterized by a distinct etiological predisposition, biological behavior, and lower frequency of cirrhosis as compared to adult hepatocellular carcinoma.

concepts.label: childhood acute myeloid leukemia
concepts.description: A childhood acute myeloid leukemia that is characterized by the rapid growth of abnormal white blood cells that accumulate in the bone marrow and interfere with the production of normal blood cells.

concepts.label: systemic Epstein-Barr virus positive T-cell lymphoma of childhood
concepts.description: A childhood lymphoma that is characterized by monoclonal expansion of Epstein-Barr virus-positive T cells with an activated cytotoxic phenotype in tissues or peripheral blood.
synonyms: EBV-positive T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of childhood
systemic EBV-positive T-cell lymphoma of childhood

concepts.label: malignant childhood adrenal gland pheochromocytoma
concepts.description: An adrenal gland pheochromocytoma that is characterized by rare chromaffin cell tumors which secrete catecholamines, and has a higher prevalence of hereditary factors and metastatis in children than adults.

concepts.label: spitzoid melanoma
concepts.description: A skin melanoma that is characterized by asymmetric shape, diameter greater than 1 cm, a lesion with a deep invasive component, and a high degree of cytologic atypia.

concepts.label: melanoma in congenital melanocytic nevus
concepts.description: A skin melanoma that arises from a congenital melanocytic nevus.
synonyms: Malignant melanoma in congenital melanocytic nevus

concepts.label: SMARCB1-deficient renal medullary carcinoma
concepts.description: A renal cell carcinoma that develops in the renal medulla.

concepts.label: fibrous dysplasia
concepts.description: A bone remodeling disease that results_in the destruction of normal bone and replacing it with fibrous bone tissue.

concepts.label: childhood acute lymphocytic leukemia
concepts.description: An acute lymphocytic leukemia occurring during childhood.

concepts.label: childhood T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia
concepts.description: A childhood acute lymphoblastic leukemia that has_material_basis_in T-cells.

concepts.label: childhood B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia
concepts.description: A childhood acute lymphoblastic leukemia that has_material_basis_in B-cells.

concepts.label: T-cell childhood lymphoblastic lymphoma
concepts.description: A lymphoblastic lymphoma that has_material_basis_in T-cells and that occurs during childhood.

concepts.label: myeloid and lymphoid neoplasms with eosinophilia and abnormalities of PDGFRA, PDGFRB, and FGFR1
concepts.description: A myeloid neoplasm that is characterized by the formation of abnormal fusion genes that encode constitutively activated tyrosine kinases.
synonyms: Myeloid and Lymphoid Neoplasms with Eosinophilia and Rearrangement of PDGFRA, PDGFRB, or FGFR1, or with PCM1-JAK2

Myeloid and lymphoid neoplasms with eosinophilia and abnormalities of platelet-derived growth factor receptor alpha (PDGFRA), platelet-derived growth factor receptor beta (PDGFRB), and fibroblast growth factor receptor-1 (FGFR1) are a group of hematologic neoplasms

concepts.label: mixed fibrolamellar hepatocellular carcinoma
concepts.description: A fibrolamellar carcinoma that is characterized by the presence of both pure fibrolamellar hepatocellular carcinoma and and conventional hepatocellular carcinoma components.

concepts.label: chronic neutrophilic leukemia
concepts.description: A chronic leukemia characterized by neutrophilic leukocytosis with no detectable Philadelphia chromosome or BCR/ABL fusion gene.

concepts.label: chronic myelomonocytic leukemia
concepts.description: A chronic leukemia characterized by monocytosis, increased monocytes in the bone marrow, variable degrees of dysplasia, but an absence of immature granulocytes in the blood.

concepts.label: malignant epithelioid hemangioendothelioma
concepts.description: A malignant hemangioma characterized by the presence of epithelioid endothelial cells. The neoplastic cells are arranged in cords and nests, which are embedded in a myxoid to hyalinized stroma.

concepts.label: obsolete PTEN hamartoma tumor syndrome
concepts.description: A syndrome comprised of a spectrum of related disorders characterized by the formation of hamartomas, overgrowth, and predisposition to cancer that has_material_basis_in heterozygous germline mutation in the PTEN gene on chromosome 10q23.

concepts.label: relapsed/refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A diffuse large B-cell lymphoma characterized by less than 50 percent decrease in lesion size with induction therapy or the appearance of new lesions or the appearance of new lesions after attainment of complete remission.

concepts.label: primary mediastinal B-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A large B-cell lymphoma that is is characterized by a diffuse proliferation of medium to large B-cells associated with sclerosis.
synonyms: Large cell lymphoma of the mediastinum
Mediastinal diffuse large-cell lymphoma with sclerosis
Primary mediastinal clear cell lymphoma of B-cell type

concepts.label: malignant pheochromocytoma
concepts.description: An adrenal medulla cancer that arises within the adrenal medulla, releasing epinephrines and norepinephrines hormones.

concepts.label: endometrial hyperplasia
concepts.description: An uterine benign neoplasm that is characterized by excessive proliferation of the cells of the endometrium.

concepts.label: desmoid tumor
concepts.description: A connective tissue benign neoplasm that occur most often in the abdomen, arms and legs.

concepts.label: chronic eosinophilic leukemia
concepts.description: A chronic leukemia characterized by a clonal proliferation of eosinophilic precursors resulting in persistently increased numbers of eosinophils in the blood, marrow and peripheral tissues.

concepts.label: ovarian sex-cord stromal tumor
concepts.description: A sex cord-gonadal stromal tumor that arises from the ovary and is composed of granulosa cells, Sertoli cells, Leydig cells, theca cells, and fibroblasts.

concepts.label: epithelioid inflammatory myofibroblastic sarcoma
concepts.description: An inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor composed of epithelioid or round cells with a characteristic perinuclear or nuclear membrane staining pattern with ALK immunohistochemistry, frequently dispersed in myxoid stroma with prominent neutrophils or lymphocytes, and often absence of plasma cells.

concepts.label: anaplastic thyroid carcinoma
concepts.description: A thyroid gland carcinoma that is composed of undifferentiated cells.

concepts.label: thyroid gland adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A thyroid gland carcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

concepts.label: differentiated high-grade thyroid carcinoma
concepts.description: A thyroid gland adenocarcinoma characterized by extensive evidence of follicular cell differentiation.

concepts.label: dedifferentiated liposarcoma
concepts.description: A liposarcoma that is characterized as a high-grade tumor that occurs when a lower-grade tumor changes and creates new high-grade cells.

concepts.label: myxofibrosarcoma
concepts.description: A sarcoma that arises from the soft tissue and is characterized by the presence of spindle-shaped cells, cellular pleomorphism, thin-walled blood vessels, fibrous septa, and myxoid stroma.

concepts.label: benign teratoma
concepts.description: A germ cell benign neoplasm that derives_from mature tissue elements or a limited amount of immature tissue elements.

concepts.label: B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma
concepts.description: A B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia that is characterized by the presence of too many B-cell lymphoblasts in the blood and bone marrow.

concepts.label: B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia
concepts.description: An acute lymphocytic leukemia characterized by too many B-cell lymphoblasts (immature white blood cells) in the bone marrow and blood.

concepts.label: B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma with BCR-ABL1
concepts.description: A B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma that derives_from B-lymphoblasts and carries a translocation between the BCR gene on chromosome 22 and the ABL1 gene on chromosome 9. It results in the production of the p190 kd or p210 kd fusion protein.

concepts.label: B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma MLL rearranged
concepts.description: A B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma that is characterized by the presence of lymphoblasts that carry a translocation between the KMT2A gene at 11q23.3 and another gene partner resulting in the production of a KMT2A related fusion protein.
synonyms: B lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma with t(v;11q23); MLL rearranged

concepts.label: B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma with ETV6-RUNX1
concepts.description: A B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma that is characterized by the presence of lymphoblasts that carry a translocation between the TEL gene on chromosome 12 and the AML1 gene on chromosome 21, (p13.2;q22.1). It results in the production of the TEL-AML1 (ETV6-RUNX1) fusion protein.

concepts.label: B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma with hyperdiploidy
concepts.description: A B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma that is composed of B-lymphoblasts which contain more than 50 and usually less than 66 chromosomes.

concepts.label: B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma with hypodiploidy
concepts.description: A B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma that is composed of B-lymphoblasts which contain less than 46 chromosomes.

concepts.label: B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma with IGH::IL3 fusion
concepts.description: A B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma that is characterized by the presence of lymphoblasts that carry a translocation between the IL3 gene on chromosome 5 and the IGH locus on chromosome 14, (q31.1;q32.3).

concepts.label: B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma with TCF3-PBX1
concepts.description: A B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma that is characterized by the presence of lymphoblasts that carry a translocation between the E2A gene on chromosome 19 and the PBX1 gene on chromosome 1.
synonyms: B Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia with t(1;19)(q23;p13.3); E2A-PBX1 (TCF3-PBX1)

concepts.label: B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma, BCR-ABL1–like
concepts.description: A B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma that has a gene expression profile similar to that of B-ALL with t(9;22)(q34.1;q11.2) BCR-ABL1, but lacks that gene fusion.

concepts.label: B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma with iAMP21
concepts.description: A B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma that is characterized by amplification of a portion of chromosome 21.

concepts.label: diffuse midline glioma, H3 K27-altered
concepts.description: A histone mutated tumor that is characterized by loss of histone H3 p.K28me3 (K27me3) methylation and located throughout the midline structures of the central nervous system. Methylation loss may be due to p.K28M (K27M) mutation in one of the histone H3 isoforms (H3.1, H3.2, or H3.3), overexpress...

concepts.label: medulloblastoma WNT activated
concepts.description: A medulloblastoma that is characterized as a molecular subtype by activation of the WNT pathway and TP53 mutations may be present or absent.

concepts.label: medulloblastoma SHH activated
concepts.description: A medulloblastoma that is characterized as a molecular subtype by activation of the sonic hedgehog (SHH) pathway and TP53 mutations that may be present or absent.

concepts.label: medulloblastoma SHH activated and TP53 mutant
concepts.description: A medulloblastoma SHH activated that is characterized as a molecular subtype by activation of the sonic hedgehog (SHH) pathway and the presence of TP53 mutations.

concepts.label: medulloblastoma SHH activated and TP53 wild-type
concepts.description: A medulloblastoma SHH activated that is characterized as a molecular subtype by activation of the sonic hedgehog (SHH) pathway and the absence of TP53 mutations.

concepts.label: medulloblastoma non-WNT/non-SHH
concepts.description: A medulloblastoma that is characterized as a molecular subtype that is not associated with activation of the WNT pathway or sonic hedgehog (SHH) pathway and TP53 mutations are absent.

concepts.label: medulloblastoma non-WNT/non-SHH group 3
concepts.description: A medulloblastoma non-WNT/non-SHH that is characterized as a molecular subtype by absent TP53 mutations and MYC amplifications that may be present.

concepts.label: medulloblastoma non-WNT/non-SHH group 4
concepts.description: A medulloblastoma non-WNT/non-SHH that is characterized as a molecular subtype by the absence of MYC amplifications and TP53 gene mutations, while chromosome 17 abnormalities may be present.

concepts.label: plasmablastic lymphoma
concepts.description: A large B-cell lymphoma that is characterized by the presence of large neoplastic cells resembling B-immunoblasts which have the immunophenotypic profile of plasma cells.

concepts.label: childhood acute megakaryoblastic leukemia
concepts.description: An acute megakaryocytic leukemia that is characterized by fusion oncogenes involving transcriptional regulators in childhood.
synonyms: pediatric non-Down syndrome acute megakaryoblastic leukemia

concepts.label: acute basophilic leukemia
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia that is characterized by primary differentiation to basophils.

concepts.label: core binding factor acute myeloid leukemia
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia that is characterized by the presence of t(8;21)(q22;q22) or inv(16)(p13q22)/t(16;16)(p13;q22). These cytogenetic abnormalities result in disruption of the transcription factor CBF, which is a regulator of normal hematopoiesis.

concepts.label: nasal type extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A mature T-cell and NK-cell lymphoma that is characterized by an often angiocentric and angiodestructive cellular infiltrate composed of EBV positive NK/T cells.

concepts.label: myeloid leukemia associated with Down Syndrome
concepts.description: An acute megakaryocytic leukemia occurring in children with Down syndrome and that has_material_basis_in mutation in the GATA1 gene.

concepts.label: sinonasal undifferentiated carcinoma
concepts.description: A nasal cavity carcinoma that arises from the sinonasal tract and that is characterized by the presence of small to medium size malignant cells.

concepts.label: salivary gland mucinous adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A salivary gland carcinoma that is characterized by the presence of large pools of extracellular mucin in which clusters of malignant epithelial cells are found.

concepts.label: mammary analogue secretory carcinoma
concepts.description: A salivary gland carcinoma that has_material_basis_in a chromosomal translocation that results in an ETV6-NTRK3 fusion gene.

concepts.label: low grade glioma
concepts.description: A cell type benign neoplasm that has_material_basis_in glial cells (astrocytes, oligodendrocytes or ependymocytes).

concepts.label: childhood low-grade glioma
concepts.description: A low-grade glioma that occurs in children and encompasses tumors of astrocytic, oligodendroglial, and mixed glial-neuronal histology.

concepts.label: anaplastic pleomorphic xanthoastrocytoma
concepts.description: A malignant astrocytoma that is characterized by the presence of five or more mitoses per 10 high-power fields.

concepts.label: IDH-mutant anaplastic astrocytoma
concepts.description: An anaplastic astrocytoma carrying IDH mutations.

concepts.label: IDH-wildtype anaplastic astrocytoma
concepts.description: An anaplastic astrocytoma lacking mutations in IDH1 or IDH2 genes.

concepts.label: astrocytoma, IDH-mutant, grade 4
concepts.description: An IDH-mutant anaplastic astrocytoma that is characterized by the presence of necrosis and/or microvascular proliferation or homozygous deletion of CDKN2A and/or CDKN2B genes. The term glioblastoma no longer applies to central nervous system WHO grade 4 IDH-mutant astrocytomas.

concepts.label: IDH-wildtype glioblastoma
concepts.description: A glioblastoma that is characterized by high cellularity, high mitotic activity, necrosis or microvascular proliferation and that lacks mutations in IDH genes.

concepts.label: histone mutated tumor
concepts.description: A high grade glioma that has_material_basis_in mutations in the genes encoding histones.

concepts.label: diffuse glioma, H3 G34 mutant
concepts.description: A histone mutated tumor that has_material_basis_in mutations in codon 34 of the H3 histone family 3A protein.

concepts.label: IDH-mutant and 1p/19q-codeleted oligodendroglioma
concepts.description: An anaplastic oligodendroglioma that has_material_basis_in IDH gene family mutation and combined whole-arm losses of 1p and 19q (1p/19q codeletion).

concepts.label: spinal ependymoma, MYCN-amplified
concepts.description: A spinal cord ependymoma that is characterized by MYCN amplification.

concepts.label: posterior fossa ependymoma
concepts.description: A high grade ependymoma that is located within the posterior fossa.

concepts.label: supratentorial ependymoma
concepts.description: A high grade ependymoma that is located within the supratentorial brain.

concepts.label: YAP1-MAMLD1 fusion-positive supratentorial ependymoma
concepts.description: A supratentorial ependymoma that has_material_basis_in YAP1-MAMLD1 fusion.

concepts.label: RELA fusion-positive ependymoma
concepts.description: A supratentorial ependymoma that has_material_basis_in presence of a RELA fusion gene.

concepts.label: pericytoma with t(7;12)
concepts.description: A perivascular tumor that is characterized by a perivascular pattern of spindle-to-ovoid cell proliferation and that has_material_basis_in t(7;12)(p22;q13) translocation with resultant ACTB-GLI1 fusion.

concepts.label: solitary fibrous tumor/hemangiopericytoma
concepts.description: A connective tissue cancer that is characterized as the combination of solitary fibrous tumors and hemangiopericytomas.

concepts.label: embryonal tumor with multilayered rosettes, C19MC-altered
concepts.description: An embryonal tumor with multilayered rosettes that is characterized by the presence of multilayered rosettes formation and the presence of amplification of the C19MC region on chromosome 19 (19q13.42).

concepts.label: astroblastoma, MN1-altered
concepts.description: An astroblastoma that is characterized by astroblastoma-like morphology with MN1 rearrangements involving the meningioma 1 (MN1) gene on chromosome 22q.
synonyms: CNS high-grade neuroepithelial tumors with MN1 alteration

concepts.label: CNS neuroblastoma with FOXR2 activation
concepts.description: A central nervous system neuroblastoma that is characterized by FOXR2 activation and that is composed of small, round cells with hyperchromatic nuclei surrounded by a clear halo.
synonyms: central nervous system neuroblastoma with FOXR2 activation

concepts.label: histiocytic sarcoma
concepts.description: A histiocytic and dendritic cell cancer that is characterized by the presence of neoplastic cells with morphologic and immunophenotypic characteristics similar to those seen in mature histiocytes.

concepts.label: childhood supratentorial embryonal tumor with multilayered rosettes, C19MC-altered
concepts.description: A childhood embryonal tumor with multilayered rosettes, C19MC-altered that arises from the supratentorial brain and occurs in children.

concepts.label: diffuse large B-cell lymphoma activated B-cell type
concepts.description: A diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that is characterized by the expression of CD44, PKCbeta1, Cyclin D2, BCL-2, and IRF4/MUM1 genes.

concepts.label: diffuse large B-cell lymphoma germinal center B-cell type
concepts.description: A diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that is characterized by the expression of CD10, BCL-6, A-myb, and LMO2 genes, BCL-2 translocation, and c-REL amplification.

concepts.label: DICER1 syndrome
concepts.description: A syndrome that is characterized by an increased risk of developing pleuropulmonary blastoma, multinodular goiter, ovarian Sertoli-Leydig cell tumors, and/or other types of tumors, and that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the DICER1 gene on chromosome 14q32. Mutations of the gene e...
synonyms: Pleuro-pulmonary blastoma familial tumor susceptibility syndrome
Pleuropulmonary blastoma familial tumor susceptibility syndrome

concepts.label: BN2 diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that is categorized as BN2 with high probability by the LymphGen algorithm. This is based on a combination of genetic features and BN2 DLBCLs often, but do not always, have a translocation involving the BCL6 locus and/or some combination of mutations affecting NOTC...

concepts.label: EZB diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that is categorized as EZB with high probability by the LymphGen algorithm. This is based on a combination of genetic features and EZB DLBCLs often, but do not always, have hot spot mutations in EZH2 and/or a BCL2 translocation. This class can be further subdivided...

concepts.label: MCD diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that is categorized as MCD with high probability by the LymphGen algorithm. This is based on a combination of genetic features and MCD DLBCLs often, but do not always, have the most common hot spot mutation in MYD88 (L265P) and/or activating mutations in CD79B. Thi...

concepts.label: N1 diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that is categorized as N1 with high probability by the LymphGen algorithm. This is based on a combination of genetic features. Although N1 DLBCLs always have an activating mutation affecting NOTCH1, LymphGen can assign cases with this mutation to other classes, dep...

concepts.label: ST2 diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that is categorized as ST2 with high probability by the LymphGen algorithm. This is based on a combination of genetic features and ST2 DLBCLs often, but do not always, have missense or nonsense mutations affecting TET2 and NFKBIA. This subgroup also commonly has mu...

concepts.label: A53 diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that is characterized by aneuploidy with TP53 inactivation.

concepts.label: EZB-MYC+ diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: An EZB diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that expresses the double hit gene expression signature (DHITsig+) according to gene expression profiling. In addition to the features characteristic of EZB, these cases commonly, but do not always, harbour MYC translocations and DDX3X mutations.

concepts.label: EZB-MYC- diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: An EZB diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that does not express the double hit gene expression signature (DHITsig-) according to gene expression profiling. These cases tend to have few MYC translocations or DDX3X mutations.

concepts.label: acute myeloid leukemia with t(6;9) (p23;q34.1)
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia associated with t(6;9)(p23;q34), resulting in DEK-NUP214(CAN) fusion protein expression. It is often associated with multilineage dysplasia and basophilia.
synonyms: Acute Myeloid Leukemia with t(6;9) (p23;q34.1); DEK-NUP214

concepts.label: acute promyelocytic leukemia with PML-RARA
concepts.description: An acute promyelocytic leukemia that is characterized by a severe coagulopathy and the t(15;17)(q24;q21), generating a PML-RARA fusion gene, and where abnormal promyelocytes predominate.

concepts.label: acute myelomonocytic leukemia
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia that is characterized by the proliferation of both neutrophil and monocyte precursors.

concepts.label: acute myeloid leukemia with inv(3) (q21.3;q26.2) or t(3;3) (q21.3;q26.2)
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia associated with inv(3)(q21q26.2) or t(3;3)(q21;q26.2), resulting in the expression of RPN1-EVI1 fusion protein and the reposition of a distal GATA2 enhancer to activate MECOM expression.
synonyms: Acute Myeloid Leukemia with inv(3) (q21.3;q26.2) or t(3;3) (q21.3;q26.2); GATA2, MECOM
Acute myeloid leukemia with inv(3)(q21;q26.2) or t(3;3)(q21;q26.2); RPN1-EVI1

concepts.label: acute myeloid leukemia with inv(16)(p13.1q22) or t(16;16)(p13.1;q22)
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia that is characterized by the presence of abnormal bone marrow eosinophils and the characteristic cytogenetic abnormality inv(16)(p13.1q22) or t(16;16)(p13.1;q22), which results in the expression of the fusion protein CBFB-MYH11.
synonyms: Acute Myeloid Leukemia with inv(16)(p13.1q22) or t(16;16)(p13.1;q22); CBFB-MYH11
acute myeloid leukemia with abnormal marrow eosinophils

concepts.label: acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia in which the blasts do not show evidence of myeloid differentiation by morphology and conventional cytochemistry.

concepts.label: acute myeloid leukemia without maturation
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia that is characterized by blasts without evidence of significant maturation in the neutrophilic lineage.

concepts.label: acute myeloid leukemia with maturation
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia characterized by blasts with evidence of significant maturation in the neutrophilic lineage.

concepts.label: chronic myelogenous leukemia, BCR-ABL1 positive
concepts.description: A chronic myeloid leukemia that is characterized by an abnormally high number of neutrophils and the expression of the BCR-ABL1 fusion gene.

concepts.label: acute myeloid leukemia with mutated NPM1
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia with mutation of the nucleophosmin gene. It is usually associated with normal karyotype and frequently has myelomonocytic or monocytic features.

concepts.label: acute myeloid leukemia with biallelic mutation of CEBPA
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia with double mutations of the CEBPA gene.

concepts.label: acute myeloid leukemia with mutated RUNX1
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia that is characterized by de novo RUNX1 gene mutation, not associated with myelodysplastic syndrome-related cytogenetic abnormalities.

concepts.label: acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia with at least 20% blasts in the bone marrow or blood and one of the following: a previous history of myelodysplastic syndrome; multilineage dysplasia; or myelodysplastic syndrome-related cytogenetic abnormalities.

concepts.label: acute myeloid leukemia with t(8;21); (q22; q22.1)
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia associated with t(8;21)(q22;q22) resulting in RUNX1-RUNX1T1 fusion protein expression. The bone marrow and the peripheral blood show large myeloblasts with abundant basophilic cytoplasm, often containing azurophilic granules.
synonyms: Acute Myeloid Leukemia with t(8;21); (q22; q22.1); RUNX1-RUNX1T1

concepts.label: acute myeloid leukemia with MLL rearrangement
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia characterized by rearrangement of the MLL (mixed-lineage leukemia) gene.
synonyms: Acute Myeloid Leukemia with KMT2A/MLL Rearrangement

concepts.label: acute myeloid leukemia with mutated CEBPA
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia with non-germline mutations of the CEBPA gene.

concepts.label: acute myeloid leukemia with t(1;22)(p13;q13)
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia typically showing megakaryocytic maturation and associated with t(1;22)(p13;q13), resulting in the expression of RBM15-MKL1 fusion protein.
synonyms: Acute Myeloid Leukemia (Megakaryoblastic) with t(1;22)(p13.3;q13.1); RBM15-MKL1

concepts.label: pituitary blastoma
concepts.description: A pituitary cancer that is characterized by features of Cushing disease, with elevated blood ACTH levels and hypercortisolism arising within the fetal anterior pituitary and associated with DICER1 mutations.

concepts.label: cauda equina neuroendocrine tumor
concepts.description: A cauda equina neoplasm that is a slow-growing, well-differentiated neuroendocrine tumor arising from the cauda equina.

concepts.label: teratoma with somatic-type malignancy
concepts.description: A teratoma that is characterized by morphologic transformation to malignancy and an aggressive clinical course.

concepts.label: dedifferentiated chondrosarcoma
concepts.description: A chondrosarcoma that is an aggressive morphologic variant of chondrosarcoma. It is composed of a low grade chondrosarcoma and a high grade non-cartilagenous sarcomatous component.

concepts.label: pineocytoma
concepts.description: An endocrine organ benign neoplasm arising from the pineal gland that is composed of small, uniform, mature cells resembling pineocytes with occasional large pineocytomatous rosettes. concepts.label: EWSR1-negative small round cell tumor

concepts.description: a branch of a credit institution authorised in another European Economic Area (EEA) country that has the right to passport its activities

concepts.label: European exercise convention
concepts.description: exercise convention that stipulates that an option may only be exercised at the date of expiration

concepts.label: European exercise terms
concepts.description: exercise terms that stipulate that an option may only be exercised at the date of expiration

concepts.label: European Free Trade Association
concepts.description: intergovernmental organization of Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Switzerland set up for the promotion of free trade and economic cooperation between its members, within Europe, and globally

concepts.label: European Money Markets Institute
concepts.description: international non-profit association under Belgian law founded in 1999 with the launch of the Euro and based in Brussels (56, Ave des Arts, 1000 Brussels)

concepts.label: European Money Markets Institute (EMMI) benchmark publisher
concepts.description: individual representing the European Money Markets Institute (EMMI) functional entity that is an international financial information publisher, responsible for the publication of euro-based benchmarks, including Euribor

concepts.label: European Union entity
concepts.description: individual representing the federated sovereignty and polity that is the European Union

concepts.label: European Union jurisdiction
concepts.description: individual representing the overall jurisdiction for the European Union, namely, that of the Court of Justice of the EU and Court of Auditors of the EU

concepts.label: examiner
concepts.description: party empowered as an official representative by a regulatory agency to investigate and review specified documents for accuracy and truthfulness

concepts.label: excess return swap
concepts.description: return swap in which the change in the level of the index will be equal to the returns generated primarily by the changes in price of each of the contracts that comprise the index

concepts.label: exchange
concepts.description: any organization, association, or group of persons, whether incorporated or unincorporated, which constitutes, maintains, or provides a facility for bringing together purchasers and sellers of financial instruments, commodities, or other products, services, or goods, and includes the market place...

concepts.label: exchange participant
concepts.description: registered agent who, in accordance with the rules of an exchange, may trade on or through the exchange and whose name is entered in a list, register or roll kept by the exchange as an agent who may trade on or through the exchange

concepts.label: exchange rate
concepts.description: rate at which one currency can be exchanged for another

concepts.label: exchange rate structure
concepts.description: structured collection of quoted or projected exchange rates, such that volatility may be constructed for the structure

concepts.label: exchange rate volatility
concepts.description: statistical measure of the rate of change in the rate at which one currency can be exchanged for another

concepts.label: exchange-sourced data provider
concepts.description: market data provider that distributes financial information originating directly from trading venues, including order-book data, trades, quotes, and venue-specific reference data

concepts.label: exchange-traded fund
concepts.description: investment fund whose fund units are traded on an exchange, much like stocks

concepts.label: exchange-traded warrant
concepts.description: warrant that is listed on a securities exchange

concepts.label: exchangeable preferred share
concepts.description: preferred share that may be exchanged for a security of another issuer

concepts.label: executive
concepts.description: person appointed and given the responsibility to manage the affairs of an organization and the authority to make decisions within specified role-specific boundaries

concepts.label: executive board member
concepts.description: member of a board of directors that is also an employee of the organization

concepts.label: executive branch
concepts.description: the branch of government that is authorized and responsible for the daily administration of the government

concepts.label: exempt issuer
concepts.description: issuer that issues securities that are excused from certain regulatory reporting requirements

concepts.label: exempt offering
concepts.description: public offering involving securities that are excused from certain regulatory reporting requirements

concepts.label: exempt security
concepts.description: security that is exempt from certain regulatory rules

concepts.label: exempt transaction
concepts.description: securities transaction for which there is no requirement to register the transaction with a regulatory agency

concepts.label: exercise convention
concepts.description: convention that determines when the holder or future holder of an option can implement the rights defined in the option

concepts.label: exercise terms
concepts.description: contract terms specific to the conditions, conventions and other stipulations related to the exercise of an option or entitlement

concepts.label: exotic option
concepts.description: option that has a non-standard payout structure or other feature

concepts.label: exotic warrant
concepts.description: warrant that gives the holder the right (but not the obligation) to buy (or sometimes sell) an underlying asset under non-standard or complex conditions, often involving additional features not found in a plain vanilla (standard) warrant

concepts.label: expected value
concepts.description: theoretical value that is anticipated based on a model or hypothesis

concepts.label: expired MIC status
concepts.description: as of the last report or update, the exchange code has expired

concepts.label: explicit contract event schedule
concepts.description: schedule of events, including but not limited to payment events, rate reset events and others that will occur over the lifetime of the credit agreement

concepts.label: explicit date
concepts.description: date in which the 'has date value' property is required

concepts.label: explicit date period
concepts.description: date period for which the start date, end date, and/or duration are required

concepts.label: explicit duration
concepts.description: duration for which the 'has duration value' property must have a value

concepts.label: explicit recurrence interval
concepts.description: recurrence interval defined via an explicit duration

concepts.label: explicit time period
concepts.description: time period for which the starting time, ending time, and/or duration are required

concepts.label: exposure
concepts.description: means by which an individual or organization is unprotected and open to damage, danger, risk of suffering a loss, or uncertainty

concepts.label: exposure bearer
concepts.description: party subject to influence or risk arising from a specific contract, instrument, or arrangement

concepts.label: exposure situation
concepts.description: state of affairs in which some party is subject to influence or risk arising from a specific contract, instrument, or arrangement

concepts.label: express certificate
concepts.description: participation certificate whose payout is conditional: should the underlying trade above the strike on the observation date, an early redemption consisting of nominal price plus an additional coupon amount is paid

concepts.label: expression
concepts.description: finite combination of symbols that are well-formed according to applicable rules

concepts.label: extendable preferred share
concepts.description: preferred share whose redemption date can be extended at the issuer or holder option

concepts.label: extension provision
concepts.description: contract terms that specify the conditions under which a contract can be extended

concepts.label: external auditor
concepts.description: independent party qualified and authorized to examine and report on the accuracy of financial records and ensure that companies comply with tax laws

concepts.label: extinct language
concepts.description: an individual language or variant that is no longer in use and has no current descendant

concepts.label: extraction resource
concepts.description: negotiable commodity that is a mineral resource obtained via withdrawal from the natural environment

concepts.label: extraordinary redemption provision
concepts.description: provision that gives a bond issuer the right to call its bonds due to an unusual one-time occurrence, as specified in the offering statement

concepts.label: extrinsic value
concepts.description: measure of the difference between the market price of an option, called the premium, and its intrinsic value

concepts.label: FDIC business entity identifier
concepts.description: Delaware Department of Corporations business entity identifier for the FDIC

concepts.label: FDIC Certificate Number
concepts.description: identifier issued to a depository institution by the FDIC on approval of that institution's application for insurance

concepts.label: FDIC Institution Directory
concepts.description: Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's (FDIC) institution directory, a repository of financial data and institution characteristics for covered institutions collected by the FDIC

concepts.label: FDIC registry entry
concepts.description: an entry in the FDIC institution directory, a repository of financial institution characteristics collected by the FDIC related to the institutions they insure

concepts.description: Financial Stability Oversight Council (FSOC), which provides comprehensive monitoring of the stability of our nation's financial system, as established under the Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act

concepts.label: Financial Times interactive data scheme
concepts.description: proprietary identification scheme for securities identifiers managed by the Financial Times

concepts.label: finite population
concepts.description: population for which it is possible to count its units

concepts.label: Finnish entity
concepts.description: sovereign state and polity that is Finland

concepts.label: firm commitment offering
concepts.description: securities offering whereby the underwriter purchases the securities outright for their own account

concepts.label: first regular coupon date
concepts.description: scheduled date for the first regular coupon payment, in a regular repeating series of coupon periods, after any non standard (long or short) first coupon period in the schedule

concepts.label: fixed basket
concepts.description: basket of goods and services whose quantity and quality are held fixed for some period of time

concepts.label: fixed basket population
concepts.description: statistical universe consisting of specific goods and/or services designed for the purposes of supporting surveys such as those used as the basis for price indices

concepts.label: fixed coupon bond
concepts.description: bond whose coupon rate and principal amount are fixed at the time of origination or sale and remain constant while the security is outstanding

concepts.label: fixed coupon terms
concepts.description: terms for payment of interest on a bond with a fixed interest rate

concepts.label: fixed fixed interest rate swap
concepts.description: interest rate swap in which both parties pay a fixed interest rate that they could not otherwise obtain outside of a swap arrangement

concepts.label: fixed float cross-currency interest rate swap
concepts.description: interest rate swap in which fixed interest payments on the notional are exchanged for floating interest payments and the two streams of interest payments are in different currencies

concepts.label: fixed float interest rate swap
concepts.description: interest rate swap in which fixed interest payments on the notional are exchanged for floating interest payments

concepts.label: fixed float single currency interest rate swap
concepts.description: interest rate swap in which fixed interest payments on the notional are exchanged for floating interest payments and where both payment streams are expressed in terms of the same currency

concepts.label: fixed income option
concepts.description: option giving the buyer (holder) the right, but not the obligation, to buy (via a call option) or sell (via a put option) the underlying fixed income assets specified at a pre-determined price (i.e., the strike price, fixed or calculated), on or before a specified date (the expiration date)

concepts.label: fixed income security
concepts.description: tradeable debt instrument that provides a return in the form of fixed periodic payments and typically the return of principal at maturity

concepts.label: fixed income specialist provider
concepts.description: market data provider that focuses on pricing, reference data, and analytics for fixed-income instruments such as bonds, credit products, and money-market securities

concepts.label: fixed interest rate
concepts.description: interest rate that does not fluctuate over the lifetime of a loan or other debt instrument

concepts.label: fixed interest rate leg
concepts.description: fixed leg that specifies fixed interest amounts and terms for the payment of that interest

concepts.label: fixed leg
concepts.description: swap leg whose paying party is obligated to make payments from time to time over the term of a swap calculated by reference to a fixed annual rate or consisting of at least one payment of a fixed amount

concepts.label: fixed lookback strike expression
concepts.description: cashflow expression specifying the arguments required to calculate the fixed price at which the lookback option is to be exercised

concepts.label: fixed payment leg
concepts.description: swap leg that specifies contractual terms associated with a schedule of payments for any swap calculated by reference to a fixed annual rate

concepts.label: fixed rate dividend
concepts.description: dividend that provides a specified annual return on the nominal value (and any premium) paid on shares

concepts.label: float float cross-currency interest rate swap
concepts.description: interest rate swap that exchanges cashflows based on two different interest rates in different currencies

concepts.label: float float interest rate swap
concepts.description: interest rate swap that exchanges cashflows based on two different floating interest rates

concepts.label: float float single currency interest rate swap
concepts.description: interest rate swap that exchanges cashflows based on two different floating interest rates in the same currency

concepts.label: floating interest rate
concepts.description: variable interest rate that is based on a specific index or benchmark rate

concepts.label: floating interest rate leg
concepts.description: floating leg in which variable interest is paid on some notional amount, linked to some underlying interest reference rate

concepts.label: floating leg
concepts.description: swap leg whose paying party is obligated to make payments from time to time over the term of a swap calculated by reference to some variable rate, calculated based on the change in value of some underlying asset, or consisting of at least one payment of some floating amount

concepts.label: floating lookback strike expression
concepts.description: cashflow expression specifying the arguments required to calculate the best projected price at which the lookback option may be exercised

concepts.label: floating rate note
concepts.description: bond with a variable interest rate based on a published reference interest rate

concepts.label: floating-rate note date
concepts.description: calculated date associated with a floating-rate note, also known as a floater or FRN, which is a debt instrument with a variable interest rate

concepts.label: floating-rate note date rule
concepts.description: business day adjustment rule applied to floating-rate note instruments

concepts.label: floor
concepts.description: all of the rooms or areas on the same level of a building; a story

concepts.label: for profit corporation
concepts.description: corporation whose objective is to make money, i.e., to ensure realization of a financial benefit such that the amount of revenue gained from a business activity exceeds the expenses, costs and taxes needed to sustain that activity

concepts.label: foreign bank
concepts.description: financial institution organized under the laws of a foreign country, a territory of the United States, Puerto Rico, Guam, American Samoa, or the Virgin Islands, which engages in the business of banking, or any subsidiary or affiliate, organized under such laws, of any such institution

concepts.label: foreign banking organization
concepts.description: financial service provider that is headquartered outside the United States and that can acquire or establish freestanding banks or bank holding companies in the United States

concepts.label: foreign banking organization as a bank holding company
concepts.description: foreign banking organization that is a bank holding company in the United States

concepts.label: foreign banking organization of a bank holding company
concepts.description: foreign banking organization that is owned or controlled by a bank holding company

concepts.label: foreign branch of foreign bank
concepts.description: branch that resides outside of the United States whose parent is located outside of the United States

concepts.label: foreign branch of foreign bank managed by US office
concepts.description: branch that resides outside of the United States whose parent is located outside of the United States that is managed by a US branch or agency of the foreign bank

concepts.label: foreign branch of US bank
concepts.description: branch that resides outside of the United States, but has a parent that is located in the United States

concepts.label: foreign branch ownership
concepts.description: ownership by some party of some formal organization or organizational sub-unit that is a foreign affiliate and legally part of the owning entity

concepts.label: foreign entity other
concepts.description: foreign institution that engages in banking activities usually in connection with the business of banking in the countries where such foreign institutions are organized or operating

concepts.label: foreign exchange master agreement
concepts.description: product-specific master agreement intended to reflect best market practice and to provide a standard agreement for participants in the foreign exchange markets

concepts.label: foreign exchange service
concepts.description: financial service involving the exchange of one currency for another, conversion of one currency for another, and transfer of money from one country to another whereby currency conversion is required

concepts.label: foreign exchange settlement netting provision
concepts.description: settlement netting provision that is specific to foreign exchange contracts

concepts.label: formula
concepts.description: rule expressed in letters and symbols that consists of at least one expression

concepts.label: forty-eight months
concepts.description: duration of exactly forty-eight months, regardless of the length in days of a given calendar month, but typically 30 days

concepts.label: forward
concepts.description: derivative instrument that is privately negotiated between parties to buy the underlier at a specified future date at the price specified in the contract

concepts.label: forward contract adjustment method
concepts.description: method by which adjustments will be made to the contract should one or more of a number of extraordinary events occur

concepts.label: ForwardRateAgreement
concepts.description: agreement to exchange an interest rate commitment on a notional amount at a future date

concepts.label: forward start option
concepts.description: exotic option that is fully specified with respect to a set expiry date, underlying asset and other parameters, purchased and paid for on initiation, but that becomes active at a set activation date with a strike price determined at the time of activation

concepts.label: FpML Business Center Code Scheme
concepts.description: the coding scheme used to define a set of codes for municipalities, or business centers, or business day adjustments for FpML

concepts.label: fractional ownership interest
concepts.description: classification indicating that several parties may share in, and mitigate the risk of, ownership of a high-value tangible asset

concepts.label: Fredericton
concepts.description: the international business center of Fredericton

concepts.label: Freetown
concepts.description: the international business center of Freetown

concepts.label: freight resource
concepts.description: negotiable commodity that is a freight index route

concepts.label: French entity
concepts.description: sovereign state and polity that is France

concepts.label: Terres australes françaises (les)
concepts.description: the country of French Southern Territories (the)

concepts.label: Friday
concepts.description: time interval that has duration 1 day and that meets a Saturday

concepts.label: from the end
concepts.description: time direction indicating that a calendar-specified date is the nth date from the end of a calendar period

concepts.label: from the start
concepts.description: time direction indicating that a calendar-specified date is the nth day from the beginning of a calendar period.

concepts.label: front
concepts.description: side or part of a building that presents itself to view first, that faces the street; the most forward part of a building

concepts.label: full amortization
concepts.description: amortization in which the very last payment (which, if the schedule was calculated correctly, should be equal to all others) pays off all remaining principal and interest on the loan

concepts.label: full faith credit bond
concepts.description: bond secured by an unconditional promise to pay by another entity

concepts.label: fully amortizing asset-backed security
concepts.description: asset-backed security based on a pool of debt instruments that returns principal to investors over the life of the security

concepts.label: fully-indexed interest rate
concepts.description: a variable interest rate that is calculated by adding a margin to a specified index rate

concepts.label: fully paid share
concepts.description: share whose payment status indicates that no additional money is owed to the company by shareholders on the value of the shares

concepts.label: fully paid share status
concepts.description: status indicating that no additional money is owed to the company by shareholders on the value of the shares

concepts.label: functional business entity
concepts.description: functional entity defined in terms of the nature of the commercial activity it conducts

concepts.label: functional entity
concepts.description: party defined in terms of a function they or it performs

concepts.label: functional role
concepts.description: role representing an underlying functionality that something, such as a person, organization, process, or service, is expected to perform or deliver

concepts.label: fund administrator
concepts.description: role of the party responsible for managing the operational, accounting, and compliance functions of an investment fund

concepts.label: fund contract
concepts.description: contract that embodies and defines the fund legal form in cases where there is no independent organization

concepts.label: fund family
concepts.description: collection of managed investments that are all managed by a single investment institution

concepts.label: fund holder
concepts.description: party that owns units in or a percentage of and has rights and responsibilities with respect to some fund, provided in exchange for investment

concepts.label: fund holding
concepts.description: ownership interest in a fund, which may represented by fund units that confer financial rights and governance privileges

concepts.label: fund manager
concepts.description: role of the party responsible for making investment decisions and managing the portfolio of an investment fund

concepts.label: fund of funds
concepts.description: investment fund that invests directly in other investment funds rather than investing in stocks, bonds, and other securities

concepts.label: fund position
concepts.description: position in some fund, which may be defined in terms of fund units

concepts.label: fund unit
concepts.description: quantified share of beneficial interest in a pooled fund, representing a proportional claim on the fund's assets, income, or entitlements

concepts.label: funds
concepts.description: artificial currency used as calculation basis for another currency(s) and accounting purposes

concepts.label: funds identifier
concepts.description: sequence of characters that can be used to uniquely identify funds

concepts.label: fungible token
concepts.description: digital token capable of mutual substitution between the individual units of digital assets

concepts.label: future
concepts.description: derivative instrument that obligates the buyer to receive and the seller to deliver the assets specified at an agreed price, at some later point in time

concepts.label: future on future
concepts.description: futures contract whose underlying asset is at least one (other) futures contract

concepts.label: future on option
concepts.description: futures contract whose underlying asset is at least one option contract

concepts.label: future on swap
concepts.description: futures contract whose underlying asset is at least one swap contract

concepts.description: banking institution organized to accept savings deposits and pay interest on those savings deposits

concepts.label: savings loan association
concepts.description: financial institution that accepts deposits primarily from individuals and channels its funds primarily into residential mortgage loans

concepts.label: savings loan holding company
concepts.description: company that directly or indirectly controls a savings association or related holding company, and explicitly excludes any company that is also a bank holding company

concepts.label: scalar quantity
concepts.description: property of a phenomenon, body, or substance, where the property has a magnitude that can be expressed by means of a number and a reference

concepts.label: scalar quantity value
concepts.description: number and reference together expressing the magnitude of a quantity

concepts.label: scalar quantity value range
concepts.description: expression of the lowest possible value and/or highest possible value for some scalar quantity

concepts.label: schedule stub
concepts.description: date period before the start of the recurring part of a schedule or after the end of the recurring part, which may be associated with a specific occurrence kind

concepts.label: scheduled calculation period end event
concepts.description: the end date of a specific calculation period

concepts.label: scheduled calculation period start event
concepts.description: the start of a specific calculation period

concepts.label: scheme
concepts.description: structure or means of organizing information such as a blueprint, schema, numbering system, organization structure, measurement system, plan, taxonomy, or language for organizing information

concepts.label: scoped measure
concepts.description: qualified measure that is constrained by filters on the statistical population to which it applies

concepts.label: Scotland entity
concepts.description: regional devolved sovereignty that is Scotland

concepts.label: Scotland jurisdiction
concepts.description: jurisdiction of the Supreme Courts of Scotland

concepts.label: script
concepts.description: a set of graphic characters used to represent one or more languages in writing

concepts.label: Seattle
concepts.description: the international business center of Seattle

concepts.label: secondary unit
concepts.description: address component that identifies an individual unit within a larger structure, such as an apartment, office, hangar, slip, mailbox, and so forth, at a given street address

concepts.label: secondary unit designator
concepts.description: classifier for a smaller structure or component within a larger facility, such as an apartment, office, mail stop, or other similar designation

concepts.label: secondary unit indicator
concepts.description: index to the specific unit within a secondary unit, such as a building or apartment, at a particular street address

concepts.label: secured bond
concepts.description: bond that is backed by collateral, such as a tangible asset or income stream, in addition to a general promise to pay

concepts.label: secured consumer loan
concepts.description: loan to one or more individuals for household, family, or other personal expenditures in which the borrower pledges some asset via a security agreement as collateral for the loan, or that is secured via third-party guarantee

concepts.label: secured loan
concepts.description: loan in which the borrower pledges some asset via a security agreement as collateral for the loan, or that is secured via third-party guarantee

concepts.label: Securities and Exchange Commission
concepts.description: independent commission established by the Securities Act of 1933 and Securities Exchange Act of 1934 whose mission is to protect investors, maintain fair, orderly, and efficient markets, and facilitate capital formation

concepts.label: securities and exchange regulator
concepts.description: regulatory agency and registration authority role of the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC)

concepts.label: securities basket constituent
concepts.description: security identified as a component of a basket of securities

concepts.label: securities offering
concepts.description: offering of a security (or securities) for sale

concepts.label: securities pool
concepts.description: pool of securities organized for the purpose of issuing notes against those securities

concepts.label: securities regulation
concepts.description: regulation codified in law specific to securities and investments

concepts.label: securities restriction
concepts.description: legal obligation that is applicable to a financial instrument or listing as mandated in a law or by contract

concepts.label: securities transaction
concepts.description: transaction between two or more parties involving the exchange of commonly defined financial products

concepts.label: security
concepts.description: financial instrument that can be bought or sold

concepts.label: security agreement
concepts.description: collateral agreement that grants a financial interest in some collateral to a party that is not an owner of that collateral, specifying terms including relative duties and rights, over and above those specified in the primary contract, regarding the disposition of the asset used as collateral

concepts.label: security-based derivative
concepts.description: derivative instrument whose underlier is based on a security, including collections of securities and indices based on securities

concepts.label: security form
concepts.description: nature of the proof of ownership of a security

concepts.label: security identification scheme
concepts.description: formal definition of the structure and application of a particular set of securities identifiers

concepts.label: security identifier
concepts.description: any publicly available identifier that is used to identify a security

concepts.label: security price
concepts.description: monetary price for a financial instrument at some point in time

concepts.label: security registry
concepts.description: registry used to manage security identifiers and related information

concepts.label: security registry entry
concepts.description: record for a security in a securities registry

concepts.label: security underwriter
concepts.description: party that has purchased from an issuer with a view to, or sells for an issuer in connection with, the distribution of any security, or participates or has a direct or indirect participation in any such undertaking, or participates or has a participation in the direct or indirect underwriting of ...

concepts.label: security underwriting arrangement
concepts.description: underwriting agreement between an organization (typically an investment bank) and a securities issuer that commits the underwriter to assuming risk involved in buying a new issue of securities and reselling it to the public

concepts.label: self-regulating organization
concepts.description: non-governmental organization that has the power to create and exercise some degree of regulatory authority over an industry or profession in some country or group of countries

concepts.label: seller
concepts.description: party that makes, offers or contracts to make a sale to an actual or potential buyer

concepts.label: Seoul
concepts.description: the international business center of Seoul

concepts.label: Serbian entity
concepts.description: sovereign state and polity that is Serbia

concepts.label: service agreement
concepts.description: written contract between a client and service provider whereby the service provider supplies some service in the form of time, effort, and/or expertise in exchange for compensation

concepts.description: negotiable commodity involving services such as transportation, communications, and trade

concepts.label: servicer
concepts.description: party that collects principal and interest payments on behalf of the lender

concepts.label: Seselwa Creole French
concepts.description: Part of ISO 639-3, not otherwise represented in OMG ontologies

concepts.label: settlement
concepts.description: act of finalizing a transaction, including but not limited to finalizing accounting, exchanging consideration, and/or legally recording documents, as applicable

concepts.label: settlement auction
concepts.description: independently administered synthetic auction process on a set of defined deliverable obligations that sets the reference final price that can be used to facilitate cash settlement of all covered transactions following a credit event

concepts.label: settlement convention
concepts.description: convention employed to determine the closing date (from the stated settlement date) in the process of settling a transaction on which securities or interests in securities are delivered, usually against (in simultaneous exchange for) payment of some consideration

concepts.label: settlement date rule
concepts.description: convention for determining settlement dates by reference to some jurisdiction or as set by a given exchange or similar venue

concepts.label: settlement event
concepts.description: specific event involving the finalization a transaction or portion thereof, including but not limited to finalizing accounting, exchanging consideration, and/or legally recording documents, as applicable

concepts.label: settlement netting provision
concepts.description: netting provision that specifies the way in which on a given payment date, each party will aggregate the amounts of a currency to be delivered by it, and only the difference in the aggregate amounts will be delivered by the party with the larger aggregate obligation

concepts.label: settlement terms
concepts.description: contract terms that define the commitment to and mechanism for settling one or more sides of a transaction

concepts.label: Shanghai
concepts.description: the international business center of Shanghai

concepts.label: share
concepts.description: financial instrument that signifies a unit of equity ownership in a corporation, or a unit of ownership in a mutual fund, or interest in a general or limited partnership, or a unit of ownership in a structured product, such as a real estate investment trust

concepts.label: share issuer
concepts.description: issuer of securities that represent an ownership interest in something

concepts.label: share payment status
concepts.description: classifier that specifies the overall payment status for shares issued

concepts.label: share yield
concepts.description: ratio of the annualized dividend per share divided by the (current) price per share

concepts.label: shareholder
concepts.description: party that owns shares in and has rights and responsibilities with respect to some asset, provided in exchange for investment

concepts.label: shareholders' equity
concepts.description: equity that is manifested in the form of shares in an entity, fund or structured product

concepts.label: shareholding
concepts.description: ownership interest in the equity of a company, represented by shares that confer financial rights and governance privileges

concepts.label: Shikomor
concepts.description: Not yet allocated a code in ISO 639

concepts.label: short mini-future certificate
concepts.description: mini-future certificate that entitles the holder to acquire cash in exchange for specific underlying assets

concepts.label: side
concepts.description: place, space, or direction with respect to a center or to a line of division

concepts.label: signatory
concepts.description: responsible party authorized to sign agreements on behalf of themselves, another person, or an organization

concepts.label: signatory capacity
concepts.description: the capacity of some natural person to sign agreements on the part of some organization or legal person

concepts.label: significant shareholder
concepts.description: party that owns a significant voting stake in an organization that is less than 50 percent but greater than some threshold

concepts.label: Silver
concepts.description: the currency whose unit is one troy ounce of the precious metal Silver

concepts.label: simple return leg
concepts.description: return leg based strictly on the income generated by the underlying asset, excluding appreciation, decrease in value, capital gains, and fees on any increase in value

concepts.label: single currency interest rate swap
concepts.description: interest rate swap in which the two streams of interest payments are in the same currency

concepts.label: single monthly mortality
concepts.description: estimated per-month percentage of mortgages in an MBS pool that will be paid off early

concepts.label: single name credit default swap
concepts.description: credit default swap whose underlying risk is a single reference obligation, or a single reference entity, such as a corporation or a sovereign borrower

concepts.label: single voting share
concepts.description: share that has the right to exactly one vote

concepts.label: sinking fund amortization terms
concepts.description: terms for the paydown of principal in a sinking fund type of amortizing security

concepts.label: Sint Maarten (Dutch part)
concepts.description: the country of Sint Maarten (Dutch part)

concepts.label: six months
concepts.description: duration of exactly six months, regardless of the length in days of a given calendar month, but typically 30 days

concepts.label: sixty months
concepts.description: duration of exactly sixty months, regardless of the length in days of a given calendar month, but typically 30 days

concepts.label: slip
concepts.description: sloping ramp extending out into the water to serve as a place for landing or repairing ships; ship's or boat's berth between two piers

concepts.label: Slovak entity
concepts.description: sovereign state and polity that is Slovakia

concepts.label: Slovene entity
concepts.description: sovereign state and polity that is Slovenia

concepts.label: gummatous syphilis
concepts.description: A tertiary syphilis that is characterized by granulomatous lesions, called gummas, which are characterized by a center of necrotic tissue with a rubbery texture. They form in the liver, bones, and testes but may affect any organ.

concepts.label: primary congenital glaucoma
concepts.description: Primary congenital glaucoma (PCG) is characterized by elevated intraocular pressure (IOP), enlargement of the globe (buphthalmos), edema, and opacification of the cornea with rupture of Descemet's membrane (Haab's striae), thinning of the anterior sclera and iris atrophy, anomalously deep anterio...

concepts.label: taeniasis
concepts.description: A parasitic infection caused by tapeworms of the genus Taenia. Humans are infected by eating undercooked or raw meat of infected animals. It is usually an asymptomatic infection and patients may become aware of the infection by noticing segments of the tapeworm in their feces. If symptoms are pre...

concepts.label: extrapulmonary tuberculosis
concepts.description: A tuberculosis that occurs at body sites other than the lung.

concepts.label: abdominal tuberculosis
concepts.description: An extrapulmonary tuberculosis that is located in gastrointestinal tract, located in peritoneum, located in omentum, located in mesentery, located in liver, located in spleen or located in pancreas.

concepts.label: oral cavity carcinoma in situ
concepts.description: A in situ carcinoma that involves the oral cavity.

concepts.label: gall bladder carcinoma in situ
concepts.description: A carcinoma in situ involving a gall bladder.

concepts.label: malignant Sertoli-Leydig cell tumor
concepts.description: A malignant form of Sertoli-leydig cell tumor.

concepts.label: paranasal sinus carcinoma
concepts.description: A malignant epithelial neoplasm arising in the paranasal sinus.

concepts.description: A benign neoplasm that involves the respiratory system.

concepts.description: A non-metastasizing neoplasm that arises from the male or female reproductive system. Representative examples include benign prostate phyllodes tumor, benign Sertoli cell tumor, uterine corpus leiomyoma, and benign ovarian serous tumor.

concepts.description: A well-differentiated neuroendocrine tumor arising from the digestive system.
