concepts.label: hypochromic microcytic anemia
concepts.description: Anemia in which the circulating RBCs are smaller than the usual size of RBCs (microcytic) and have decreased red color (hypochromic).

concepts.label: vitelliform macular dystrophy
concepts.description: A rare genetic disorder characterized by macular degeneration in the retina resulting in progressive loss of central vision with retention of the peripheral vision.

concepts.label: partial fetal alcohol syndrome
concepts.description: A fetal alcohol spectrum disorder that results in most, but not all, of the growth deficiency and/or craniofacial features of fetal alcohol syndrome including central nervous system dysfunction due to prenatal alcohol exposure.

concepts.label: alcohol-related birth defect
concepts.description: A physical or cognitive mental abnormality caused by maternal alcohol consumption and its toxic effect on the developing embryo during pregnancy.

concepts.label: spastic cerebral palsy
concepts.description: A form of cerebral palsy wherein spasticity is the exclusive impairment present.

concepts.label: ataxic cerebral palsy
concepts.description: A form of cerebral palsy caused by damage to cerebellar structures.

concepts.label: small cell carcinoma
concepts.description: A neuroendocrine carcinoma composed of small malignant cells which are often said to resemble "oat cells" under the microscope. Small cell carcinoma most often affects the lungs. Clinically, this is often a rapidly growing cancer that spreads to distant sites early.

concepts.label: anal canal cancer
concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm involving the anal canal

concepts.label: malignant pleural solitary fibrous tumor
concepts.description: A malignant form of pleural solitary fibrous tumor.

concepts.label: fetal alcohol spectrum disorder
concepts.description: A group of disorders caused by a prenatal exposure to maternal consumption of alcohol leading to a range of behavioral, cognitive and neurological deficits in the offspring. It is characterized by physical growth problems, distinct facies, and varying psycho-neurological issues.
synonyms: growth retardation, facial abnormalities, and central nervous system dysfunction

concepts.label: adolescence-adult electroclinical syndrome
concepts.description: An electroclinical syndrome with onset in adolescence and adulthood.

concepts.label: inborn serine deficiency
concepts.description: An inherited metabolic disease that is has its basis in the disruption of L-serine biosynthetic process.
synonyms: inborn error of L-serine biosynthetic process
rare inborn error of L-serine biosynthetic process

concepts.label: autosomal genetic disease
concepts.description: A monogenic disease that is has material basis in a mutation in a single gene on one of the non-sex chromosomes.

concepts.label: mature T-cell and NK-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma
concepts.description: This type of lymphoma is not frequently seen in the western hemisphere. Clinically, with the exception of anaplastic large cell lymphoma, mature T- and NK-cell lymphomas are among the most aggressive of all hematopoietic neoplasms. Representative disease entities include mycosis fungoides, angioi...
synonyms: mature T-cell and NK-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma
mature T-cell and NK-cell non-Hodgkin's lymphoma

concepts.label: lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma
concepts.description: A clonal neoplasm of small B-lymphocytes, lymphoplasmacytoid cells, and plasma cells involving the bone marrow, lymph nodes, and the spleen. The majority of patients have a serum IgM paraprotein.

concepts.label: cerebellar ataxia
concepts.description: A neurological syndrome characterized by clumsy and uncoordinated movement of the limbs, trunk, and cranial muscles. It results from pathology in the cerebellum and its connections, or in the proprioceptive sensory pathways.

concepts.label: autosomal dominant polycystic liver disease
concepts.description: An autosomal dominant inherited condition characterized by many cysts of various sizes scattered throughout the liver.

concepts.label: paraganglioma
concepts.description: A benign or malignant neoplasm arising from paraganglia located along the sympathetic or parasympathetic nerves. Infrequently, it may arise outside the usual distribution of the sympathetic and parasympathetic paraganglia. Tumors arising from the adrenal gland medulla are called pheochromocytomas...

concepts.label: short QT syndrome
concepts.description: A genetic disease of the electrical system of the heart that consists of a constellation of signs and symptoms, consisting of a short QT interval on an EKG (< 300 ms) that does not significantly change with heart rate, tall and peaked T waves, and a structurally normal heart. Short QT syndrome ap...
synonyms: ventricular arrhythmia associated with short QT syndrome

concepts.label: cone dystrophy
concepts.description: An inherited ocular disorder characterized by the loss of cone cells, the photoreceptors responsible for both central and color vision.

concepts.label: cerebral creatine deficiency syndrome
concepts.description: Creatine deficiency syndrome (CDS) comprises a group of inborn errors of creatine metabolism, characterized by a global developmental delay, intellectual disability and associated neurological (seizures, movement disorders, myopathy) and behavioral manifestions. CDS includes two creatine biosynth...

concepts.label: classical glioblastoma
concepts.description: A molecular subtype of glioblastoma characterized by lack of p53 mutations, chromosome 7 amplifications or deletions, and high levels of EGFR amplification.

concepts.label: proneural glioblastoma
concepts.description: A molecular subtype of glioblastoma that is associated with younger age at presentation and is characterized by p53 mutations and PDGFRa amplifications.

concepts.label: mesenchymal glioblastoma
concepts.description: A molecular subtype of glioblastoma characterized by the presence of NF1 mutations.

concepts.label: neural glioblastoma
concepts.description: A molecular subtype of glioblastoma characterized by the expression of the neural markers NEFL, GABRA1, SYT1, and SLC12A5.

concepts.label: atrioventricular block
concepts.description: A heart block that is initiated in the atrioventricular node.

concepts.label: second-degree atrioventricular block
concepts.description: Intermittent failure of atrial electrical impulse conduction to the ventricles.

concepts.label: sinoatrial node disorder
concepts.description: A disease involving the sinoatrial node.

concepts.label: tricuspid valve disorder
concepts.description: A disease involving the tricuspid valve.

concepts.label: arterial disorder
concepts.description: An impairment of the structure or function of the blood vessels which carry blood away from the heart.

concepts.label: focal dystonia
concepts.description: A dystonia that is localized to a specific part of the body.

concepts.label: multifocal dystonia
concepts.description: A dystonia that involves two or more unrelated body parts.

concepts.label: segmental dystonia
concepts.description: A dystonia that affects two or more adjacent parts of the body.

concepts.label: anismus
concepts.description: A focal dystonia of the pelvic floor muscles during attempted defecation.

concepts.label: focal hand dystonia
concepts.description: A focal dystonia that affects a single muscle or small group of muscles in the hand resulting from involuntary muscular contractions.

concepts.label: oculogyric crisis
concepts.description: A focal dystonia that is characterized by a prolonged involuntary upward deviation of the eyes.

concepts.label: spasmodic dystonia
concepts.description: A chronic voice disorder characterized by momentary periods of uncontrolled spasms of the muscles of the larynx.

concepts.label: craniofacial dystonia
concepts.description: A focal dystonia that is characterized as dystonia that affects the muscles of the head, face, and neck.

concepts.label: hemidystonia
concepts.description: A multifocal dystonia that involves the arm and leg on the same side of the body.

concepts.label: glomerulosclerosis
concepts.description: A hardening of the kidney glomerulus caused by scarring of the blood vessels.

concepts.label: renal fibrosis
concepts.description: A final common manifestation of a wide variety of chronic kidney diseases characterized by glomerulosclerosis and tubulointerstitial fibrosis.

concepts.label: arteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy
concepts.description: An anterior ischemic neuropathy that is the cause of vision loss that occurs in temporal arteritis (aka giant cell arteritis)

concepts.label: tongue squamous cell carcinoma
concepts.description: A squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the tongue. It usually presents as a painful ulcerated or nodular lesion. The size of the tumor and the status of the lymph nodes are the most important factors that determine prognosis.
synonyms: squamous cell carcinoma of the tongue

concepts.label: villous adenoma
concepts.description: An epithelial neoplasm morphologically characterized by the presence of a villous architectural pattern. concepts.label: lung adenocarcinoma in situ
concepts.description: A localized non-invasive adenocarcinoma of the lung measuring 3 cm or less. It is characterized by a pure lepidic growth pattern and the lack of stromal, vascular, or pleural invasion.

concepts.description: Inclusion body myopathy with Paget disease of bone and frontotemporal dementia (IBMPFD) is a multisystem degenerative genetic disorder characterized by adult-onset proximal and distal muscle weakness (clinically resembling limb-girdle muscular dystrophy); early-onset Paget disease of bone, manife...

concepts.label: non-syndromic intellectual disability
concepts.description: An intellectual disability that is not part of a larger syndrome.

concepts.label: synucleinopathy
concepts.description: A neurodegenerative disease that is characterized by the abnormal accumulation of aggregates of alpha-synuclein protein in neurons, nerve fibers or glial cells. [url:http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Synucleinopathies ]

concepts.label: bone ameloblastoma

concepts.description: A medulloblastoma that involves the brainstem.

concepts.label: sacrum chordoma
concepts.description: A chordoma (disease) that involves the fused sacrum.

concepts.label: corpus callosum oligodendroglioma
concepts.description: A oligodendroglioma that involves the corpus callosum.

concepts.label: parietal lobe ependymal tumor
concepts.description: An ependymal tumor affecting the parietal lobe of the brain.

concepts.label: salivary gland carcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from the major or minor salivary glands. Representative examples include carcinoma ex pleomorphic adenoma, adenocarcinoma, adenoid cystic carcinoma, and mucoepidermoid carcinoma.

concepts.label: mixed extragonadal germ cell cancer
concepts.description: A mixed germ cell cancer that is located in areas of the body other than the ovary or testicle.

concepts.label: cecum villous adenoma
concepts.description: A neoplasm that arises from the glandular epithelium of the cecal mucosa. It is characterized by a villous architectural pattern. The neoplastic glandular cells have dysplastic features.

concepts.label: colon adenoma
concepts.description: An adenoma that arises from the colon. The group of colonic adenomas includes tubular, villous, and tubulovillous adenomas, traditional serrated adenomas, sessile serrated adenomas/polyps, and familial adenomatous polyposis.

concepts.label: bronchus mucoepidermoid carcinoma
concepts.description: A mucoepidermoid carcinoma that involves the bronchus.

concepts.label: lung combined type small cell adenocarcinoma

concepts.label: trachea mucoepidermoid carcinoma

concepts.label: striated muscle rhabdoid tumor
concepts.description: A rhabdoid tumor that involves the striated muscle tissue.

concepts.label: cervical neuroblastoma

concepts.label: extra-adrenal sympathetic paraganglioma
concepts.description: A benign or malignant sympathetic paraganglioma arising from paraganglia outside the adrenal gland. Clinical symptoms are related to secretion of catecholamines. Representative examples include the superior and inferior paraaortic and bladder paragangliomas.

concepts.label: retroperitoneal neuroblastoma
concepts.description: A neuroblastoma that involves the retroperitoneal space.

concepts.label: breast lobular carcinoma
concepts.description: An adenocarcinoma of the breast arising from the lobules. This is a relatively uncommon carcinoma, represents approximately 10% of the breast adenocarcinomas and is often bilateral or multifocal.
synonyms: carcinoma of lobule of mammary gland

concepts.label: endocervical adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An adenocarcinoma that arises from the endocervix. It is the most common type of endocervical adenocarcinoma. The neoplastic epithelium shows a pseudostratified architecture and the malignant cells have enlarged, elongated, and hyperchromatic nuclei.

concepts.label: recombinase activating gene 2 deficiency

concepts.label: congenital anemia
concepts.description: Anemia, the cause of which is present at birth.

concepts.label: autoimmune disorder of exocrine system

concepts.label: pervasive developmental disorder
concepts.description: A category of developmental disorders characterized by impaired communication and socialization skills. The impairments are incongruent with the individual's developmental level or mental age. These disorders can be associated with general medical or genetic conditions.

concepts.label: primary cutaneous T-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma
concepts.description: A T-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma arising from the skin. Representative examples include mycosis fungoides and primary cutaneous anaplastic large cell lymphoma.
synonyms: T-cell non-Hodgkin's lymphoma of the skin

concepts.label: marantic endocarditis
concepts.description: Formation of a non-infectious thrombus, referred to as vegetation, on previously undamaged endocardium. It usually occurs as a complication of connective-tissue diseases and cancers because of the associated hypercoagulable state (see thrombophilia).

concepts.label: benign female reproductive system neoplasm
concepts.description: A non-metastasizing neoplasm that arises from the female reproductive system. Representative examples include uterine corpus leiomyoma, endocervical polyp, and benign ovarian germ cell tumor.

concepts.label: benign male reproductive system neoplasm
concepts.description: A non-metastasizing neoplasm that arises from the male reproductive system. Representative examples include benign prostate phyllodes tumor, benign Sertoli cell tumor, seminal vesicle cystadenoma, and epididymal adenomatoid tumor.

concepts.description: Abnormal growth of cells in the nervous system without evidence of malignant characteristics. concepts.description: A benign neoplasm that involves the integumental system.

concepts.label: akinetopsia
concepts.description: An agnosia that is a loss of motion perception.

concepts.label: alexithymia
concepts.description: An agnosia that is a deficiency in understanding, processing, or describing emotions.

concepts.label: amusia
concepts.description: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to recognize musical notes, rhythms, and intervals.

concepts.label: anosognosia
concepts.description: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to gain feedback about one's own condition or impairments.

concepts.label: apperceptive agnosia
concepts.description: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to distinguish visual shapes.

concepts.label: associative visual agnosia
concepts.description: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to recognize visual scenes or classes of objects but retain the ability to describe them.

concepts.label: auditory agnosia
concepts.description: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to distinguishing environmental and non-verbal auditory cues including difficulty distinguishing speech from non-speech sounds even though hearing is usually normal.

concepts.label: autotopagnosia
concepts.description: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to orient parts of the body.

concepts.label: color agnosia
concepts.description: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to recognize a color, while being able to perceive or distinguish it.

concepts.label: cortical deafness
concepts.description: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to perceive any auditory information but whose hearing is intact.

concepts.label: finger agnosia
concepts.description: An agnosia characterized by an inability to distinguish, name, or recognize the fingers

concepts.label: form agnosia
concepts.description: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to perceive a whole object while perceiving only parts of details.

concepts.label: integrative agnosia
concepts.description: Agnosia characterized by the inability to integrate perceptual wholes within knowledge.

concepts.label: mirror agnosia
concepts.description: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to acknowledge objects in the neglected field that are visible when a mirror reflects the object visible in the non-neglected field.

concepts.label: pain agnosia

concepts.label: phonagnosia
concepts.description: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to recognize familiar voices.

concepts.description: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to visually recognize an object while maintaining the use of non-visual sensory systems such as feeling, tapping, smelling, rocking or flicking the object to recognize the object.

concepts.label: simultanagnosia
concepts.description: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to recognize a whole image or scene while retaining the ability to recognize objects or details in their visual field one at a time.

concepts.label: astereognosia
concepts.description: An agnosia that is the loss of the ability to recognize objects by touch based on its texture, size and weight.

concepts.label: tactile agnosia
concepts.description: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to recognize or identify objects by touch alone.

concepts.label: time agnosia
concepts.description: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to comprehend the succession and duration of events.

concepts.label: topographical agnosia
concepts.description: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to rely on visual cues to guide them directionally due to the inability to recognize objects.

concepts.label: verbal auditory agnosia
concepts.description: An agnosia that is a loss of the ability to recognizing spoken words as semantically meaningful.

concepts.description: A benign or malignant tumor characterized by the presence of cells that show myoepithelial differentiation. Based on its morphologic features, it is classified as benign or malignant. A representative example of benign myoepithelioma is benign salivary gland myoepithelioma. Representative example...

concepts.label: sweat gland neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant neoplasm arising from the sweat glands.

concepts.label: Pacinian tumor
concepts.description: A neurofibroma characterized by the presence of structures which resemble Vater-Pacini corpuscles.

concepts.label: liver angiosarcoma
concepts.description: A malignant vascular neoplasm arising from the liver.

concepts.label: liver sarcoma
concepts.description: A malignant soft tissue neoplasm that arises from the liver. Representative examples include angiosarcoma, undifferentiated (embryonal) sarcoma, rhabdomyosarcoma, and leiomyosarcoma.

concepts.label: tenosynovial giant cell tumor, localized type
concepts.description: A well-circumscribed, lobulated tumor, completely or partially covered by a fibrous capsule. It usually arises in the fingers. It is characterized by the presence of mononuclear cells, multinucleated osteoclast-like giant cells, hemosiderin-laden macrophages, foam cells, and an inflammatory infil...

concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm characterized by then presence of atypical giant cells.

concepts.label: liver hemangioma
concepts.description: A hemangioma arising from the liver.

concepts.label: hepatic vascular disorder
concepts.description: A non-neoplastic or neoplastic vascular disorder that affects the liver. Representative examples include veno-occlusive disease, hemangioma, lymphangioma, and angiosarcoma.

concepts.label: dermatitis
concepts.description: An inflammatory process affecting the skin. Signs include red rash, itching, and blister formation. Representative examples are contact dermatitis, atopic dermatitis, and seborrheic dermatitis.

concepts.label: capillary hemangioma
concepts.description: A common hemangioma characterized by the presence of capillary-sized vascular channels without prominent epithelioid endothelial cells.

concepts.label: hereditary hyperbilirubinemia
concepts.description: An inherited disorder affecting the metabolism of bilirubin. It results in increased levels of bilirubin in the blood. Representative examples of this condition include Gilbert syndrome and Crigler-Najjar syndrome.

concepts.label: auditory system disorder
concepts.description: A disease involving the auditory system.
synonyms: disease or disorder of auditory system

concepts.label: disorder of glycogen metabolism
concepts.description: An inherited metabolic disorder characterized either by defects in glycogen synthesis or defects in the breaking down of glycogen. It results either in the creation of abnormal forms of glycogen or accumulation of glycogen in the tissues.
synonyms: inborn error of glycogen metabolic process
rare inborn error of glycogen metabolic process

concepts.label: glycogen storage disease I
concepts.description: Glycogenosis due to glucose-6-phosphatase (G6P) deficiency or glycogen storage disease, (GSD), type 1, is a group of inherited metabolic diseases, including types a and b, and characterized by poor tolerance to fasting, growth retardation and hepatomegaly resulting from accumulation of glycogen a...
synonyms: glycogen storage disease due to G6P deficiency
glycogen storage disease due to glucose-6-phosphatase deficiency

concepts.label: bone carcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that involves the bone element.

concepts.label: ethmoid sinus squamous cell carcinoma
concepts.description: A squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the mucosal epithelial surface of the ethmoid sinus. Patients may present with nasal fullness, obstruction, and/or epistaxis.
synonyms: epidermoid carcinoma of the ethmoid sinus
epidermoid carcinoma of the ethmoidal sinus
squamous cell carcinoma of ethmoid sinus

concepts.label: ethmoid sinus adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from glandular epithelial cells of the epithelial cell

concepts.label: adamantinoma
concepts.description: A low grade malignant neoplasm arising from the long bones. The tibia is the most frequently affected bone site. concepts.label: lung sarcoma
concepts.description: A malignant mesenchymal neoplasm that arises from the lung. Representative examples include Kaposi sarcoma, leiomyosarcoma, and synovial sarcoma.

concepts.label: cerebellar disorder
concepts.description: Diseases that affect the structure or function of the cerebellum. Cardinal manifestations of cerebellar dysfunction include dysmetria, gait ataxia, and muscle hypotonia.

concepts.label: protozoa infectious disease
concepts.description: An infection that is caused by protozoans.

concepts.label: idiopathic interstitial pneumonia
concepts.description: A class of diffuse lung diseases that typically affect the pulmonary interstitium, although some also have a component affecting the airways (for instance, Cryptogenic organizing pneumonitis).

concepts.label: malignant cranial nerve neoplasm
concepts.description: Abnormal malignant growth of the cells that comprise the cranial nerve.
synonyms: malignant neoplasm of the cranial nerve
malignant tumor of the cranial nerve
malignant tumour of the cranial nerve

concepts.label: acquired polycythemia
concepts.description: An instance of polycythemia that is acquired during the lifetime of the individual.

concepts.label: erythropoietin polycythemia
concepts.description: Polycythemia that is caused by excess erythropoietin.
synonyms: polycythaemia due to Excess erythropoetin production
polycythemia due to excess erythopoetin production

concepts.label: Jervell and Lange-Nielsen syndrome
concepts.description: An autosomal recessive inherited syndrome caused by mutations in the KCNE1 and KCNQ1 genes. It is characterized by congenital hearing loss and arrhythmia. It is a form of long QT syndrome.
synonyms: Cardioauditory syndrome of Jervell and Lange-Nielsen
deafness, congenital, and functional heart disease
prolonged QT interval in EKG and sudden death

concepts.label: long QT syndrome
concepts.description: A condition that is characterized by episodes of fainting (syncope) and varying degree of ventricular arrhythmia as indicated by the prolonged QT interval. The inherited forms are caused by mutation of genes encoding cardiac ion channel proteins. The two major forms are Romano-Ward syndrome (also...
synonyms: ventricular arrhythmia associated with long QT syndrome

concepts.label: endometrial carcinoma
concepts.description: A malignant tumor arising from the epithelium that lines the cavity of the uterine body. The vast majority of endometrial carcinomas are adenocarcinomas; squamous cell and adenosquamous carcinomas represent a minority of the cases. Endometrioid adenocarcinoma is the most frequently seen variant o...

concepts.label: laryngeal sarcoma
concepts.description: A rare malignant soft tissue neoplasm that arises from the larynx.

concepts.label: benign prostate phyllodes tumor
concepts.description: A rare benign neoplasm that arises from the prostate gland and is characterized by the presence of hyperplastic glands and stroma that contains spindle-shaped cells.
synonyms: benign phyllodes neoplasm of the prostate
benign phyllodes tumor of the prostate
benign phyllodes tumour of the prostate

concepts.label: retrocochlear disease
concepts.description: Pathological processes involving the vestibulocochlear nerve; brainstem; or central nervous system. When hearing loss is due to retrocochlear pathology, it is called retrocochlear hearing loss.

concepts.label: Treacher-Collins syndrome
concepts.description: A congenital disorder of craniofacial development characterized by bilateral symmetrical oto-mandibular dysplasia without abnormalities of the extremities, and associated with several head and neck defects.

concepts.label: type IV hypersensitivity disease
concepts.description: A disease that has its basis in the disruption of type IV hypersensitivity.

concepts.label: lacrimal system cancer
concepts.description: A cancer that involves the lacrimal apparatus.

concepts.label: membranoproliferative glomerulonephritis
concepts.description: Inflammation of the glomeruli characterized by deposits at the intraglomerular mesangium, resulting in thickening of the glomerular basement membrane, activation of complement, and impaired kidney function secondary to damaged glomeruli.

concepts.label: glomerulonephritis
concepts.description: A renal disorder characterized by damage in the glomeruli. It may be acute or chronic, focal or diffuse, and it may lead to renal failure. Causes include autoimmune disorders, infections, diabetes, and malignancies.

concepts.label: lacrimal gland carcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the lacrimal gland.

concepts.label: lacrimal gland cancer
concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm involving the lacrimal gland.
synonyms: malignant neoplasm of the lacrimal gland
malignant tumor of the lacrimal gland
malignant tumour of the lacrimal gland

concepts.label: bronchiolitis
concepts.description: Inflammation of the bronchioles characterized by swelling of the bronchioles and mucus accumulation. It is usually caused by the respiratory syncytial virus and affects children. Signs and symptoms include coughing, wheezing, and shortness of breath.

concepts.label: eye carcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the eye
synonyms: carcinoma of eyeball of camera-type eye

concepts.label: inner ear disorder
concepts.description: A non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder affecting the inner ear. Causes are inner ear infections, head injuries, and neoplasms (e.g., acoustic schwannoma). Symptoms include dizziness, imbalance, nausea, and vision problems.
synonyms: disease or disorder of internal ear

concepts.label: photosensitive trichothiodystrophy
concepts.description: A trichothiodystrophy that is photosensitive, and caused by defects in the NER pathway
synonyms: Ichtyosis, brittle hair, intellectual impairment, decreased fertility, and short stature

concepts.label: carcinoma ex pleomorphic adenoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma arising in a pre-existing pleomorphic adenoma. It most often occurs in the parotid gland and less often in the submandibular gland and minor salivary gland. Patients usually present with a history of a long-standing mass which recently had undergone rapid growth. The prognosis depends...

concepts.label: cystic kidney disease
concepts.description: A congenital or acquired kidney disorder characterized by the presence of renal cysts.

concepts.label: primary hyperoxaluria
concepts.description: A hereditary disorder characterized by excessive oxalate production, leading to hyperoxaluria.

concepts.label: lacrimal gland adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from glandular epithelial cells of the lacrimal gland

concepts.label: prostate neuroendocrine neoplasm
concepts.description: A neoplasm with neuroendocrine differentiation that arises from the prostate gland. This category includes carcinoid tumors and small cell carcinomas.
synonyms: prostate gland neuroendocrine tumor, well differentiated, low or intermediate grade

concepts.label: mixed germ cell-sex cord-stromal tumor
concepts.description: A biphasic neoplasm that arises from the ovary or the testis. It is characterized by the presence of neoplastic germ cells and neoplastic sex cord-stromal cells. It includes the gonadoblastoma and mixed germ cell-sex cord stromal tumor, unclassifiable.
synonyms: mixed germ cell-sex cord-stromal tumor (morphologic abnormality)
mixed germ cell-sex cord-stromal tumour (morphologic abnormality)

concepts.label: Sertoli-Leydig cell tumor
concepts.description: A sex cord-gonadal stromal tumor consists of leydig cells; sertoli cells; and fibroblasts in varying proportions and degree of differentiation. Most such tumors produce androgens in the Leydig cells, formerly known as androblastoma or arrhenoblastoma. Androblastomas occur in the testis or the ova...

concepts.label: endometrioid tumor
concepts.description: A benign, borderline, or malignant epithelial tumor of the female reproductive system characterized by the presence of glands and/or cysts lined by neoplastic cells that resemble endometrial cells.
synonyms: endometrioid neoplasm of female reproductive system
endometrioid neoplasm of the female reproductive system
endometrioid tumor of female reproductive system
endometrioid tumor of the female reproductive system
endometrioid tumour of female reproductive system
endometrioid tumour of the female reproductive system

concepts.label: ovarian neuroendocrine neoplasm
concepts.description: An epithelial neoplasm with neuroendocrine differentiation that arises from the ovary. It includes carcinoid tumor, small cell carcinoma pulmonary type, and large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma.
synonyms: ovary neuroendocrine tumor, well differentiated, low or intermediate grade

concepts.label: nipple neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant neoplasm that arises in the area of the nipple.

concepts.label: breast myoepithelial tumor
concepts.description: A benign or malignant tumor that arises from the breast and originates from or is composed of myoepithelial cells. Representative examples include adenomyoepithelioma, myoepitheliosis, and malignant myoepithelioma.

concepts.label: breast neuroendocrine neoplasm
concepts.description: A neoplasm that arises from the breast and is composed of cells of neuroendocrine origin. Most cases are neuroendocrine carcinomas. Primary carcinoid tumors of the breast are very rare.
synonyms: breast neuroendocrine tumor, well differentiated, low or intermediate grade

concepts.label: breast granular cell tumor
concepts.description: A usually benign neoplasm that arises from the breast. It presents as a single, firm, and painless mass. It is characterized by the presence of neoplastic cells with eosinophilic granular cytoplasm.

concepts.label: malignant breast phyllodes tumor
concepts.description: A phyllodes tumor of the breast characterized by infiltrative margins and a sarcomatous stromal component. The sarcomatous stroma usually displays features of fibrosarcoma. Liposarcomatous, osteosarcomatous, or rhabdomyosarcomatous elements may also be present.
synonyms: malignant cystosarcoma phyllodes of the breast
malignant phyllodes neoplasm of the breast
malignant phyllodes tumor of the breast
malignant phyllodes tumour of the breast

concepts.label: breast sarcoma
concepts.description: A malignant mesenchymal neoplasm that arises from the breast. Representative examples include angiosarcoma, liposarcoma, leiomyosarcoma, rhabdomyosarcoma, and extraskeletal osteosarcoma.

concepts.label: prostatic acinar adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An invasive adenocarcinoma of the prostate gland composed of secretory cells. It is the most common histologic type of prostate adenocarcinoma. Several morphologic variants exist, including atrophic, pseudohyperplastic, foamy gland, and oncocytic variants.

concepts.label: substance-related disorder
concepts.description: A category of psychiatric disorders which include disorders related to the taking of a drug of abuse (including alcohol, prescribed medications and recreational drugs).

concepts.label: brain glioblastoma
concepts.description: A WHO grade IV malignant astrocytic tumor that arises from the brain, usually the cerebral hemispheres. It is characterized by the presence of poorly differentiated astrocytes, cellular polymorphism, nuclear atypia, and increased mitotic activity. The prognosis is poor.
synonyms: grade IV astrocytic tumour of brain

concepts.label: adult astrocytic tumor
concepts.description: An astrocytic tumor occurring during adulthood. Representative examples include diffuse astrocytoma, anaplastic astrocytoma, and glioblastoma.

concepts.label: childhood astrocytic tumor
concepts.description: An astrocytic tumor appearing before the age of twenty one without designation of benign or malignant nor designated location.

concepts.label: gingival overgrowth
concepts.description: Excessive growth of the gingiva either by an increase in the size of the constituent cells (gingival hypertrophy) or by an increase in their number (gingival hyperplasia). (From Jablonski's Dictionary of Dentistry, 1992, p574)

concepts.label: papillary adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A morphologic variant of adenocarcinoma. It is characterized by the presence of a papillary growth pattern. Representative examples include thyroid gland papillary carcinoma, invasive papillary breast carcinoma, and ovarian serous surface papillary adenocarcinoma.

concepts.label: kidney benign neoplasm
concepts.description: A non-metastasizing neoplasm that arises from the kidney. Representative examples include cystic nephroma, metanephric adenoma, oncocytoma, and urothelial papilloma of the renal pelvis.

concepts.label: hepatobiliary neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant neoplasm that affects the liver parenchyma, bile ducts, and gallbladder. Representative examples of benign neoplasms include hepatocellular adenoma, bile duct adenoma, and gallbladder lipoma. Representative examples of malignant neoplasms include hepatocellular carcinoma, in...

concepts.label: hepatobiliary disorder
concepts.description: A non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder that affects the liver, bile ducts, and gallbladder. Representative examples of non-neoplastic disorders include hepatitis, cirrhosis, cholangitis, and cholecystitis. Representative examples of neoplastic disorders include hepatocellular adenoma, hepatocell...
synonyms: disease or disorder of hepatobiliary system

concepts.label: digestive system cancer
concepts.description: A primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm involving any part of the digestive system.

concepts.label: gallbladder papillary neoplasm
concepts.description: A non-invasive, papillary epithelial neoplasm that arises from the epithelium of the gallbladder. Intraepithelial neoplasia is present.

concepts.label: anus disorder
concepts.description: A non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder that affects the anal canal or anal margin. Representative examples of non-neoplastic disorders include hemorrhoids and anal ulcer. Representative examples of neoplastic disorders include carcinoma, lymphoma, and melanoma.

concepts.label: hepatic porphyria
concepts.description: A group of metabolic diseases due to deficiency of one of a number of liver enzymes in the biosynthetic pathway of heme. concepts.label: tenosynovial giant cell tumor
concepts.description: A tumor usually arising in the synovium of joints, bursa or tendon sheath. synonyms: giant cell neoplasm of tendon sheath

giant cell tumor of the Tenosynovium

concepts.description: The mucinoses are a diverse group of disorders which have in common the deposition of basophilic, finely granular and stringy material (mucin) in the connective tissues of the dermis (dermal mucinoses), in the pilosebaceous follicles (follicular mucinoses), or in the epidermis and tumors derived ...

concepts.label: inherited lipid metabolism disorder
concepts.description: An inherited metabolic disorder caused by an enzyme deficiency, resulting in an inability to oxidize fatty acids for energy production.

concepts.label: keratoacanthoma
concepts.description: A dome-shaped, rapidly growing skin lesion composed of well differentiated squamous cells. It represents a proliferation of the infundibular epithelium of the hair follicle and its morphologic distinction from a well differentiated carcinoma may be difficult or impossible. Keratoacanthomas affect...

concepts.label: synovium neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant soft tissue neoplasm arising exclusively from the synovial membrane. Examples include the diffuse giant cell tumor of tendon sheath, localized giant cell tumor of tendon sheath, and malignant giant cell tumor of tendon sheath.
synonyms: neoplasm of synovial membrane of synovial joint
synovial membrane of synovial joint neoplasm
synovial membrane of synovial joint neoplasm (disease)
synovial membrane of synovial joint tumor
synovial membrane of synovial joint tumour
tumor of synovial membrane of synovial joint
tumour of synovial membrane of synovial joint

concepts.label: skin squamous cell carcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma arising from the squamous cells of the epidermis. Skin squamous cell carcinoma is most commonly found on sun-exposed areas. The majority of the tumors are well-differentiated.
synonyms: squamous cell carcinoma of the skin
zone of skin squamous cell carcinoma

concepts.label: skin neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant tumor involving the skin. Representative examples of benign skin neoplasms include the benign melanocytic skin nevus, acanthoma, sebaceous adenoma, sweat gland adenoma, lipoma, hemangioma, fibroma, and benign fibrous histiocytoma. Representative examples of malignant skin ne...

concepts.label: squamous cell neoplasm
concepts.description: A neoplasm that is composed of squamous epithelial cells. Squamous cell carcinoma is a representative example.

concepts.label: fallopian tube papilloma
concepts.description: A benign epithelial neoplasm that arises from the fallopian tube. It is characterized by the presence of fibrovascular stalks lined by serous epithelial cells.

concepts.label: inverted papilloma
concepts.description: An endophytic benign papillary epithelial neoplasm that results from the invagination and proliferation of epithelial cells in the underlying stroma. Representative examples are the inverted urothelial papilloma that arises from the urinary tract and inverted Schneiderian papilloma that arises fr...

concepts.label: childhood oligodendroglioma
concepts.description: An oligodendroglioma that arises from the central nervous system and occurs during childhood.

concepts.label: spinal cord oligodendroglioma
concepts.description: A oligodendroglioma that involves the spinal cord.
synonyms: well differentiated spinal cord oligodendroglial tumor
well differentiated spinal cord oligodendroglial tumour

concepts.label: spinal cord glioma
concepts.description: A neoplasm that arises from glial cells in the spinal cord. Representative examples include astrocytoma, oligodendroglioma, and ependymoma.

concepts.label: brain oligodendroglioma
concepts.description: A oligodendroglioma that involves the brain.

concepts.label: spinal cord disorder
concepts.description: A disease involving the spinal cord.
synonyms: disease or disorder of spinal cord

concepts.label: schwannoma
concepts.description: A benign, usually encapsulated slow growing tumor composed of Schwann cells. It affects peripheral and cranial nerves. It recurs infrequently and only rare cases associated with malignant transformation have been reported.

concepts.label: nerve sheath neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant neoplasm arising from the perineural cells in the sheaths surrounding the nerves. Representative examples include neurofibroma, schwannoma, and malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor.

concepts.label: cellular schwannoma
concepts.description: A morphologic variant of schwannoma characterized by hypercellularity, Antoni A pattern, and the absence of well-formed Verocay bodies.

concepts.label: schwannoma of twelfth cranial nerve
concepts.description: A schwannoma that involves the hypoglossal nerve.
synonyms: neurilemmoma of the twelfth cranial nerve
schwannoma of the twelfth cranial nerve

concepts.label: hypoglossal nerve neoplasm
concepts.description: A neoplasm involving a hypoglossal nerve.
synonyms: neoplasm of the twelfth cranial nerve
tumor of the twelfth cranial nerve
tumour of the twelfth cranial nerve

concepts.label: cerebellopontine angle tumor
concepts.description: A neoplasm that affects the cerebellopontine angle. Representative examples include vestibular schwannoma and meningioma.
synonyms: neoplasm of the cerebellar Pontine angle
tumor of the cerebellar Pontine angle
tumour of the cerebellar Pontine angle

concepts.label: sympathetic neurilemmoma
concepts.description: A benign tumor derived from schwann cells of the peripheral sympathetic nervous system, including the sympathetic plexus.

concepts.label: trigeminal schwannoma
concepts.description: A schwannoma that involves the trigeminal nerve.
synonyms: neurilemmoma of the fifth cranial nerve
schwannoma of the fifth cranial nerve

concepts.label: microcystic/reticular schwannoma
concepts.description: The rarest histopathologic subtype of Schwannoma. The reported cases have been located in the gastrointestinal submucosa or subcutaneous tissue. Morphologically it is characterized by the presence of a microcyst-rich network of spindle cells with minimal amount of cytoplasm and Antoni A tissue.

concepts.label: melanotic neurilemmoma
concepts.description: A rare circumscribed, non-encapsulated and grossly pigmented nerve sheath tumor. It is composed of cells with the immunophenotypic and electron microscopic features of Schwann cells which contain melanosomes and are positive for melanoma markers. It usually involves spinal nerve roots but may occ...

concepts.label: plexiform schwannoma
concepts.description: A schwannoma characterized by a plexiform or multinodular growth pattern. It usually arises from the skin or subcutaneous tissues in the extremities, trunk, and head and neck.

concepts.label: lysosomal storage disease
concepts.description: A metabolic disorder caused by mutations in proteins critical for lysosomal function, including lysosomal enzymes, lysosomal integral membrane proteins, and proteins involved in the post-translational modification and trafficking of lysosomal proteins.

concepts.label: demyelinating disease
concepts.description: A broad group of disorders that affect the myelin sheaths that cover the neurons. Myelin sheathes cover neuronal axons in the central and peripheral nervous system and function to increase traveling impulse speeds. Disruption of this sheath impairs neuronal transmission and can result in disorder...

concepts.label: jejunal somatostatinoma
concepts.description: A somatostatin-producing neuroendocrine tumor that arises from the jejunum. It is characterized by the presence of tubulo-glandular structures.
synonyms: Delta cell tumor of the jejunum
Delta cell tumour of the jejunum
jejunal delta cell somatostatin producing tumour

concepts.label: jejunal neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant neoplasm that affects the wall of the jejunum. Representative examples include adenoma, carcinoma, and lymphoma.

concepts.label: myelitis
concepts.description: An inflammatory process affecting the spinal cord. Causes include viral infections, autoimmune disorders, vascular disorders, and toxic agents. Symptoms include weakness, paresthesia, sensory loss, pain, and incontinence.

concepts.label: tracheal disorder
concepts.description: A non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder that affects the trachea. Representative examples of non-neoplastic disorders include congenital malformations and infection. Representative examples of neoplastic disorders include carcinoma and lymphoma.

concepts.label: primary central nervous system lymphoma
concepts.description: A non-Hodgkin or Hodgkin lymphoma that arises in the brain or spinal cord as a primary lesion. There is no evidence of lymphoma outside the central nervous system at the time of diagnosis.

concepts.label: prostate embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma
concepts.description: A malignant mesenchymal neoplasm of the prostate. It is characterized by the presence of skeletal muscle exhibiting embryonic features.

concepts.label: embryonal extrahepatic bile duct rhabdomyosarcoma
concepts.description: An embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma that arises from the extrahepatic bile ducts.
synonyms: embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma (disease) of extrahepatic bile duct
embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma of extrahepatic bile duct
embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma of the extrahepatic bile duct

concepts.label: extrahepatic bile duct rhabdomyosarcoma
concepts.description: A malignant mesenchymal tumor with skeletal muscle differentiation, arising from the extrahepatic bile ducts.
synonyms: rhabdomyosarcoma of the extrahepatic bile duct

concepts.label: botryoid rhabdomyosarcoma
concepts.description: A morphologic variant of embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma arising from organs with a mucosal epithelial surface. It is characterized by the formation of a cambium layer in the affected tissue and polypoid nodules within an abundant myxoid stroma.

concepts.label: orbit embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma
concepts.description: A malignant mesenchymal neoplasm that arises from the orbit. It is characterized by the presence of skeletal muscle tissue exhibiting embryonic features.

concepts.label: orbit rhabdomyosarcoma
concepts.description: A malignant mesenchymal neoplasm with skeletal muscle differentiation that arises from the orbit.

concepts.label: spindle cell rhabdomyosarcoma
concepts.description: An uncommon variant of rhabdomyosarcoma characterized by the presence of whorls of spindle cells forming a storiform pattern. In children it usually arises in the paratesticular region. In adults it usually arises from the deep soft tissues in the head and neck.

concepts.label: subacute leukemia
concepts.description: A leukemia that is in between acute and chronic leukemia and is characterized by a moderate duration or severity.

concepts.label: thymus cancer
concepts.description: A primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm involving the thymus. This category includes malignant thymomas, thymic lymphomas, primary thymic carcinomas, and metastatic carcinomas from other anatomic sites.

concepts.label: encapsulated thymoma
concepts.description: A thymoma that is confined within the capsule and may display benign or malignant morphologic characteristics.

concepts.label: thymoma type A
concepts.description: A thymic epithelial neoplasm characterized by the presence of spindle and/or oval neoplastic epithelial cells. Lymphocytic infiltration is minimal or absent. synonyms: primary thymic epithelial neoplasm type A
primary thymic epithelial tumor type A
primary thymic epithelial tumour type A

concepts.label: invasive malignant thymoma
concepts.description: A malignant thymoma that extends beyond the capsule and infiltrates the surrounding tissues.

concepts.label: notochordal tumor
concepts.description: A bone tumor arising from the remnants of the fetal notochord. This category includes the chordoma and benign notochordal cell tumor.

concepts.label: germinoma
concepts.description: A malignant germ cell tumor arising in the central nervous system. It is characterized by the presence of primitive, large malignant germ cells and lymphocytes.

concepts.label: teratocarcinoma
concepts.description: A germ cell tumor characterized by the presence of an embryonal carcinoma component and a teratoma component.

concepts.label: teratoma
concepts.description: A non-seminomatous germ cell tumor characterized by the presence of various tissues which correspond to the different germinal layers (endoderm, mesoderm, and ectoderm). It occurs in the testis, ovary, and extragonadal sites including central nervous system, mediastinum, lung, and stomach. Accord...

concepts.label: central nervous system disorder
concepts.description: A disease involving the central nervous system.
synonyms: central nervous system disease or disorder
disease of the central nervous system
disease or disorder of central nervous system

concepts.label: angiomyolipoma
concepts.description: A neoplasm with perivascular epithelioid cell differentiation often associated with tuberous sclerosis. It is characterized by a mixture of epithelioid cells, smooth muscle, vessels, and mature adipose tissue. The kidney is the most common site of involvement. Other sites of involvement include t...

concepts.label: pericytic neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant mesenchymal neoplasm arising from the perivascular cells of the connective and soft tissues. It is characterized by the presence of pericytes that grow in a circumferential pattern around vessels.

concepts.label: hepatic angiomyolipoma
concepts.description: An angiomyolipoma arising from the liver.

concepts.label: epithelioid type angiomyolipoma
concepts.description: An angiomyolipoma composed exclusively or predominantly by polygonal epithelioid cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm, often associated with cytologic atypia.

concepts.label: purpura
concepts.description: A small blood vessel hemorrhage into the skin and/or mucous membranes. Newer lesions appear reddish in color. Older lesions are usually a darker purple color and eventually become a brownish-yellow color.

concepts.label: frontal lobe epilepsy
concepts.description: A localization-related (focal) form of epilepsy characterized by seizures which arise in the frontal lobe. A variety of clinical syndromes exist depending on the exact location of the seizure focus. Frontal lobe seizures may be idiopathic (cryptogenic) or caused by an identifiable disease process...

concepts.label: xanthomatosis
concepts.description: A condition marked by the development of widespread xanthomas, yellow tumor-like structures filled with lipid deposits. Xanthomas can be found in a variety of tissues including the skin; tendons; joints of knees and elbows. Xanthomatosis is associated with disturbance of lipid metabolism and form...

concepts.label: mesenchymal cell neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign, intermediate, or malignant neoplasm that arises from the mesenchyma-derived cells of the soft tissue or bone. Representative examples include lipoma, leiomyoma, leiomyosarcoma and osteosarcoma.

concepts.label: bone angiosarcoma
concepts.description: A high-grade malignant vascular neoplasm that arises from the bone. It is characterized by the presence of neoplastic cells with endothelial differentiation.

concepts.label: undifferentiated high grade pleomorphic sarcoma of bone
concepts.description: A rare, high-grade pleomorphic malignant neoplasm arising from the bone. It usually presents with pain which may or may not be associated with swelling in the affected area. It is characterized by the presence of spindle-shaped cells, polygonal or epithelioid cells, multinucleated giant cells, an...
synonyms: malignant fibrous histiocytoma of the bone
undifferentiated high grade pleomorphic sarcoma of bone

concepts.label: bone fibrosarcoma
concepts.description: A usually aggressive malignant neoplasm arising from the bone. It is characterized by the presence of spindle-shaped fibroblasts and collagenous stroma formation in a herringbone growth pattern.

concepts.label: extraosseous osteosarcoma
concepts.description: An osteosarcoma arising from the soft tissue.

concepts.label: bone leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: A rare aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the bone. It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

concepts.label: Ewing sarcoma of bone
concepts.description: A small round cell bone tumor that lacks morphologic, immunohistochemical, and electron microscopic evidence of neuroectodermal differentiation. It represents one of the two ends of the spectrum called Ewing sarcoma/peripheral neuroectodermal tumor. It often affects the diaphysis or metaphyseal-d...
synonyms: Ewing's sarcoma/bone peripheral primitive neuroectodermal tumour

concepts.label: chondroblastic osteosarcoma
concepts.description: An osteosarcoma characterized by the presence of atypical cartilage of variable cellularity. It may or may not be associated with the presence of myxoid areas or focal bone formation.

concepts.label: peripheral osteosarcoma
concepts.description: A usually aggressive malignant bone-forming mesenchymal neoplasm arising from the surface of the bone.

concepts.label: bone osteosarcoma
concepts.description: A usually aggressive malignant bone-forming mesenchymal neoplasm arising from the bone. It may arise de novo or from a pre-existing lesion of the bone. Pain and a palpable mass are the most frequent clinical sign and symptom. It may spread to other anatomic sites, particularly the lungs.

concepts.label: small cell osteogenic sarcoma
concepts.description: An osteosarcoma usually arising from the metaphysis of long bones. It is characterized by the presence of small cells and osteoid production. The prognosis is usually unfavorable.

concepts.label: conventional osteosarcoma
concepts.description: A high grade malignant bone-forming mesenchymal neoplasm producing osteoid. The tumor arises from the medullary portion of the bone. It affects the long bones and most commonly, the distal femur, proximal tibia, and proximal humerus. Pain with or without a palpable mass is the most common clinica...

concepts.label: metachronous osteosarcoma of the bone
concepts.description: A bone osteosarcoma that has metastasized to skeletal or extraskeletal sites.

concepts.label: cranial nerve neoplasm
concepts.description: Abnormal growth of the cells that comprise the cranial nerves.

concepts.label: liposarcoma of bone
concepts.description: A very rare malignant adipose tissue neoplasm that arises from the bone.

concepts.label: periodontal disorder
concepts.description: An inflammatory process of the gingival tissues and/or periodontal membrane of the teeth, resulting in an abnormally deep gingival sulcus, possibly producing periodontal pockets and loss of alveolar bone support.

concepts.label: histiocytosis
concepts.description: A morphologic finding indicating tissue infiltration by non-neoplastic or neoplastic histiocytes.

concepts.label: glossopharyngeal nerve neoplasm
concepts.description: A neoplasm involving a glossopharyngeal nerve.
synonyms: neoplasm of the Ninth cranial nerve
tumor of the Ninth cranial nerve
tumour of the Ninth cranial nerve

concepts.label: glossopharyngeal nerve disorder
concepts.description: A disease involving the glossopharyngeal nerve.
synonyms: disease or disorder of glossopharyngeal nerve

concepts.label: optic nerve neoplasm
concepts.description: Benign and malignant neoplasms which arise from or metastasize to the optic or second cranial nerve which extends from the optic disk of the eye and joins the optic chiasm. Clinical features may include visual loss, proptosis, and local pain. The majority of optic nerve tumors or optic gliomas.
synonyms: neoplasm of the second cranial nerve
tumor of the second cranial nerve
tumour of the second cranial nerve

concepts.label: vestibular disorder
concepts.description: Pathological processes of the vestibular labyrinth which contains part of the balancing apparatus. Patients with vestibular diseases show instability and are at risk of frequent falls.
synonyms: disease or disorder of vestibular labyrinth

concepts.label: laryngitis
concepts.description: An acute or chronic, bacterial or viral inflammatory process affecting the larynx. Signs and symptoms include sore throat, cough, swallowing difficulties, and hoarseness.

concepts.label: mammary Paget disease
concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm in which there is infiltration of the skin overlying the breast by neoplastic large cells with abundant pale cytoplasm and large nuclei with prominent nucleoli (Paget cells). It is almost always associated with an intraductal or invasive ductal carcinoma of the breast. The cl...

concepts.label: anal Paget disease
concepts.description: A slowly spreading, erythematous eczematoid plaque in the anal region. Histologically, the basal part or whole thickness of the squamous epithelium is infiltrated by large cells with abundant pale cytoplasm and large nuclei. Half of the cases are associated with an internal malignancy, most often...

concepts.label: anus adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An adenocarcinoma arising in the anal canal epithelium, including the mucosal surface, the anal glands, and the lining of fistulous tracts. The prognosis is related to the stage at diagnosis.

concepts.label: Paget disease of the penis
concepts.description: A premalignant condition morphologically characterized by the presence of the characteristic Paget cells in the intraepithelial tissue of the penis. It presents as a smooth raised reddish area that may or may not be painful. -- 2003

concepts.label: uterine disorder
concepts.description: A non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder that affects the uterine corpus or the cervix. Representative examples of non-neoplastic disorders include endometritis and cervicitis. Representative examples of neoplastic disorders include endometrial carcinoma, carcinosarcoma, and cervical carcinoma.

concepts.label: cutaneous Paget disease
concepts.description: A skin carcinoma that is characterized by infiltration of the skin by neoplastic large cells with abundant pale cytoplasm and large nuclei with prominent nucleoli.

concepts.label: skin carcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the zone of skin

concepts.label: iris cancer
concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm involving the iris.

concepts.label: uveal cancer
concepts.description: A primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm that affects the choroid, ciliary body, or iris.

concepts.label: uveal disorder
concepts.description: A non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder that affects the uvea. Representative examples include uveitis, chorioretinitis, and uveal melanoma.

concepts.label: extrahepatic bile duct signet ring cell carcinoma
concepts.description: An adenocarcinoma that arises from the extrahepatic bile ducts. It is characterized by the presence of signet ring malignant epithelial cells.
synonyms: bile duct signet Ring cell carcinoma
bile duct signet ring cell carcinoma
extrahepatic bile duct signet Ring cell carcinoma
signet Ring cell bile duct carcinoma
signet Ring cell carcinoma of bile duct
signet Ring cell carcinoma of the bile duct

concepts.label: extrahepatic bile duct adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from glandular epithelial cells of the extrahepatic bile duct
synonyms: adenocarcinoma of the extrahepatic bile duct

concepts.label: pancreatic signet ring cell adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A rare pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma with poor prognosis. It is characterized by the presence of malignant signet ring cells infiltrating the pancreatic parenchyma in an individual cell pattern.
synonyms: signet Ring cell carcinoma of pancreas
signet Ring cell carcinoma of the pancreas

concepts.label: gallbladder signet ring cell adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An adenocarcinoma that arises from the gallbladder. It is characterized by the presence of signet ring malignant epithelial cells.
synonyms: gall bladder signet ring cell carcinoma
signet Ring cell carcinoma of gallbladder
signet Ring cell carcinoma of the gallbladder

concepts.label: ampullary signet ring cell adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An adenocarcinoma arising from the ampulla of Vater. Morphologically, it is characterized by the presence of mucin-containing signet-ring cells.
synonyms: ampulla of Vater signet Ring cell carcinoma

concepts.label: ampulla of vater adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from glandular epithelial cells of the hepatopancreatic ampulla
synonyms: invasive adenocarcinoma of the ampullary region

concepts.label: acinar prostate adenocarcinoma, signet ring variant
concepts.description: A morphologic variant of acinar adenocarcinoma of the prostate gland characterized by the presence of signet ring malignant cells.
synonyms: acinar prostate adenocarcinoma, signet Ring variant
prostate gland signet ring cell carcinoma
signet Ring cell carcinoma of the prostate

concepts.label: neurofibrosarcoma
concepts.description: A malignant tumor that arises from small cutaneous nerves, is locally aggressive, and has a potential for metastasis. concepts.label: adult fibrosarcoma
concepts.description: A malignant mesenchymal neoplasm composed of fibroblasts. It is characterized by collagen production and a herringbone architectural pattern. It is more commonly seen in middle-aged and older adults. It usually affects the deep soft tissues of extremities, trunk, head and neck. Adult fibrosarcoma...

concepts.label: conventional fibrosarcoma
concepts.description: A malignant mesenchymal neoplasm composed of fibroblasts, and characterized by collagen production and usually a herringbone architectural pattern.

concepts.label: pediatric fibrosarcoma
concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm arising from the deep soft tissues in children. It is characterized by the presence of spindle-shaped fibroblasts and collagenous stroma formation in a herringbone growth pattern.

concepts.label: choroid plexus cancer
concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm involving the choroid plexus
synonyms: malignant neoplasm of the choroid plexus
malignant tumor of the choroid plexus
malignant tumour of the choroid plexus

concepts.label: cerebral ventricle cancer
concepts.description: A neoplasm that involves a brain ventricle. It may be a primary neoplasm arising from a brain ventricle, a metastasis from a distant anatomic site, or an extension of an invasive neoplasm from an adjacent brain structure.

concepts.label: adult choroid plexus neoplasm
concepts.description: A choroid plexus neoplasm that occurs in an adult.
synonyms: neoplasm of the adult choroid plexus
tumor of the adult choroid plexus
tumour of the adult choroid plexus

concepts.label: atypical choroid plexus papilloma
concepts.description: A choroid plexus papilloma characterized by increased mitotic activity.

concepts.label: childhood choroid plexus carcinoma
concepts.description: A choroid plexus carcinoma that occurs during childhood.

concepts.label: superior mesenteric artery syndrome
concepts.description: Superior mesenteric artery syndrome (SMAS) is a digestive condition that occurs when the duodenum (the first part of the small intestine) is compressed between two arteries (the aorta and the superior mesenteric artery). This compression causes partial or complete blockage of the duodenum. Sympto...
synonyms: syndromic disease of superior mesenteric artery

concepts.label: duodenal obstruction
concepts.description: Blockage of the normal flow of stomach contents through the duodenum.

concepts.label: liver cancer
concepts.description: An epithelial or non-epithelial malignant neoplasm that arises from the liver. Representative examples include hepatocellular carcinoma, intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, lymphoma, and sarcoma.
synonyms: malignant neoplasm of liver, not specified as primary or secondary

concepts.label: Sertoli cell tumor
concepts.description: A sex cord-stromal tumor of the testis or the ovary. It is characterized by the presence of Sertoli cells forming tubules. Leydig cells are rare or absent. It may be associated with Peutz-Jeghers syndrome. In males, the presenting symptom is a slow growing testicular mass. Most cases follow a ben...

concepts.label: ovarian gonadoblastoma
concepts.description: A neoplasm that arises from the ovary and is composed of tissues that resemble dysgerminoma or seminoma and are admixed with sex cord tissues. It is found in children or young adults and usually is associated with secondary sex organs abnormalities. The majority of patients present as phenotypic ...

concepts.label: testicular gonadoblastoma
concepts.description: A testicular mixed germ cell-sex cord-stromal tumor. It is usually associated with mixed gonadal dysgenesis and ambiguous genitalia. It is characterized by the presence of nests of large neoplastic germ cells and immature cells that resemble Sertoli cells.

concepts.label: ovarian mucinous cystadenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An invasive cystic adenocarcinoma arising from the ovary. It is characterized by the presence of malignant glandular epithelial cells which contain intracytoplasmic mucin. The malignant cells invade the ovarian stroma and the cystic spaces contain mucoid material. In a minority of cases both ovar...

concepts.label: ovarian cystadenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An adenocarcinoma that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of cystic structures. It includes the serous cystadenocarcinoma, mucinous cystadenocarcinoma, and clear cell cystadenocarcinoma.

concepts.label: appendix mucinous cystadenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An adenocarcinoma arising from the appendix, characterized by the presence of mucinous stroma formation and cystic structures.

concepts.label: central nervous system cancer
concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm involving the central nervous system

concepts.label: uterine cancer

concepts.label: spinal cord intramedullary teratoma
synonyms: intramedullary teratoma of the spinal cord

concepts.label: central nervous system teratoma
concepts.description: A mature or immature teratoma that affects the central nervous system.
synonyms: teratoma of the central nervous system

concepts.label: sella turcica neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant neoplasm that occurs in sella turcica. Representative examples include craniopharyngioma and pituitary gland adenoma.

concepts.label: necrosis of pituitary
concepts.description: Ischemic or hemorrhagic necrosis of the pituitary gland.

concepts.label: olfactory nerve neoplasm
concepts.description: Benign and malignant neoplasms which arise from or metastasize to the olfactory or first cranial nerve. Clinical features may include facial pain and impairments of taste or smell.
synonyms: neoplasm of the first cranial nerve
tumor of the first cranial nerve
tumour of the first cranial nerve

concepts.label: mast cell neoplasm
concepts.description: A heterogeneous group of disorders characterized by the abnormal growth and accumulation of mast cells in one or more organ systems. Recent data suggest that most variants of mast cell neoplasms are clonal disorders. (WHO, 2001)

concepts.label: cutaneous solitary mastocytoma
concepts.description: A variant of cutaneous mastocytosis which occurs as a single lesion usually in infants. It is found mostly in the wrist and trunk and there is no atypical cytomorphology.

concepts.label: olfactory nerve disorder
concepts.description: A disease involving the olfactory nerve.
synonyms: disease or disorder of olfactory nerve

concepts.label: rhabdoid tumor
concepts.description: An aggressive malignant embryonal neoplasm usually occurring during childhood. It is characterized by the presence of large cells with abundant cytoplasm, large eccentric nucleus, and a prominent nucleolus and it is associated with abnormalities of chromosome 22. It can arise from the central ner...

concepts.label: rhabdoid tumor of the kidney
concepts.description: A rhabdoid tumor that arises from the kidney. It occurs in children and it is associated with abnormalities of chromosome 22. It is characterized by the presence of cells with a large eccentric nucleus, prominent nucleolus, and abundant cytoplasm. The prognosis is poor.
synonyms: malignant rhabdoid tumor of the kidney
malignant rhabdoid tumour of the kidney

concepts.label: childhood kidney neoplasm
concepts.description: A kidney neoplasm that occurs during childhood.

concepts.label: cerebral hemisphere cancer
concepts.description: A cancer that involves the cerebral hemisphere.
synonyms: malignant neoplasm of the cerebral hemispheres
malignant tumor of the cerebral hemispheres
malignant tumour of the cerebral hemispheres

concepts.label: lung benign neoplasm
concepts.description: A non-metastasizing neoplasm that arises from the lung parenchyma or the bronchi. Representative examples include lung adenoma, lung hamartoma, and endobronchial lipoma.

concepts.label: anal mucinous adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An anal adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of mucoid stroma formation.

concepts.label: anal canal adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An anal adenocarcinoma arising from the anal canal mucosa. Morphologically, it resembles the adenocarcinoma which arises from the colorectal glandular epithelium. Symptoms include anal pruritus, discomfort when sitting, pain, change in bowel habit, and bleeding.
synonyms: adenocarcinoma arising in the anal mucosa

concepts.label: ampulla of vater mucinous adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma with glandular differentiation arising from the ampulla of Vater. Morphologically, it is characterized by the presence of mucoid stroma formation.

concepts.label: extrahepatic bile duct mucinous adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An adenocarcinoma that arises from the extrahepatic bile ducts. It is characterized by the presence of extracellular mucin that constitutes more than fifty-percent of the tumor.

concepts.label: uterine ligament mucinous adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A rare mucinous adenocarcinoma that arises from the uterine ligament.

concepts.label: uterine ligament adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A rare adenocarcinoma that arises from the uterine ligament.

concepts.label: cervical mucinous adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A usually well to moderately differentiated cervical adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of malignant glandular cells that contain significant amount of intracytoplasmic mucin.

concepts.label: fallopian tube mucinous adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An extremely rare adenocarcinoma that arises from the fallopian tube. It is characterized by the presence of neoplastic epithelial cells that contain intracytoplasmic mucin. The cases that have been reported are predominantly in situ mucinous adenocarcinomas.

concepts.label: fallopian tube mucinous tumor
concepts.description: A rare borderline or malignant epithelial tumor of the fallopian tube characterized by the presence of neoplastic epithelial cells that contain intracytoplasmic mucin and may resemble the epithelial cells of the endocervix or gastrointestinal tract.

concepts.label: fallopian tube adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from glandular epithelial cells of the fallopian tube

concepts.label: rectum mucinous adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An invasive adenocarcinoma of the rectum characterized by the presence of pools of extracellular mucin. Malignant glandular epithelial cells are present in the mucin collections. Mucin constitutes more than 50% of the lesion.

concepts.label: extracranial neuroblastoma
concepts.description: A neuroblastoma arising from an anatomic site other than the brain.

concepts.label: bladder adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from glandular epithelial cells of the urinary bladder

concepts.label: ovarian adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An adenocarcinoma that arises from the ovary. It is the most common type of ovarian carcinoma. It includes the serous adenocarcinoma, mucinous adenocarcinoma, clear cell adenocarcinoma, and endometrioid adenocarcinoma.

concepts.label: extramedullary plasmacytoma
concepts.description: A plasma cell neoplasm arising at an extraosseous site. There is no involvement of the bone marrow. It most frequently involves the oropharynx, nasopharynx, sinuses, and larynx. Other sites of involvement include the gastrointestinal tract, central nervous system, breast, skin, lymph nodes, and b...

concepts.label: solitary osseous plasmacytoma
concepts.description: A localized, clonal (malignant) plasma cell infiltrate in the bone, without peripheral blood involvement. The most commonly affected bones are the vertebrae, ribs, skull, pelvis and femur. X-rays examination reveals a solitary lytic lesion.

concepts.label: solitary plasmacytoma of chest wall
concepts.description: A solitary plasmacytoma that arises from the chest wall.
synonyms: solitary plasmacytoma of the chest wall

concepts.label: vulva verrucous carcinoma
concepts.description: A highly differentiated squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the vulva. It is characterized by the presence of a warty and hyperkeratinized surface, malignant cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, minimal cytologic atypia, and absence or rarity of mitotic figures. concepts.label: bladder squamous cell carcinoma
concepts.description: A squamous cell carcinoma of the bladder arising from metaplastic epithelium. It represents less than 10% of bladder carcinomas. concepts.label: cervical verrucous carcinoma
concepts.description: A highly differentiated variant of cervical squamous cell carcinoma characterized by the presence of a warty surface and stromal invasion with pushing borders. The malignant cells have abundant cytoplasm and minimal nuclear atypia. Koilocytosis is not present.

concepts.label: esophagus verrucous carcinoma
concepts.description: A rare variant of esophageal squamous cell carcinoma. It is an exophytic, cauliflower-like or papillary mass that can arise in any part of the esophagus. This variant of squamous cell carcinoma grows slowly and invades locally, with a very low metastasizing potential. (WHO)

concepts.label: urethral verrucous carcinoma
concepts.description: A verrucous carcinoma that involves the urethra.

concepts.label: urethra squamous cell carcinoma
concepts.description: A well differentiated, moderately differentiated, or poorly differentiated squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the male or female urethra.
synonyms: squamous cell carcinoma of the urethra

concepts.label: larynx verrucous carcinoma
concepts.description: A well differentaited, non-metastasizing squamous cell carcinoma arising from the larynx. It is an exophytic, warty, and slow growing tumor affecting predominantly older men. concepts.label: true hermaphroditism
concepts.description: A rare condition characterized by the unequivocal presence of both testicular and ovarian tissues in an individual. It is usually manifested with ambiguous external genitalia.

concepts.label: pulmonary fibrosis
concepts.description: Chronic progressive interstitial lung disorder characterized by the replacement of the lung tissue by connective tissue, leading to progressive dyspnea, respiratory failure, or right heart failure. concepts.label: intraventricular meningioma
concepts.description: A meningioma that affects the ventricles of the brain.

concepts.label: external ear disorder
concepts.description: A disease involving the external ear.
synonyms: disease or disorder of external ear

concepts.label: epidural spinal canal meningioma
concepts.description: A meningioma that arises in the epidural spinal canal space.
synonyms: meningioma of the epidural spinal canal

concepts.label: cranial nerve palsy
concepts.description: Injury to any of the cranial nerves or their nuclei in the brain resulting in muscle weakness.

concepts.label: skull base neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant neoplasm that affects the skull base.

concepts.label: adamantinous craniopharyngioma
concepts.description: A craniopharyngioma consisting of broad strands, cords and bridges of a multistratified squamous epithelium with peripheral palisading of nuclei. Diagnostic features include nodules of compact 'wet' keratin and dystrophic calcification. (Adapted from WHO)

concepts.label: papillary craniopharyngioma
concepts.description: A craniopharyngioma composed of sheets of squamous epithelium which separate to form pseudopapillae. concepts.label: hemangiopericytic tumor
concepts.description: A term that refers to vascular neoplasms with a prominent hemangiopericytic growth pattern.

concepts.label: large cell medulloblastoma
concepts.description: A medulloblastoma composed of large cells with prominent nucleoli and a larger amount of cytoplasm in contrast with the cells of the classic medulloblastoma.

concepts.label: cerebellar vermis medulloblastoma
concepts.description: A medulloblastoma arising from the vermis of the cerebellum.

concepts.label: adult medulloblastoma
concepts.description: A medulloblastoma arising from the brain, occurring in adults.

concepts.label: adult central nervous system primitive neuroectodermal neoplasm
concepts.description: A central nervous system embryonal tumor, not otherwise specified that occurs in adults.

concepts.label: melanotic medulloblastoma
concepts.description: A rare malignant embryonal neoplasm characterized by the presence of small cells which resemble the cells of classic medulloblastoma and a minor population of melanin-forming neuroepithelial cells. It usually has an unfavorable clinical course.

concepts.label: childhood central nervous system primitive neuroectodermal neoplasm

concepts.label: colonic pseudo-obstruction
concepts.description: Functional obstruction of the colon leading to megacolon in the absence of obvious colonic diseases or mechanical obstruction.
