concepts.label: functional colonic disease
concepts.description: Chronic or recurrent colonic disorders without an identifiable structural or biochemical explanation. The widely recognized irritable bowel syndrome falls into this category.

concepts.label: intestinal pseudo-obstruction
concepts.description: Intestinal pseudo-obstruction is a digestive disorder in whichthe intestinal walls are unable to contract normally (called hypomotility); the conditionresembles a true obstruction, but no actual blockage exists. concepts.label: bronchogenic carcinoma
concepts.description: A lung carcinoma arising from the bronchial epithelium.

concepts.label: bronchial neoplasm
concepts.description: Tumors or cancer of the bronchi.

concepts.label: pancreatic cystadenoma
concepts.description: A non-metastasizing cystic epithelial neoplasm arising from the exocrine pancreas.

concepts.label: pancreatic serous cystic neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant epithelial neoplasm that is usually cystic and arises from the exocrine pancreas. It is characterized by the presence of neoplastic epithelial cells that produce fluid similar to serum. Representative examples include serous cystadenoma and serous cystadenocarcinoma.

concepts.label: lipomatous cancer

concepts.description: The sudden onset of inflammation of heart muscle with myocellular necrosis; this is generally secondary to an infectious cause, and patients often have a recent history of a flu-like illness.

concepts.label: adrenal cortex disorder
concepts.description: A disease involving the adrenal cortex.

concepts.label: extrinsic cardiomyopathy
concepts.description: A cardiomyopathy that is not due to abnormalities in heart muscle cells.

concepts.label: Bartholin gland transitional cell carcinoma
concepts.description: A rare carcinoma that arises from the Bartholin gland and is characterized by the presence of malignant urothelial-type epithelial cells.
synonyms: major vestibular gland transitional cell carcinoma

concepts.label: bartholin gland carcinoma

concepts.label: benign meningioma
concepts.description: A grade I, slowly growing meningioma. Only a minority of tumors recur following complete resection.

concepts.label: secretory meningioma
concepts.description: A WHO grade I meningioma characterized by the presence of epithelial differentiation and numerous intracellular PAS positive bodies that are rich in glycogen.

concepts.label: lymphoplasmacyte-rich meningioma
concepts.description: A WHO grade I meningioma characterized by the presence of prominent chronic inflammatory infiltrates that predominate over the meningioma cells.

concepts.label: pediatric meningioma
concepts.description: A meningioma that occurs during childhood.

concepts.label: microcystic meningioma
concepts.description: A WHO grade I meningioma characterized by the presence of intercellular microcystic spaces that contain mucinous fluid.

concepts.label: bile duct cancer
concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm involving the bile duct

concepts.label: biliary tract cancer
concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm involving the biliary tree

concepts.label: benign muscle neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign mesenchymal neoplasm arising from smooth, skeletal, or cardiac muscle tissue.

concepts.label: intestinal benign neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign neoplasm that involves the intestine.
synonyms: benign neoplasms of large and/or small intestine
benign neoplasms of the large and/or small intestine

concepts.label: retinal cancer
concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm involving the retina.

concepts.label: trilateral retinoblastoma
concepts.description: Trilateral retinoblastoma refers to bilateral (or less often unilateral) retinoblastoma associated with an intracranial primitive neuroectodermal tumor in the pineal or suprasellar region. This syndrome is often associated with a increased familial incidence of retinoblastoma. (From Cancer 86(1):...

concepts.label: bilateral retinoblastoma
concepts.description: Retinoblastoma involving both eyes. This occurs in the majority of patients with the inherited variant. A minority of patient with bilateral retinoblastoma were found to have involvement of the pineal gland as well.

concepts.label: unilateral retinoblastoma
concepts.description: A retinoblastoma that only involves a single eye.

concepts.label: extraocular retinoblastoma
concepts.description: Retinoblastoma that has spread beyond the eye e.g. to brain, soft tissue/bone, bone marrow.

concepts.label: mastocytoma
concepts.description: A localized tumor composed of sheets of mast cells without atypia. It includes the cutaneous mastocytoma which involves the dermis and subcutaneous tissue, and the extracutaneous mastocytoma. Most cases of extracutaneous mastocytoma have been reported in the lung.

concepts.label: thalamic disorder
concepts.description: A disorder of the thalamus. Causes include brain neoplasms, cerebrovascular disorders, brain trauma, brain hypoxia, infections, and brain hemorrhage. Signs and symptoms include movement and sensory abnormalities, visual abnormalities, ataxia, and coma.
synonyms: disease of dorsal plus ventral thalamus
disease or disorder of dorsal plus ventral thalamus
disorder of dorsal plus ventral thalamus
dorsal plus ventral thalamus disease or disorder

concepts.label: keratitis
concepts.description: A corneal disease that is characterized by inflammation of the cornea.

concepts.label: thymic mucoepidermoid carcinoma
concepts.description: A rare primary thymic carcinoma, characterized by the presence of squamous cells, intermediate type cells, and mucus-producing cells. Published information on clinical course is limited to single-case reports.

concepts.label: mucoepidermoid breast carcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma of the breast characterized by pools of mucin and islands of malignant squamous cells. Mucoepidermoid carcinomas of the breast are extremely rare.

concepts.label: extrahepatic bile duct mucoepidermoid carcinoma
concepts.description: A mucoepidermoid carcinoma that arises from the extrahepatic bile ducts.
synonyms: mucoepidermoid carcinoma of the bile duct

concepts.label: extrahepatic bile duct carcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the extrahepatic bile duct.
synonyms: carcinoma of the extrahepatic bile duct

concepts.label: cutaneous mucoepidermoid carcinoma
concepts.description: A mucoepidermoid carcinoma that involves the zone of skin.

concepts.label: lacrimal gland mucoepidermoid carcinoma
concepts.description: An extremely rare carcinoma that arises from the lacrimal gland. It is characterized by the presence of infiltrating nests of epidermoid cells and mucus producing cells.
synonyms: mucoepidermoid carcinoma of the lacrimal gland

concepts.label: mucoepidermoid esophageal carcinoma
concepts.description: A rare carcinoma of the esophagus which contains squamous cells, mucus secreting cells, and cells of an intermediate type. (WHO)

concepts.label: laryngeal mucoepidermoid carcinoma
concepts.description: A rare mucoepidermoid carcinoma of the larynx. It usually arises from the supraglottic area. Hoarseness and dysphagia are the presenting symptoms.

concepts.label: mediastinal neural neoplasm
concepts.description: A neurogenic tumor that arises from the mediastinum. Neural tumors are the most common tumors that arise from the posterior mediastinum. Representative examples include Schwannoma, neurofibroma, and neuroblastoma.

concepts.label: nerve plexus neoplasm
concepts.description: A neoplasm (disease) that involves the nerve plexus.

concepts.label: nerve root neoplasm
concepts.description: Benign and malignant neoplasms arising from one or more of the cervical, thoracic, lumbar, sacral, or coccygeal nerve roots. The majority of these tumors are benign. concepts.label: epicardium cancer
concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm involving the epicardium.

concepts.label: prostate disorder
concepts.description: A disease involving the prostate gland.
synonyms: disease or disorder of prostate gland

concepts.label: infratentorial cancer
concepts.description: Malignant neoplasms which arise or occur within the intracranial cavity below the tentorium cerebelli. This includes neoplasms within the brain and/or surrounding spaces.

concepts.label: foramen magnum meningioma
concepts.description: A meningioma that affects the foramen magnum.

concepts.label: skin hemangioma
concepts.description: A hemangioma arising from the skin.

concepts.label: gastric neuroendocrine neoplasm
concepts.description: A neoplasm with neuroendocrine differentiation that arises from the stomach. It includes well differentiated neuroendocrine tumors (low and intermediate grade) and poorly differentiated neuroendocrine carcinomas (high grade).

concepts.label: somatoform disorder
concepts.description: A category of psychiatric disorders which are characterized by the presence of physical symptoms that suggest a medical condition but are not fully explained by any known medical reasons.

concepts.label: mixed testicular germ cell cancer
concepts.description: A malignant germ cell tumor that arises from the testis and is characterized by the presence of more than one histologic component. concepts.label: striatonigral degeneration
concepts.description: A progressive neurodegenerative disorder caused by a disruption in the connection between the striatum and the substantia nigra. It is a type of multiple system atrophy (MSA). Signs and symptoms include rigidity, instability, impaired speech, and slow movements.

concepts.label: testicular Leydig cell tumor
concepts.description: A sex cord-stromal tumor that arises from the testis and is characterized by the presence of cells that resemble the successive stages of development of Leydig cells. concepts.description: A benign or malignant tumor that arises from the testis. It is composed of granulosa cells, Leydig cells, Sertoli cells, and fibroblasts. concepts.label: breast hemangioma
concepts.description: A capillary or cavernous hemangioma arising from the breast.

concepts.label: classic pulmonary blastoma
concepts.description: A pulmonary blastoma composed of a mixture of irregular tubular structures and mesenchymal elements.

concepts.label: epithelial predominant pulmonary blastoma
concepts.description: A non-encapsulated, well defined pulmonary blastoma, composed of irregular tubular structures. It affects mostly middle-aged adults and it is rare in children. The prognosis is better compared to the biphasic pulmonary blastoma.

concepts.label: mesoblastic nephroma
concepts.description: A solid, unencapsulated tumor of the kidney composed of spindle mesenchymal cells that resemble fibroblasts or muscle cells. concepts.label: exudative glomerulonephritis
concepts.description: Inflammation of the glomeruli with infiltration by polymorphonuclear leukocytes.

concepts.label: proliferative glomerulonephritis
concepts.description: A constellation of renal disorders characterized by an increase number of cells in the glomerulus; these disorders generally present with nephrotic syndrome, and generally progress to end stage renal failure over a matter of weeks to years, depending on the etiology. concepts.label: focal embolic glomerulonephritis
concepts.description: Inflammation of a specific segment of glomeruli, which is associated with subacute bacterial endocarditis, and frequently produces microscopic hematuria without azotemia.

concepts.label: anti-basement membrane glomerulonephritis
concepts.description: Inflammation of the glomeruli secondary to presence of autoantibodies directed at specific antigenic targets within the glomerular basement membrane, causing hematuria, proteinuria, and impaired renal function.

concepts.label: diffuse glomerulonephritis
concepts.description: Inflammation of the glomeruli, in which all glomeruli are affected, resulting in renal failure.

concepts.label: subacute glomerulonephritis
concepts.description: A term that refers to glomerular damage resulting in hematuria, proteinuria, and azotemia. The histopathologic changes include rapidly progressive glomerulonephritis and membranoproliferative glomerulonephritis.

concepts.label: mesangial proliferative glomerulonephritis

concepts.label: immune-complex glomerulonephritis
concepts.description: Inflammation of the glomeruli characterized by the accumulation of antibody-antigen immune complexes, resulting in glomerular damage and impaired kidney function.

concepts.label: space motion sickness
concepts.description: Disorder characterized by nausea, vomiting, and dizziness, possibly in response to vestibular disorientation or fluid shifts associated with space flight. (From Webster's New World Dictionary)

concepts.label: disappearing bone disease

concepts.label: malignant myoepithelioma
concepts.description: An infiltrating malignant tumor characterized by the presence of atypical cells with myoepithelial differentiation. Representative examples include malignant breast myoepithelioma and salivary gland myoepithelial carcinoma.

concepts.label: diencephalic astrocytomas

concepts.label: brain stem astrocytic neoplasm

concepts.label: spinal cord astrocytoma

concepts.label: salivary gland adenoid cystic carcinoma

concepts.label: anterior horn disorder

concepts.label: esophageal adenoid cystic carcinoma

concepts.label: peritoneal serous adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A rare, serous adenocarcinoma that arises from the lining of the peritoneum. It affects females. The clinical behavior and pathologic characteristics are similar to the serous adenocarcinoma that arises from the ovary.

concepts.label: appendix carcinoma

concepts.label: granular cell carcinoma

concepts.label: small intestine adenocarcinoma

concepts.label: villous adenocarcinoma

concepts.label: renal pelvis adenocarcinoma

concepts.label: thymus gland adenocarcinoma

concepts.label: ovarian cystic teratoma
concepts.description: A teratoma that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of cystic structures. Representative example is the dermoid cyst.

concepts.label: fallopian tube leiomyoma
concepts.description: A benign smooth muscle neoplasm arising from the fallopian tube. It is characterized by the presence of spindle cells with cigar-shaped nuclei, interlacing fascicles, and a whorled pattern.

concepts.label: bizarre leiomyoma
concepts.description: A morphologic variant of leiomyoma characterized by the presence of pleomorphic muscle cells with bizarre hyperchromatic nuclei and eosinophilic cytoplasm.

concepts.label: leiomyoma cutis
concepts.description: A benign smooth muscle neoplasm arising from the arrector pili muscle, tunica media of blood vessels, and dartos muscle of the genitalia. It is characterized by the presence of spindle cells with cigar-shaped nuclei, interlacing fascicles, and a whorled pattern.

concepts.label: leiomyomatosis
concepts.description: A condition characterized by the presence of numerous small benign smooth muscle neoplasms located throughout the body.

concepts.label: cellular leiomyoma
concepts.description: A morphologic variant of classic leiomyoma characterized by a dense cellular infiltrate composed of spindle or round cells with scant cytoplasm and a less obvious interlacing fascicle pattern.

concepts.label: colorectal leiomyoma
concepts.description: A well-circumscribed benign smooth muscle neoplasm arising from the colorectal area. It is characterized by the presence of spindle cells with cigar-shaped nuclei, interlacing fascicles, and a whorled pattern.

concepts.label: appendix leiomyoma
concepts.description: A well-circumscribed benign smooth muscle neoplasm arising from the appendix. It is characterized by the presence of spindle cells with cigar-shaped nuclei, interlacing fascicles, and a whorled pattern.

concepts.label: dartoic leiomyoma
concepts.description: A cutaneous leiomyoma arising from the dartos muscle of the scrotum or labia majora.

concepts.label: epithelioid neurofibroma
concepts.description: A rare neurofibroma with epithelioid morphology.

concepts.label: neurofibroma of gallbladder
concepts.description: A non-metastasizing encapsulated neoplasm arising from nerves in the gallbladder. Morphologically, it is characterized by the presence of fibroblasts and Schwann cells.

concepts.label: plexiform neurofibroma
concepts.description: An elongated and multinodular neurofibroma, formed when the tumor involves either multiple trunks of a plexus or multiple fascicles of a large nerve, such as the sciatic. Some plexiform neurofibromas resemble a bag of worms, others produce a massive ropy enlargement of the nerve. (Adapted from WHO.)

concepts.label: cellular neurofibroma
concepts.description: A neurofibroma characterized by the presence of areas with increased cellularity.

concepts.label: atypical neurofibroma
concepts.description: A neurofibroma characterized by the presence of cellular pleomorphism.

concepts.label: pleural mesothelioma
concepts.description: A neoplasm that arises from the mesothelial cells of the pleura. The primary cause is exposure to asbestos. The major histologic variants are the epithelioid malignant mesothelioma, desmoplastic malignant mesothelioma, and sarcomatoid malignant mesothelioma. Patients present with persistent cough...

concepts.label: endometrial stromal tumor
concepts.description: Neoplasms of the endometrial stroma that sometimes involve the myometrium. These tumors contain cells that may closely or remotely resemble the normal stromal cells. concepts.label: endometrioid stromal sarcoma of the vagina
concepts.description: A rare sarcoma that arises from the vagina. This category includes low grade endometrioid stromal sarcoma and undifferentiated vaginal sarcoma.
synonyms: endometrioid stromal sarcoma of the vagina

concepts.label: endometrioid stromal and related neoplasms of the vagina
concepts.description: A category of rare neoplasms that arise from the vagina. It includes low grade endometrioid stromal sarcoma and undifferentiated sarcoma.

concepts.label: nonanaplastic kidney Wilms tumor
concepts.description: Wilms tumor of the kidney characterized by the absence of nuclear anaplasia.

concepts.label: metachronous kidney Wilms' tumor
concepts.description: Wilms tumor arising in the remaining kidney following treatment of the original Wilms tumor.
synonyms: metachronous Wilms tumor of the kidney
metachronous Wilms tumour of the kidney

concepts.label: mixed cell type kidney Wilms' tumor
concepts.description: Wilms tumor of the kidney characterized by the presence of blastema, epithelial, and mesenchymal components (triphasic pattern) or a combination of two of them (biphasic pattern).

concepts.label: blastema predominant kidney Wilms tumor

concepts.label: hereditary Wilms tumor
concepts.description: Familial embryonal neoplasm derived from nephrogenic blastemal cells. Several lines of differentiation, including blastemal, stromal and epithelial, are usually expressed. Comprises approximately 1% of Wilms tumors. (AFIP fascicle version 2.0)

concepts.label: epithelial predominant Wilms' tumor
concepts.description: Wilms tumor of the kidney characterized by the predominance of the epithelial component. The epithelial cells may form papillary and tubular patterns and pseudorosettes.

concepts.label: nodular ganglioneuroblastoma
concepts.description: A ganglioneuroblastoma characterized by the presence of neuroblastic cells in a Schwannian stroma, and the formation of hemorrhagic neuroblastic nodules.

concepts.label: intermixed schwannian stroma-rich ganglioneuroblastoma
concepts.description: A ganglioneuroblastoma characterized by the presence of neuroblastic cells in a Schwannian stroma, without the presence of hemorrhagic neuroblastic nodules.

concepts.label: peripheral ganglioneuroblastoma
concepts.description: A ganglioneuroblastoma arising from the peripheral nervous system.

concepts.label: fallopian tube adenomatoid tumor
concepts.description: A benign neoplasm that arises from the fallopian tube and originates from mesothelial cells. It is characterized by the presence of gland-like structures that are lined by flat or cuboidal cells. It is usually discovered as an incidental finding.

concepts.label: ovarian monodermal teratoma
concepts.description: A teratoma that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of tissues derived exclusively from one embryonic germ cell layer.

concepts.label: malignant struma ovarii
concepts.description: An ovarian mature teratoma characterized by the presence of aberrant thyroid tissue with morphologic changes identical to thyroid carcinoma. Patients may present with abdominal mass and unusual symptoms due to thyrotoxicosis, or with Meigs syndrome (ascites and pleural effusion).

concepts.label: benign struma ovarii
concepts.description: A mature monodermal teratoma that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of benign, thyroid-type tissues.

concepts.label: demyelinating polyneuropathy
concepts.description: Polyneuropathy that is characterized by demyelination of axons.

concepts.label: chronic polyneuropathy
concepts.description: Polyneuropathy that is persistent or long-standing in nature.

concepts.label: acute necrotizing encephalitis
concepts.description: A fulminant and often fatal demyelinating disease of the brain which primarily affects young adults and children. Clinical features include the rapid onset of weakness, seizures, and coma. It may follow a viral illness or mycoplasma pneumoniae infections but in most instances there is no precipit...

concepts.label: acute hemorrhagic encephalitis
concepts.description: Acute encephalitis that is characterized by bleeding.

concepts.label: malignant glomus tumor
concepts.description: A very rare morphologic variant of glomus tumor with a size greater than 2 cm. The tumor arises in subfascial or visceral tissues. It is characterized by the presence of atypical mitotic figures, or marked nuclear atypia, or the combination of both. It has an aggressive clinical course.

concepts.label: subungual glomus tumor
concepts.description: A glomus tumor arising in the finger and usually associated with pain.

concepts.label: benign perivascular tumor
concepts.description: A benign mesenchymal neoplasm arising from the perivascular cells of the connective and soft tissues. It is characterized by the presence of pericytes that grow in a circumferential pattern around vessels.

concepts.label: retinal hemangioblastoma
concepts.description: A hemangioblastoma that arises from the retina. It is typically a sign of von Hippel-Lindau disease. It may also be seen as an isolated entity without systemic involvement.

concepts.label: hilar cholangiocarcinoma
concepts.description: A cholangiocarcinoma that arises from the junction, or adjacent to the junction, of the right and left hepatic ducts.
synonyms: cholangiocarcinoma of hilar portion of hepatic duct
hilar portion of hepatic duct cholangiocarcinoma

concepts.label: central nervous system vasculitis
concepts.description: Vasculitis affecting the blood vessels of the brain and/or spinal cord.

concepts.label: inflammatory leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: A morphologic variant of leiomyosarcoma characterized by the presence of an inflammatory infiltrate admixed with malignant spindle cells.

concepts.label: conventional leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: An uncommon, aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm. It is characterized by the presence of atypical large spindle or round cells, nuclear palisading, tumor cell necrosis, mitotic figures and may be associated with vascular invasion.

concepts.label: central nervous system leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: An aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the central nervous system. It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.
synonyms: leiomyosarcoma of the central nervous system

concepts.label: granular cell leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: An aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm. It is characterized by the presence of malignant smooth muscle cells with granular cytoplasmic changes.

concepts.label: colon leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: An aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm that arises from the colon. It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

concepts.label: colon sarcoma
concepts.description: A malignant soft tissue neoplasm that arises from the colon. Representative examples include angiosarcoma, Kaposi sarcoma, and leiomyosarcoma.

concepts.label: heart leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: An aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the heart. It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

concepts.label: heart sarcoma
concepts.description: A malignant soft tissue neoplasm that arises from the heart. The majority of cases are angiosarcomas.

concepts.label: ovary leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: An aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the ovary. It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

concepts.label: epithelioid leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: A morphologic variant of leiomyosarcoma characterized by the presence of epithelioid round cells with eosinophilic to clear cytoplasm.

concepts.label: lung leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: An aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the lung. It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

concepts.label: anus leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: An aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the anus. It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

concepts.label: myxoid leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: A morphologic variant of leiomyosarcoma characterized by the presence of cellular pleomorphism, malignant cells with large nuclei, and a myxoid stroma.

concepts.label: small intestine leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: An aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the small intestine. It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

concepts.label: small intestinal sarcoma
concepts.description: A malignant soft tissue neoplasm that arises from the small intestine. Representative examples include leiomyosarcoma, angiosarcoma, and Kaposi sarcoma.

concepts.label: cutaneous leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: An aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the skin. It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

concepts.label: malignant dermis tumor
concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm involving the dermis.

concepts.label: gallbladder leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: An aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the gallbladder. It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

concepts.label: esophagus leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: An aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the esophagus. It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

concepts.label: gastric leiomyosarcoma

concepts.label: prostate leiomyosarcoma

concepts.label: vagina leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: An aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the vagina. It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

concepts.label: retroperitoneal leiomyosarcoma

concepts.label: breast leiomyosarcoma

concepts.label: vulvar leiomyosarcoma

concepts.label: kidney leiomyosarcoma

concepts.label: mediastinum leiomyosarcoma

concepts.label: fallopian tube germ cell tumor
concepts.description: A rare germ cell tumor that affects the fallopian tube. The vast majority of cases are teratomas.

concepts.label: thymus gland disorder
concepts.description: A non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder that affects the thymus. Representative examples include thymic hyperplasia, thymoma, and thymic carcinoma.

concepts.label: testicular granulosa cell tumor

concepts.description: A benign or malignant neoplasm arising from the hair follicle.

concepts.label: oncocytic adenoma
concepts.description: A benign neoplasm composed of large cells with abundant eosinophilic granular cytoplasm. Representative examples include oncocytic adenomas of the thyroid gland, parathyroid gland, and pituitary gland.

concepts.label: ophthalmoplegia
concepts.description: Weakness or paralysis of at least one of the muscles controlling the movement of the eye. It results from degeneration of the muscles or the neural pathways involved in the eye movement. Representative disorders causing ophthalmoplegia include ocular myopathies and multiple sclerosis.

The tumors are round and solitary and contain connective tissue and papillary or tubular structures lined by serous-type...

concepts.label: cystadenofibroma
concepts.description: A benign or borderline neoplasm that arises from the ovaries and the fallopian tubes. It is characterized by the presence of cystic glandular structures and fibrous tissue.

concepts.label: spindle cell synovial sarcoma
concepts.description: A synovial sarcoma characterized by the presence of a spindle cell component only.
synonyms: synovial sarcoma with spindle cell components

concepts.label: mediastinum synovial sarcoma
concepts.description: A synovial sarcoma arising from the mediastinum.

concepts.label: tanycytic ependymoma
concepts.description: A variant of ependymoma, often found in the spinal cord, with tumor cells arranged in fascicles of variable width and cell density. concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm involving the myocardium.

concepts.label: neurofibroma of the heart
concepts.description: A rare neurofibroma that affects the heart.

concepts.label: nasal cavity neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant neoplasm that affects the nasal cavity. Representative examples of benign neoplasms include Schneiderian papilloma and salivary gland-type adenoma. Representative examples of malignant neoplasms include carcinoma and lymphoma.

concepts.label: keratoconjunctivitis
concepts.description: Inflammation of both the cornea and the conjunctiva.

concepts.label: iridocyclitis
concepts.description: An inflammation of the iris and the ciliary body

concepts.label: gonococcal iridocyclitis
concepts.description: An iridocyclitis (disease) caused by infection with Neisseria gonorrhoeae.

concepts.label: epididymitis
concepts.description: Inflammation of the epididymis. Its clinical features include enlarged epididymis, a swollen scrotum; pain; pyuria; and fever. It is usually related to infections in the urinary tract, which likely spread to the epididymis through either the vas deferens or the lymphatics of the spermatic cord.

concepts.label: diabetes insipidus
concepts.description: A disorder characterized by excretion of large amounts of urine, accompanied by excessive thirst. Causes include deficiency of antidiuretic hormone or failure of the kidneys to respond to antidiuretic hormone. It may also be drug-related.

concepts.label: blepharitis
concepts.description: Inflammation of the eyelids near the eyelashes.

concepts.label: cholangitis
concepts.description: An acute or chronic inflammatory process affecting the biliary tract.

concepts.label: fatty liver disease
concepts.description: A reversible condition wherein large vacuoles of triglyceride fat accumulate in liver cells via the process of steatosis.

concepts.label: cancer of isthmus of fallopian tube
concepts.description: A cancer that involves the UBERON:0016632.
synonyms: cancer of isthmus of fallopian tube
malignant isthmus of fallopian tube neoplasm
malignant neoplasm of isthmus of fallopian tube

concepts.label: infectious meningitis
concepts.description: Inflammation of the meninges of the brain and/or spinal cord caused by an infectious agent (viral, bacterial, or fungal). Symptoms include headache, fever, vomiting, neck stiffness, photophobia, confusion, and seizures.

concepts.label: mononeuritis of lower limb
concepts.description: A mononeuritis simplex that involves the hindlimb.

concepts.label: pulmonary eosinophilia
concepts.description: A condition characterized by infiltration of the lung with eosinophils due to inflammation or other disease processes. Major eosinophilic lung diseases are the eosinophilic pneumonias caused by infections, allergens, or toxic agents.

concepts.label: chronic eosinophilic pneumonia
concepts.description: Chronic inflammatory disorder of the lungs characterized by the presence of eosinophils in the interalveolar septa and alveolar spaces and peripheral blood eosinophilia. Chest x-rays reveal peripheral infiltrates. Approximately half of the patients have history of asthma or atopic disease. Signs ...

concepts.label: tuberculous pneumothorax
concepts.description: A pneumothorax caused by tuberculosis infection, typically resulting from rupture of a cavitary tuberculous lesion into the pleural space.

concepts.label: osteosclerotic plasma cell myeloma
concepts.description: A plasma cell neoplasm associated with osteosclerotic and fibrotic changes in the bone trabeculae. Often, the lymph nodes show changes resembling the plasma cell variant of Castleman disease. It is often part of POEMS syndrome which is characterized by polyneuropathy, organomegaly, endocrinopathy...

concepts.label: refractory plasma cell neoplasm
concepts.description: A plasma cell neoplasm that is resistant to treatment.

concepts.label: non-secretory plasma cell myeloma
concepts.description: A rare type of multiple myeloma in which the plasma cells synthesize but do not secrete immunoglobulins. As a result, none of the immunoglobulins appear out of the normal range. The symptoms are generally the same with those of immunoglobulin-secreting myeloma; however, the incidence of renal ins...

concepts.label: peripheral nerve schwannoma
concepts.description: A benign, usually encapsulated slow growing tumor of the peripheral nervous system composed of Schwann cells. It recurs infrequently and only rare cases associated with malignant transformation have been reported.

concepts.label: nasopharyngeal disorder
concepts.description: A non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder that affects the nasopharynx. Representative examples include nasopharyngitis, angiofibroma, and carcinoma.

concepts.label: bronchiectasis
concepts.description: Segmental, irreversible dilation of the bronchial tree resulting in the accumulation of secretions which leads to obstruction. The most common cause is bacterial infection.

concepts.label: Krukenberg carcinoma
concepts.description: Metastatic signet-ring cell carcinoma to the ovary. The primary site is the gastrointestinal tract or breast.

concepts.label: necrotizing fasciitis
concepts.description: Necrotizing fasciitis is a serious infection of the skin, the tissue just beneath the skin (subcutaneous tissue), and the tissue that covers internal organs (fascia). Necrotizing fasciitis can be caused by several different types of bacteria, and the infection can arise suddenly and spread quickl...

concepts.label: intravascular fasciitis
concepts.description: A rare self-limiting, rapidly growing, non-encapsulated benign neoplasm that arises from the vessels. It is characterized by the presence of plump spindle-shaped fibroblasts, multinucleated osteoclast-like giant cells, chronic inflammatory infiltrate, red blood cell extravasation, and high mitoti...

concepts.label: neurofibroma of the esophagus
concepts.description: A non-metastasizing encapsulated neoplasm arising from nerves in the esophagus. Morphologically, it is characterized by the presence of fibroblasts and Schwann cells.

concepts.label: stomatitis
concepts.description: Inflammation of the oral mucosa due to local or systemic factors.

concepts.label: pathologic nystagmus
concepts.description: Involuntary movements of the eyeballs. The presence or absence of nystagmus is often used in the diagnosis of a variety of neurological and visual disorders.

concepts.label: ulcerative stomatitis
concepts.description: Inflammation of the mouth mucosa associated with the presence of ulcers.

concepts.label: pulmonary emphysema
concepts.description: A subcategory of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). It occurs in people who smoke and suffer from chronic bronchitis. It is characterized by inflation of the alveoli, alveolar wall damage, and reduction in the number of alveoli, resulting in difficulty breathing.

concepts.label: ophthalmia neonatorum
concepts.description: Inflammation of the conjunctiva in a newborn due to chemical or infectious causes. Aseptic conjunctivitis is often related to the use of prophylactic medications for infectious conjunctivitis. Septic conjunctivitis is related to perinatal exposure to microorganisms.

concepts.label: tenosynovitis
concepts.description: Inflammation of the synovial lining of a tendon sheath. Causes include trauma, tendon stress, bacterial disease (gonorrhea, tuberculosis), rheumatic disease, and gout. Common sites are the hand, wrist, shoulder capsule, hip capsule, hamstring muscles, and Achilles tendon. The tendon sheaths becom...

concepts.label: tendinitis
concepts.description: Inflammation of a tendon, usually resulting from an overuse injury. It is characterized by swelling of the tendon, tenderness around the inflamed tendon, and pain while moving the affected area of the body.

concepts.label: vitreous disorder
concepts.description: A disease involving the vitreous humor.
synonyms: disease or disorder of vitreous humor
disease or disorder of vitreous humour

concepts.label: upper respiratory tract disorder
concepts.description: A disease involving the upper respiratory tract.
synonyms: disease or disorder of upper respiratory tract
upper respiratory tract disease or disorder

concepts.label: biliary tract disorder
concepts.description: A disease involving the biliary tree.
synonyms: disease or disorder of biliary tree

concepts.label: myositis fibrosa
concepts.description: A form of myositis that is characterized by the formation of connective tissue within the muscle.

concepts.label: angioid streaks of choroid
concepts.description: A angioid streaks that involves the optic choroid.

concepts.label: eye degenerative disorder
concepts.description: A neurodegenerative disease that involves the eye.
synonyms: eyeball of camera-type eye neurodegenerative disease
neurodegenerative disease of eyeball of camera-type eye

concepts.label: choroidal sclerosis
concepts.description: A neurodegenerative disease that involves the optic choroid.

concepts.label: refractive error
concepts.description: A defect in the focusing of light on the retina as in astigmatism, myopia, or hyperopia.

concepts.label: intestinal disaccharidase deficiency
concepts.description: Inherited or acquired disorders of sugar metabolism. Deficiencies of lactase, maltase or sucrase-isomaltase usually occur irreversibly and independent of one another. Congenital deficiencies are rare whereas acquired deficiencies are more common and may be seen following intestinal mucosal brush-...
synonyms: intestinal disaccharidase deficiency and disaccharide malabsorption

concepts.label: alopecia
concepts.description: Hair loss usually from the scalp. It may result in bald spots or spread to the entire scalp or the entire epidermis. It may be androgenetic or caused by chemotherapeutic agents, compulsive hair pulling, autoimmune disorders or congenital conditions.

concepts.label: mitral valve prolapse
concepts.description: A fairly common and often benign valvular heart disorder characterized by redundancy or hooding of mitral valve leaflets so that they prolapse into the left atrium, often causing mitral regurgitation. It is often a symptomless condition but may be marked by varied symptoms (e.g. chest pain, fatig...

concepts.label: cardiovascular syphilis
concepts.description: A tertiary syphilis that is manifested as aneurysm formation in the ascending aorta, caused by chronic inflammatory destruction of the vasa vasorum, insufficiency of the aortic valve, or narrowing of the coronary arteries.

concepts.label: lymph node disorder
concepts.description: Any disorder of the lymph nodes.
synonyms: disease or disorder of lymph node

concepts.label: hypoplastic left heart syndrome
concepts.description: Hypoplastic left heart syndrome (HLHS) refers to the abnormal development of the left-sided cardiac structures, resulting in obstruction to blood flow from the left ventricular outflow tract. In addition, the syndrome includes underdevelopment of the left ventricle, aorta, and aortic arch, as wel...

concepts.label: eosinophilia-myalgia syndrome
concepts.description: A complex systemic syndrome with inflammatory and autoimmune components that affect the skin, fascia, muscle, nerve, blood vessels, lung, and heart. Diagnostic features generally include eosinophilia, myalgia severe enough to limit usual activities of daily living, and the absence of coexisting i...
synonyms: severe muscle pain and abnormally high eosinophils
syndrome with inflammatory and autoimmune components that affect the skin, fascia, muscle, nerve, blood vessels, lung, and heart

concepts.label: orbit lymphoma
concepts.description: A lymphoma that arises from the structures of the orbit. Representative examples include mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue lymphoma, follicular lymphoma, and diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.

concepts.label: orbit sarcoma
concepts.description: A malignant soft tissue neoplasm that arises from the structures of the orbit. The majority of the cases are rhabdomyosarcomas.

concepts.label: neurosyphilis
concepts.description: Infection of the brain or spinal cord by Treponema pallidum. It occurs many years following the original infection which remained untreated. Signs and symptoms include abnormal gait, blindness, depression, paralysis, seizures and dementia.

concepts.label: B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia
concepts.description: A neoplasm of lymphoblasts committed to the B-cell lineage, typically composed of small to medium-sized blast cells. When the neoplasm involves predominantly the bone marrow and the peripheral blood, it is called B acute lymphoblastic leukemia. When it involves nodal or extranodal sites, it is ca...

concepts.label: B-cell chronic lymphocytic leukemia
concepts.description: B-cell chronic lymphocytic leukemia (B-CLL) is a type of B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma, and the most common form of leukemia in Western countries, affecting elderly adults (mean age of 67 and 72 years) with a slight male predominance (1.7:1), and characterized by a highly variable clinical presenta...

concepts.label: neoplasm of mature B-cells
concepts.description: A neoplasm of follicle center B cells which has at least a partial follicular pattern. Follicular lymphomas comprise about 35% of adult non-Hodgkin lymphomas in the U.S. and 22% worldwide. Most patients have widespread disease at diagnosis. Morphologically, follicular lymphomas are classified as ...

concepts.label: gastric carcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the stomach.

concepts.label: Hodgkins lymphoma
concepts.description: A heterogeneous group of malignant lymphoid neoplasms of B-cell origin characterized histologically by the presence of Hodgkin and Reed-Sternberg (HRS) cells in the vast majority of cases. There are two distinct subtypes: nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma and classical Hodgkin lymph...

concepts.label: invasive ductal breast carcinoma
concepts.description: The most common type of invasive breast carcinoma, accounting for approximately 70% of breast carcinomas. The gross appearance is usually typical with an irregular stellate outline. Microscopically, randomly arranged epithelial elements are seen. When large sheets of malignant cells are present, ...
synonyms: infiltrating ductal carcinoma of the breast
invasive ductal carcinoma of the breast
invasive ductal carcinoma, No specific type

concepts.label: mucinous adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An invasive adenocarcinoma composed of malignant glandular cells which contain intracytoplasmic mucin. Often, the infiltrating glandular structures are associated with mucoid stromal formation. It may arise from the large and small intestine, appendix, stomach, lung, ovary, breast, corpus uteri, ...

concepts.label: oral cavity squamous cell carcinoma
concepts.description: A squamous cell carcinoma arising from the oral cavity. It affects predominantly adults in their fifth and sixth decades of life and is associated with alcohol and tobacco use. Human papillomavirus is present in approximately half of the cases. It is characterized by a tendency to metastasize ear...
synonyms: squamous cell carcinoma of oral cavity
squamous cell carcinoma of the mouth
squamous cell carcinoma of the oral cavity

concepts.label: plasma cell neoplasm
concepts.description: A clonal proliferation of immunoglobulin-secreting plasma cells. This category includes plasma cell myeloma, plasma cell leukemia, plasmacytoma, monoclonal immunoglobulin deposition disease, and monoclonal gammopathy of undetermined significance.

concepts.label: monoclonal gammopathy
concepts.description: A condition characterized by the abnormal presence of monoclonal immunoglobulins in the blood or urine.

concepts.label: T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia
concepts.description: Acute lymphoblastic leukemia of T-cell origin. It comprises about 15% of childhood cases and 25% of adult cases. It is more common in males than females. (WHO, 2001)

concepts.label: peripheral T-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified
concepts.description: Aggressive nodal or extranodal mature (peripheral) T-cell lymphomas that do not belong to the better defined entities of the remainder of mature T-cell lymphomas. This category includes the following variants: lymphoepithelioid cell variant (Lennert's lymphoma), follicular variant, and T-zone var...
synonyms: peripheral T-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified

concepts.label: acinar cell carcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the acinar cell

concepts.label: acute lymphoblastic leukemia
concepts.description: Leukemia with an acute onset, characterized by the presence of lymphoblasts in the bone marrow and the peripheral blood. It includes the acute B lymphoblastic leukemia and acute T lymphoblastic leukemia.

concepts.label: acute quadriplegic myopathy
concepts.description: Acute quadriplegic myopathy (AQM) is a specific acquired myopathy in ICU patients. Patients with AQM are characterized by severe muscle weakness and atrophy of spinal nerve innervated limb and trunk muscles, while cranial nerve innervated craniofacial muscles, sensory and cognitive functions are ...

concepts.label: adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A common cancer characterized by the presence of malignant glandular cells. Morphologically, adenocarcinomas are classified according to the growth pattern (e.g., papillary, alveolar) or according to the secreting product (e.g., mucinous, serous). Representative examples of adenocarcinoma are duc...

concepts.label: adenoid cystic carcinoma
concepts.description: A malignant tumor arising from the epithelial cells. Microscopically, the neoplastic epithelial cells form cylindrical spatial configurations (cribriform or classic type of adenoid cystic carcinoma), cordlike structures (tubular type of adenoid cystic carcinoma), or solid structures (basaloid var...

concepts.label: adenoma
concepts.description: A neoplasm arising from the epithelium. It may be encapsulated or non-encapsulated but non-invasive. The neoplastic epithelial cells may or may not display cellular atypia or dysplasia. In the gastrointestinal tract, when dysplasia becomes severe it is sometimes called carcinoma in situ. Represen...

concepts.label: adrenal gland pheochromocytoma
concepts.description: A benign or malignant neuroendocrine neoplasm of the sympathetic nervous system that secretes catecholamines. It arises from the chromaffin cells of the adrenal medulla. Clinical presentation includes headaches, palpitations, chest and abdominal pain, hypertension, fever, and tremor. Microscopica...
synonyms: chromaffin paraganglioma of the adrenal gland

concepts.label: Alzheimer disease
concepts.description: A progressive, neurodegenerative disease characterized by loss of function and death of nerve cells in several areas of the brain leading to loss of cognitive function such as memory and language.

concepts.label: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis
concepts.description: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a neurodegenerative disease characterized by progressive muscular paralysis reflecting degeneration of motor neurons in the primary motor cortex, corticospinal tracts, brainstem and spinal cord.

concepts.label: angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A mature T-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma, characterized by systemic disease and a polymorphous infiltrate involving lymph nodes and extranodal sites. The clinical course is typically aggressive.

concepts.label: atopic eczema
concepts.description: A common chronic pruritic inflammatory skin disease with a strong genetic component. Onset typically occurs during the first 2 years of life.

concepts.label: atrial fibrillation
concepts.description: A disorder characterized by an electrocardiographic finding of a supraventricular arrhythmia characterized by the replacement of consistent P waves by rapid oscillations or fibrillatory waves that vary in size, shape and timing and are accompanied by an irregular ventricular response. (CDISC)

concepts.label: spermatogenic failure
concepts.description: A male infertility characterized by dirsuption of the process of sperm development from diploid cells into mature haploid spermatozoa.

concepts.label: urinary bladder carcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the urinary bladder

concepts.label: urinary bladder neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant, primary or metastatic neoplasm of the bladder. - 2003

concepts.label: breast adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from glandular epithelial cells of the breast

concepts.label: breast carcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the breast

concepts.label: minimally invasive lung adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A solitary adenocarcinoma arising from the lung measuring 3 cm or less. It is characterized by a predominantly lepidic pattern and 5 mm or less invasion in greatest dimension. It is usually a non-mucinous adenocarcinoma, but rarely may be mucinous.

concepts.label: cancer
concepts.description: A tumor composed of atypical neoplastic, often pleomorphic cells that invade other tissues. Malignant neoplasms often metastasize to distant anatomic sites and may recur after excision. The most common malignant neoplasms are carcinomas (adenocarcinomas or squamous cell carcinomas), Hodgkin and n...

concepts.label: carcinoma
concepts.description: A malignant tumor arising from epithelial cells. Carcinomas that arise from glandular epithelium are called adenocarcinomas, those that arise from squamous epithelium are called squamous cell carcinomas, and those that arise from transitional epithelium are called transitional cell carcinomas. Mo...

concepts.label: cardiomyopathy
concepts.description: A disease of the heart muscle or myocardium proper. Cardiomyopathies may be classified as either primary or secondary, on the basis of etiology, or on the pathophysiology of the lesion: hypertrophic, dilated, or restrictive.

concepts.label: cardiovascular disorder
concepts.description: A disease involving the cardiovascular system.
synonyms: disease or disorder of cardiovascular system

concepts.label: childhood acute myeloid leukemia
concepts.description: Acute myeloid leukemia occurring in childhood.

concepts.label: chondroblastoma
concepts.description: A benign, chondroid-producing, well-circumscribed, lytic neoplasm usually arising from the epiphysis of long bones. It is characterized by the presence of chondroblasts, osteoclast-like giant cells, chondroid formation, calcification, and mitotic activity. In aggressive cases, there is rearrangem...

concepts.label: chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
concepts.description: A chronic and progressive lung disorder characterized by the loss of elasticity of the bronchial tree and the air sacs, destruction of the air sacs wall, thickening of the bronchial wall, and mucous accumulation in the bronchial tree. The pathologic changes result in the disruption of the air flo...

concepts.label: chronic pancreatitis
concepts.description: A chronic inflammatory process causing damage and fibrosis of the pancreatic parenchyma. Signs and symptoms include abdominal pain, malabsorption and diabetes mellitus.

concepts.label: clear cell adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm composed of glandular epithelial clear cells. Various architectural patterns may be seen, including papillary, tubulocystic, and solid.

concepts.label: clear cell renal carcinoma
concepts.description: A malignant epithelial neoplasm of the kidney characterized by the presence of lipid-containing clear cells within a vascular network. The tumor may metastasize to unusual sites and late metastasis is common.
synonyms: clear cell adenocarcinoma of the kidney
clear cell carcinoma of the kidney
renal cell carcinoma, clear cell adenocarcinoma

concepts.label: clear cell sarcoma of kidney
concepts.description: A rare pediatric sarcoma affecting the kidney. It is characterized by the presence of epithelioid or spindle cells forming cords or nests, separated by fibrovascular septa. It is associated with internal tandem duplications in the BCOR gene. It metastasizes to lung, bone, brain and soft tissue.
synonyms: childhood clear cell sarcoma of the kidney
clear cell sarcoma of the kidney

concepts.label: colon mucinous adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An invasive adenocarcinoma of the colon characterized by the presence of pools of extracellular mucin. Malignant glandular epithelial cells are present in the mucin collections. Mucin constitutes more than 50% of the lesion.

concepts.label: colorectal adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: The most common type of colorectal carcinoma. It is characterized by the presence of malignant glandular epithelial cells invading through the muscularis mucosa into the submucosa. Histologic variants include mucinous adenocarcinoma, signet ring cell carcinoma, medullary carcinoma, serrated adeno...

concepts.label: congestive heart failure
concepts.description: Failure of the heart to pump a sufficient amount of blood to meet the needs of the body tissues, resulting in tissue congestion and edema. Signs and symptoms include shortness of breath, pitting edema, enlarged tender liver, engorged neck veins, and pulmonary rales.

concepts.label: coronary artery disorder
concepts.description: Narrowing of the coronary arteries due to fatty deposits inside the arterial walls. The diagnostic criteria may include documented history of any of the following: documented coronary artery stenosis greater than or equal to 50% (by cardiac catheterization or other modality of direct imaging of t...
synonyms: disease or disorder of coronary artery

concepts.label: cutaneous melanoma
concepts.description: A primary melanoma arising from atypical melanocytes in the skin. Precursor lesions include acquired and congenital melanocytic nevi, and dysplastic nevi. Several histologic variants have been recognized, including superficial spreading melanoma, acral lentiginous melanoma, nodular melanoma, and ...
synonyms: malignant melanoma of skin stage unspecified

concepts.label: dedifferentiated chondrosarcoma
concepts.description: An aggressive morphologic variant of chondrosarcoma. It is composed of a low grade chondrosarcoma and a high grade non-cartilagenous sarcomatous component. Due to the aggressive nature of the disease, its prognosis is poor.

concepts.label: diabetes mellitus
concepts.description: A metabolic disorder characterized by abnormally high blood sugar levels due to diminished production of insulin or insulin resistance/desensitization.

concepts.label: diffuse gastric adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An adenocarcinoma arising from the stomach. Microscopically, it is characterized by the presence of a diffuse infiltrate, composed of individual adenocarcinoma cells or groups of adenocarcinoma cells in a fibrous or mucoid stroma. Many cells contain mucin droplets, producing a signet-ring configu...
synonyms: adenocarcinoma of the linitis plastica type

concepts.label: diffuse scleroderma
concepts.description: A variant of systemic scleroderma characterized by sclerosis of the skin, Raynaud phenomenon, and organ involvement, including pulmonary fibrosis, renal disease, and gastrointestinal tract involvement.

concepts.label: intestinal disorder
concepts.description: A non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder that affects the small or large intestine.

concepts.label: dilated cardiomyopathy
concepts.description: Cardiomyopathy which is characterized by dilation and contractile dysfunction of the left and right ventricles. It may be idiopathic, or it may result from a myocardial infarction, myocardial infection, or alcohol abuse. It is a cause of congestive heart failure.

concepts.label: endometrioid adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of malignant glandular epithelial cells resembling endometrial cells. It can arise from the uterine body, ovary, fallopian tube, cervix, vagina, and uterine ligament.
synonyms: endometrioid carcinoma of female reproductive system
endometrioid carcinoma of the female reproductive system

concepts.label: epilepsy
concepts.description: A brain disorder characterized by episodes of abnormally increased neuronal discharge resulting in transient episodes of sensory or motor neurological dysfunction, or psychic dysfunction. These episodes may or may not be associated with loss of consciousness or convulsions.

concepts.label: esophageal adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A malignant tumor with glandular differentiation arising predominantly from Barrett mucosa in the lower third of the esophagus. Rare examples of esophageal adenocarcinoma deriving from ectopic gastric mucosa in the upper esophagus have also been reported. Grossly, esophageal adenocarcinomas are s...

concepts.label: essential thrombocythemia
concepts.description: A chronic myeloproliferative neoplasm that involves primarily the megakaryocytic lineage. It is characterized by sustained thrombocytosis in the blood, increased numbers of large, mature megakaryocytes in the bone marrow, and episodes of thrombosis and/or hemorrhage. (WHO, 2008)

concepts.label: fibromatosis
concepts.description: A poorly circumscribed neoplasm arising from the soft tissues. It is characterized by the presence of spindle-shaped fibroblasts and an infiltrative growth pattern.

concepts.label: follicular thyroid adenoma
concepts.description: A benign, encapsulated tumor, arising from the follicular cells of the thyroid gland. It may be associated with thyroid hormone secretion but it does not have malignant characteristics.
synonyms: follicular adenoma of the thyroid gland

concepts.label: ganglioneuroma
concepts.description: A benign neuroblastic tumor of the sympathetic nervous system that occurs in childhood. Ganglioneuroma typically arises from the sympathetic trunk in the mediastinum. Histologic features include spindle cell proliferation (resembling a neurofibroma) and the presence of large ganglion cells. Commo...

concepts.label: thyroid gland follicular carcinoma
concepts.description: A differentiated adenocarcinoma arising from the follicular cells of the thyroid gland. The nuclear features which characterize the thyroid gland papillary carcinoma are absent. Radiation exposure is a risk factor and it comprises approximately 10% to 15% of thyroid cancers. Clinically, it usuall...
synonyms: follicular carcinoma of the thyroid gland

concepts.label: ganglioneuroblastoma
concepts.description: A neuroblastic tumor characterized by the presence of neuroblastic cells, ganglion cells, and a stroma with Schwannian differentiation constituting more than fifty-percent of the tumor volume. There are two histologic subtypes identified: ganglioneuroblastoma, intermixed and ganglioneuroblastoma,...

concepts.label: gastric adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from glandular epithelial cells of the stomach

concepts.label: gastric intestinal type adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An adenocarcinoma of the stomach arising on a background of intestinal metaplasia. Microscopically, it is characterized by a glandular pattern and it closely resembles a colonic adenocarcinoma. Grossly, it tends to be nodular, polypoid or ulcerated.

concepts.label: reproductive system disorder
concepts.description: A disease involving the reproductive system.
synonyms: disease or disorder of reproductive system

concepts.label: germ cell tumor
concepts.description: A benign or malignant, gonadal or extragonadal neoplasm that originates from germ cells. Representative examples include teratoma, seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, and yolk sac tumor.
synonyms: malignant tumour of the germ cell

concepts.label: glaucoma
concepts.description: Increased pressure in the eyeball due to obstruction of the outflow of aqueous humor.

concepts.label: hyperplasia
concepts.description: An abnormal increase in the number of cells in an organ or a tissue with consequent enlargement.

concepts.label: hypertensive disorder
concepts.description: Persistently high systemic arterial blood pressure. Based on multiple readings (blood pressure determination), hypertension is currently defined as when systolic pressure is consistently greater than 140 mm Hg or when diastolic pressure is consistently 90 mm Hg or more.

concepts.label: hypertrophic cardiomyopathy
concepts.description: A condition in which the myocardium is hypertrophied without an obvious cause. The hypertrophy is generally asymmetric and may be associated with obstruction of the ventricular outflow tract.

concepts.label: immune system disorder
concepts.description: A disorder resulting from an abnormality in the immune system.
synonyms: disease or disorder of immune system

concepts.label: infertility disorder
concepts.description: Inability to conceive for at least one year after trying and having unprotected sex. Causes of female infertility include endometriosis, fallopian tubes obstruction, and polycystic ovary syndrome. Causes of male infertility include abnormal sperm production or function, blockage of the epididymis...

concepts.label: pancreatic insulin-producing neuroendocrine tumor
concepts.description: An insulin-producing neuroendocrine tumor arising from the beta cells of the pancreas. It may or may not be associated with inappropriate secretion of insulin and an associated clinical syndrome.
synonyms: Beta cell tumor of the pancreas
Beta cell tumour of the pancreas
beta cell tumor of the pancreas
beta cell tumour of the pancreas
insulin-producing tumor of the islet cells
insulin-producing tumour of the islet cells

concepts.label: ischemic disease
concepts.description: Lack of blood supply to an area of the body, resulting in impairment of tissue oxygenation.

concepts.label: Kaposi's sarcoma
concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm characterized by a vascular proliferation which usually contains blunt endothelial cells. concepts.label: keratinizing squamous cell carcinoma
concepts.description: Squamous cell carcinomas with morphologically prominent production of keratin.

concepts.label: large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma
concepts.description: A usually aggressive carcinoma composed of large malignant cells which display neuroendocrine characteristics.
