concepts.label: leiomyosarcoma
concepts.description: An uncommon, aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, usually occurring in post-menopausal women. It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells. Morphologic variants include epithelioid, granular cell, inflammatory and myxoid leimyosarcomas.

concepts.label: leukemia
concepts.description: A malignant (clonal) hematologic disorder, involving hematopoietic stem cells and characterized by the presence of primitive or atypical myeloid or lymphoid cells in the bone marrow and the blood. Leukemias are classified as acute or chronic based on the degree of cellular differentiation and the...

concepts.label: liposarcoma
concepts.description: A usually painless malignant tumor that arises from adipose tissue. Microscopically, it may contain a spectrum of neoplastic adipocytes ranging from lipoblasts to pleomorphic malignant adipocytes. Morphologic variants include: well differentiated, dedifferentiated, pleomorphic, and myxoid liposar...

concepts.label: lung adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from the lung and is characterized by the presence of malignant glandular epithelial cells. There is a male predilection with a male to female ratio of 2:1. Usually lung adenocarcinoma is asymptomatic and is identified through screening studies or as an incidental radiolog...

concepts.label: lymphoma
concepts.description: A malignant (clonal) proliferation of B- lymphocytes or T- lymphocytes which involves the lymph nodes, bone marrow and/or extranodal sites. This category includes Non-Hodgkin lymphomas and Hodgkin lymphomas.

concepts.label: mesothelioma
concepts.description: A usually malignant and aggressive neoplasm of the mesothelium which is often associated with exposure to asbestos.

concepts.label: metabolic disease
concepts.description: A congenital disorder (due to inherited enzyme abnormality) or acquired (due to failure of a metabolically important organ) disorder resulting from an abnormal metabolic process.

concepts.label: monophasic synovial sarcoma
concepts.description: A synovial sarcoma characterized by the presence of an epithelial or a spindle cell component only.

concepts.label: neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant tissue growth resulting from uncontrolled cell proliferation. Benign neoplastic cells resemble normal cells without exhibiting significant cytologic atypia, while malignant cells exhibit overt signs such as dysplastic features, atypical mitotic figures, necrosis, nuclear ple...

concepts.label: nervous system disorder
concepts.description: A non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder that affects the brain, spinal cord, or peripheral nerves.
synonyms: disease or disorder of nervous system

concepts.label: neuroblastoma
concepts.description: Neuroblastoma (NB) is the most common solid, extracranial childhood tumor. It is an aggressive pediatric cancer that originates from neural crest tissues of the sympathetic nervous system.

concepts.label: melanocytic nevus
concepts.description: A neoplasm composed of melanocytes that usually appears as a dark spot on the skin.

concepts.label: thyroid gland papillary carcinoma
concepts.description: A differentiated adenocarcinoma arising from the follicular cells of the thyroid gland. Radiation exposure is a risk factor and it is the most common malignant thyroid lesion, comprising 75% to 80% of all thyroid cancers in iodine sufficient countries. Diagnostic procedures include thyroid ultras...
synonyms: papillary cancer of the thyroid gland
papillary carcinoma of the thyroid gland

concepts.label: periodontitis
concepts.description: An acute or chronic inflammatory process that affects the tissues that surround and support the teeth.

concepts.label: pertussis
concepts.description: A contagious bacterial respiratory infection caused by Bordetella pertussis. It is characterized by severe and uncontrollable cough, resulting in a whooping sound during breathing following the cough.
synonyms: Bordetella pertussis caused disease or disorder

concepts.label: phyllodes tumor
concepts.description: A benign, borderline, or malignant fibroepithelial neoplasm arising from the breast and rarely the prostate gland. It may recur following resection. The recurrence rates are higher for borderline and malignant phyllodes tumors. In borderline and malignant phyllodes tumors metastases to distant an...

concepts.label: polyp
concepts.description: A usually exophytic mass attached to the underlying tissue by a broad base or a thin stalk. Polyps can be neoplastic or non-neoplastic. Neoplastic polyps usually represent proliferations of the epithelium, and are commonly seen in the gastrointestinal tract. Polyps of the gastrointestinal tract a...

concepts.label: preeclampsia
concepts.description: Preeclampsia is a hypertensive disorder of pregnancy that is characterized by new-onset hypertension with proteinuria presenting after 20 weeks of gestation, and depending on mild or severe forms may initially present with severe headache, visual disturbances, and hyperreflexia.

concepts.label: prostate adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from glandular epithelial cells of the prostate gland

concepts.label: psoriasis
concepts.description: An autoimmune condition characterized by red, well-delineated plaques with silvery scales that are usually on the extensor surfaces and scalp. They can occasionally present with these manifestations: pustules; erythema and scaling in intertriginous areas, and erythroderma, that are often distribu...

concepts.label: mental disorder
concepts.description: A disease that has its basis in the disruption of mental process.

concepts.label: pterygium
concepts.description: A wedge-shaped fibrovascular lesion arising from the bulbar conjunctiva and extending to the cornea. It is caused by chronic exposure to solar ultraviolet radiation, heat, and dust. It may cause severe vision loss. Studies have linked pterygium to neoplastic proliferation and suggest that it may ...

concepts.label: renal cell carcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from glandular epithelial cells of the kidney

concepts.label: respiratory system disorder
concepts.description: A non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder that affects the respiratory system. Representative examples include pneumonia, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, pulmonary failure, lung adenoma, lung carcinoma, and tracheal carcinoma.
synonyms: disease or disorder of respiratory system

concepts.label: sarcoma
concepts.description: A usually aggressive malignant neoplasm of the soft tissue or bone. It arises from muscle, fat, fibrous tissue, bone, cartilage, and blood vessels. Sarcomas occur in both children and adults. The prognosis depends largely on the degree of differentiation (grade) of the neoplasm. Representative su...
synonyms: sarcoma of soft tissue and bone
sarcoma of the soft tissue and bone
tumour of soft tissue and skeleton

concepts.label: schizophrenia
concepts.description: A major psychotic disorder characterized by abnormalities in the perception or expression of reality. It affects the cognitive and psychomotor functions. Common clinical signs and symptoms include delusions, hallucinations, disorganized thinking, and retreat from reality.

concepts.label: severe acute respiratory syndrome
concepts.description: A viral respiratory infection caused by the SARS coronavirus. It is transmitted through close person-to-person contact. It is manifested with high fever, headache, dry cough and myalgias. It may progress to pneumonia and cause death.
synonyms: SARS coronavirus caused disease or disorder

concepts.label: signet ring cell carcinoma
concepts.description: A usually aggressive, poorly differentiated invasive adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of malignant glandular cells in which the nucleus is pressed to one side by the presence of intracytoplasmic mucus. It may arise from the stomach, small and large intestine, ampulla of Vater, appendi...

concepts.label: skin disorder
concepts.description: Any deviation from the normal structure or function of the skin or subcutaneous tissue that is manifested by a characteristic set of symptoms and signs.
synonyms: disease or disorder of zone of skin
zone of skin disease or disorder

concepts.label: hemangiopericytoma
concepts.description: An antiquated term that refers to benign or malignant mesenchymal neoplasms characterized by the presence of neoplastic spindle-shaped to round cells arranged around thin-walled branching vascular spaces.

concepts.label: spondyloarthropathy
concepts.description: A group of inflammatory rheumatic diseases associated with arthritis and enthesitis, and often involving the axial skeleton. The most common form of spondyloarthritis is ankylosing spondylitis. Other forms include axial spondyloarthritis, peripheral spondyloarthritis, reactive arthritis, psoriati...

concepts.label: squamous cell carcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma arising from squamous epithelial cells. Morphologically, it is characterized by the proliferation of atypical, often pleomorphic squamous cells. Squamous cell carcinomas are graded by the degree of cellular differentiation as well, moderately, or poorly differentiated. Well differenti...

concepts.label: stroke disorder
concepts.description: A sudden loss of neurological function secondary to hemorrhage or ischemia in the brain parenchyma due to a vascular event.

concepts.label: subarachnoid hemorrhage
concepts.description: A serious neurological disorder characterized by intracranial hemorrhage into the subarachnoid space.

concepts.label: systemic sclerosis
concepts.description: A chronic disorder, possibly autoimmune, marked by excessive production of collagen which results in hardening and thickening of body tissues. The two types of systemic scleroderma, limited cutaneous and diffuse cutaneous are classified with focus on the extent of affected skin. A relationship ex...

concepts.label: undifferentiated (embryonal) sarcoma
concepts.description: An aggressive malignant mesenchymal neoplasm that arises from the liver and usually occurs in older children. It is composed of immature spindle, stellate, polymorphous, and giant cells.

concepts.label: well-differentiated liposarcoma
concepts.description: A locally aggressive malignant neoplasm composed of mature adipocytes showing cell size variation and nuclear atypia. It is often associated with the presence of hyperchromatic multinucleated stromal cells, and varying numbers of lipoblasts. There are three histologic subtypes, sclerosing, inflam...

concepts.label: melanoma
concepts.description: A malignant, usually aggressive tumor composed of atypical, neoplastic melanocytes. Most often, melanomas arise in the skin (cutaneous melanomas) and include the following histologic subtypes: superficial spreading melanoma, nodular melanoma, acral lentiginous melanoma, and lentigo maligna melano...

concepts.label: lipoma
concepts.description: A benign, usually painless, well-circumscribed lipomatous tumor composed of adipose tissue.

concepts.label: viral infectious disease
concepts.description: Any disease caused by a virus.

concepts.label: HIV infectious disease
concepts.description: An infection caused by the human immunodeficiency virus.
synonyms: Human immunodeficiency virus caused disease or disorder
Human immunodeficiency virus disease or disorder

concepts.label: idiopathic cardiomyopathy
concepts.description: A disease of the heart muscle or myocardium proper whose cause is unknown.

concepts.label: malignant pleural mesothelioma
concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm that arises from mesothelial cells in the pleura and shows a diffuse growth pattern. It arises on the parietal and sometimes visceral pleura as multiple small nodules that later become confluent and invade the chest wall adipose tissue and muscle. Asbestos exposure is the mai...

concepts.label: bacterial infectious disease
concepts.description: An acute infectious disorder that is caused by gram positive or gram negative bacteria; representative examples include pneumococcal, streptococcal, salmonella, and meningeal infections.

concepts.label: pneumococcal infection
concepts.description: Infections with bacteria of the species streptococcus pneumoniae.
synonyms: Streptococcus pneumoniae caused disease or disorder

concepts.label: temporal lobe epilepsy
concepts.description: A localization-related (focal) form of epilepsy characterized by recurrent seizures that arise from foci within the temporal lobe, most commonly from its mesial aspect. A wide variety of psychic phenomena may be associated, including illusions, hallucinations, dyscognitive states, and affective e...

concepts.label: Whipple disease
concepts.description: A systemic infection caused by the Gram-positive bacterium Tropheryma whipplei. It affects the small intestine resulting in malabsorption. Other sites or systems affected by the infection are the joints, central nervous system, and the cardiovascular system.
synonyms: Tropheryma whipplei caused disease or disorder

concepts.label: human granulocytic anaplasmosis
concepts.description: A tick-borne, infectious disease caused by Anaplasma phagocytophilum, an obligate intracellular bacterium that is typically transmitted to humans by ticks of the Ixodes ricinus species complex.
synonyms: human anaplasmosis caused by Anaplasma phagocytophilum
human ehrlichial infection, human granulocytic type

concepts.label: anthrax infection
concepts.description: An infection caused by Bacillus anthracis bacteria. It may affect the lungs, gastrointestinal tract, or skin. Patients with lung infection present with fever, headaches, cough, chest pain and shortness of breath. Patients with gastrointestinal infection present with nausea, vomiting and bloody di...
synonyms: Bacillus anthracis caused disease or disorder

concepts.label: leprosy
concepts.description: Leprosy is a chronic infectious disease affecting primarily the skin and peripheral nervous system.
synonyms: Mycobacterium leprae caused disease or disorder

concepts.label: borderline leprosy
concepts.description: A form of leprosy in which there are clinical manifestations of both principal types (lepromatous and tuberculoid). The disease may shift toward one of these two polar or principal forms.

concepts.label: tuberculoid leprosy
concepts.description: A principal or polar form of leprosy in which the skin lesions are few and are sharply demarcated. Peripheral nerve involvement is pronounced and may be severe. Unlike lepromatous leprosy (leprosy, lepromatous), the lepromin test is positive. Tuberculoid leprosy is rarely a source of infection to...

concepts.label: lepromatous leprosy
concepts.description: A chronic communicable infection which is a principal or polar form of leprosy. This disorder is caused by mycobacterium leprae and produces diffuse granulomatous skin lesions in the form of nodules, macules, or papules. The peripheral nerves are involved symmetrically and neural sequelae occur i...

concepts.label: cataract
concepts.description: Partial or complete opacity of the crystalline lens of one or both eyes that decreases visual acuity and eventually results in blindness. Some cataracts appear in infancy or in childhood, but most develop in older individuals. (Sternberg Diagnostic Surgical Pathology, 3rd ed.)

concepts.label: celiac disease
concepts.description: An autoimmune genetic disorder with an unknown pattern of inheritance that primarily affects the digestive tract. It is caused by intolerance to dietary gluten. Consumption of gluten protein triggers an immune response which damages small intestinal villi and prevents adequate absorption of nutri...

concepts.label: cervical carcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma arising from either the exocervical squamous epithelium or the endocervical glandular epithelium. The major histologic types of cervical carcinoma are: squamous carcinoma, adenocarcinoma, adenosquamous carcinoma, adenoid cystic carcinoma and undifferentiated carcinoma.

concepts.label: cytomegalovirus infection
concepts.description: A herpesvirus infection caused by Cytomegalovirus. Healthy individuals generally do not produce symptoms. However, the infection may be life-threatening in affected immunocompromised patients. The virus may cause retinitis, esophagitis, gastritis, and colitis. Morphologically, it is characterized...

concepts.label: parasitic infectious disease
concepts.description: A successful invasion of a host by an organism that uses the host for food and shelter.

concepts.label: malaria
concepts.description: Malaria is a serious and sometimes fatal disease caused by a parasite that commonly infects a certain type of mosquito which feeds on humans. Infection with malaria parasites may result in a wide variety of symptoms, ranging from absent or very mild symptoms to severe disease and even death. Peop...

concepts.label: nutritional disorder
concepts.description: Any condition related to a disturbance between proper intake and utilization of nourishment.

concepts.label: lung carcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the lung

concepts.label: ovarian carcinoma
concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm originating from the surface ovarian epithelium. It accounts for the greatest number of deaths from malignancies of the female genital tract and is the fifth leading cause of cancer fatalities in women. It is predominantly a disease of older white women of northern European e...

concepts.label: Pseudomonas infection
concepts.description: Infections with bacteria of the genus pseudomonas.

concepts.label: familial amyotrophic lateral sclerosis
concepts.description: An instance of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis that is caused by an inherited modification of the individual's genome.

concepts.label: sporadic amyotrophic lateral sclerosis
concepts.description: Sporadic amyotrophic lateral sclerosis is a amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in which there is no known cause, such as no family history.

concepts.label: type 2 diabetes mellitus
concepts.description: A type of diabetes mellitus that is characterized by insulin resistance or desensitization and increased blood glucose levels. This is a chronic disease that can develop gradually over the life of a patient and can be linked to both environmental factors and heredity.

concepts.label: pulmonary hypertension
concepts.description: Increased pressure within the pulmonary circulation due to lung or heart disorder.

concepts.label: age-related macular degeneration
concepts.description: Age-related loss of vision in the central portion of the retina (macula), secondary to retinal degeneration.

concepts.label: endocrine system disorder
concepts.description: A disease involving the endocrine system.
synonyms: disease or disorder of endocrine system

concepts.label: hypopituitarism
concepts.description: A condition of diminution or cessation of secretion of one or more hormones from the anterior pituitary gland. This may result from surgical or radiation ablation, non-secretory pituitary neoplasms, metastatic tumors, infarction, pituitary apoplexy, infiltrative or granulomatous processes, and ot...

concepts.label: cervical adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An adenocarcinoma arising from the cervical epithelium. It accounts for approximately 15% of invasive cervical carcinomas. Increased numbers of sexual partners and human papillomavirus (HPV) infection are risk factors. Grossly, advanced cervical adenocarcinoma may present as an exophytic mass, an...

concepts.label: liver disorder
synonyms: liver and intrahepatic bile duct disorder

concepts.label: cirrhosis of liver
concepts.description: A disorder characterized by replacement of the liver parenchyma with fibrous tissue and regenerative nodules. It is usually caused by alcoholism, hepatitis B, and hepatitis C. Complications include the development of ascites, esophageal varices, bleeding, and hepatic encephalopathy.

concepts.label: encephalomyelitis
concepts.description: Inflammation of the brain and the spinal cord.

concepts.label: lymphoid neoplasm
concepts.description: A neoplasm composed of a lymphocytic cell population which is usually malignant (clonal) by molecular genetic and/or immunophenotypic analysis. Lymphocytic neoplasms include Hodgkin and non-Hodgkin lymphomas, acute and chronic lymphocytic leukemias, and plasma cell neoplasms.

concepts.label: prostate carcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the prostate gland.

concepts.label: aortic aneurysm
concepts.description: A ruptured aneurysm located in the wall of the proximal portion of the descending aorta proceeding from the arch of the aorta.
synonyms: aortic aneurysm of unspecified site, ruptured
thoracic aortic aneurysm which HAS ruptured

concepts.label: human papilloma virus infection
concepts.description: An infectious process caused by a human papillomavirus. This infection can cause abnormal tissue growth.
synonyms: Human papillomavirus caused disease or disorder

concepts.label: fibrosarcoma
concepts.description: A malignant mesenchymal fibroblastic neoplasm affecting the soft tissue and bone.

concepts.label: benign neoplasm
concepts.description: A neoplasm which is characterized by the absence of morphologic features associated with malignancy (severe cytologic atypia, tumor cell necrosis, and high mitotic rate). Benign neoplasms remain confined to the original site of growth and do not metastasize to other anatomic sites.

concepts.label: osteoma
concepts.description: A benign, well-circumscribed, bone-forming neoplasm predominantly composed of lamellar bone. It usually arises from the calvarial, facial, or jaw bones. It is usually asymptomatic but it may cause local swelling or obstruction of the paranasal sinuses. Asymptomatic cases have an indolent clinical...

concepts.label: fibroma
concepts.description: A non-metastasizing neoplasm arising from the fibrous tissue. It is characterized by the presence of spindle-shaped fibroblasts.

concepts.label: neoplasm of immature B and T cells
concepts.description: A neoplasm arising from immature B and T cells

concepts.label: neoplasm of mature T-cells or NK-cells
concepts.description: A group of neoplasms composed of T-lymphocytes with a mature (peripheral/post-thymic) immunophenotypic profile and/or NK-cells.

concepts.label: myeloid neoplasm
concepts.description: Proliferation of myeloid cells originating from a primitive stem cell.

concepts.label: skeletal system disorder
concepts.description: A disease involving the skeletal system.
synonyms: disease or disorder of skeletal system

concepts.label: Parkinson disease
concepts.description: A progressive degenerative disorder of the central nervous system characterized by loss of dopamine producing neurons in the substantia nigra and the presence of Lewy bodies in the substantia nigra and locus coeruleus. Signs and symptoms include tremor which is most pronounced during rest, muscle...

concepts.label: progressive external ophthalmoplegia
concepts.description: A mitochondrial myopathy characterized by slowly progressive paralysis of the levator palpebrae, orbicularis oculi, and extraocular muscles. concepts.label: pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An infiltrating adenocarcinoma that arises from the epithelial cells of the pancreas. It affects males more often than females and the patients are usually over 50 years of age. Microscopically it is characterized by the presence of glandular (ductal) differentiation and desmoplastic stroma forma...

concepts.label: iatrogenic Kaposi's sarcoma
concepts.description: A Kaposi sarcoma that develops after organ transplantation or immunosuppressive treatment.

concepts.label: exocrine pancreatic carcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the exocrine pancreas

concepts.label: thymus neoplasm
concepts.description: A neoplasm that affects the thymus. Representative examples include thymoma and carcinoma.

concepts.label: vulvar intraepithelial neoplasia
concepts.description: Intraepithelial neoplasia of the vulvar squamous epithelium. There is no evidence of invasion. This category includes vulvar high grade squamous intraepithelial lesion and vulvar intraepithelial neoplasia, differentiated type.

concepts.label: viral dilated cardiomyopathy
concepts.description: An dilated cardiomyopathy caused by infection with Viruses.

concepts.label: restrictive cardiomyopathy
concepts.description: A type of heart disorder referring to the inability of the ventricles to fill with blood because the myocardium (heart muscle) stiffens and looses its flexibility. Causes include replacement of the myocardium with scar tissue, abnormal cellular infiltration of the myocardium, or deposition of a s...

concepts.label: primary antiphospholipid syndrome
concepts.description: An antiphospholipid syndrome that occurs as an isolated disorder.

concepts.label: renal carcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma arising from the epithelium of the renal parenchyma or the renal pelvis. The majority are renal cell carcinomas. Kidney carcinomas usually affect middle aged and elderly adults. Hematuria, abdominal pain, and a palpable mass are common symptoms.

concepts.label: choriocarcinoma
concepts.description: An aggressive malignant tumor arising from trophoblastic cells. The vast majority of cases arise in the uterus and represent gestational choriocarcinomas that derive from placental trophoblastic cells. Approximately half of the cases develop from a complete hydatidiform mole. A minority of cases ...

concepts.label: uterine corpus sarcoma
concepts.description: A malignant mesenchymal neoplasm arising from the wall of the uterine corpus (uterine body). The most representative examples are leiomyosarcoma and endometrial stromal sarcoma.
synonyms: sarcoma of the body of uterus

concepts.label: ovarian serous adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An adenocarcinoma that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of malignant epithelial cells that, in well differentiated tumors, resemble the epithelium of the fallopian tube or, in poorly differentiated tumors, show anaplastic features and marked nuclear atypia.

concepts.label: rhabdomyosarcoma
concepts.description: A rare aggressive malignant mesenchymal neoplasm arising from skeletal muscle. It usually occurs in children and young adults. Only a small percentage of tumors arise in the skeletal muscle of the extremities. The majority arise in other anatomical sites.

concepts.label: vulva sarcoma
concepts.description: A malignant mesenchymal neoplasm that arises from the vulva. Representative examples include childhood botryoid-type embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma, alveolar soft part sarcoma, and leiomyosarcoma.

concepts.label: vulvar carcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the mammalian vulva

concepts.label: hypopharyngeal carcinoma
concepts.description: Carcinoma, predominantly squamous cell, arising from the epithelial cells of the hypopharynx.

concepts.label: familial cardiomyopathy
concepts.description: An instance of cardiomyopathy that is caused by an inherited modification of the individual's genome.

concepts.label: collecting duct carcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the collecting duct of renal tubule
synonyms: carcinoma of collecting duct of renal tubule
carcinoma of collecting ducts of Bellini

concepts.label: renal pelvis urothelial carcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from the transitional epithelium of the renal pelvis. It is associated with tobacco use and usually presents with gross or microscopic hematuria. Urothelial carcinomas of the renal pelvis are usually of higher grade and higher stage compared to bladder urothelial carcinomas.
synonyms: transitional cell carcinoma of renal pelvis
transitional cell carcinoma of the renal pelvis
urothelial cell carcinoma of renal pelvis
urothelial cell carcinoma of the renal pelvis

concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia (AML) in which the blasts do not show evidence of myeloid differentiation by morphology and conventional cytochemistry. (WHO, 2001)

concepts.label: abscess
concepts.description: An inflammatory process characterized by the accumulation of pus within a newly formed tissue cavity which is the result of a bacterial, fungal, or parasitic infection or the presence of a foreign body.

concepts.label: bacterial infectious disease with sepsis
concepts.description: An infectious disease caused by bacteria causing sepsis.

concepts.label: large cell carcinoma
concepts.description: A malignant epithelial neoplasm composed of large, atypical cells.

concepts.label: non-small cell lung carcinoma
concepts.description: A group of at least three distinct histological types of lung cancer, including non-small cell squamous cell carcinoma, adenocarcinoma, and large cell carcinoma. Non-small cell lung carcinomas have a poor response to conventional chemotherapy.
synonyms: non-small cell cancer of the lung
non-small cell carcinoma of the lung

concepts.label: smoldering plasma cell myeloma
concepts.description: A plasma cell myeloma lacking clinical manifestations and organ impairment.

concepts.label: round cell liposarcoma
concepts.description: A poorly differentiated liposarcoma, characterized by the presence of solid sheets of primitive round mesenchymal cells and the absence of myxoid stroma.

concepts.label: empyema
concepts.description: An accumulation of pus in a body cavity, usually the pleural space.

concepts.label: peripheral neuropathy
concepts.description: A disorder affecting the peripheral nervous system. It manifests with pain, tingling, numbness, and muscle weakness. It may be the result of physical injury, toxic substances, viral diseases, diabetes, renal failure, cancer, and drugs.

concepts.label: osteomyelitis
concepts.description: An acute or chronic inflammation of the bone and its structures due to infection with pyogenic bacteria.

concepts.label: bacterial urinary tract infection
concepts.description: A bacterial infectious process affecting any part of the urinary tract, most commonly the bladder and the urethra. Symptoms include urinary urgency and frequency, burning sensation during urination, lower abdominal discomfort, and cloudy urine.

concepts.label: pneumonia
concepts.description: An acute, acute and chronic, or chronic inflammation focally or diffusely affecting the lung parenchyma, caused by an infection in one or both of the lungs (by bacteria, viruses, fungi, or mycoplasma.). Symptoms include cough, shortness of breath, fevers, chills, chest pain, headache, sweating, a...

concepts.label: heart failure
concepts.description: Inability of the heart to pump blood at an adequate rate to meet tissue metabolic requirements. Clinical symptoms of heart failure include: unusual dyspnea on light exertion, recurrent dyspnea occurring in the supine position, fluid retention or rales, jugular venous distension, pulmonary edema o...

concepts.label: autism spectrum disorder
concepts.description: A spectrum of developmental disorders that includes autism, and Asperger syndrome. Signs and symptoms include poor communication skills, defective social interactions, and repetitive behaviors.
synonyms: pervasive developmental disorder - not otherwise specified

concepts.label: autism
concepts.description: Persistent deficits in social interaction and communication and interaction as well as a markedly restricted repertoire of activity and interest as well as repetitive patterns of behavior.

concepts.label: inflammatory bowel disease
concepts.description: A spectrum of small and large bowel inflammatory diseases of unknown etiology. It includes Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, and colitis of indeterminate type.

concepts.label: heart disorder
concepts.description: A disease involving the heart and/or pericardium.

concepts.label: carotid artery disorder
concepts.description: A disease involving the carotid artery segment.
synonyms: carotid artery segment disease or disorder
disease or disorder of carotid artery segment

concepts.label: allergic disease
concepts.description: An immune response that occurs following re-exposure to an innocuous antigen, and that requires the presence of existing antibodies against that antigen. This response involves the binding of IgE to mast cells, and may worsen with repeated exposures.
synonyms: allergic form of disease or disorder
allergic form of immune system disease

concepts.label: myelodysplastic syndrome with single lineage dysplasia
concepts.description: A myelodysplastic syndrome characterized by dysplasia seen in at least 10% of the early cells of 1 cell type (either red blood cells, white blood cells, or megakaryocytes) in the bone marrow.

concepts.label: migraine disorder
concepts.description: A common, severe type of vascular headache often associated with increased sympathetic activity, resulting in nausea, vomiting, and light sensitivity.

concepts.label: serous adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An adenocarcinoma that is characterized by the presence of papillary patterns and cellular budding. Psammoma bodies may be present. Representative examples include cervical serous adenocarcinoma, endometrial serous adenocarcinoma, ovarian serous adenocarcinoma, and primary peritoneal serous adeno...

concepts.label: gallbladder disorder
concepts.description: A disease involving the gall bladder.
synonyms: disease or disorder of gall bladder

concepts.label: cutaneous lupus erythematosus
concepts.description: An autoimmune disorder that manifests as different lupus-specific skin disorders; it can occur with systemic lupus erythematosus, or as a singular disease.

concepts.label: retinal disorder
concepts.description: Any disease or disorder of the retina.

concepts.label: palatal neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant neoplasm that affects the hard palate, soft palate, or uvula.

concepts.label: developmental disability
concepts.description: Disorders in which there is a delay in development based on that expected for a given age level or stage of development. concepts.label: paranasal sinus neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant neoplasm that affects the paranasal sinuses. Representative examples of benign neoplasms include Schneiderian papilloma and salivary gland-type adenoma. Representative examples of malignant neoplasms include carcinoma and lymphoma.

concepts.label: brain aneurysm
concepts.description: A congenital or acquired aneurysm within the cranium.

concepts.label: peripheral vascular disease
concepts.description: Any disorder affecting blood flow through the veins or arteries outside of the heart.

concepts.label: osteoporosis
concepts.description: A condition of reduced bone mass, with decreased cortical thickness and a decrease in the number and size of the trabeculae of cancellous bone (but normal chemical composition), resulting in increased fracture incidence. Osteoporosis is classified as primary (Type 1, postmenopausal osteoporosis; ...
synonyms: bone mineral density quantitative trait locus

concepts.label: brain ischemia
concepts.description: Diminished or absent blood supply to the brain caused by obstruction (thrombosis or embolism) of an artery resulting in neurologic damage.

concepts.label: chronic kidney disease
concepts.description: Impairment of the renal function secondary to chronic kidney damage persisting for three or more months.

concepts.label: multiple sclerosis
concepts.description: A progressive autoimmune disorder affecting the central nervous system resulting in demyelination. Patients develop physical and cognitive impairments that correspond with the affected nerve fibers.

concepts.label: biliary tract neoplasm
concepts.description: A neoplasm that involves the biliary tract.
synonyms: tumour of the extrahepatic bile duct

concepts.label: ciliopathy
concepts.description: A genetic disorder of the cellular cilia or the cilia anchoring structures, the basal bodies, or of ciliary function.

concepts.label: atrial flutter
concepts.description: A disorder characterized by an electrocardiographic finding of an organized, regular atrial rhythm with atrial rate of 240-340 beats per minute. Multiple P waves typically appear in the inferior leads in a saw tooth-like pattern between the QRS complexes. (CDISC)

concepts.label: pouchitis
concepts.description: Acute inflammation in the intestinal mucosa of the continent ileal reservoir (or pouch) in patients who have undergone ileostomy and restorative proctocolectomy (proctocolectomy, restorative).

concepts.label: necrotizing enterocolitis
concepts.description: Necrotizing enterocolitis (NEC) is a devastating disease that affects mostly the intestine of premature infants. concepts.label: bacterial sexually transmitted disease
concepts.description: Bacterial diseases that are potentially transmitted or propagated by sexual conduct.

concepts.label: eye disorder
concepts.description: A non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder that affects the eye. Representative examples include conjunctivitis, glaucoma, cataract, conjunctival squamous cell carcinoma, uveal melanoma, and retinoblastoma.

disorder of eyeball of camera-type eye

concepts.label: hyperthyroxinemia
concepts.description: Abnormally elevated thyroxine level in the blood.

concepts.label: hereditary nephritis
concepts.description: A group of inherited conditions characterized initially by hematuria and slowly progressing to renal insufficiency. concepts.label: colorectal neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant neoplasm that affects the colon or rectum. Representative examples of benign neoplasms include lipoma and leiomyoma. concepts.label: myopathy
concepts.description: A disease of the muscle in which the muscle fibers do not function properly. This results in muscular weakness.

concepts.label: open-angle glaucoma
concepts.description: Chronic outflow obstruction of the eye's drainage canals that can lead to increased internal eye pressure and optic nerve damage.

concepts.label: alopecia areata
concepts.description: Loss of scalp and body hair involving microscopically inflammatory patchy areas.

concepts.label: skin basal cell carcinoma
concepts.description: The most frequently seen skin cancer. It arises from basal cells of the epidermis and pilosebaceous units. concepts.label: IgA glomerulonephritis
concepts.description: Inflammation of a specific segment of glomeruli within the kidney.

concepts.label: hypospadias
concepts.description: Hypospadias is the displacement of the urethral meatus on the ventrum of the penis. This abnormality is associated with a varyingly bent, twisted penis and opened dorsal prepuce.

concepts.label: hypertriglyceridemia
concepts.description: A laboratory test result indicating elevated triglyceride concentration in the blood.

concepts.label: otosclerosis
concepts.description: Formation of spongy bone in the labyrinth capsule which can progress toward the stapes (stapedial fixation) or anteriorly toward the cochlea leading to conductive, sensorineural, or mixed hearing loss. concepts.label: abdominal aortic aneurysm
concepts.description: Enlargement and ballooning of the vessel that supplies arterial blood to the abdomen, pelvis and legs.

concepts.label: anorexia nervosa
concepts.description: A disorder most often seen in adolescent females characterized by a refusal to maintain a minimally normal body weight, an intense fear of gaining weight, a disturbance in body image, and, in postmenarcheal females, the development of amenorrhea.

concepts.label: coronary vasospasm
concepts.description: Sudden coronary artery smooth muscle contraction leading to lumen constriction and decreased blood flow.

concepts.label: Creutzfeldt Jacob disease

concepts.label: Dengue hemorrhagic fever
concepts.description: A serious condition caused by Dengue virus infection. Patients present with an acute febrile illness followed by restlessness, irritability, and bleeding. It may lead to hemorrhagic shock and death.

concepts.label: eosinophilic esophagitis
concepts.description: Eosinophilic esophagitis (EoE) is a chronic, allergic disease of the esophagus characterized clinically by symptoms of esophageal dysfunction (including vomiting, dysphagia, feeding disorders, food impaction and abdominal pain) which persist after treatment with proton pump inhibitors (PPIs).

concepts.label: erectile dysfunction
concepts.description: Persistent or recurrent inability to achieve or to maintain an erection during sexual activity.

concepts.label: inherited focal segmental glomerulosclerosis
concepts.description: An instance of focal segmental glomerulosclerosis that is caused by an inherited genomic modification in an individual.

concepts.label: Graves disease
concepts.description: Graves' disease is an autoimmune disorder that leads to overactivity of the thyroid gland (hyperthyroidism).It is caused by an abnormal immune system response that causes the thyroid gland to produce too much thyroid hormones. concepts.label: hearing loss disorder
concepts.description: A partial or complete loss of hearing in one or both ears. It is classified as conductive, sensory, or central.

concepts.label: carcinoid tumor
concepts.description: A slow growing neuroendocrine tumor, composed of uniform, round, or polygonal cells having monotonous, centrally located nuclei and small nucleoli, infrequent mitoses, and no necrosis. concepts.label: male infertility
concepts.description: The inability of the male to effect fertilization of an ovum after a specified period of unprotected intercourse. Male sterility is permanent infertility.
synonyms: infertility disorder of male reproductive system

concepts.label: meningococcal infection
concepts.description: Infections with bacteria of the species neisseria meningitidis.

concepts.label: bone marrow neoplasm
concepts.description: Neoplasms that affect the bone marrow. Such neoplasms may arise in the bone marrow (e.g. myeloid leukemias) or may involve the bone marrow as secondary, metastatic tumors (e.g. metastatic carcinomas to the bone marrow).

concepts.label: nasopharyngeal neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant neoplasm affecting the nasopharynx. Representative examples of benign neoplasms include angiofibroma and squamous papilloma. Representative examples of malignant neoplasms include keratinizing squamous cell carcinoma and nonkeratinizing carcinoma.

concepts.label: membranous glomerulonephritis
concepts.description: A slowly progressive inflammation of the glomeruli characterized by immune complex deposits at the glomerular basement membrane, resulting in a thickened membrane, and nephrotic syndrome.

concepts.label: nephrotic syndrome
concepts.description: A collection of symptoms that include severe edema, proteinuria, and hypoalbuminemia; it is indicative of renal dysfunction.

concepts.label: osteonecrosis
concepts.description: A none disease characterized by death of bone tissue due to a lack of blood supply.

concepts.label: bone disorder
synonyms: disease or disorder of bone element

concepts.label: bone Paget disease
concepts.description: A disease of bone that initially results in the excessive resorption of bone (by osteoclasts) followed by the replacement of normal bone marrow with vascular and fibrous tissue.

concepts.label: focal epilepsy
concepts.description: A seizure caused by a localized disorder.

concepts.label: vascular disorder
concepts.description: A general term used to describe any disease affecting blood vessels]. concepts.label: primary ovarian failure
concepts.description: Absent or premature cessation of ovarian function due to a pathologic process originating within the ovaries.

concepts.label: primary biliary cholangitis
concepts.description: Primary biliary cholangitis (PBC) is a chronic and slowly progressive cholestatic liver disease of autoimmune etiology characterized by injury of the intrahepatic bile ducts that may eventually lead to liver failure.

concepts.label: brain infarction
concepts.description: Tissue necrosis in any area of the brain, including the cerebral hemispheres, the cerebellum, and the brain stem. concepts.label: movement disorder
concepts.description: Neurological conditions resulting in abnormal voluntary or involuntary movement, which may impact the speed, fluency, quality and ease of movement.

concepts.label: goiter
concepts.description: Enlargement of the thyroid gland usually caused by lack of iodine in the diet, hyperthyroidism, or thyroid nodules. Symptoms include difficulty in breathing and swallowing.

concepts.label: colonic neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant neoplasm that affects the colon. Representative examples of benign neoplasms include lipoma and leiomyoma. concepts.label: lymphoid leukemia
concepts.description: A malignant lymphocytic neoplasm of B-cell or T-cell lineage involving primarily the bone marrow and the peripheral blood. This category includes precursor or acute lymphoblastic leukemias and chronic leukemias.

concepts.label: myalgic encephalomeyelitis/chronic fatigue syndrome
concepts.description: A medical condition characterized by long-term fatigue and other symptoms that limit a person's ability to carry out ordinary daily activities.

concepts.description: An eosinophilic esophagitis that starts in childhood.

concepts.label: gallbladder cancer

concepts.label: hypothyroidism

concepts.label: elephantiasis
concepts.description: Enlargement of an area of the body due to obstruction within the lymphatic system and the resulting accumulation of lymph.

concepts.label: skin sensitivity to sun

concepts.label: ventricular tachycardia
concepts.description: A disorder characterized by an electrocardiographic finding of three or more consecutive complexes of ventricular origin with a rate greater than a certain threshold (100 or 120 beats per minute are commonly used). concepts.description: A disorder characterized by an electrocardiographic finding of an organized, regular atrial rhythm with atrial rate between 101 and 240 beats per minute. The P wave morphology must be distinct from the sinus P wave morphology. (CDISC)

concepts.label: histiocytoma
concepts.description: A mesenchymal tumor composed of fibroblastic and histiocytic cells.

concepts.label: dopaminergic neuroblastoma

concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm arising from mesothelial cells in the pleura. It is characterized by the presence of neoplastic cells with an epithelioid appearance. concepts.label: ovarian mucinous adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An invasive adenocarcinoma that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of malignant epithelial cells that contain intracytoplasmic mucin. There is cellular atypia, increased layering of cells, complexity of glands, and papillary formations.

concepts.description: A non-seminomatous germ cell tumor arising from the ovary. concepts.description: A highly contagious viral infection caused by the varicella zoster virus. Clinically, it may be manifested as shingles or chicken pox.

concepts.label: herpes zoster

concepts.description: An adenocarcinoma of the cervix or the vagina arising from mesonephric remnants.

concepts.label: pancreatic adenosquamous carcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from the pancreas showing both ductal and squamous differentiation. The squamous component should represent at least 30% of the malignant cellular infiltrate. The prognosis is usually worse than that of ductal adenocarcinoma.

concepts.label: plasmacytoma
concepts.description: Plasmacytoma is a localized mass of neoplastic monoclonal plasma cells that represents approximately 5% of all plasma cell neoplasms. concepts.label: pulmonary mucoepidermoid carcinoma
concepts.description: A lung carcinoma characterized by the presence of malignant non-keratinizing squamoid cells, mucin-producing cells and intermediate type cells.

concepts.label: undifferentiated carcinoma

concepts.label: typhoid fever

concepts.description: A benign or malignant neoplasm that arises from and is composed of epithelial cells. This category include adenomas, papillomas, and carcinomas.

concepts.description: A rare disorder characterized by the lack of ability to recognize individuals, objects, shapes, sounds, or smells. There is no loss of memory. It is caused by neurological damage in the brain, specifically in the occipital or parietal lobes.

concepts.label: ancylostomiasis
concepts.description: Infection by hookworms of the genus Ancylostoma.

concepts.label: anogenital human papillomavirus infection

concepts.description: Babesiosis refers to a condition caused by microscopic parasites that infect the red blood cells. concepts.description: An infectious disease produced by bacteria of the genus Bartonella.

concepts.label: congenital toxoplasmosis
concepts.description: Toxoplasma infection that is present from birth.

concepts.label: coxsackievirus infectious disease
concepts.description: A heterogeneous group of infections produced by coxsackieviruses, including herpangina, aseptic meningitis (meningitis, aseptic), a common-cold-like syndrome, a non-paralytic poliomyelitis-like syndrome, epidemic pleurodynia (pleurodynia, epidemic) and a serious myocarditis.

concepts.label: echinococcosis
concepts.description: A parasitic infection caused by tapeworm larvae of Echinococcus. It affects livestock and humans. It is characterized by the formation of hydatid cysts mainly in the liver, lungs, spleen, and kidneys. Rupture of the cysts may lead to shock.

synonyms: malignant neoplasm of Male reproductive system
malignant neoplasm of male genital organ, site unspecified
malignant neoplasm of male reproductive organ
malignant neoplasm of the Male reproductive system
malignant tumor of Male reproductive system
malignant tumor of male genital organ
malignant tumor of male reproductive system
malignant tumor of the Male reproductive system
malignant tumour of Male reproductive system
malignant tumour of male genital organ
malignant tumour of male reproductive system
malignant tumour of the Male reproductive system

concepts.label: mandibular cancer
concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm involving the mandible
synonyms: malignant neoplasm of lower jaw bone

concepts.label: mansonelliasis
concepts.description: A parasitic infection caused by the nematode Mansonella, including M. ozzardi, M. perstans (Dipetalonema perstans), and M. streptocerca (Dipetalonema streptocerca). Signs and symptoms include pruritus, headache, fever, arthralgias, and eosinophilia.
synonyms: Mansonella perstans caused disease or disorder

concepts.label: maxillary neoplasm
concepts.description: Cancer or tumors of the maxilla or upper jaw.
synonyms: neoplasm of bone of upper jaw
tumor of bone of upper jaw
tumour of bone of upper jaw

concepts.label: mediastinal cancer
concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm involving the mediastinum

concepts.label: meningoencephalitis
concepts.description: Inflammation of the meninges and brain, generally secondary to an infectious cause. Pathogens may be bacterial, viral, fungal, or protozoan.

concepts.label: microsporidiosis
concepts.description: A fungal infection caused by Microsporidia. It occurs in immunocompromised patients, causing diarrhea and wasting.

concepts.label: miliary tuberculosis
concepts.description: I would say the hematogenous widespread dissemination of tuberculosis in the body. The term derives from the chest X-ray image of the tiny (1-5 mm) tuberculosis lesions which are seen through out the lung parenchyma.

concepts.label: Miller Fisher syndrome
concepts.description: An autoimmune process characterized by the clinical triad of ophthalmoplegia, ataxia, and areflexia.
synonyms: Guillain Barre syndrome, Miller Fisher variant
Miller Fisher variant of Guillain Barre syndrome

concepts.label: mitral valve stenosis
concepts.description: Narrowing of the left atrioventricular mitral orifice.

concepts.label: malignant mixed neoplasm
concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm composed of a carcinomatous epithelial component and a sarcomatous mesenchymal component. Representative examples include malignant mixed mesodermal (Mullerian) tumor of the female reproductive system and carcinosarcoma of the salivary gland and the lung.

concepts.label: mixed connective tissue disease
concepts.description: Mixed connective tissue disease (MCTD) is a rare autoimmune disorder that is characterized by features commonly seen in three different connective tissue disorders: systemic lupus erythematosus, scleroderma, and polymyositis. Some affected people may also have symptoms of rheumatoid arthritis. Al...

concepts.label: Mononegavirales infectious disease
concepts.description: Infections with viruses of the order mononegavirales. The concept includes filoviridae infections; paramyxoviridae infections; and rhabdoviridae infections.

concepts.label: morbillivirus infectious disease
concepts.description: Infections with viruses of the genus morbillivirus, family paramyxoviridae. Infections mainly cause acute disease in their hosts, although in some cases infection is persistent and leads to degenerative conditions.

concepts.label: mucinous cystadenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An invasive adenocarcinoma characterized by cystic changes and the presence of malignant glandular cells which contain intracytoplasmic mucin. It may arise from the ovary, pancreas, appendix, and lung.

concepts.label: mucocutaneous leishmaniasis
concepts.description: The most common form of leishmaniasis that is transmitted through the bite of female phlebotomine sand flies or after exposure to leishmania parasites. It is characterized by skin lesions at the site of insect bite which typically develop within weeks or months after exposure. The lesions typical...

concepts.label: multidrug-resistant tuberculosis
concepts.description: A type of drug-resistant tuberculosis that is resistant to both rifampicin and isoniazid, the two most powerful anti-TB drugs.

concepts.label: muscle cancer
concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm affecting the skeletal or smooth muscles. Malignant neoplasms arising from the skeletal muscles are called rhabdomyosarcomas. Malignant neoplasms arising from the smooth muscles are called leiomyosarcomas.

concepts.label: mushroom workers' lung
concepts.description: An extrinsic allergic alveolitis involving inflammation of the alveoli within the lung caused by hypersensitivity to the inhalation of organic dust particles derived from either the mushrooms, their spores or the compost in which the mushrooms are grown. It is usually caused by the spores of ther...

concepts.label: Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia
concepts.description: Interstitial pneumonia caused by extensive infection of the lungs (lung) and bronchi, particularly the lower lobes of the lungs, by mycoplasma pneumoniae in humans. In sheep, it is caused by mycoplasma ovipneumoniae. In cattle, it may be caused by mycoplasma dispar.

concepts.label: myelophthisic anemia
concepts.description: An aplastic anemia that is characterized by displacement of hemopoietic bone-marrow tissue either by fibrosis, tumors or granulomas.

concepts.label: Nematoda infectious disease
concepts.description: Infections caused by nematode larvae which never develop into the adult stage and migrate through various body tissues. They commonly infect the skin, eyes, and viscera in humans. Ancylostoma brasiliensis causes cutaneous larva migrans. Toxocara causes visceral larva migrans.

concepts.label: nervous system cancer
concepts.description: A primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm involving the nervous system.
synonyms: malignant neoplasm of the nervous system
malignant tumor of the nervous system
malignant tumour of the nervous system

concepts.label: neuroaspergillosis
concepts.description: Infections of the nervous system caused by fungi of the genus aspergillus, most commonly aspergillus fumigatus. concepts.label: neuroschistosomiasis
concepts.description: Schistosomiasis of the brain, spinal cord, or meninges caused by infections with trematodes of the genus schistosoma (primarily schistosoma japonicum; schistosoma mansoni; and schistosoma haematobium in humans). S. japonicum infections of the nervous system may cause an acute meningoencephalitis ...

concepts.label: Nidovirales infectious disease
concepts.description: Infections with viruses of the order nidovirales. The concept includes arterivirus infections and coronaviridae infections.

concepts.label: ocular onchocerciasis
synonyms: onchocerciasis of eyeball of camera-type eye

concepts.label: oesophagostomiasis
concepts.description: Infection of the intestinal tract with worms of the genus oesophagostomum. This condition occurs mainly in animals other than humans.

concepts.label: ophthalmic herpes zoster
concepts.description: Virus infection of the Gasserian ganglion and its nerve branches characterized by pain and vesicular eruptions with much swelling. Ocular involvement is usually heralded by a vesicle on the tip of the nose. This area is innervated by the nasociliary nerve.

concepts.label: optic neuritis
concepts.description: Optic neuritis is inflammation of the optic nerve, the nerve that carries the visual signal from the eye to the brain.The conditionmay cause sudden, reduced vision in the affected eye(s). While the cause of optic neuritis is unknown, it has been associated with autoimmune diseases, infections, mu...

concepts.label: oral tuberculosis
concepts.description: Tuberculosis of the mouth, tongue, and salivary glands.

concepts.label: ornithosis
concepts.description: Disease caused by the Chlamydophila psittaci bacteria, usually transmitted from birds to humans.

concepts.label: ostertagiasis
concepts.description: A disease of herbivorous mammals, particularly cattle and sheep, caused by stomach worms of the genus ostertagia.

concepts.label: pancreatic endocrine carcinoma
concepts.description: An aggressive, high-grade and poorly differentiated carcinoma with neuroendocrine differentiation that arises from the pancreas. The mitotic count is more than 20 per 10 HPF. According to the size of the malignant cells, the prominence of the nucleoli, and the amount of cytoplasm, it is classifie...
synonyms: malignant neoplasm of islets of Langerhans

concepts.label: paracoccidioidomycosis
concepts.description: A systemic fungal infection caused by Paracoccidioides brasiliensis that is most often seen in immunocompromised patients. It affects the mucous membranes, lymph nodes, lungs and bones.

concepts.label: paragonimiasis
concepts.description: A parasitic infection caused by trematodes of the Paragonimus genus. Humans are infected from ingestion of raw or undercooked food. It results in chronic lung infection and eosinophilia.
synonyms: Paragonimus westermani caused disease or disorder

concepts.label: Paramyxoviridae infectious disease
concepts.description: Infections with viruses of the family paramyxoviridae. This includes morbillivirus infections; respirovirus infections; pneumovirus infections; henipavirus infections; avulavirus infections; and rubulavirus infections.

concepts.label: parotid disorder
concepts.description: A disease involving the parotid gland.
synonyms: disease or disorder of parotid gland

concepts.label: pasteurellosis
concepts.description: Infections with bacteria of the genus pasteurella.

concepts.label: pericardial tuberculosis
concepts.description: Inflammation of the sac surrounding the heart (pericardium) due to mycobacterium tuberculosis infection. Pericarditis can lead to swelling (pericardial effusion), compression of the heart (cardiac tamponade), and preventing normal beating of the heart.

concepts.label: pericarditis
concepts.description: An inflammatory process affecting the pericardium.

concepts.label: phagocyte bactericidal dysfunction
concepts.description: Disorders in which phagocytic cells cannot kill ingested bacteria; characterized by frequent recurring infection with formulation of granulomas.

concepts.label: Picornaviridae infectious disease
concepts.description: Virus diseases caused by the picornaviridae.

concepts.label: placenta accreta
concepts.description: The clinical condition in which any part of the placenta invades and is inseparable from the uterine wall. (reVITALize)

concepts.label: placental insufficiency
concepts.description: Failure of the placenta to deliver an adequate supply of nutrients and oxygen to the fetus.

concepts.label: Plasmodium falciparum malaria
concepts.description: Malaria resulting from infection by Plasmodium falciparum.

concepts.label: Plasmodium vivax malaria
concepts.description: Malaria resulting from infection by Plasmodium vivax.

concepts.label: pleural tuberculosis
concepts.description: Inflammation of the pleura secondary to an infection with Mycobacterium tuberculosis.

concepts.label: Pneumocystis infectious disease
concepts.description: Infections with species in the genus pneumocystis, a fungus causing interstitial plasma cell pneumonia (pneumonia, pneumocystis) and other infections in humans and other mammals. Immunocompromised patients, especially those with aids, are particularly susceptible to these infections. Extrapulmona...

concepts.label: pulmonary blastoma
concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm of the lung composed of tubular structures and immature mesenchymal elements, which may differentiate towards skeletal and smooth muscle, cartilage or a combination of muscle and cartilage. This is a nodular tumor found in the periphery of the lung. It can occur at any age. T...

concepts.label: renal tuberculosis
concepts.description: Infection of the kidney due to mycobacteria.

concepts.label: Reoviridae infectious disease
concepts.description: Infections produced by reoviruses, general or unspecified.

concepts.label: respirovirus infectious disease
concepts.description: Infections with viruses of the genus respirovirus, family paramyxoviridae. Host cell infection occurs by adsorption, via hemagglutinin, to the cell surface.

concepts.label: retroperitoneal cancer
concepts.description: A primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm involving the retroperitoneum. The vast majority of cases are carcinomas, lymphomas, or sarcomas.
synonyms: malignant neoplasm of retroperitoneum and peritoneum
malignant tumour of peritoneum and retroperitoneum

concepts.label: Reye syndrome
concepts.description: An acute and potentially fatal metabolic disorder characterized by cerebral edema, fatty liver and hypoglycemia. It occurs primarily in children and has been associated with the use of aspirin for the treatment of viral infections. However, it can also occur in the absence of aspirin use.

concepts.label: Rhabditida infectious disease
concepts.description: Infections with nematodes of the order rhabditida.

concepts.label: rickettsial pneumonia
concepts.description: Pneumonia caused by infection with bacteria of the family rickettsiaceae.

concepts.label: roseolovirus infectious disease
concepts.description: Infection with roseolovirus, the most common in humans being exanthema subitum, a benign disease of infants and young children.

concepts.label: Salmonella gastroenteritis
concepts.description: Poisoning caused by ingestion of food harboring species of salmonella. Conditions of raising, shipping, slaughtering, and marketing of domestic animals contribute to the spread of this bacterium in the food supply.

concepts.label: scarlet fever
concepts.description: A streptococcal infection, mainly occurring among children, that is characterized by a red skin rash, sore throat, and fever.

concepts.label: screw worm infectious disease
concepts.description: Infection with larvae of the blow fly Cochliomyia hominivorax (Callitroga americanum), a common cause of disease in livestock in the southern and southwestern U.S.A.
synonyms: Cochliomyia hominivorax caused disease or disorder

concepts.label: septicemic plague
concepts.description: A plague in which the bacteria have entered the bloodstream.

concepts.label: setariasis
concepts.description: Infection with nematodes of the genus Setaria. This condition is usually seen in cattle and equines and is of little pathogenic significance, although migration of the worm to the eye may lead to blindness.

concepts.label: sick building syndrome
concepts.description: A group of symptoms that are two- to three-fold more common in those who work in large, energy-efficient buildings, associated with an increased frequency of headaches, lethargy, and dry skin. Clinical manifestations include hypersensitivity pneumonitis (alveolitis, extrinsic allergic); allergic ...

concepts.label: silicosis
concepts.description: Silicosis is a respiratory disease caused by breathing in (inhaling) silica dust. There are three types of silicosis: Simple chronic silicosis, the most common type of silicosis, results from long-term exposure (usually more than 20years) to low amounts of silica dust. concepts.label: skeletal tuberculosis
concepts.description: Tuberculosis of the bones or joints.

concepts.label: spleen cancer
concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm involving the spleen

concepts.label: splenic tuberculosis
concepts.description: Infection of the spleen with species of mycobacterium.

concepts.label: sporotrichosis
concepts.description: The commonest and least serious of the deep mycoses, characterized by nodular lesions of the cutaneous and subcutaneous tissues. It is caused by inhalation of contaminated dust or by infection of a wound.

concepts.label: st. Louis encephalitis
concepts.description: A viral encephalitis caused by the St. Louis encephalitis virus (encephalitis virus, st. louis), a flavivirus. It is transmitted to humans and other vertebrates primarily by mosquitoes of the genus culex. The primary animal vectors are wild birds and the disorder is endemic to the midwestern and ...
synonyms: Neuroinvasive St. Louis encephalitis virus infection
St. Louis encephalitis virus caused infectious encephalitis
St. Louis encephalitis virus infectious encephalitis

concepts.label: strongyloidiasis
concepts.description: An infection that is caused by nematodes of the genus Strongyloides, most commonly Strongyloides stercoralis, which is a soil-transmitted helminth, and which is characterized by a variety of gastrointestinal, dermatologic, and, occasionally, pulmonary manifestations. The worm's autoinfective life...

concepts.label: syphilis
concepts.description: A contagious bacterial infection caused by the spirochete Treponema pallidum. It is a sexually transmitted disorder, although it can also be transmitted from the mother to the fetus in utero. Typically, it is initially manifested with a single sore which heals without treatment. If the infection ...
synonyms: Treponema pallidum caused disease or disorder

concepts.label: tabes dorsalis
concepts.description: A form of neurosyphilis characterized by slowly progressive degeneration of the spinal cord. Signs and symptoms include pain, ataxia, loss of coordination, personality changes, blindness, urinary incontinence, dementia, and degeneration of the joints.

concepts.label: thoracic outlet syndrome
concepts.description: A syndrome resulting from the compression of the blood vessels or nerves in the space between the clavicle and first rib (thoracic outlet). It is caused by car accident injuries or repetitive job or sport-related injuries. Signs and symptoms include pain in the shoulders and neck, numbness in the...

concepts.label: tick infestation
concepts.description: Infestations with soft-bodied (Argasidae) or hard-bodied (Ixodidae) ticks.

concepts.label: tick paralysis
concepts.description: Paralysis caused by a neurotropic toxin secreted by the salivary glands of ticks.

concepts.label: tinea infection
concepts.description: A skin infection caused by a fungus.

concepts.label: Togaviridae infectious disease
concepts.description: Virus diseases caused by the togaviridae.

concepts.label: toxascariasis
concepts.description: Infections with nematodes of the genus toxascaris.

concepts.label: toxocariasis
concepts.description: A parasitic infection caused by worms found in domestic animals. In humans nematode larvae enter the portal system from the small intestine and disseminate in visceral organs causing inflammatory reactions. Signs and symptoms include eosinophilia, hepatomegaly, splenomegaly, and lung infections.

concepts.label: toxoplasmosis
concepts.description: A parasitic disease contracted by the ingestion or fetal transmission of toxoplasma gondii.
synonyms: Toxoplasma gondii caused disease or disorder

concepts.label: trench fever
concepts.description: An intermittent fever characterized by intervals of chills, fever, and splenomegaly each of which may last as long as 40 hours. It is caused by bartonella quintana and transmitted by the human louse.
synonyms: Bartonella quintana caused disease or disorder
bartonellosis due to Bartonella quintana infection

concepts.label: trichostrongyloidiasis
concepts.description: Infection by roundworms of the superfamily trichostrongyloidea, including the genera trichostrongylus; ostertagia; Cooperia, haemonchus; Nematodirus, Hyostrongylus, and dictyocaulus.

concepts.label: trichostrongylosis
concepts.description: Infestation with nematode worms of the genus trichostrongylus. Humans become infected by swallowing larvae, usually with contaminated food or drink, although the larvae may penetrate human skin.

concepts.label: tuberculous empyema
concepts.description: An empyema resulting from infection by Mycobacterium tuberculosis.

concepts.label: tuberculous peritonitis
concepts.description: A form of peritonitis seen in patients with tuberculosis, characterized by lesion either as a miliary form or as a pelvic mass on the peritoneal surfaces. Most patients have ascites, abdominal swelling, abdominal pain, and other systemic symptoms such as fever; weight loss; and anemia.

concepts.label: urinary schistosomiasis
concepts.description: A bladder infection that occurs as a manifetation of a systemic infection with one or more species of the parasitic worms of the Schistosoma type; this can progress to bladder cancer in time.

concepts.label: urogenital tuberculosis
concepts.description: A general term for mycobacterium infections of any part of the urogenital system in either the male or the female.

concepts.label: uterine corpus cancer
concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm involving the body of uterus.
synonyms: malignant neoplasm of body of uterus

concepts.label: Venezuelan equine encephalitis
concepts.description: A condition caused by infection by the Venezuelan equine encephalitis virus, which is characterized by headache, fever, myalgia, nausea, and vomiting.
synonyms: Venezuelan equine encephalitis virus caused disease or disorder
Venezuelan equine encephalitis virus disease or disorder
Venezuelan equine encephalitis virus infectious disease

concepts.label: verrucous carcinoma
concepts.description: A well differentiated squamous cell carcinoma characterized by a papillary growth pattern, acanthosis, mild cytologic atypia, and pushing tumor margins. concepts.label: vesicoureteral reflux
concepts.description: Abnormal flow of urine from the urinary bladder back into the ureters.

concepts.label: vestibular neuronitis
concepts.description: Idiopathic inflammation of the vestibular nerve, characterized clinically by the acute or subacute onset of vertigo; nausea; and imbalance. concepts.label: viral hepatitis
concepts.description: An acute or chronic inflammation of the liver parenchyma caused by viruses. Representative examples include hepatitis A, B, and C, cytomegalovirus hepatitis, and herpes simplex hepatitis.

concepts.label: Waterhouse-Friderichsen syndrome
concepts.description: A serious disorder characterized by massive adrenal gland hemorrhage secondary to a bacterial infection, most often Neisseria meningitidis infection. It is manifested with decreased blood pressure, shock, disseminated intravascular coagulation, and adrenocortical insufficiency.

concepts.label: yaws
concepts.description: An endemic, infectious, nonvenereal disease in humans that presents mainly in children younger than 15 years. concepts.description: A syndrome typically consisting of angina (cardiac chest pain) at rest that occurs in cycles. concepts.label: acidosis disorder
concepts.description: An abnormally high acidity of the blood and other body tissues. Acidosis can be either respiratory or metabolic.

concepts.label: urinary bladder disorder
concepts.description: A disease involving the urinary bladder.
synonyms: disease or disorder of urinary bladder

concepts.label: breast synovial sarcoma
concepts.description: A synovial sarcoma (disease) that involves the breast.

concepts.label: cecum adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from glandular epithelial cells of the caecum

concepts.label: cecum carcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the caecum

concepts.label: chronic cystitis
concepts.description: Recurrent infections of the urinary bladder.

concepts.label: diffuse intrinsic pontine glioma
concepts.description: A neuroglial tumor that arises from the middle portion of the brain stem. It usually affects children and has a poor prognosis.

concepts.label: gastric adenosquamous carcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from the stomach and is characterized by the presence of malignant cells with glandular and squamous differentiation.

concepts.label: gastric tubular adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A variant of gastric adenocarcinoma characterized by prominent dilated or slit-like tubules.

concepts.label: granulosa cell tumor
concepts.description: A slow-growing, malignant tumor, characterize by the presence of granulosa-like cells and Call-Exner bodies, that is almost always found in the ovary. synonyms: granulosa cell tumor, adult type (morphologic abnormality)

concepts.label: hydrolethalus syndrome
concepts.description: Hydrolethalus (HLS) is a severe fetal malformation syndrome characterized by craniofacial dysmorphic features, central nervous system, cardiac, respiratory tract and limb abnormalities.

concepts.label: lactic acidosis
concepts.description: Metabolic acidosis characterized by the accumulation of lactate in the body. It is caused by tissue hypoxia.

concepts.label: lung carcinoid tumor
concepts.description: A neuroendocrine neoplasm that arises from the lung. It is characterized by the presence of uniform polygonal cells with small or moderate amount of cytoplasm and inconspicuous nucleoli. The cells are usually arranged in organoid and trabecular patterns. It is classified as typical or atypical ca...

concepts.label: meningeal tuberculosis
concepts.description: A bacterial infection of the membranes covering the brain and the spinal cord caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis.

concepts.label: metaplastic breast carcinoma
concepts.description: A group of invasive breast carcinomas characterized by the presence of an adenocarcinomatous component which is admixed with a dominant component that is composed of squamous cells, spindle cells, or mesenchymal cells.

concepts.label: ovarian clear cell adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A malignant glandular epithelial neoplasm characterized by the presence of clear and hobnail cells. It is highly associated with ovarian endometriosis, pelvic endometriosis and paraendocrine hypercalcemia.

concepts.label: ovarian serous cystadenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A malignant serous cystic epithelial neoplasm arising from the ovary. It is characterized by the presence of glandular, papillary, or solid structures. concepts.label: pancreatic adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from glandular epithelial cells of the pancreas

concepts.label: papillary lung adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A morphologic variant of lung adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of papillary structures.

concepts.label: pulmonary tuberculosis
concepts.description: A bacterial infection that affects the lungs and is caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis. concepts.label: reproductive system neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant, primary or metastatic neoplasm affecting the male and female reproductive system.

concepts.label: sex cord-stromal tumor
concepts.description: A neoplasm involving a sex cord.
synonyms: Sex cord-stromal tumor, no ICD-O subtype
Sex cord-stromal tumor, no ICD-O subtype (morphologic abnormality)

concepts.label: squamous cell breast carcinoma
concepts.description: A rare carcinoma that arises from the breast parenchyma and is entirely composed of squamous cells.
synonyms: primary squamous cell carcinoma of breast
primary squamous cell carcinoma of the breast
squamous cell carcinoma of the breast

concepts.label: Wilms tumor
concepts.description: An embryonal neoplasm characterized by the presence of epithelial, mesenchymal, and blastema components. The vast majority of cases arise from the kidney. A small number of cases with morphologic features resembling Wilms tumor of the kidney have been reported arising from the ovary and the cervix.

concepts.label: nasal cavity squamous cell carcinoma
concepts.description: A squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the nasal cavity mucosa. Signs and symptoms include nasal fullness and obstruction, pain, epistaxis, and the presence of a nasal mass.
synonyms: squamous cell carcinoma of nasal cavity
squamous cell carcinoma of the nasal cavity

concepts.label: nasopharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma
concepts.description: A squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the nasopharynx.

concepts.description: A variant of acinar prostate adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of malignant cells with abundant xanthomatous appearing cytoplasm.

concepts.label: acinar prostate mucinous adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A usually aggressive morphologic variant of acinar adenocarcinoma of the prostate gland characterized by the presence of lakes of extracellular mucin. This diagnosis applies when at least 25% of the resected tumor contains extracellular mucin.

concepts.label: adrenal gland myelolipoma

concepts.label: basaloid carcinoma

concepts.label: benign carotid body paraganglioma

concepts.label: benign conjunctival neoplasm

concepts.description: A well circumscribed benign tumor arising from cardiac muscle. It usually affects children and may be present in the fetus. concepts.label: cecum neuroendocrine tumor G1
concepts.description: A well differentiated, low grade neuroendocrine tumor (carcinoid tumor) that arises from the cecum. The mitotic count is less than 2 per 10 HPF and/or the Ki67 index is equal to or less than 2 percent.

concepts.label: cortisol-producing adrenal cortex adenoma

concepts.label: cribriform carcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma characterized by the presence of a cribriform architectural pattern. Representative examples include the intraductal cribriform breast carcinoma and invasive cribriform breast carcinoma.

concepts.label: dedifferentiated solitary fibrous tumor
concepts.description: A solitary fibrous tumor characterized by the presence of areas of abrupt transition to high grade sarcoma.

concepts.label: desmoplastic ameloblastoma
