concepts.label: fibrolamellar hepatocellular carcinoma
concepts.description: A distinctive type of liver cell carcinoma that arises in non-cirrhotic livers and is seen predominantly in young patients. concepts.label: gallbladder adenocarcinoma

concepts.label: lymphangiosarcoma

concepts.label: thymic carcinoma
concepts.description: Thymic carcinoma (TC) is a type of thymic epithelial neoplasm characterized by a high malignant potential.
synonyms: thymic carcinoma (excluding well differentiated thymic carcinoma)
thymic carcinoma excluding well differentiated thymic carcinoma

concepts.label: thymic sarcomatoid carcinoma
concepts.description: A rare, usually aggressive, primary thymic carcinoma, characterized by the presence of tumor cells morphologically resembling soft tissue sarcoma.

concepts.label: thymic undifferentiated carcinoma
concepts.description: A rare primary thymic carcinoma, characterized by an undifferentiated solid tumor growth, without associated sarcomatoid features.

concepts.label: thymoma
concepts.description: A neoplasm arising from the epithelial cells of the thymus. Although thymomas are usually encapsulated tumors, they may invade the capsule and infiltrate the surrounding tissues or even metastasize to distant anatomic sites. The following morphologic subtypes are currently recognized: type A, typ...

concepts.label: thymoma type B3
concepts.description: Also known as well-differentiated thymic carcinoma, atypical thymoma, or epithelial thymoma, this type of thymoma displays morphologic characteristics of a well-differentiated carcinoma. The majority of cases occur in the anterior mediastinum as Masaoka stage II or stage III tumors. It is almost ...

concepts.label: thymoma type B1
concepts.description: A thymic epithelial neoplasm characterized by the presence of expanded areas which resemble the normal thymic cortex. The neoplastic epithelial cells are small and scant and there is a dense T-lymphocytic component present. Areas of medullary differentiation with or without Hassall's corpuscles a...

concepts.label: thyroglossal duct cyst
concepts.description: A congenital benign cyst arising from the remnants of the thyroglossal duct. It is usually located in the midline of the neck.

concepts.label: thyroid gland diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A diffuse large B-cell lymphoma primarily involving the thyroid gland.
synonyms: diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the thyroid
diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the thyroid gland
diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of thyroid
diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of thyroid gland
primary thyroid gland diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
thyroid gland diffuse large B-cell lymphoma

concepts.label: thyroid gland mucoepidermoid carcinoma
concepts.description: A primary, low grade carcinoma of the thyroid gland composed of groups of squamoid and mucous cells, surrounded by fibrous tissue. Prominent cystic structures may be present. The clinical course is usually indolent.

concepts.label: thyroid gland mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue lymphoma
concepts.description: An extranodal marginal zone B-cell lymphoma arising from mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue in the thyroid gland. The vast majority of cases are associated with chronic lymphocytic thyroiditis.

concepts.label: thyroid gland spindle cell tumor with thymus-like differentiation
concepts.description: A rare, slow growing, primary carcinoma of the thyroid gland characterized by a lobulated architectural pattern and the presence of a biphasic cellular population composed of spindle epithelial cells and glandular cells. A small number of cases are composed exclusively of spindle epithelial cells...
synonyms: spindle epithelial tumor with thymus-like differentiation tumor

concepts.label: thyroid gland squamous cell carcinoma
concepts.description: A rapidly growing primary carcinoma of the thyroid gland composed of malignant squamous cells. The clinical course is usually aggressive.

concepts.label: thyroid gland undifferentiated (anaplastic) carcinoma
concepts.description: A primary carcinoma of the thyroid gland composed of undifferentiated cells. The malignant cells demonstrate evidence of epithelial differentiation, either by immunohistochemistry or electron microscopic studies. Microscopically, in the majority of cases there is a mixture of spindle, epithelioid...
synonyms: anaplastic carcinoma of the thyroid gland
undifferentiated carcinoma of the thyroid gland

concepts.label: tibial adamantinoma
concepts.description: An adamantinoma arising from the tibia. The tibia is the site which is more frequently involved by adamantinoma (80-90% of cases).

concepts.label: tonsillar squamous cell carcinoma
concepts.description: A squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the mucosal lining of the tonsil and tends to metastasize early to the lymph nodes. It predominantly affects middle aged and elderly patients who have a history of alcohol and tobacco use. Patients may present with tonsillar swelling, sore throat, pain r...
synonyms: squamous cell carcinoma of the tonsil

concepts.label: tracheal adenoid cystic carcinoma
concepts.description: An adenoid cystic carcinoma that arises from the trachea. It spreads to the submucosal tracheal tissue and to regional lymph nodes.
synonyms: adenoid cystic carcinoma of the trachea

concepts.label: transitional cell carcinoma
concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm arising from the transitional epithelium, usually affecting the urinary bladder, ureter, or renal pelvis. It may or may not have a papillary configuration. It is graded 1 to 3 or 4 according to the degree of cellular differentiation and architectural patterns. Grade 1 transit...

concepts.label: undifferentiated gallbladder carcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma without evidence of differentiation arising from the gallbladder. The most common variant is the spindle and giant cell type which resembles a sarcoma.

concepts.label: undifferentiated ovarian carcinoma
concepts.description: An aggressive carcinoma arising from the ovary. Most patients present with advanced disease. Microscopically, it is characterized by significant cytologic atypia, increased mitotic activity, and necrosis. The prognosis is usually poor.

concepts.label: undifferentiated pancreatic carcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma with poor prognosis that arises from the pancreas. It is characterized by the presence of a significant malignant component that does not show differentiation. The malignant cells represent a mixture of large, pleomorphic cells and giant cells, or adenocarcinoma cells and spindle cell...

concepts.label: undifferentiated pancreatic carcinoma with osteoclast-like giant cells
concepts.description: A rare variant of undifferentiated pancreatic carcinoma characterized by the presence of non-neoplastic osteoclast-like giant cells.
synonyms: osteoclast-like giant cell neoplasm of pancreas
osteoclast-like giant cell neoplasm of the pancreas
osteoclastic giant cell tumor of pancreas
osteoclastic giant cell tumour of pancreas
pancreatic undifferentiated carcinoma with osteoclast-like giant cells
undifferentiated carcinoma of pancreas with osteoclast-like giant cells
undifferentiated pancreatic carcinoma with osteoclast-like giant cells

concepts.label: undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma, inflammatory variant
concepts.description: An undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma characterized by the presence of numerous inflammatory cells.

concepts.label: ureter carcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the ureter.

concepts.label: ureter small cell carcinoma
concepts.description: A rare carcinoma that arises from the ureter. It is characterized by the presence of small neuroendocrine cells. The prognosis is poor.
synonyms: small cell carcinoma of the ureter

concepts.label: uterine carcinosarcoma
concepts.description: A usually aggressive malignant neoplasm arising from the uterine corpus and less often the cervix. It is characterized by the presence of two components: a malignant epithelial component and a sarcomatous component. In the uterine corpus the epithelial component is usually glandular whereas in th...
synonyms: malignant mixed mesodermal (Mullerian) tumor of the uterus
malignant mixed mesodermal (Mullerian) tumour of the uterus
malignant mixed mesodermal (Müllerian) tumor of the uterus
malignant mixed mesodermal (Müllerian) tumour of the uterus
uterine carcinosarcoma/uterine malignant mixed mullerian tumor
uterine carcinosarcoma/uterine malignant mixed mullerian tumour

concepts.label: uveal melanoma
concepts.description: A melanoma derived from melanocytes of the uveal tract. It is the most common primary intraocular tumor in the United States and Western Europe. Similar to melanoma of the skin, it is rare in Africa and Asia. Diagnostic procedures include ophthalmoscopic exam, fluorescein angiography and ultrasou...

concepts.label: vaginal adenoid cystic carcinoma
concepts.description: An adenoid cystic carcinoma that arises from the vagina. Myoepithelial cells are usually not present.

concepts.label: vaginal squamous cell carcinoma
concepts.description: A squamous cell carcinoma arising from the vagina. Human papillomavirus infection is associated with the development of vaginal intraepithelial neoplasia and invasive squamous cell carcinoma. Signs and symptoms include painless bleeding, postcoital bleeding, and urinary tract symptoms. Morphologi...
synonyms: epidermoid cell carcinoma of the vagina
squamous cell carcinoma of the vagina
squamous cell carcinoma of the vulva/vagina

concepts.label: palsy
concepts.description: A general term most often used to describe severe or complete loss of muscle strength due to motor system disease from the level of the cerebral cortex to the muscle fiber. This term may also occasionally refer to a loss of sensory function. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, p45)

concepts.label: cerebral palsy
concepts.description: A group of disorders affecting the development of movement and posture, often accompanied by disturbances of sensation, perception, cognition, and behavior. It results from damage to the fetal or infant brain.

concepts.label: hamartoma
concepts.description: A benign and excessive tumor-like growth of mature cells and normal tissues which grow in a disorganized pattern.

concepts.label: hemangioma
concepts.description: A benign vascular lesion characterized by the formation of capillary-sized or cavernous vascular channels.

concepts.label: acute respiratory distress syndrome
concepts.description: Progressive and life-threatening pulmonary distress in the absence of an underlying pulmonary condition, usually following major trauma or surgery. Cases of neonatal respiratory distress syndrome are not included in this definition.

concepts.label: acquired metabolic disease
concepts.description: An instance of metabolic disease that is acquired during the lifetime of the individual.

concepts.label: congenital nonspherocytic hemolytic anemia
concepts.description: Any one of a group of congenital hemolytic anemias in which there is no abnormal hemoglobin or spherocytosis and in which there is a defect of glycolysis in the erythrocyte. Common causes include deficiencies in glucose-6-phosphate isomerase; pyruvate kinase; and glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase.

concepts.label: hereditary hemochromatosis
concepts.description: An inherited metabolic disorder characterized by iron accumulation in the tissues.

concepts.label: papillary carcinoma
concepts.description: A malignant epithelial neoplasm characterized by a papillary growth pattern. A papillary carcinoma may be composed of glandular cells (papillary adenocarcinoma), squamous cells (papillary squamous cell carcinoma), or transitional cells (papillary transitional cell carcinoma). Bladder carcinoma is...

concepts.label: renal tubular transport disease
concepts.description: Genetic defects in the selective or non-selective transport functions of the kidney tubules.

concepts.label: childhood malignant neoplasm
concepts.description: A malignant tumor that occurs in children. Representative examples include soft tissue and bone sarcomas (e.g. osteosarcoma) and embryonal neoplasms (e.g. hepatoblastoma and rhabdoid tumor).

concepts.label: rectal cancer
concepts.description: A primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm that affects the rectum. Representative examples include carcinoma, lymphoma, and sarcoma.

concepts.label: Achenbach syndrome
concepts.description: A rare disorder which affects the volar surfaces of fingers. Clinical signs include recurrent, spontaneous or post-traumatic bruising of fingers. The clinical course of the resultant hematoma usually follows a pattern of resolution within days.

concepts.label: acrodermatitis
concepts.description: An inflammatory skin condition affecting children. It is often associated with Epstein-Barr virus infection, hepatitis B infection or cytomegalovirus infection. It is characterized by the presence of cutaneous rashes and patches on the palms and soles. The trunk is not affected.

concepts.label: acrodermatitis chronica atrophicans
concepts.description: An acrodermatitis characterized by a chronically progressive course, leading to widespread atrophy of the skin. It is a clinical manifestation of Lyme borreliosis.

concepts.label: allergic contact dermatitis
concepts.description: An inflammatory skin condition caused by an immune response to direct contact between the skin and an allergen. It consists of a delayed type of allergic reaction at the affected site with resulting red, swollen, and blistered skin that may itch or leak.

concepts.label: allergic urticaria
concepts.description: A urticaria with a basis in a pathological type I hypersensitivity reaction.

concepts.label: anhidrosis
concepts.description: Lack of sweating or the ability to sweat when provoked by the appropriate stimulus.

concepts.label: congenital generalized lipodystrophy
concepts.description: An extremely rare autosomal recessive condition, characterized by an extreme scarcity of fat in the subcutaneous tissues.

concepts.label: epidermolysis bullosa
concepts.description: Epidermolysis bullosa (EB) is a group of genetic skin diseases that cause the skin to blister very easily. Blisters form in response to minor injuries or friction, such as rubbing or scratching. There are four main types of epidermolysis bullosa: dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa Epidermolysis bul...

concepts.label: epidermolysis bullosa dystrophica
concepts.description: A genetic skin disorder caused by mutations in the type VII collagen gene (COL7A1). It is characterized by the formation of blisters and scarring in the skin and mucous membranes.

concepts.label: exanthem
concepts.description: A skin disease characterized by widespread, often symmetrical skin eruption that typically occurs acutely in association with a systemic disease, especially infectious or immune-mediated conditions.

concepts.label: facial dermatosis
concepts.description: Facial Dermatosis, also known as facial dermatoses, is related tolipogranulomatosis. An important gene associated with Facial Dermatosis isCCNE1(cyclin E1). The drugsbetamethasoneandbetamethasone acetatehave been mentioned in the context of this disorder.

concepts.label: alopecia mucinosa
concepts.description: A rare dermatologic disorder characterized by the accumulation of mucinous material in the hair follicles. In some cases it is associated with lymphoproliferative disorders, most often mycosis fungoides and Hodgkin lymphoma.
synonyms: cutaneous focal mucinosis of hair follicle

concepts.label: folliculitis
concepts.description: Inflammation of the hair follicles. Causes include excessive perspiration, skin infections, and skin wounds.

concepts.label: Fox-Fordyce disease
concepts.description: A chronic skin disease most common in women aged 13-35 years.It is characterized by the development of intense itching in the underarm area, the pubic area, and around the nipple of the breast as a result of perspiration which becomes trapped in the sweat gland and surrounding areas. The cause is...

concepts.label: granuloma annulare
concepts.description: Granuloma annulare is a long-term (chronic) skin disease consisting of a rash with reddish bumps arranged in a circle or ring. The most commonly affected areas are the forearms, hands and feet. The lesions associated with granuloma annulare usually resolve without treatment. Strong steroids (appl...

concepts.label: hemangioma of subcutaneous tissue
concepts.description: A hemangioma arising from the subcutaneous soft tissues.

concepts.label: pemphigoid gestationis
concepts.description: A rare pregnancy-associated autoimmune skin disease that is characterized by an itchy rash that develops into blisters. It is most common during the second and third trimesters of pregnancy. It was previously known as herpes gestationis although it has no association with the herpes virus whatsoe...

concepts.label: inverted follicular keratosis
concepts.description: Seborrheic keratosis that arises from follicular structures in the skin. It presents as a solitary nodule in the skin and is characterized by the presence of prominent squamous eddies.

concepts.label: irritant dermatitis
concepts.description: An inflammatory skin condition caused by direct contact between the skin and an irritating substance. It is typically manifested by erythema, mild edema, and scaling at the affected site.

concepts.label: keratosis
concepts.description: A skin disorder consisting of hypertrophy of the stratum corneum of the skin.

concepts.label: kernicterus due to isoimmunization
concepts.description: Encephalopathy in infants due to high levels of unconjugated bilirubin that are a result of Rh incompatibility between the mother and the fetus.
synonyms: kernicterus due to isoimmunization of fetus or newborn
kernicterus due to isoimmunization of foetus or newborn

concepts.label: lichen disease
concepts.description: A long-term skin condition that mainly affects the skin of the genitals. It usually causes itching and white patches to appear on the affected skin.

concepts.label: lichen planus
concepts.description: A chronic, recurrent, pruritic inflammatory disorder of unknown etiology that affects the skin and mucus membranes. It presents with rashes and papules that tend to resolve spontaneously. It may be associated with hepatitis C. Certain drugs that contain arsenic or bismuth are associated with reac...

concepts.label: lipodystrophy
concepts.description: A congenital or acquired disorder characterized by abnormal loss or redistribution of the adipose tissue in the body.

concepts.label: lipomatosis
concepts.description: A neoplastic process characterized by diffuse overgrowth of mature adipose tissue.

concepts.label: necrobiosis lipoidica
concepts.description: Necrobiosis lipoidica is a rare skin disorder of collagen degeneration. It is characterized by a rash that occurs on the lower legs. It is more common in women, and there are usually several spots. They are slightly raised shiny red-brown patches. The centers are often yellowish and may develop o...

concepts.label: palmoplantar keratosis
concepts.description: A group of autosomal dominant, autosomal recessive, X-linked inherited or acquired disorders characterized by the thickening of the palms and soles due to hyperkeratosis.

concepts.label: panniculitis
concepts.description: Inflammation of the subcutaneous adipose tissue.

concepts.label: parapsoriasis
concepts.description: An inflammatory skin disorder of unknown etiology characterized by papules and plaques or scaly patches resembling psoriasis.

concepts.label: pemphigus
concepts.description: Pemphigus is a group of rare autoimmune diseases that cause blistering of the skin and mucous membranes (mouth, nose, throat, eyes, and genitals).This conditioncan occur at any age, but often strikes people in middle or older age. Studies have shown that some populations may be at greater risk fo...

concepts.label: photoallergic dermatitis
concepts.description: A delayed hypersensitivity involving the reaction between sunlight or other radiant energy source and a chemical substance to which the individual has been previously exposed and sensitized. It manifests as a papulovesicular, eczematous, or exudative dermatitis occurring chiefly on the light-expo...

concepts.label: photosensitivity disease
concepts.description: Abnormal responses to sunlight or artificial light due to extreme reactivity of light-absorbing molecules in tissues. It refers almost exclusively to skin photosensitivity, including sunburn, reactions due to repeated prolonged exposure in the absence of photosensitizing factors, and reactions re...

concepts.label: phototoxic dermatitis
concepts.description: Dermatitis caused or precipitated by exposure to ultraviolet sunlight, or by mediating phototoxic or photoallergic material in response to ultraviolet sunlight.

concepts.label: physical urticaria
concepts.description: A distinct subgroup of the urticaria that are induced by an exogenous physical stimulus rather than occurring spontaneously.

concepts.label: porokeratosis
concepts.description: A clonal proliferation of abnormal keratinocytes characterized by the development of localized or multiple atrophic skin patches surrounded by an annular keratotic ring called cornoid lamella.

concepts.label: scleredema adultorum
concepts.description: A usually benign and self-limited skin disorder of unknown etiology, characterized by induration of the skin. It may be associated with infection, diabetes mellitus, and hematologic malignancies. Morphologically, there is deposition of mucin in the dermis.

concepts.label: sebaceous gland disorder
concepts.description: A disease involving the sebaceous gland.
synonyms: disease or disorder of sebaceous gland

concepts.label: skin sarcoidosis
concepts.description: Formation of non-necrotizing granulomas in the skin. It may be a manifestation of systemic sarcoidosis or may also arise in isolation.

concepts.label: subcorneal pustular dermatosis
concepts.description: A rare, benign, chronic disease characterized by sterile pustular eruption, typically involving the flexural sites of the trunk and proximal extremities.

concepts.label: sweat gland disorder
concepts.description: A disease involving the sweat gland.
synonyms: disease or disorder of sweat gland

concepts.label: vesiculobullous skin disease
concepts.description: Skin diseases characterized by local or general distributions of blisters. They are classified according to the site and mode of blister formation. Lesions can appear spontaneously or be precipitated by infection, trauma, or sunlight. Etiologies include immunologic and genetic factors. (From Scie...

concepts.label: vibratory urticaria
concepts.description: This very rare form of angioedema develops in reply to contact with vibration. In vibratory angioedema, symptoms develop within two to five minutes after contact with vibration and dissolve after about an hour. Patients with this disorder do not suffer from dermographism or pressure urticaria. Vi...

concepts.label: vulvar inverted follicular keratosis
concepts.description: Seborrheic keratosis that arises from follicular structures in the vulva. It is characterized by the presence of prominent squamous eddies.
synonyms: inverted follicular keratosis of mammalian vulva

concepts.label: vulvar seborrheic keratosis
concepts.description: A benign squamous neoplasm that arises from the vulva. It is characterized by the proliferation of the basal cells in the squamous epithelium, acanthosis, hyperkeratosis, and cysts formation.

concepts.label: pituitary gland acidophil adenoma
concepts.description: An epithelial neoplasm of the anterior pituitary gland in which the neoplastic cells stain positive with acidic dyes.

concepts.label: acute retinal necrosis syndrome
concepts.description: Mild to fulminant necrotizing vaso-occlusive retinitis associated with a high incidence of retinal detachment and poor vision outcome.

concepts.label: adrenal cortex carcinoma
concepts.description: A rare, usually large (greater than 5cm), malignant epithelial tumor arising from the adrenal cortical cells. Symptoms are usually related to the excessive production of hormones, and include Cushing's syndrome and virilism in women. Common sites of metastasis include liver, lung, bone, and retro...

concepts.label: adrenal gland hyperfunction
concepts.description: Excess production of adrenal cortex hormones.

concepts.label: alcoholic cardiomyopathy
concepts.description: A dilated cardiomyopathy which is associated with consumption of large amounts of alcohol over a period of years.

concepts.label: anterior compartment of tibia syndrome
concepts.description: Rapid swelling, increased tension, pain, and ischemic necrosis of the muscles of the anterior tibial compartment of the leg, often following excessive physical exertion.

concepts.label: anterior ischemic optic neuropathy
concepts.description: Anterior ischemic optic neuropathy (AION) is an eye disease characterized by infarction of the optic disk leading to vision loss. It can be nonarteritic (nonarteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy or NAION) or arteritic, the latter being associated with giant cell arteritis (GCA; often terme...
synonyms: optic disc infarction leading to vision loss

concepts.label: anterior uveitis
concepts.description: Inflammation of the iris and anterior chamber of the eye.

concepts.label: anthracosilicosis
concepts.description: Fibrosis of the lung parenchyma caused by inhalation of carbon and silica dust. It manifests as shortness of breath.

concepts.label: anthracosis
concepts.description: A chronic lung disorder characterized by deposition of coal dust in the lung parenchyma leading to the formation of black nodules and emphysema. It occurs in coal miners.

concepts.label: aortitis
concepts.description: Inflammation of the aorta. Causes include trauma, infectious disorders, and connective tissue disorders.

concepts.label: aseptic meningitis
concepts.description: Inflammation of the membranes surrounding the brain and spinal cord without a bacterial pathogen.

concepts.label: perinatal asphyxia
concepts.description: A disorder caused by a lack of blood flow or gas exchange to or from the fetus in the period immediately before, during, or after the birth process.
synonyms: hypoxic and ischaemic brain injury in the newborn
neonatal hypoxic and ischaemic brain injury

concepts.label: atrial septal defect
concepts.description: Interauricular communication is a congenital malformation characterized by a communication between the atrial chambers of the heart.

concepts.label: bacterial conjunctivitis
concepts.description: Inflammation of the conjunctiva caused by a variety of bacterial agents.

concepts.label: bacterial endocarditis
concepts.description: Endocarditis that is caused by an infection with a bacterial agent.

concepts.label: bacterial meningitis
concepts.description: Inflammation of the membranes surrounding the brain and spinal cord due to a bacterial infection.

concepts.label: pituitary gland basophil adenoma
concepts.description: An epithelial neoplasm of the anterior pituitary gland in which the neoplastic cells stain positive with basic dyes.

concepts.label: Borrelia infectious disease
concepts.description: Infections with bacteria of the genus borrelia.

concepts.label: brachial plexus neuritis
concepts.description: An inflammatory process affecting the brachial plexus. It results in severe pain in the upper extremity and shoulder, upper arm weakness and loss of sensation in the upper arm.

concepts.label: brachial plexus neuropathy
concepts.description: A brachial plexus disorder characterized by regional paresthesia, pain and muscle weakness, and limited movement in the arm or hand.
synonyms: peripheral neuropathy of brachial nerve plexus

concepts.label: brain stem infarction
concepts.description: Infarctions that occur in the brain stem which is comprised of the midbrain; pons; and medulla oblongata. There are several named syndromes characterized by their distinctive clinical manifestations and specific sites of ischemic injury.

concepts.label: burning mouth syndrome
concepts.description: A condition characterized by a burning or tingling sensation on the lips, tongue, or entire mouth.

concepts.label: byssinosis
concepts.description: An occupational lung disorder caused by exposure to cotton dust. It occurs more commonly in workers in the textile industry. Signs and symptoms include chest tightness, cough and wheezing. The symptoms tend to get worse at the beginning of the week and subside by the end of the week.

concepts.label: cerebral arterial disease
concepts.description: Pathological conditions of intracranial arteries supplying the cerebrum. These diseases often are due to abnormalities or pathological processes in the anterior cerebral artery; middle cerebral artery; and posterior cerebral artery.

concepts.label: choroid cancer
concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm involving the optic choroid.

concepts.label: chromophobe adenoma
concepts.description: An epithelial neoplasm of the anterior pituitary gland in which the neoplastic cells do not stain with acidic or basic dyes.
synonyms: chromophobe adenoma of the pituitary gland

concepts.label: chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyradiculoneuropathy
concepts.description: A rare neurological disorder in which there is inflammation of nerve roots and peripheral nerves and destruction of the fatty protective covering (myelin sheath) over the nerves. This affects how fast the nerve signals are transmitted and leads to loss of nerve fibers. This causes weakness, paral...

concepts.label: CNS demyelinating autoimmune disease
concepts.description: Conditions characterized by loss or dysfunction of myelin (see myelin sheath) in the brain, spinal cord, or optic nerves secondary to autoimmune mediated processes. This may take the form of a humoral or cellular immune response directed toward myelin or oligodendroglia associated autoantigens.

concepts.label: common bile duct neoplasm
concepts.description: Tumor or cancer of the common bile duct including the ampulla of vater and the sphincter of oddi.

concepts.label: cutaneous fibrous histiocytoma
concepts.description: A benign, intermediate, or malignant mesenchymal neoplasm composed of fibrohistiocytic cells, spindle fibroblastic cells, and histiocytes, in a storiform pattern.
synonyms: benign fibrous histiocytoma of the skin

concepts.label: cutaneous syphilis
concepts.description: Cutaneous lesions arising from infection with Treponema pallidum. In the primary stage, 18-21 days following infection, one or more chancres appear. If untreated, the subsequent stages of the disease appear as syphilids. These eruptions are superficial, nondestructive, exanthematic, transient, ma...
synonyms: Treponema pallidum caused skin disease caused by bacterial infection
Treponema pallidum skin disease caused by bacterial infection

concepts.label: cystic, mucinous, and serous neoplasm
concepts.description: Neoplasms containing cyst-like formations or producing mucin or serum.

concepts.label: diaphragmatic eventration
concepts.description: A congenital or acquired abnormality characterized by elevation of the hemidiaphragm.

concepts.label: discrete subaortic stenosis
concepts.description: A type of constriction that is caused by the presence of a fibrous ring (discrete type) below the aortic valve, anywhere between the aortic valve and the mitral valve. It is characterized by restricted outflow from the left ventricle into the aorta.

concepts.label: dry eye syndrome
concepts.description: A syndrome characterized by dryness of the cornea and conjunctiva. It is usually caused by a deficiency in tear production. Symptoms include a feeling of burning eyes and a possible foreign body presence in the eye.

concepts.label: dysplasia of cervix
concepts.description: Abnormal development of immature squamous epithelial cells of the uterine cervix, a term used to describe premalignant cytological changes in the cervical epithelium. These atypical cells do not penetrate the epithelial basement membrane.

concepts.label: empty sella syndrome
concepts.description: Empty sella syndrome (ESS) is a condition that involves the sella turcica, a bony structure at the base of the brain that protects the pituitary gland. There is a primary and secondary form of the condition. The primary form occurs when a structural defect above the pituitary gland increases pres...

concepts.label: endocrine tuberculosis
concepts.description: Infection of the endocrine glands with species of mycobacterium, most often mycobacterium tuberculosis.

concepts.label: endolymphatic hydrops
concepts.description: An accumulation of endolymph in the inner ear (labyrinth) leading to buildup of pressure and distortion of intralabyrinthine structures, such as cochlea and semicircular canals. It is characterized by sensorineural hearing loss; tinnitus; and sometimes vertigo.

concepts.label: endometrioid stromal sarcoma
concepts.description: A malignant mesenchymal neoplasm that affects the uterine corpus, and rarely, the ovaries, cervix, and vagina. In the uterine corpus it is classified as low grade or high grade endometrial stromal sarcoma. In the remainder of the anatomic sites it is classified as low grade endometrioid stromal s...
synonyms: stromal sarcoma of the corpus uteri

concepts.label: endomyocardial fibrosis
concepts.description: A disease characterized by fibrotic thickening of the endocardium, particularly the right and/or left inflow tracts. The disease often involves the atrioventricular valves, leading to valvular regurgitaion. It most commonly occurs in children living within 15 degrees of the equator.

concepts.label: Escherichia coli meningitis
concepts.description: A form of gram-negative meningitis that tends to occur in neonates, in association with anatomical abnormalities (which feature communication between the meninges and cutaneous structures) or as opportunistic infections in association with immunologic deficiency syndromes. In premature neonates t...

concepts.label: extrahepatic cholestasis
concepts.description: Impairment of the bile flow caused by an obstruction in the portion of the bile duct system located outside of the liver.

concepts.label: femoral neuropathy
synonyms: peripheral nerve lesion of femoral nerve

concepts.label: fetal erythroblastosis
concepts.description: A disorder of the fetus or newborn that occurs when fetal cells that are coated with IgG alloantibodies from the mother attack antigens inherited from the father. Severity can range from absence of symptoms to death.
synonyms: hemolytic disease of the fetus or newborn
hemolytic disease of the foetus or newborn
isoimmune hemolytic disease of the newborn

concepts.label: fibromuscular dysplasia
concepts.description: A disorder characterized by fibrous thickening of the arterial wall resulting in narrowing of the arterial lumen. It most often affects the renal artery and less often the carotid artery and abdominal arteries. It can cause hypertension and aneurysm formation.

concepts.label: fungal meningitis
concepts.description: Meningitis caused by fungal agents which may occur as opportunistic infections or arise in immunocompetent hosts.

concepts.label: gastric antral vascular ectasia
concepts.description: Dilatation of the vessels in the antrum of the stomach. It is associated with portal hypertension, scleroderma, and chronic renal failure. It may cause gastric bleeding.

concepts.label: gastroparesis
concepts.description: Paralysis of the muscles of the stomach wall resulting in delayed emptying of the gastric contents into the small intestine.

concepts.label: giant cell reparative granuloma
concepts.description: A rare tumor-like lesion of the hands and feet characterized by the presence of hemorrhagic fibrous tissue, hemosiderin deposition, osteoclast-like giant cells which are irregularly distributed, and reactive bone formation. Pain and swelling are the most frequent symptoms. It may recur following ...
synonyms: giant cell lesion of small bones

concepts.label: hemorrhagic disease of newborn
concepts.description: A condition characterized as a coagulation disturbance in newborns due to vitamin K deficiency resulting in impaired production of coagulation factors II, VII, IX, and X, and proteins C and S by the liver.
synonyms: vitamin K deficiency bleeding in newborn

concepts.label: hyperamylasemia
concepts.description: Abnormally high level of amylase in the blood.

concepts.label: hyperglobulinemic purpura
concepts.description: Purplish or brownish red discoloration of the skin associated with increase in circulating polyclonal globulins, usually gamma-globulins. This syndrome often occurs on the legs of women aged 20 to 40 years.

concepts.label: hyperpituitarism
concepts.description: Disease of the glandular, anterior portion of the pituitary (pituitary gland, anterior) resulting in hypersecretion of adenohypophyseal hormones such as growth hormone; prolactin; thyrotropin; luteinizing hormone; follicle stimulating hormone ; and adrenocorticotropic hormone. Hyperpituitarism us...

concepts.label: hypersensitivity vasculitis
concepts.description: A small vessel vasculitis affecting the skin and/or internal organs. It is characterized by the presence of neutrophils and fibrinoid necrosis in small arteries and venules. It may be idiopathic or the result of drug treatment, infections, food intake, collagen vascular disorders, inflammatory bo...

concepts.label: hypersplenism
concepts.description: Overactive functioning of the spleen, resulting in excessive destruction of blood cells.

concepts.label: hypothalamic neoplasm
concepts.description: A primary or metastatic neoplasm that affects the hypothalamus.

concepts.label: ileal neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant neoplasm that affects the wall of the ileum. Representative examples include adenoma, carcinoma, and lymphoma.

concepts.label: inflammatory breast carcinoma
concepts.description: An advanced, invasive breast adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of distinct changes in the overlying skin. These changes include diffuse erythema, edema, peau d'orange (skin of an orange) appearance, tenderness, induration, warmth, enlargement, and in some cases a palpable mass. The ski...

concepts.label: intestinal perforation
concepts.description: A rupture in the wall of the small or large intestine due to traumatic or pathologic processes.

concepts.label: intracranial arterial disease
concepts.description: Pathological conditions involving arteries in the skull, such as arteries supplying the cerebrum, the cerebellum, the brain stem, and associated structures. They include atherosclerotic, congenital, traumatic, infectious, inflammatory, and other pathological processes.

concepts.label: intracranial hypertension
concepts.description: A finding characterized by increased cerebrospinal fluid pressure within the skull.

concepts.label: jejunal cancer
concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm involving the jejunum.

concepts.label: arthropathy
synonyms: disease or disorder of skeletal joint

concepts.label: juxtacortical osteosarcoma
concepts.description: A low grade malignant bone-forming mesenchymal neoplasm arising from the surface of the bone. It usually affects the distal posterior femur, the proximal tibia, and proximal humerus. Painless swelling is the usual clinical sign. Most patients are young adults and the prognosis is usually excellent.

concepts.label: kuru
concepts.description: A prion disease found exclusively among the Fore linguistic group natives of the highlands of new guinea. The illness is primarily restricted to adult females and children of both sexes. It is marked by the subacute onset of tremor and ataxia followed by motor weakness and incontinence. Death occ...

concepts.label: lateral medullary syndrome
concepts.description: A syndrome caused by an infarct in the vertebral or posterior inferior cerebellar artery. It is characterized by sensory defects affecting the same side of the face as the infarct and the opposite side of the trunk as the infarct. Patients experience difficulty swallowing and/or speaking.

concepts.label: leukemoid reaction
concepts.description: A hematology test result that indicates the presence of an increased white blood cell count and increased neutrophil precursors resembling leukemia, in a peripheral blood smear.

concepts.label: leukostasis
concepts.description: A disorder involving the aberrant infiltration and aggregation of leukocytes into the vasculature of the body. Leukostasis is typically detected in the brain and lungs of persons with leukemia. It requires substantial ablative modalities to both reduce the number of cells present and to ensure di...

concepts.label: lip cancer
concepts.description: A primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm involving the lip.
synonyms: malignant neoplasm of lip, inner aspect
malignant neoplasm of lip, unspecified, inner aspect
malignant neoplasm of lip, unspecified, vermilion border
malignant neoplasm of oral aspect of lip, not specified whether upper or lower
malignant tumor of commissure of lip
malignant tumour of commissure of lip
malignant tumour of lower labial mucosa

concepts.label: minimal change disease
concepts.description: A glomerular disorder characterized by the electron microscopic finding of loss of podocyte foot processes. Light microscopic examination does not show glomerular changes. Patients present with proteinuria and nephrotic syndrome.
synonyms: nephrotic syndrome with lesion of minimal change glomerulonephritis

concepts.label: Listeria meningitis
concepts.description: Inflammation of the meninges caused by listeria monocytogenes infection, usually occurring in individuals under the age of 3 years or over the age of 50 years. It may occur at any age in individuals with immunologic deficiency syndromes. Clinical manifestations include fever, altered mentation, h...

concepts.label: lupus vulgaris
concepts.description: A form of cutaneous tuberculosis. It is seen predominantly in women and typically involves the nasal mucosa; buccal mucosa; and conjunctival mucosa.

concepts.label: Lutembacher syndrome
concepts.description: A condition characterized by a combination of ostium secundum atrial septal defect and an acquired mitral valve stenosis.

concepts.label: lymphangioendothelioma
concepts.description: A lymphangioma characterized by the presence of collagen bundle formation. It has an indolent clinical course and may be associated with skin plaques.

concepts.label: lymphangiomyoma
concepts.description: A neoplasm with perivascular epithelioid cell differentiation, often associated with tuberous sclerosis. It is characterized by the presence of smooth muscle and epithelioid cells and by the proliferation of lymphatic vessels. Sites of involvement include the lymph nodes, lung, mediastinum, and r...

concepts.label: male genital tuberculosis
concepts.description: Mycobacterium infections of the male reproductive tract (genitalia, male).

concepts.label: malignant lymphatic vessel tumor
concepts.description: Neoplasms composed of lymphoid tissue, a lattice work of reticular tissue the interspaces of which contain lymphocytes. The concept does not refer to neoplasms located in lymphatic vessels.

concepts.label: maxillary sinus neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant neoplasm that affects the maxillary sinus. Representative examples of benign neoplasms include Schneiderian papilloma and salivary gland-type adenoma. Representative examples of malignant neoplasms include carcinoma and lymphoma.

concepts.label: meconium aspiration syndrome
concepts.description: A serious condition in which a newborn breathes a mixture of meconium (the first intestinal discharge) and amniotic fluid into the lungs around the time of delivery. Meconium aspiration syndrome occurs in 5-10 percent of births and typically occurs when the infant is stressed, as when the infant ...

concepts.label: mesenchymal chondrosarcoma
concepts.description: A morphologic variant of chondrosarcoma arising from bone and soft tissue. It is characterized by the presence of malignant small round cells, biphasic growth pattern, and well differentiated hyaline cartilage. Clinical presentation includes pain and swelling. The clinical course is aggressive, w...

concepts.label: mesothelial neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant neoplasm arising from mesothelial cells. Mesothelial cells are the lining cells of the pleura and peritoneum. -- 2003

concepts.label: mucinous cystadenoma
concepts.description: A benign or low malignant potential cystic epithelial neoplasm composed of cells which contain intracytoplasmic mucin. It may arise from the ovary, pancreas, appendix, and lung.

concepts.label: myeloid sarcoma
concepts.description: A tumor mass composed of myeloblasts or immature myeloid cells. It occurs in extramedullary sites or the bone. (WHO, 2001)

concepts.label: myofascial pain syndrome
concepts.description: Muscular pain in numerous body regions that can be reproduced by pressure on trigger points, localized hardenings in skeletal muscle tissue. Pain is referred to a location distant from the trigger points. A prime example is the temporomandibular joint dysfunction syndrome.

concepts.label: myxosarcoma
concepts.description: An infiltrating malignant soft tissue neoplasm characterized by the presence of immature undifferentiated cells and abundant myxoid stroma formation.

concepts.label: neonatal myasthenia gravis
concepts.description: A disorder of neuromuscular transmission that occurs in a minority of newborns born to women with myasthenia gravis. Clinical features are usually present at birth or develop in the first 3 days of life and consist of hypotonia and impaired respiratory, suck, and swallowing abilities. This condit...

concepts.label: nodular goiter
concepts.description: Goiter characterized by discrete tissue mass(es) that may or may not produce thyroid hormones.

concepts.label: non-gestational choriocarcinoma
concepts.description: A highly malignant choriocarcinoma derived from the non-placental origin such as the totipotent cells in the testis, the ovary, and the pineal gland. It produces high levels of chorionic gonadotropin and can metastasize widely through the bloodstream to the lungs, brain, liver, bone, and other vi...

concepts.label: nutritional deficiency disease
concepts.description: A condition produced by dietary or metabolic deficiency. The term includes all diseases caused by an insufficient supply of essential nutrients, i.e., protein (or amino acids), vitamins, and minerals. It also includes an inadequacy of calories. (From Dorland, 27th ed; Stedman, 25th ed)

concepts.label: ocular tuberculosis
concepts.description: Tuberculous infection of the eye, primarily the iris, ciliary body, and choroid.

concepts.label: oophoritis
concepts.description: Inflammation of the ovary, generally caused by an ascending infection of organisms from the endocervix.

concepts.label: optic papillitis
concepts.description: Swelling of the optic disk, usually in association with increased intracranial pressure, characterized by hyperemia, blurring of the disk margins, microhemorrhages, blind spot enlargement, and engorgement of retinal veins. Chronic papilledema may cause optic atrophy and visual loss. (Miller et al...
synonyms: papilledema associated with decreased intraocular pressure
papilledema associated with increased intracranial pressure

concepts.label: panophthalmitis
concepts.description: Acute suppurative inflammation of the inner eye with necrosis of the sclera (and sometimes the cornea) and extension of the inflammation into the orbit. Pain may be severe and the globe may rupture. In endophthalmitis the globe does not rupture.

concepts.label: thyroid gland papillary and follicular carcinoma
concepts.description: A thyroid neoplasm of mixed papillary and follicular arrangement. Its biological behavior and prognosis is the same as that of a papillary adenocarcinoma of the thyroid. (From DeVita Jr et al., Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 3d ed, p1271)
synonyms: thyroid gland papillary and follicular carcinoma

concepts.label: paraneoplastic polyneuropathy
concepts.description: A diffuse or multifocal peripheral neuropathy caused by the effects of a distant neoplasm. It may be attributed, in part, to the immune response to neoplasm-elaborated proteins. The neuropathy may be sensory, motor, mixed or autonomic. It may be the initial presentation of an occult neoplasm. Det...

concepts.label: Pasteurella hemorrhagic septicemia
concepts.description: Any of several bacterial diseases, usually caused by pasteurella multocida, marked by the presence of hemorrhagic areas in the subcutaneous tissues, serous membranes, muscles, lymph glands, and throughout the internal organs. The diseases primarily affect animals and rarely humans.

concepts.label: penile neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign, borderline, or malignant neoplasm that affects the penis. Representative examples include penile hemangioma, penile intraepithelial neoplasia, and penile carcinoma.

concepts.label: peritoneal neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant neoplasm that affects the peritoneal cavity. Representative examples of benign neoplasms include adenomatoid tumor and disseminated peritoneal leiomyomatosis. Representative examples of malignant neoplasms include primary peritoneal carcinoma, metastatic carcinoma to the per...

concepts.label: pituitary apoplexy
concepts.description: A rare, potentially life-threatening disorder caused by acute ischemic infarction or hemorrhage in the pituitary gland. It is most often associated with the presence of a pituitary gland adenoma. Signs and symptoms include headache, vomiting, visual disturbances, and endocrine dysfunction.

concepts.label: pituitary dwarfism
concepts.description: Proportionately decreased bodily growth due to failure of the pituitary gland to produce an adequate supply of growth hormone.

concepts.label: pneumococcal meningitis
concepts.description: An acute purulent infection of the meninges and subarachnoid space caused by Streptococcus pneumoniae, most prevalent in children and adults over the age of 60. This illness may be associated with otitis media; mastoiditis; sinusitis; respiratory tract infections; sickle cell disease (anemia, sic...

concepts.label: polyradiculoneuropathy
concepts.description: Diseases characterized by injury or dysfunction involving multiple peripheral nerves and nerve roots. The process may primarily affect myelin or nerve axons. Two of the more common demyelinating forms are acute inflammatory polyradiculopathy (guillain-barre syndrome) and polyradiculoneuropathy, c...

concepts.label: posterior uveitis
concepts.description: Inflammation of the choroid as well as the retina and vitreous body. Some form of visual disturbance is usually present. The most important characteristics of posterior uveitis are vitreous opacities, choroiditis, and chorioretinitis.

concepts.label: Actinomycetales infectious disease
concepts.description: Infections with bacteria of the order actinomycetales.

concepts.label: Anaplasmataceae infectious disease
concepts.description: Infections with bacteria of the family anaplasmataceae.

concepts.label: Bacillaceae infectious disease
concepts.description: Infections with bacteria of the family bacillaceae.

concepts.label: Bartonellaceae infectious disease
concepts.description: Infections with bacteria of the family bartonellaceae.

concepts.label: haemophilus infectious disease
concepts.description: Infections with bacteria of the genus haemophilus.

concepts.label: Rickettsiaceae infectious disease
concepts.description: Infections with bacteria of the family rickettsiaceae.

concepts.label: pulmonary edema
concepts.description: Accumulation of fluid in the lung tissues causing disturbance of the gas exchange that may lead to respiratory failure. It is caused by direct injury to the lung parenchyma or congestive heart failure. The symptoms may appear suddenly or gradually. Suddenly appearing symptoms include difficulty b...

concepts.label: pulmonary valve stenosis
concepts.description: The pathologic narrowing of the orifice of the pulmonary valve. This lesion restricts blood outflow from the right ventricle to the pulmonary artery. When the trileaflet valve is fused into an imperforate membrane, the blockage is complete.

concepts.label: radial nerve lesion
concepts.description: A peripheral nerve lesion that involves the radial nerve.
synonyms: peripheral nerve lesion of radial nerve

concepts.label: rat-bite fever
concepts.description: An infectious disease that is caused transmitted by the bite of a rat. Two species of bacteria can cause the infection: Streptobacillus moniliformis and Spirillum minus.

concepts.label: renal aminoaciduria
concepts.description: A group of inherited kidney disorders characterized by the abnormally elevated levels of amino acids in urine. Genetic mutations of transport proteins result in the defective reabsorption of free amino acids at the proximal renal tubules. Renal aminoaciduria are classified by the specific amino a...

concepts.label: renal osteodystrophy
concepts.description: Abnormalities of bone mineral metabolism associated with chronic kidney disease.

concepts.label: retinal artery occlusion
concepts.description: An occlusion of the retinal artery.

concepts.label: retinal drusen
concepts.description: Colloid or hyaline bodies lying beneath the retinal pigment epithelium. They may occur either secondary to changes in the choroid that affect the pigment epithelium or as an autosomal dominant disorder of the retinal pigment epithelium.

concepts.label: retinal vasculitis
concepts.description: Inflammation of the retinal vasculature with various causes including infectious disease; lupus erythematosus, systemic; multiple sclerosis; behcet syndrome; and chorioretinitis.

concepts.label: retinal vein occlusion
concepts.description: An occlusion of the retinal vein.

concepts.label: retinopathy of prematurity
concepts.description: A bilateral retinopathy characterized by neovascularization, scarring, retinal detachment, and eventually blindness. It may be mild or severe. It occurs in babies born prematurely. Causes include oxygen toxicity and hypoxia.

concepts.label: rheumatic heart disease
concepts.description: An autoinflammatory condition following an infection with Group A Beta Hemolytic Streptococcus (GABHS), in which the heart is attacked by antibodies formed in reaction to a recent GABHS infection. Chief anatomic changes of the valve include leaflet thickening, commissural fusion, and shortening a...

concepts.label: Rickettsiosis
concepts.description: A group of infectious diseases that is caused by Rickettsia.

concepts.label: sciatic neuropathy
concepts.description: Disease or damage involving the SCIATIC NERVE, which divides into the PERONEAL NERVE and TIBIAL NERVE (see also PERONEAL NEUROPATHIES and TIBIAL NEUROPATHY). Clinical manifestations may include SCIATICA or pain localized to the hip, PARESIS or PARALYSIS of posterior thigh muscles and muscles inne...

concepts.label: scrapie
concepts.description: A fatal disease of the nervous system in sheep and goats, characterized by pruritus, debility, and locomotor incoordination. It is caused by proteinaceous infectious particles called prions.

concepts.label: sebaceous adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An adenocarcinoma with sebaceous differentiation. It presents as a painless mass and it may be multifocal. It grows in the ocular adnexae and in the skin of head and neck, trunk, genitals, and extremities. It is characterized by the presence of malignant cells with multivesicular and clear cytopl...

concepts.label: sebaceous gland neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant neoplasm that arises from the sebaceous glands. Representative examples include sebaceous adenoma and sebaceous carcinoma.

concepts.label: secondary hyperparathyroidism
concepts.description: Overproduction of parathyroid hormone in response to influence external to the parathyroid glands.

concepts.label: secondary Parkinson disease
concepts.description: A condition with a clinical picture similar to that of Parkinson disease, but which is caused by external factors, including medication.

concepts.label: skin appendage carcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma arising from the sebaceous glands, sweat glands, or the hair follicles. Representative examples include sebaceous carcinoma, apocrine carcinoma, eccrine carcinoma, and pilomatrical carcinoma.

concepts.label: small cell sarcoma
concepts.description: A sarcoma characterized by the presence of small round or elongated malignant cells with a small amount of cytoplasm.

concepts.label: smooth muscle tumor
concepts.description: A benign or malignant myomatous neoplasm arising from smooth muscle.

concepts.label: somatostatinoma
concepts.description: A rare, usually malignant neuroendocrine tumor arizing from delta cells. This neoplasm produces large amounts of somatostatin, which may result in a syndrome characterized by diarrhea, steatorrhea, weight loss, and gastric hyposecretion. Sixty percent are found in the pancreas and 40% in the duod...

concepts.label: splenic infarction
concepts.description: Insufficiency of arterial or venous blood supply to the spleen due to emboli, thrombi, vascular torsion, or pressure that produces a macroscopic area of necrosis. (From Stedman, 25th ed)

concepts.label: struma ovarii
concepts.description: An ovarian mature teratoma characterized by the presence of aberrant thyroid tissue. The aberrant thyroid tissue shows morphologic changes identical to thyroid adenoma or carcinoma. Patients may present with abdominal mass and unusual symptoms due to thyrotoxicosis, or Meigs syndrome (ascites and...

concepts.label: subacute bacterial endocarditis
concepts.description: Subacute inflammation of the endocardium. Streptococcus viridans is the usual etiologic agent of subacute bacterial endocarditis. The distinction between "acute" and "subacute" endocarditis has traditionally been made based on the pathogenic organism and clinical presentation.

concepts.label: subdural empyema
concepts.description: An intracranial or rarely intraspinal suppurative process invading the space between the inner surface of the dura mater and the outer surface of the arachnoid.

concepts.label: subvalvular aortic stenosis
concepts.description: An aortic stenosis caused by fibromuscular stenosis or hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. It may be associated with congenital heart defects.

concepts.label: sulfhemoglobinemia
concepts.description: A morbid condition due to the presence of sulfmethemoglobin in the blood. It is marked by persistent cyanosis, but the blood count does not reveal any special abnormality in the blood. It is thought to be caused by the action of hydrogen sulfide absorbed from the intestine. (Stedman, 25th ed)

concepts.label: suppurative uveitis
concepts.description: Intraocular infection caused mainly by pus-producing bacteria and rarely by fungi. The infection may be caused by an injury or surgical wound (exogenous) or by endogenous septic emboli in such diseases as bacterial endocarditis or meningococcemia.

concepts.label: syphilitic aortitis
concepts.description: Cardiovascular manifestations of syphilis, an infection of treponema pallidum. In the late stage of syphilis, sometimes 20-30 years after the initial infection, damages are often seen in the blood vessels including the aorta and the aortic valve. Clinical signs include syphilitic aortitis, aortic...

concepts.label: tarsal tunnel syndrome
concepts.description: Tarsal tunnel syndrome is a nerve disorder that is characterized by pain in the ankle, foot, and toes. This condition is caused by compression of the posterior tibial nerve, which runs through a canal near the heel into the sole of the foot. When tissues around this nerve become inflamed, they ca...
synonyms: neuropathy of the posterior tibial nerve and its branches

concepts.label: tibial neuropathy
concepts.description: Disease of the tibial nerve (also referred to as the posterior tibial nerve). The most commonly associated condition is the tarsal tunnel syndrome. However, leg injuries; ischemia; and inflammatory conditions (e.g., collagen diseases) may also affect the nerve. Clinical features include paralysis...

concepts.label: tonsil cancer
concepts.description: A primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm that affects the tonsil.

concepts.label: tooth disorder
concepts.description: A disease involving the calcareous tooth.
synonyms: disease or disorder of calcareous tooth

concepts.label: Treponema infectious disease
concepts.description: An disease caused by infection with Treponema.

concepts.label: tricuspid valve prolapse
concepts.description: Abnormal protrusion of one or more of the leaflets of tricuspid valve into the right atrium during systole. This allows the backflow of blood into right atrium leading to tricuspid valve insufficiency; systolic murmurs. Its most common cause is not primary valve abnormality but rather the dilatio...

concepts.label: trochlear nerve disorder
concepts.description: A disease involving the trochlear nerve.
synonyms: disease or disorder of trochlear nerve

concepts.label: ulnar neuropathy
concepts.description: Disease involving the ulnar nerve from its origin in the brachial plexus to its termination in the hand. Clinical manifestations may include paresis or paralysis of wrist flexion, finger flexion, thumb adduction, finger abduction, and finger adduction. Sensation over the medial palm, fifth finger...

concepts.label: uremia
concepts.description: A clinical syndrome associated with the retention of renal waste products or uremic toxins in the blood. It is usually the result of renal insufficiency. Most uremic toxins are end products of protein or nitrogen catabolism, such as urea or creatinine. Severe uremia can lead to multiple organ dys...

concepts.label: uveoparotid fever
concepts.description: A manifestation of sarcoidosis marked by chronic inflammation of the parotid gland and the uvea.

concepts.label: variant Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease
concepts.description: A form of Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease that is most commonly contracted after consuming meat from an animal suffering from bovine spongiform encephalopathy.

concepts.label: vibrio infectious disease
concepts.description: Infections with bacteria of the genus vibrio.

concepts.label: viral meningitis
concepts.description: Inflammation of the membranes surrounding the brain and spinal cord due to a viral infection.

concepts.label: vitreous detachment
concepts.description: Detachment of the vitreous humor from the retina.

concepts.label: Yersinia infectious disease
concepts.description: Infections with bacteria of the genus yersinia.

concepts.label: Yersinia pseudotuberculosis infectious disease
concepts.description: Infections with bacteria of the species yersinia pseudotuberculosis.

concepts.label: chancre
concepts.description: The primary sore of syphilis, a painless indurated, eroded papule, occurring at the site of entry of the infection.

concepts.label: branchio-oto-renal syndrome
concepts.description: A syndrome characterized by branchial arch anomalies (branchial clefts, fistulae, cysts), hearing impairment (malformations of the auricle with pre-auricular pits, conductive or sensorineural hearing impairment), and renal malformations (urinary tree malformation, renal hypoplasia or agenesis, re...

concepts.label: autosomal dominant Aarskog syndrome
concepts.description: We place the DO class here as it is explicitly AD, but it's not clear if the intent is for the DO class to be equivalent to the classic X-linked form (the DO synonyms suggest this is the case)

concepts.label: familial abdominal aortic aneurysm
concepts.description: An instance of abdominal aortic aneurysm that is caused by an inherited modification of the individual's genome.

concepts.label: prune belly syndrome
concepts.description: Prune belly syndrome is a rare congenital disorder, belonging to the group of fetal lower urinary tract obstructions (LUTO), involving variable dilation of the lower urinary tract in association with partial or complete absence of the lateral and inferior abdominal wall musculature and in males b...
synonyms: syndrome of agenesis of abdominal muscles

concepts.label: Adams-Oliver syndrome
concepts.description: Adams-Oliver Syndrome (AOS) is a rare disorder characterized by the combination of congenital limb abnormalities and scalp defects, often accompanied by skull ossification defects.
synonyms: congenital scalp defects with distal limb anomalies
congenital scalp defects with distal limb reduction anomalies

concepts.label: acanthosis nigricans
concepts.description: A melanotic cutaneous lesion that develops in the axilla and other body folds. It may be idiopathic, drug-induced, or it may be associated with the presence of an endocrine disorder or malignancy.

concepts.label: Achard syndrome
concepts.description: A rare genetic syndrome featuring connective tissue abnormalities. Clinical signs include brachycephaly, arachnodactyly, receding mandible and joint laxity at the hands and feet.
synonyms: arachnodactyly, receding lower jaw and joint laxity of hands/feet

concepts.label: achondroplasia
concepts.description: Achondroplasia is the most common form of chondrodysplasia, characterized by rhizomelia, exaggerated lumbar lordosis, brachydactyly, and macrocephaly with frontal bossing and midface hypoplasia.

concepts.label: NF2-related schwannomatosis
concepts.description: A tumor-prone disorder characterized by the development of multiple schwannomas and meningiomas.

concepts.label: Sakati-Nyhan syndrome
concepts.description: An acrocephalosyndactylia characterized by abnormalities in the bones of the legs, congenital heart defects and craniofacial defects and craniosynostosis. The patients suffer from cyanosis and other respiratory and breathing infections.

concepts.label: Apert syndrome
concepts.description: Apert syndrome (AS) is a frequent form of acrocephalosyndactyly, a group of inherited congenital malformation disorders, characterized by craniosynostosis, midface hypoplasia, and finger and toe anomalies and/or syndactyly.

concepts.label: Saethre-Chotzen syndrome
concepts.description: Saethre-Chotzen syndrome (SCS) is an inherited craniosynostosis syndrome characterized by unilateral or bilateral coronal synostosis, facial asymmetry, ptosis, strabismus and small ears with prominent crus, among other less common manifestations.
synonyms: Saethre-Chotzen syndrome with or without eyelid anomalies
blepharophimosis, epicanthus inversus, and ptosis 3, formerly

concepts.label: Pfeiffer syndrome
concepts.description: Pfeiffer syndrome (PS) is a common form of acrocephalosyndactyly, a group of inherited congenital malformation disorders, characterized by variable degrees of bicoronal craniosynostosis, variable hand and foot malformations and various other associated manifestations.

concepts.label: Acrodysostosis 1 with or without hormone resistance
concepts.description: An autosomal dominant skeletal dysplasia caused by mutation(s) in the PRKAR1A gene, encoding cAMP-dependent protein kinase type I-alpha regulatory subunit. It is characterized by short stature, brachydactyly, and characteristic facial features. Resistance to multiple hormones is a common finding.
synonyms: Acrodysostosis 1 with or without hormone resistance
Acrodysostosis 1, with or without hormone resistance

concepts.label: acrofacial dysostosis, Catania type
concepts.description: Acrofacialdysostosis, Catania type is a very rare type of acrofacialdysostosis characterized by mild intrauterine growth retardation (IUGR), postnatal short stature, microcephaly, widow's peak, mandibulofacial dysostosis without cleft palate, frequent caries, mild pre- and postaxial limb hypoplas...

concepts.label: punctate palmoplantar keratoderma type III
concepts.description: Acrokeratoelastoidosis of Costa is a rare dermatosis characterized by small, firm papules or plaques (resembling warts) on the sides of the hands and feet. These stationary and asymptomatic lesions appear generally at puberty, or sometimes later
synonyms: collagenous plaques of hand and feet

concepts.label: acrokeratosis verruciformis
concepts.description: A rare genetic skin keratinization disorder with an autosomal dominant mode of inheritance. It is characterized by numerous flesh-colored warty papules on the back of the hands, medial aspect of the feet, knees, and elbows.

concepts.label: acromegaloid facial appearance syndrome
concepts.description: Acromegaloid facial appearance (AFA) syndrome is a multiple congenital anomalies/dysmorphic syndrome with a probable autosomal dominant inheritance, characterized by a progressively coarse acromegaloid-like facial appearance with thickening of the lips and intraoral mucosa, large and doughy hands...

concepts.label: growth hormone secreting pituitary adenoma 1
synonyms: pituitary adenoma 1, multiple types, autosomal dominant, somatic mutation
pituitary adenoma predisposition, autosomal dominant, somatic mutation

concepts.label: Acromicric dysplasia
concepts.description: A rare bone dysplasia characterized by short stature, short hands and feet, mild facial dysmorphism, and characteristic X-ray abnormalities of the hands.

concepts.label: acroosteolysis
concepts.description: A condition that is characterized by degeneration of the distal phalanges.

concepts.label: acroosteolysis dominant type
concepts.description: A rare genetic osteolysis syndrome resulting from protein-truncating variants in exon 34 of the NOTCH2 gene. These variants disrupt only the PEST domain, escape nonsense-mediated decay, and are postulated to function through a gain-of-function mechanism. This condition is characterized by acroost...
synonyms: acroosteolysis with osteoporosis and changes in skull and mandible

concepts.label: Acropectorovertebral dysplasia
concepts.description: A skeletal dysplasia characterized by fusion of the carpal and tarsal bones, with complex anomalies of the fingers and toes (preaxial polydactyly of the hands and/or feet, syndactyly of fingers and toes, hypoplasia and dysgenesis of metatarsal bones).

concepts.label: acrorenal syndrome
concepts.description: Acrorenal syndrome comprises a wide spectrum of congenital malformative disorders characterized by the co-occurrence of distal limb anomalies (usually bilateral cleft feet and/or hands) and renal defects (e.g. unilateral or bilateral agenesis), that can be associated with a variety of other anoma...

concepts.label: spermatogenic failure 6
concepts.description: Any azoospermia in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the SPATA16 gene.
synonyms: azoospermia caused by mutation in SPATA16

concepts.label: lattice corneal dystrophy type I
concepts.description: Type I lattice corneal dystrophy (LCDI) is a frequent form of stromal corneal dystrophy characterized by a network of delicate interdigitating branching filamentous opacities within the cornea with progressive visual impairment and no systemic manifestations.

concepts.label: epithelial recurrent erosion dystrophy
concepts.description: Epithelial recurrent erosion dystrophy (ERED) is a rare form of superficial corneal dystrophy characterized by recurrent episodes of epithelial erosions from childhood in the absence of associated diseases, with occasional impairment of vision.

concepts.label: congenital trigeminal anesthesia
concepts.description: Congenital trigeminal anesthesia is a rare neuro-ophtalmological disorder characterized by a congenital sensory deficit involving all or some of the sensory components of the trigeminal nerve. concepts.label: Cornelia de Lange syndrome 1
concepts.description: Any Cornelia de Lange syndrome in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the NIPBL gene.
synonyms: Cornelia de Lange syndrome caused by mutation in NIPBL

concepts.label: congenitally short costocoracoid ligament
concepts.description: Congenital shortness of the costocoracoid ligament is a rare anomaly characterized by fixation of the scapula to the first rib, resulting in a cosmetic deformity with rounding of the shoulders and loss of the anterior clavicular contour.

concepts.label: coxa vara
concepts.description: Hip deformity in which the femoral neck leans forward resulting in a decrease in the angle between femoral neck and its shaft. It may be congenital often syndromic, acquired, or developmental.

concepts.label: coxoauricular syndrome
concepts.description: Coxoauricular syndrome is an extremely rare primary bone defect, described only in a mother and her three daughters to date, characterized by short stature, hip dislocation, minor vertebral and pelvic changes, and microtia with hearing loss. concepts.label: craniofacial-deafness-hand syndrome
concepts.description: Craniofacial-deafness-hand syndrome (CDHS) is an autosomal dominant disorder, described in one family to date, characterized by characteristic facial features (flat facial profile with normal calvarium, hypertelorism, small downslanting palpebral fissures, hypoplastic nose with button tip and sli...
synonyms: features of flat facial profile, hypertelorism, hypoplastic nose with slitlike nares, and a sensorineural hearing loss

concepts.label: dysostosis, Stanescu type
concepts.description: Stanescu type dysostosis is a rare form of osteosclerosis.

concepts.label: TWIST1-related craniosynostosis
concepts.description: Any craniosynostosis in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the TWIST1 gene.

concepts.label: Jackson-Weiss syndrome
concepts.description: Jackson-Weiss syndrome (JWS) is a rare genetic disorder characterized by foot malformations (tarsal and metatarsal fusions; short, broad, medially deviated great toes) and in some patients craniosynostosis with facial anomalies. Hands are normal in affected patients.

concepts.label: craniosynostosis-Dandy-Walker malformation-hydrocephalus syndrome
concepts.description: Craniosynostosis, Dandy-Walker malformation and hydrocephalus is a malformation disorder characterized by sagittal craniosynostosis, Dandy-Walker malformation, hydrocephalus, craniofacial dysmorphism (including dolichocephaly, hypertelorism, micrognathia, positional ear deformity) and variable de...

sagittal craniosynostosis, Dandy-Walker malformation and hydrocephalus

concepts.label: Cri-du-chat syndrome
concepts.description: Monosomy 5p, also known as Cri du chat syndrome, is a rare autosomal deletion syndrome characterized by a mewing cry (cri du chat) in infancy, multiple congenital anomalies, intellectual disability, microcephaly, and facial dysmorphism.

concepts.label: Crouzon syndrome
concepts.description: Crouzon disease is characterized by craniosynostosis and facial hypoplasia.

concepts.label: Cryoglobulinemic vasculitis
concepts.description: Mixed cryoglobulinemia (MC) is a rare multisystem disease characterized by the presence of circulating cryoprecipitable immune complexes in the serum, manifested clinically by a classical triad of purpura, weakness and arthralgia.

concepts.label: cryptomicrotia-brachydactyly-excess fingertip arch syndrome
concepts.description: Cryptomicrotia - brachydactyly - excess fingertip arch syndrome describes a combination of malformations that include bilateral cryptomicrotia, brachytelomesophalangy with short middle and distal phalanges of digits 2 through 5, hypoplastic toenails and excess fingertip arch patterns, and has bee...

concepts.description: Isolated cryptophtalmia is a congenital abnormality in which the eyelids are absent and skin covers the ocular bulb, which is often microphthalmic. Six cases of complete bilateral crytophthalmia have been described. Transmission is autosomal dominant.

concepts.label: cutis laxa, autosomal dominant 1

concepts.label: Cyprus facial-neuromusculoskeletal syndrome
concepts.description: Cyprus facial-neuromusculoskeletal syndrome is an exceedingly rare, genetic malformation syndrome characterized by a striking facial appearance, variable skeletal deformities, and neurological defects.

concepts.label: Gorham-Stout disease
concepts.description: Gorham-Stout disease (GSD) is a rare disease of massive osteolysis associated with proliferation and dilation of lymphatic vessels. concepts.label: mitochondrial complex III deficiency nuclear type 1
concepts.description: Any mitochondrial complex III deficiency in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the BCS1L gene.
synonyms: mitochondrial complex III deficiency caused by mutation in BCS1L
mitochondrial complex III deficiency, nuclear type 1

concepts.label: Balkan nephropathy
concepts.description: A chronic tubulointerstitial nephropathy that affects people in certain rural areas along the Danube river in the Balkans. It leads to end-stage renal disease.

concepts.label: Darier disease
concepts.description: Darier disease (DD) is a keratinization disorder characterized by the development of keratotic papules in seborrheic areas and specific nail anomalies.

concepts.label: autosomal dominant deafness - onychodystrophy syndrome
concepts.description: Dominant deafness-onychodystrophy (DDOD) syndrome is a multiple congenital anomalies syndrome characterized by congenital hearing impairment, small or absent nails on the hands and feet, and small terminal phalanges.

concepts.label: keratoderma hereditarium mutilans
concepts.description: A rare, diffuse, mutilating, hereditary palmoplantar keratoderma disorder characterized by severe, honeycomb-pattern palmoplantar keratosis and pseudoainhum of the digits leading to autoamputation, associated with mild to moderate congenital sensorineural hearing loss. concepts.label: autosomal dominant nonsyndromic hearing loss 1
concepts.description: Any autosomal dominant nonsyndromic deafness in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the DIAPH1 gene.

concepts.description: Dentatorubral pallidoluysian atrophy (DRPLA) is a rare subtype of type I autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia (ADCA type I). It is characterized by involuntary movements, ataxia, epilepsy, mental disorders, cognitive decline and prominent anticipation.

concepts.label: dentin dysplasia type I

concepts.label: dentin dysplasia type II
concepts.description: Dentin dysplasia type II (DD-II) is a rare mild form of dentin dysplasia (DD) characterized by normal tooth roots but abnormal primary dentition.

concepts.label: dentin dysplasia-sclerotic bones syndrome
concepts.description: A rare, genetic odontologic disease characterized by the clinical, radiographic, and histologic features of dentine dysplasia and osteosclerosis of all long bones, with heavy cortical bone and narrowed or occluded marrow spaces. There have been no further descriptions in the literature since 1977.

concepts.label: dentinogenesis imperfecta type 2
concepts.description: Dentinogenesis imperfecta type 2 (DGI-2) is a rare, severe form of dentinogenesis imperfecta (DGI) and is characterized by weakness and discoloration of all teeth.

concepts.label: dentinogenesis imperfecta type 3
