concepts.description: Secondary intestinal lymphangiectasia is an acquired from of intestinal lymphangiectasia manifesting as a protein-losing enteropathy due to another disorder such as CrohnBs disease, congestive heart failure, sarcoidosis, Turner syndrome and often in patients who have undergone a Fontan operation....

concepts.label: hypotrichosis simplex of the scalp
concepts.description: Hypotrichosis simplex of the scalp (HSS) is characterized by diffuse progressive hair loss that is confined to the scalp.
synonyms: hereditary hypotrichosis simplex of the scalp

concepts.label: nodular lichen myxedematosus
concepts.description: Nodular lichen myxedematosus is a rare form of localized lichen myxedematosus characterized by the development of skin-coloured mucinous nodules on the limbs and trunk, with mild or absent papular eruption.

concepts.label: discrete papular lichen myxedematosus
concepts.description: Discrete papular lichen myxedematosus is a rare chronic, slowly progressive form of localized lichen myxedematosus characterized by the development of a few to multiple small symmetrical skin-coloured mucinous papules on the limbs and trunk.

concepts.label: papular mucinosis of infancy
concepts.description: Papular mucinosis of infancy is a rare pediatric non progressive form of localized lichen myxedematosus characterized by the development of firm opalescent mucinous papules on the upper arms and the trunk.

concepts.label: acral persistent papular mucinosis
concepts.description: Acral persistent papular mucinosis is a rare chronic form of localized lichen myxedematosus characterized by the development of multiple symmetrical skin-colored mucinous papules exclusively on the extensor surface of the hands and distal forearms.

concepts.label: self-healing papular mucinosis
concepts.description: Self-healing papular mucinosis is a rare form of localized lichen myxedematosus occurring primarily in children and characterized by the development of mucinous papules on various parts of the body (face, neck, trunk, and limbs) that resolve spontaneously within some weeks to months. Systemic sym...

concepts.label: localized lichen myxedematosus with mixed features of different subtypes
concepts.description: Localized lichen myxedematosus (LM) with mixed features of different subtypes is a form of atypical lichen myxedematosus, characterized by mixed features of the 5 subtypes of localized LM which are: discrete papular LM, acral persistent papular mucinosis, self-healing papular mucinosis, papular m...

concepts.label: localized lichen myxedematosus with monoclonal gammopathy or systemic symptoms
concepts.description: Localized lichen myxedematosus with monoclonal gammopathy or systemic symptoms is a form of atypical lichen myxedematosus, characterized by the appearance of several 2-4 mm erythematous waxy papules confined to a few sites that may be associated with either an immunoglobulin A (IgA) nephropathy i...

concepts.label: scleromyxedema without monoclonal gammopathy
concepts.description: Scleromyxedema without monoclonal gammopathy is a form of atypical lichen myxedematosus, characterized by a generalized sclerodermoid infiltration of skin studded with multiple, firm papules of 1-3 mm in diameter involving face (leonine appearance), trunk, and limbs, without monoclonal gammopathy...

concepts.description: Autosomal recessive form of nonsyndromic deafness.

concepts.label: panhypopituitarism
concepts.description: Insufficient production of all the anterior pituitary hormones.

concepts.description: Xeroderma pigmentosum (XP) is a rare genodermatosis characterized by extreme sensitivity to ultraviolet (UV)-induced changes in the skin and eyes, and multiple skin cancers. concepts.description: A rare monoclonalgammopathy characterized by renal proximal tubule dysfunction secondary to monoclonal kappa light chain deposits in proximal tubular cells. concepts.description: A group of very rare glomerular diseases, composed of immunotactoid glomerulopathy (ITG) and non-amyloid fibrillary glomerulopathy (non-amyloid FGP), that are characterized by mesangial deposition of monoclonal microtubular or polyclonal fibrillar deposits. concepts.label: simple cryoglobulinemia
concepts.description: Simple (monoclonal) cryoglobulinemia or type I cryoglobulinemia refers to the presence in the serum of one isotype or subclass of immunoglobulin (Ig) that precipitates reversibly below 37°C.

concepts.label: unspecified juvenile idiopathic arthritis
concepts.description: Unspecified juvenile idiopathic arthritis is a rare, pediatric, rheumatologic disease, a subtype of juvenile idiopathic arthritis (JIA) characterized by arthritis of an unknown cause that persists for at least 6 weeks, and does not fulfill the criteria for any of the other JIA subtypes, or fulfil...

concepts.label: Zellweger spectrum disorders
concepts.description: The most severe variant seen in the peroxisome biogenesis disorders that is characterized by neuronal migration defects in the brain, dysmorphic craniofacial features, profound hypotonia, neonatal seizures, and liver dysfunction.

concepts.label: Zollinger-Ellison syndrome
concepts.description: Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (ZES) is characterized by severe peptic disease (ulcers/esophageal disease) caused by hypergastrinemia secondary to a gastrinoma resulting in increased gastric acid secretion.

concepts.label: TSH-secreting pituitary adenoma
concepts.description: A rare adenoma of the anterior lobe of the pituitary gland that produces thyrotropin. It is usually associated with goiter and hyperthyroidism.

concepts.label: congenital esophageal diverticulum
concepts.description: Congenital esophageal diverticulum is a rare, non-syndromic malformation of the esophagus, present at birth, and characterized by a false diverticulum, most often located in the upper, posterior esophagus. Many patients are asymptomatic, but respiratory distress, food regurgitation, dysphagia, ch...

concepts.label: chronic pneumonitis of infancy
concepts.description: Chronic pneumonitis of infancy is a rare pediatric form of interstitial lung disease (ILD).

concepts.label: non-specific interstitial pneumonia
concepts.description: Idiopathic interstitial pneumonia characterized by chronic inflammation and fibrosis in the interstitial lung tissue. It includes cases that cannot be classified into one of the other types of idiopathic interstitial pneumonia.

concepts.label: hereditary angioedema
concepts.description: Hereditary angioedema (HAE) is a genetic disease characterized by the occurrence of transitory and recurrent subcutaneous and/or submucosal edemas resulting in swelling and/or abdominal pain.

concepts.label: acquired angioedema
concepts.description: Acquired angioedema (AAE) is characterized by the occurrence of transitory and recurrent subcutaneous and/or submucosal edemas resulting in swelling and/or abdominal pain due to an acquired C1 inhibitor (C1-INH) deficiency.

concepts.label: familial thoracic aortic aneurysm and aortic dissection
concepts.description: A rare genetic vascular disease characterized by the familial occurrence of thoracic aortic aneurysm, dissection or dilatation affecting one or more aortic segments (aortic root, ascending aorta, arch or descending aorta) in the absence of any other associated disease. concepts.label: isolated ankyloblepharon filiforme adnatum
concepts.description: Isolated ankyloblepharon filiforme adnatum (AFA) is characterized by the presence of single or multiple thin bands of connective tissue between the upper and lower eyelids, preventing full opening of the eye. concepts.label: isolated congenital alacrima
concepts.description: Congenital alacrima is characterized by deficient lacrimation (ranging from a complete absence of tears to hyposecretion of tears) that is present from birth.

concepts.label: Rieger anomaly
concepts.description: Rieger's anomaly is a congenital ocular defect caused by anterior segment dysgenesis and is characterized by severe anterior chamber deformity with prominent strands and marked atrophy of the iris stroma, with hole or pseudo-hole formation and corectopia. concepts.label: sclerocornea
concepts.description: A corneal disease in which the cornea blends with sclera, resulting in clouding of the cornea.

concepts.label: congenital ectropion uveae
concepts.description: Congenital ectropion uveae is a rare, genetic, non-syndromic developmental defect of the eye characterized by the presence of iris pigment epithelium on the anterior surface of the iris, anterior insertion of the iris, angle dysgenesis and progressive open-angle glaucoma (the latter may present i...

concepts.label: persistent hyperplastic primary vitreous
concepts.description: A developmental ocular anomaly in which the primary vitreous body and its surrounding hyaloid vasculature failed to regress. It is usually unilateral and characterized by cataract; microphthalmos (small eyeballs), and retrolenticular fibrovascular tissue. (from Yanoff: Ophthalmology, 2nd ed.)

concepts.label: Lyme disease
concepts.description: Lyme disease (named after the towns in the USA where the disease was first identified) is a bacterial infection caused by Borrelia burgdorferi.
synonyms: Borreliella burgdorferi caused disease or disorder

concepts.label: relapsing fever
concepts.description: Relapsing fever is an infection caused by bacteria of the genus Borrelia, excluding those responsible for Lyme disease belonging to the Borrelia burgdorferi complex.

concepts.label: familial nasal acilia
concepts.description: Familial nasal acilia is a rare genetic otorhinolaryngologic disease characterized by respiratory morbidity due to lack of cilia on the respiratory tract epithelial cells. The disease manifests from birth with respiratory distress, neonatal pneumonia, dyspnea, lobar atelectasis and bronchiectasis...

concepts.label: idiopathic achalasia
concepts.description: A primary esophageal motor disorder characterized by loss of esophageal peristalsis and insufficient lower esophageal sphincter (LES) relaxation in response to deglutition.

concepts.label: renal agenesis, unilateral
concepts.description: Unilateral renal agenesis (URA) is a form of renal agenesis characterized by the complete absence of development of one kidney accompanied by an absent ureter.

concepts.label: renal hypoplasia
concepts.description: Renal hypoplasia is a developmental anomaly in which one or both kidneys (unilateral or bilateral renal hypoplasia, respectively) have a deficit in the number of nephrons and may be small. Oligomeganephronia represents a severe variant of hypoplasia in which nephron number is reduced by 80% and n...

concepts.label: renal dysplasia
concepts.description: Renal dysplasia is a form of renal malformation in which the kidney(s) are present but their development is abnormal and incomplete. Renal dysplasia can be unilateral or bilateral, segmental, and of variable severity, with renal aplasia corresponding to extreme dysplasia.

concepts.label: congenital megacalycosis
concepts.description: Congenital megacalycosis is a rare renal malformation, characterized by non-obstructive dilation of the renal calyces as well as an increased calyceal number (12-20), with a normal renal pelvis, ureter, and bladder. It may be unilateral or bilateral and is usually asymptomatic unless complicated ...

concepts.label: posterior urethral valve

concepts.label: Pauci-immune glomerulonephritis
concepts.description: Pauci-immune glomerulonephritis (GN) is one of the most frequent causes of rapidly progressive GN (RPGN). concepts.label: vitamin D-dependent rickets, type 2
concepts.description: Hypocalcemic vitamin D-resistant rickets (HVDRR) is a hereditary disorder of vitamin D action characterized by hypocalcemia, severe rickets and in many cases alopecia.
synonyms: hereditary 1,25 dihydroxyvitamin D-resistant rickets with abnormal Vitamin D receptor

concepts.label: transient pseudohypoaldosteronism
concepts.description: Transient pseudohypoaldosteronism is a renal tubulopathy characterized by renal tubular resistance to aldosterone, characterized by hyponatremia, metabolic acidosis and hyperkalemia and manifesting as dehydration, secondary to urinary tract malformation and infections in infants.

concepts.label: renal dysplasia, unilateral

concepts.label: X-linked intellectual disability, Golabi-Ito-hall type

concepts.label: infectious encephalitis

concepts.label: hereditary hyperekplexia
concepts.description: Hereditary hyperekplexia is a hereditary neurological disorder characterized by excessive startle responses.

concepts.description: Complete androgen insensitivity syndrome (CAIS) is a form of androgen insensitivity syndrome (AIS), a disorder of sex development (DSD), characterized by the presence of female external genitalia in a 46,XY individual with normal testis development but undescended testes and unresponsiveness to a...

concepts.label: keratosis pilaris
concepts.description: A form of dry skin characterized by hair follicles plugged by scale.

concepts.description: A localized neoplasm of probable fibroblastic derivation, that arises from the pleura. It is characterized by the presence of round to spindle-shaped cells, hylanized stroma formation, thin-walled branching blood vessels, and thin bands of collagen.

concepts.label: mixed neoplasm
concepts.description: A neoplasm composed of at least two distinct cellular populations.

concepts.label: fibroepithelial neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign, borderline, or malignant neoplasm characterized by the presence of an epithelial and a fibrous component. Representative examples are fibroadenoma and phyllodes tumor.

concepts.label: breast fibroepithelial neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant biphasic neoplasm that arises from the breast parenchyma. It is characterized by the presence of an epithelial and a mesenchymal (stromal) component. The typical examples are fibroadenoma and phyllodes tumor.

concepts.label: breast phyllodes tumor
concepts.description: A benign, malignant, or borderline circumscribed biphasic neoplasm that arises from the breast. It usually affects middle-aged women. It is characterized by the presence of a double layer of epithelial cells that are arranged in clefts, surrounded by a spindle cell mesenchymal (stromal) component.

concepts.label: benign mastocytoma
concepts.description: A localized mast cell neoplasm without metastatic potential.

concepts.label: vulvar neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant neoplasm that affects the vulva. Representative examples include Bartholin gland adenoma, vulvar nodular hidradenoma, vulvar carcinoma, and vulvar melanoma.

concepts.label: vaginal neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant neoplasm affecting the vagina. Representative examples of benign neoplasms include squamous papilloma and melanocytic nevus. Representative examples of malignant neoplasms include carcinoma, melanoma, and sarcoma.

concepts.label: parasympathetic paraganglioma
concepts.description: A benign or malignant, usually non-functioning, extra-adrenal paraganglioma that arises from paraganglia located along the parasympathetic nerves. Representative examples include aorticopulmonary, carotid body, jugulotympanic, and mediastinal paragangliomas.

concepts.label: carotid body paraganglioma
concepts.description: A benign or malignant extra-adrenal parasympathetic paraganglioma arising from paraganglia adjacent to or in the bifurcation of the common carotid artery. Most patients present with a slow growing, painless mass in the neck.

concepts.label: bone sarcoma
concepts.description: A sarcoma that arises from the bone. Representative examples are osteosarcoma and chondrosarcoma.

concepts.label: classic familial adenomatous polyposis
concepts.description: Familial adenomatous polyposis (FAP) is characterized by the development of hundreds to thousands of adenomas in the rectum and colon during the second decade of life.
synonyms: familial adenomatous polyposis of the colon

concepts.label: familial adenomatous polyposis 1
concepts.description: An autosomal dominant disorder caused by pathogenic variants in the APC gene, characterized by the development of colorectal adenomatous polyposis, a very high risk of colorectal cancer and other extracolonic manifestations including both classic and attenuated familial adenomatous polyposis (FAP).

concepts.label: classic or attenuated familial adenomatous polyposis
concepts.description: An inherited diseases haracterized by the development of adenomas in the rectum and colon; classified into classic FAP and attenuated FAP.
synonyms: classic or attenuated familial adenomatous polyposis

concepts.label: neoplastic syndrome
concepts.description: A broad classification for disorders in which the development of neoplasms typically occur in association with a characteristic set of signs or symptoms. These disorders may be inherited or acquired.

concepts.label: RASopathy
concepts.description: Developmental syndromes caused by germline mutations (or in rare cases by somatic mosaicism) in genes that alter the Ras subfamily and mitogen-activated protein kinases that control signal transduction.
synonyms: disorder of Ras protein signal transduction

concepts.label: neurofibromatosis
concepts.description: A hereditary neoplastic syndrome in which tumors grow in the nervous system. There are typically 3 main types recognized, but other forms with uncertain etiology exist.

concepts.label: malignant colon neoplasm
concepts.description: A primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm that affects the colon. Representative examples include carcinoma, lymphoma, and sarcoma.

concepts.label: jugulotympanic paraganglioma
concepts.description: A benign or malignant extra-adrenal parasympathetic paraganglioma arising from paraganglia in the base of the skull and middle ear.

concepts.label: pleural neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant neoplasm that involves the serous membrane that lines the lungs and thoracic cavity. Most pleural neoplasms are metastatic. Diffuse malignant mesothelioma is the most common primary malignant neoplasm of the pleura.

concepts.label: urinary system neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant, primary or metastatic neoplasm involving the urinary system. --2003

concepts.label: mediastinal germ cell tumor
concepts.description: A germ cell tumor that arises from the mediastinum. Representative examples include seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, teratoma, and mixed germ cell tumor.
synonyms: germ cell neoplasm of the mediastinum
germ cell tumor of the mediastinum
germ cell tumour of the mediastinum

concepts.label: ovarian neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign, borderline, or malignant neoplasm involving the ovary.

concepts.label: malignant endocrine neoplasm
concepts.description: A malignant neoplasm affecting the endocrine glands. Representative examples include thyroid gland carcinoma, parathyroid gland carcinoma, pituitary gland carcinoma, and adrenal cortex carcinoma.
synonyms: malignant neoplasm of the endocrine gland
malignant tumor of the endocrine gland
malignant tumour of the endocrine gland

concepts.label: sublingual gland carcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that arises from the sublingual gland. Representative examples include cystadenocarcinoma and mucoepidermoid carcinoma.

concepts.label: laryngeal neoplasm

concepts.label: precancerous condition
concepts.description: A pathological process with signs indicating it may become cancerous. Representative examples include leukoplakia, dysplastic nevus, actinic keratosis, xeroderma pigmentosum, and intraepithelial neoplasia.

concepts.label: pancreatic exocrine neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant neoplasm that arises from the epithelial cells of the exocrine pancreatic tissue.

concepts.label: cystic neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign or malignant neoplasm that contains a single or multiple cystic spaces. Examples include cystadenoma, mucinous cystadenocarcinoma, and serous cystadenocarcinoma.

concepts.label: childhood neoplasm

concepts.label: blood vessel neoplasm

concepts.description: An autoimmune acute encephalitis caused by antibodies against the glutamate NMDA receptor. concepts.label: papillary meningioma

concepts.label: laminopathy
concepts.description: A rare genetic disorder caused by mutations in genes encoding proteins of the nuclear lamina.

concepts.label: narcolepsy
concepts.description: A sleep disorder characterized by a tendency for excessive sleepiness during the day which occurs even after adequate sleep in the nighttime. The persons who suffer from this condition experience fatigue and may fall asleep at inappropriate times during the day.

concepts.label: meningitis

concepts.label: sweat gland adenoma

concepts.label: myositis disease

concepts.label: hibernoma
concepts.description: A rare benign slow growing adipose tissue tumor, characterized by the presence of polygonal brown fat cells with multivacuolated and/or granular cytoplasm. The tumor is usually painless and is most often seen in young adults.

concepts.label: epithelioid hemangioma

concepts.label: autoimmune hepatitis type 3

concepts.label: proteostasis deficiencies

concepts.description: A glial tumor of the brain or spinal cord showing astrocytic differentiation. It includes the following clinicopathological entities: pilocytic astrocytoma, diffuse astrocytoma, anaplastic astrocytoma, pleomorphic xanthoastrocytoma, subependymal giant cell astrocytoma, and glioblastoma.

concepts.label: low grade glioma
concepts.description: A grade I or grade II glioma arising from the central nervous system. This category includes pilocytic astrocytoma, diffuse astrocytoma, subependymal giant cell astrocytoma, ependymoma, oligodendroglioma, oligoastrocytoma, and angiocentric glioma.

concepts.label: low grade astrocytic tumor
concepts.description: A grade I or grade II astrocytic tumor. This category includes pilocytic astrocytoma (grade I), subependymal giant cell astrocytoma (grade I), and diffuse astrocytoma (grade II).

concepts.label: grade II glioma
concepts.description: A glioma arising from the central nervous system. This category includes diffuse astrocytoma, ependymoma, oligodendroglioma, and oligoastrocytoma.

concepts.label: grade III glioma
concepts.description: A group of malignant gliomas that includes anaplastic astrocytoma, anaplastic oligodendroglioma, anaplastic oligoastrocytoma, and anaplastic ependymoma.

concepts.label: synpolydactyly

concepts.label: neuralgia

concepts.label: gram-positive bacterial infections

concepts.label: PSAP-related sphingolipidosis
concepts.description: A sphingolipidosis caused by variants in the PSAP gene. Clinical and biochemical features vary based on the location of variants within the gene and their molecular impact.

concepts.description: The NKX2-1 gene is located on chromosome 14 at 14q13.3 and encodes the NK2 homeobox 1 protein, a transcription factor that binds and activates thyroid specific genes. concepts.label: ASAH1-related sphingolipidosis

concepts.label: dysplastic cortical hyperostosis, Kozlowski-Tsuruta type
concepts.description: An extremely rare primary bone dysplasia with increased bone density characterized by lethal neonatal dwarfism with hydrops, narrow chest and short limbs with extensive cortical thickening of all long bones, ribs, clavicles and scapulae, and coronal clefts in vertebral bodies.

concepts.label: myopathy caused by variation in CRPPA
concepts.description: Any myopathy in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the CRPPA gene.

concepts.description: A precancerous condition characterized by cellular proliferation of hematopoietic cells where a substantial proportion of the cells are derived from a single hematopoietic stem cell lineage.

concepts.label: hereditary neurological disease
concepts.description: A heterogeneous group of genetic conditions with Mendelian (autosomal dominant, recessive, or X-linked) or chromosomal etiology characterized by abnormalities in the brain, spinal cord, nerves, or muscles.

concepts.label: hereditary neuromuscular disease
concepts.description: A heterogeneous group of genetic conditions with Mendelian (autosomal dominant, recessive, or X-linked) or chromosomal etiology that is characterized by progressive muscle degeneration and weakness.

concepts.label: cardiogenetic disease
concepts.description: A heterogeneous group of genetic conditions, with Mendelian (autosomal dominant, recessive, or X-linked) or chromosomal etiology that are characterized by abnormalities in the cardiovascular system.

concepts.label: SERAC1-related neurological disorder
concepts.description: Any neurological disorder in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the SERAC1 gene.

concepts.label: orbital myositis
concepts.description: A rare form of myositis that affects only the orbital muscles.

concepts.label: AFG2B-related complex neurodevelopmental disorder with motor features and hearing loss

concepts.label: OPTN-related open angle glaucoma
concepts.description: Any open angle glaucoma in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the OPTN gene.

concepts.label: hereditary narcolepsy
concepts.description: An instance of narcolepsy that is caused by an inherited genomic modification in an individual.

concepts.label: PRRT2-associated paroxysmal movement disorder
concepts.description: A group of rare movement and seizure disorders caused by changes (disease-causing variants or mutations) in the PRRT2 gene. concepts.label: RNU4ATAC spectrum disorder
concepts.description: A syndromic disease characterized by growth restriction, microcephaly, skeletal dysplasia, and cognitive impairment. concepts.label: ALG14-congenital disorder of glycosylation
concepts.description: Deficiency in the ALG14 enzyme results in incomplete assembly of the lipid linked oligosaccharide (LLO), leading to insufficient N-glycosylation of glycoproteins.

concepts.label: ligneous conjunctivitis
concepts.description: A rare form of chronic conjunctivitis characterized by the development of firm fibrin-rich, woody-like pseudomembraneous lesions mainly on the tarsal conjunctivae. Ligneous conjunctivitis is usually the initial and most common manifestation of type I congenital plasminogen deficiency.

concepts.label: HBA1-related alpha thalassemia spectrum
concepts.description: Mild microcytic anemia caused by biallelic variation in the HBA1 gene.

concepts.label: HBA2-related alpha thalassemia spectrum
concepts.description: Mild microcytic anemia caused by biallelic variation in the HBA2 gene.

concepts.label: digenic alpha thalassemia spectrum
concepts.description: An instance of alpha thalessemia spectrum that is caused by an inherited multiallelic modification in an individual.

concepts.label: HBA1; HBA2-related digenic alpha thalassemia spectrum
concepts.description: Mild microcytic anemia caused by variation in two of the four copies of the alpha hemoglobin genes, which can be in cis (e.g., large deletion of HBA1 and HBA2 genes) or in trans (e.g., HBA1 variant on one chromosome and HBA2 variant on the other chromosome).

concepts.label: monogenic alpha thalassemia spectrum
concepts.description: An instance of alpha thalessemia spectrum that is caused by an inherited monogenomic modification in an individual.

concepts.description: A neonatal/infantile epilepsy syndrome that is characterized by the onset of myoclonic seizures between the ages of 6-18 months (range 4 months to 3 years). concepts.label: hereditary angioedema with normal C1Inh

concepts.description: A spectrum of conditions, including dyskeratosis congenita, Hoyeraal-Hreidarsson syndrome, hereditary aplastic anemia, and pulmonary fibrosis, typically characterized by shortened telomeres due to a pathogenic variant(s) in ACD that results in impaired telomere maintenance.

concepts.label: MTOR-related overgrowth spectrum
concepts.description: Any overgrowth syndrome in which the cause of the disease is a pathogenic gain-of-function variants in the MTOR gene. The variants can be germline or somatic.

concepts.label: combined generalized and focal epilepsy
concepts.description: Any epilepsy where patients have both generalized and focal seizure types, with interictal and/or ictal EEG findings that accompany both seizure types. Patients with Dravet syndrome and Lennox-Gastaut syndrome may have combined focal and generalized epilepsy.

concepts.label: generalized epilepsy
concepts.description: Epilepsy that is characterized by generalized seizure types and may have typical interictal and/or ictal EEG findings that accompany generalized seizure types (for example generalized spike-wave).

concepts.label: genetic generalized epilepsy
concepts.description: A generalized epilepsy that is understood to have a genetic etiology. This does not always mean that the epilepsy is inherited or can be transmitted to offspring, as the genetic etiology may be a de novo pathogenic variant, or the genetic etiology may have complex/polygenic inheritance.

concepts.label: hereditary generalized epilepsy
concepts.description: An instance of generalized epilepsy that is caused by an inherited genomic modification in an individual.

concepts.label: myoclonic epilepsy
concepts.description: A group of epilepsy syndromes in which myoclonic seizures are a prominent feature.

concepts.label: ocular growth disorder
concepts.description: An eye disorder characterized by an aberrant development of the eye resulting in significant shortening or elongation, and therefore affecting the final ocular dimensions.

concepts.description: A congenital myopathy in which the cause of the disease is pathogenic variation in the TOR1AIP1 gene. May include fatigable muscle weakness resulting from impaired transmission at the neuromuscular synapse.

concepts.label: COL1A2-related Ehlers-Danlos syndrome
concepts.description: Any Ehler-Danlos syndrome caused by any variant in the COL1A2 gene.

concepts.label: ciliary dyskinesia, primary, 54
concepts.description: Any primary ciliary dyskinesia in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the CFAP54 gene.

concepts.label: ALPL-related autosomal dominant hypophosphatasia
concepts.description: Any hypophosphatasia in which the cause of the disease is a variant with a dominant negative effect or haploinsufficiency in the ALPL gene.

concepts.label: ALPL-related autosomal recessive hypophosphatasia
concepts.description: Any hypophosphatasia in which the cause of the disease is an autosomal recessive loss-of-function in the ALPL gene.

concepts.label: autism spectrum disorder 2
concepts.description: A moderate form of autism spectrum disorder marked by more significant challenges in social communication and more noticeable restricted, repetitive behaviors, requiring substantial support for daily functioning.

concepts.label: autism spectrum disorder 3
concepts.description: The most severe form of autism spectrum disorder, characterized by severe impairments in social communication and extreme restricted, repetitive behaviors, requiring very substantial support for daily functioning.

concepts.label: BMP4-related ocular growth disorder
concepts.description: Any ocular growth disorder in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the BMP4 gene.

concepts.label: syndromic congenital heart disease
concepts.description: Congenital heart disease with co-occurrence of other extracardiac congenital anomalies, or well characterized genetic conditions.

concepts.description: An epilepsy syndrome that has an onset during variable ages and stages of life.

concepts.label: DCTN1-related neurodegeneration

concepts.label: congenital right-sided heart lesions

concepts.label: leukoencephalopathy with vanishing white matter
concepts.description: A new leukoencephalopathy, the CACH syndrome (Childhood Ataxia with Central nervous system Hypomyelination) or VWM (Vanishing White Matter) was identified on clinical and MRI criteria. Classically, this disease is characterized by (1) an onset between 2 and 5 years of age, with a cerebello-spasti...
synonyms: childhood ataxia with diffuse central nervous system hypomyelination
childhood ataxia with central nervous system hypomyelination/vanishing white matter

congenital amegakaryocytic thrombocytopenia 1

concepts.label: juvenile absence epilepsy
concepts.description: A genetic epilepsy with onset occurring around puberty. Juvenile absence epilepsy is characterized by sporadic occurrence of absence seizures, frequently associated with a long-life prevalence of generalized tonic-clonic seizures (GTCS) and sporadic myoclonic jerks.

concepts.label: Birt-Hogg-Dube syndrome 2
concepts.description: Birt-Hogg-Dube syndrome caused by the mutations in PRDM10.

concepts.label: NR2F2 related multiple congenital anomalies/dysmorphic syndrome
concepts.description: A heart disease that is present at birth. Representative examples include atrial, ventricular, and atrioventricular septal defects, double-outlet right ventricle, tetralogy of Fallot, hypoplastic left heart syndrome, aortic stenosis, and coarctation of the aorta.
synonyms: NR2F2 related multiple congenital anomalies/dysmorphic syndrome

concepts.label: noxacusis
concepts.description: Noxacusis/pain hyperacusis is characterized by individuals who experience otalgia or pain (e.g., dull ache, burning, sharp, stabbing pain and throbbing pain) in response to everyday sounds. This differs clinically from those whose primary symptom is the perception of everyday sounds as excessivel...

concepts.label: COL4A1-related disorder
concepts.description: The spectrum of COL4A1-related disorders includes small-vessel brain disease of varying severity including porencephaly, variably associated with eye defects (retinal arterial tortuosity, Axenfeld-Rieger anomaly, cataract) and systemic findings (kidney involvement, muscle cramps, cerebral aneurys...

concepts.label: FHL1-related myopathy
concepts.description: A group of myopathies that includes Emery-Dreifuss muscular dystrophy (EDMD), and two allelic disorders characterized by the presence of reducing body on histopathology, namely reducing body myopathy (RBM) and scapuloperoneal myopathy.

concepts.label: KIF7-related ciliopathy
concepts.description: A spectrum of ciliopathy disorders that typically show autosomal recessive inheritance and includes Al-Gazali-Bakalinova syndrome, hydrolethalus syndrome 2, acrocallosal syndrome, Joubert syndrome 12.

concepts.label: SQSTM1-related multisystem proteinopathy
concepts.description: A group of disorders including Paget disease of bone (PBD), inclusion body myopathy (IBM), and less frequently frontotemporal dementia (FTD) and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Phenotypic presentation and severity are highly variable, and individuals within the same family may present with d...

concepts.label: CTSC-related disorder
concepts.description: Any ectodermal dysplasia syndrome in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the CTSC gene. Variations in the CTSC gene can result in (1) Papillon-Lefevre syndrome (PLS) characterized by palmoplantar keratoderma, severe periodontitis affecting deciduous and permanent dentitions, and prem...

concepts.label: disorder of GNAS inactivation
concepts.description: Any endocrine system disorder in which the cause of the disease is inactivation of the GNAS gene. Phenotypes include pseudohypoparathyroidism Ia, Ib, and Ic (PHP-Ia, -Ib, -Ic), pseudopseudohypoparathyroidism (PPHP), progressive osseous heteroplasia (POH), and osteoma cutis (OC).

concepts.label: dyskeratosis congenita and related telomere biology disorder
concepts.description: A dyskeratosis congenita caused by impaired telomere maintenance resulting in short or very short telomeres. The phenotypic spectrum includes individuals with classic dyskeratosis congenita (DC) as well as those with very short telomeres and an isolated physical finding. Classic DC is characteriz...
synonyms: dyskeratosis congenita and related telomere biology disorder

concepts.label: SCN4A-related channelopathy
concepts.description: Any muscular channelopathy in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SCN4 gene. This is characteristic of a continuum in the clinical spectrum that includes sodium-channel myotonia, paramyotonia congenita, hypokalemic periodic paralysis type II and hyperkalemic periodic paralysis.

concepts.label: ACD-related telomere biology disorder
concepts.description: A complex set of inherited conditions caused by a pathogenic variant(s) in the ACD gene that results in aberrant telomere biology.

concepts.label: TUBB4A-related neurologic disorder
concepts.description: Any neurologic condition in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the TUBB4A gene.

concepts.label: CYP1B1-related glaucoma with or without anterior segment dysgenesis
concepts.description: Any primary congenital glaucoma in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the CYP1B1 gene.

concepts.label: NACC1-related neurodevelopmental disorder with epilepsy, cataracts and episodic irritability
concepts.description: A neurodevelopmental disorder caused by heterozygous variants in NACC1 and characterized by developmental delay, intellectual disability, epilepsy, cataracts, feeding difficulties, and recurring episodes of extreme irritability. Other phenotypes include hypotonia, delayed myelination, microcephal...
synonyms: NACC1-related neurodevelopmental disorder with epilepsy, cataracts and episodic irritability

concepts.label: SETD2-related neurodevelopmental disorder without or with macrocephaly/overgrowth
concepts.description: A neurodevelopmental disorder caused by heterozygous variants in SETD2 and characterized by intellectual disability or developmental delay, motor delay, speech delay, hypotonia, autism spectrum disorder, attention deficit disorder, and sometimes features such as macrocephaly, overgrowth, and dysm...
synonyms: SETD2-related neurodevelopmental disorder without or with macrocephaly/overgrowth

concepts.label: trigeminal trophic syndrome
concepts.description: A syndrome characterized by an uncommon and relatively unknown cause of facial ulceration that occurs after damage to the trigeminal nerve. It characteristically involves non-healing facial ulceration(s) with accompanying anesthesia, paresthesia, and dysesthesia along the distribution of a trigem...

concepts.label: self-limited neonatal seizures
concepts.description: A neonatal/infantile epilepsy syndrome where seizures start in the neonate between day 4 and 7 of life and are often unilateral clonic events that recur and may alternate sides from seizure to seizure. Seizures can be repetitive over hours to days. Seizures remit by 4-6 months of age. A proportio...

concepts.label: non-verbal learning disability
concepts.description: A neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by core deficits in visual-spatial processing and a significant discrepancy between verbal and nonverbal intelligence (where verbal intelligence is higher).

concepts.label: SF3B4-related acrofacial dysostosis
concepts.description: A congenital malformation syndrome characterized by mandibulofacial dysostosis and anterior upper-limb defects, though occasionally, lower-limb defects have also been reported. Intrafamilial variability has been observed along with phenotype variability and severity including shoulder and pelvic ...

concepts.label: PRKAG2-related cardiomyopathy
concepts.description: A metabolic heart condition characterized by variable cardiac hypertrophy, ventricular pre-excitation, and aberrant glycogen storage in the cardiac tissue due to a pathogenic variant in PRKAG2 that results in a net anabolic effect in cardiac cells.

concepts.label: AKT3-related overgrowth spectrum
concepts.description: Any overgrowth syndrome where the cause of the disease is a gain-of-function variant in the AKT3 gene.

concepts.label: metabolic bone disorder
concepts.description: A group of disorders that affect the bones secondary to increased levels of minerals or deficient levels of minerals such as calcium, magnesium, phosphorus, and vitamin D. Representative examples are osteomalacia, osteoporosis, and Paget disease.

concepts.label: variable-age onset idiopathic generalized epilepsy syndrome
concepts.description: Any idiopathic generalized epilepsy syndrome that has a variable-age onset.

concepts.label: neonatal/infantile-onset self-limited epilepsy syndrome
concepts.description: An epilepsy syndrome characterized by the onset of seizures in neonates/infants where there is a high likelihood of spontaneously remitting at a predictable age.

concepts.label: genetic epilepsy with febrile seizures plus spectrum
concepts.description: A neonatal/infantile-onset self-limited familial syndrome characterized by the presence of febrile seizures in an individual with a family history of seizures/epilepsy. Febrile seizures may be typical febrile seizures or 'febrile seizures plus' (FS+) may occur, where febrile seizures continue pas...

concepts.label: neonatal/infantile-onset epilepsy syndrome with developmental and epileptic encephalopathy
concepts.description: A neonatal/infantile epilepsy syndrome characterized by the onset of non-self-limiting seizures and developmental regression or delay in infants/neonates. This condition is typically caused by genetic mutations that disrupt normal brain development, affecting both cognitive and motor development ...

concepts.label: early-infantile DEE
concepts.description: A neonatal/infantile epilepsy syndrome characterized by frequent drug-resistant seizures that begin ≤3 months of age, with abnormal interictal EEG and neurological examination. In up to 80% of patients, EIDEE is caused by an underlying structural, genetic, or metabolic reason.
synonyms: early infantile epileptic encephalopathy with suppression-bursts
early-infantile developmental and epileptic encephalopathy syndrome

concepts.label: variable-age onset focal epilepsy syndrome
concepts.description: An epilepsy syndrome characterized by focal seizures where age at seizure onset varies.

concepts.label: familial mesial temporal lobe epilepsy
concepts.description: A focal epilepsy syndrome where the age at onset is typically in adolescence or adulthood. Affected individuals have focal aware seizures with mesial temporal lobe features, especially prominent déjà vu. Most patients have a normal MRI, and seizures respond to treatment. A subgroup is recognised ...

concepts.label: variable-age onset combined generalized and focal epilepsy syndrome
concepts.description: An epilepsy syndrome characterized by a combined generalized and focal epilepsy syndromes where age at seizure onset varies.

concepts.label: variable-age epilepsy syndrome with developmental and/or epileptic encephalopathy or progressive neurological deterioration
concepts.description: An epilepsy syndrome characterized by seizures along with developmental and/or epileptic encephalopathy or progressive neurological deterioration where age at seizure onset varies.

concepts.label: epilepsy with auditory features
concepts.description: A variable-age onset focal epilepsy syndrome with characteristic focal aware sensory auditory seizures. Seizures often produce such mild symptoms that they are not diagnosed. There are no implications expected for development or learning and seizures are typically infrequent and well controlled. ...

concepts.label: interstitial lung disease 2
concepts.description: An interstitial lung disease in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SFTPA2 gene.

concepts.label: childhood-onset genetic generalized epilepsy syndrome
concepts.description: A genetic generalized epilepsy that has an onset during childhood.

concepts.label: childhood-onset idiopathic generalized epilepsy syndrome
concepts.description: An idiopathic generalized epilepsy that has an onset during childhood.

concepts.label: childhood-onset epilepsy syndrome with developmental and/or epileptic encephalopathy
concepts.description: A childhood-onset epilepsy syndrome where the onset of the condition includes manifestations of cognitive, neurological, or psychiatric impairment, stagnation, or regression, due directly to the underlying etiology. In contrast, an epileptic encephalopathy (EE) is present when the encephalopathy ...

concepts.label: developmental and/or epileptic encephalopathy with spike-wave activation in sleep
concepts.description: A rare epileptic encephalopathy of childhood characterized by seizures, an electroencephalographic (EEG) pattern of electrical status epilepticus in sleep (ESES) and neurocognitive regression in at least 2 domains of development. This syndrome encompasses the previous syndromes epileptic encephal...
synonyms: continuous slow spike and wave of sleep
continuous spike-wave during slow sleep syndrome
continuous spikes and waves during sleep
continuous spikes and waves during slow-wave sleep
developmental and epileptic encephalopathy with spike-wave activation in sleep
epileptic encephalopathy with continuous spike-and-wave during slow sleep
epileptic encephalopathy with spike and wave activation in sleep
epileptic encephalopathy with spike-and-wave activation in sleep

concepts.label: childhood-onset self-limited focal epilepsy syndrome
concepts.description: A group of conditions characterized by age-dependent occurrence in otherwise normal children. Cognition and neurological evaluation are typically normal. Remission occurs in almost all patients by puberty. Presumed genetic factors have an important role. Seizure semiology and electroencephalograp...

concepts.label: TMEM63B-related developmental and epileptic encephalopathy with anemia
concepts.description: A developmental and epileptic encephalopathy caused by variation in the TMEM63B gene. This disorder is characterised by early-onset drug-resistant epilepsy, with moderate-to-profound intellectual disability, severe motor impairment and brain structural anomalies. Most patients present early gener...
synonyms: TMEM63B-related developmental and epileptic encephalopathy with anaemia

concepts.label: idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis
concepts.description: An interstitial lung disease with a poor prognosis, that is characterized by the progressive formation of scar tissue within the lungs in the absence of any known cause.

concepts.label: congenital neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis
concepts.description: Congenital neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis (CNCL) is a severe form of neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis (NCL; see this term) with onset at birth characterized by primary microcephaly, neonatal epilepsy, and death in early infancy.

Fu...

non-specific autoimmune supratentorial encephalitis without characteristic antibodies

concepts.label: testicular sex cord-stromal benign neoplasm
concepts.description: A sex cord-stromal benign neoplasm that arises from the testis.

concepts.label: germ cell benign neoplasm
concepts.description: A benign neoplasm that derives from germ cells.

concepts.label: lymph node carcinoma
concepts.description: A lymph node cancer that has material basis in abnormally proliferating cells derives from epithelial cells.

concepts.label: B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma MLL rearranged
concepts.description: A B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma that is characterized by the presence of lymphoblasts that carry a translocation between the KMT2A gene at 11q23.3 and another gene partner resulting in the production of a KMT2A related fusion protein.

concepts.label: B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma with ETV6-RUNX1
concepts.description: A B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma that is characterized by the presence of lymphoblasts that carry a translocation between the TEL gene on chromosome 12 and the AML1 gene on chromosome 21, (p13.2;q22.1). It results in the production of the TEL-AML1 (ETV6-RUNX1) fusion protein.

concepts.label: B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma with IL3-IGH
concepts.description: A B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma that is characterized by the presence of lymphoblasts that carry a translocation between the IL3 gene on chromosome 5 and the IGH locus on chromosome 14, (q31.1;q32.3).

concepts.label: B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma, BCR-ABL1–like
concepts.description: A B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma that has a gene expression profile similar to that of B-ALL with t(9;22)(q34.1;q11.2) BCR-ABL1, but lacks that gene fusion.

concepts.label: B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma with IAMP21
concepts.description: A B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma that is characterized by amplification of a portion of chromosome 21.

concepts.label: spinal muscular atrophy type 0
concepts.description: A childhood spinal muscular atrophy that is evident before birth and characterized by diminished movement in the womb, joint deformities, extremely weak muscle tone and very weak respiratory muscles.

concepts.label: medulloblastoma WNT activated
concepts.description: A medulloblastoma that is characterized as a molecular subtype by activation of the WNT pathway and TP53 mutations may be present or absent.

concepts.label: medulloblastoma SHH activated
concepts.description: A medulloblastoma that is characterized as a molecular subtype by activation of the sonic hedgehog (SHH) pathway and TP53 mutations that may be present or absent.

concepts.label: medulloblastoma non-WNT/non-SHH
concepts.description: A medulloblastoma that is characterized as a molecular subtype that is not associated with activation of the WNT pathway or sonic hedgehog (SHH) pathway and TP53 mutations are absent.

concepts.label: NK cell deficiency
concepts.description: A primary immunodeficiency disease that results from defeciency in the number or function of CD56+CD3− NK cell in peripheral blood.

concepts.label: T cell and NK cell immunodeficiency
concepts.description: A primary immunodeficiency disease that involves multiple components of the immune system, including both T cell and NK cell immunodeficiency.

concepts.label: autoimmune cholangitis
concepts.description: An autoimmune hepatitis that is characterized by primary biliary cirrhosis clinical, biochemical, and histologic characteristics with antinuclear antibody positive sera.

concepts.label: mucinous pancreas adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A pancreatic adenocarcinoma that derives from epithelial cells originating in glandular tissue, which produce mucin.

concepts.label: childhood acute megakaryoblastic leukemia
concepts.description: An acute megakaryocytic leukemia that is characterized by fusion oncogenes involving transcriptional regulators in childhood.

concepts.label: core binding factor acute myeloid leukemia
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia that is characterized by the presence of t(8;21)(q22;q22) or inv(16)(p13q22)/t(16;16)(p13;q22). These cytogenetic abnormalities result in disruption of the transcription factor CBF, which is a regulator of normal hematopoiesis.

concepts.label: myeloid leukemia associated with down syndrome
concepts.description: An acute megakaryocytic leukemia occurring in children with Down syndrome and that has material basis in mutation in the GATA1 gene.

concepts.label: salivary gland mucinous adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A salivary gland carcinoma that is characterized by the presence of large pools of extracellular mucin in which clusters of malignant epithelial cells are found.

concepts.label: mammary analog secretory carcinoma
concepts.description: A salivary gland carcinoma that has material basis in a chromosomal translocation that results in an ETV6-NTRK3 fusion gene.

concepts.label: pemphigoid
concepts.description: An autoimmune disease of skin and connective tissue that is characterized by subepidermal blistering especially in the lower abdomen, groin, and flexor surfaces of the extremities, creating tense blisters that do not break easily.

concepts.label: intracranial meningioma
concepts.description: A meningioma that arises within the cranial cavity.

concepts.label: supratentorial meningioma
concepts.description: A meningioma that affects the supratentorial brain.

concepts.label: anaplastic pleomorphic xanthoastrocytoma
concepts.description: A malignant astrocytoma that is characterized by the presence of five or more mitoses per 10 high-power fields.

concepts.label: IDH-mutant anaplastic astrocytoma
concepts.description: An anaplastic astrocytoma carrying IDH mutations.

concepts.label: IDH-wildtype anaplastic astrocytoma
concepts.description: An anaplastic astrocytoma lacking mutations in IDH1 or IDH2 genes.

concepts.label: IDH-wildtype glioblastoma
concepts.description: A glioblastoma that is characterized by high cellularity, high mitotic activity, necrosis or microvascular proliferation and that lacks mutations in IDH genes.

concepts.label: spinal ependymoma, MYCN-amplified
concepts.description: A spinal cord ependymoma that is characterized by MYCN amplification.

concepts.label: posterior fossa ependymoma
concepts.description: A high grade ependymoma that is located within the posterior fossa.

concepts.label: supratentorial ependymoma
concepts.description: A high grade ependymoma that is located within the supratentorial brain.

concepts.label: oral rhabdomyosarcoma
concepts.description: A rhabdomyosarcoma located in the oral cavity.

concepts.label: bladder sarcomatoid transitional cell carcinoma
concepts.description: A sarcomatoid transitional cell carcinoma that is located in the bladder.

concepts.label: astroblastoma, MN1-altered
concepts.description: An astroblastoma that is characterized by astroblastoma-like morphology with MN1 rearrangements involving the meningioma 1 (MN1) gene on chromosome 22q.

concepts.label: immunoglobulin heavy-and-light chain
concepts.description: An amyloidosis that is characterized by both Ig heavy chains and LC contribute to the amyloid fibrils.

concepts.label: childhood supratentorial embryonal tumor with multilayered rosettes, C19MC-altered
concepts.description: A childhood embryonal tumor with multilayered rosettes, C19MC-altered that arises from the supratentorial brain and occurs in children.

concepts.label: rhabdomyolysis-myalgia syndrome
concepts.description: A myopathy that is characterized by muscle breakdown (rhabdomyolysis), heat and exertion-related muscle pain (myalgia) and cramping symptoms, severe muscle pain, sudden elevation and subsequent fall of serum creatine phosphokinase levels and products of muscle breakdown in the urine (myoglobinuri...

concepts.label: tuberculous encephalopathy
concepts.description: A tuberculosis that is characterized by cerebral edema sometimes with features similar to acute disseminated encephalomyelitis (ADEM) and may manifest with a variety of symptoms ranging from focal neurological deficits to convulsions and decreased conscious state.

concepts.label: diffuse large B-cell lymphoma activated B-cell type
concepts.description: A diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that is characterized by the expression of CD44, PKCbeta1, Cyclin D2, BCL-2, and IRF4/MUM1 genes.

concepts.label: diffuse large B-cell lymphoma germinal center B-cell type
concepts.description: A diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that is characterized by the expression of CD10, BCL-6, A-myb, and LMO2 genes, BCL-2 translocation, and c-REL amplification.

concepts.label: high-grade B-cell lymphoma double-hit/triple-hit
concepts.description: A B-cell lymphoma that is characterized by the abnormal rearrangement of two genes, MYC gene and either BCL2 or BCL6 genes.

concepts.label: mixed phenotype acute leukemia with BCR-ABL1
concepts.description: An acute biphenotypic leukemia that is characterized by blasts that also carry the translocation t(9;22)(q34.1;q11.2) by karyotypic analysis or the BCR-ABL1 translocation by FISH or PCR.

concepts.label: mixed phenotype acute leukemia with MLL rearranged
concepts.description: An acute biphenotypic leukemia that is characterized by blasts which carry a translocation between the MLL (KMT2A) gene at 11q23.3 and another gene partner.

concepts.label: mixed phenotype acute leukemia, B/myeloid
concepts.description: An acute biphenotypic leukemia that is characterized by blasts which express B-lymphoid and myeloid lineage markers but are negative for MLL translocation and t(9;22)(q34;q11.2) translocation.

concepts.label: mixed phenotype acute leukemia,T/myeloid
concepts.description: An acute biphenotypic leukemia that is characterized by blasts that express antigens of both T and myeloid antigens.

concepts.label: primary cutaneous gamma-delta t-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A primary cutaneous T-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma that is characterized by the clonal cutaneous proliferation of activated mature gamma-delta T cells with a cytotoxic phenotype.

concepts.label: neurobehavioral disorder with prenatal alcohol exposure
concepts.description: A fetal alcohol spectrum disorder that is characterized by one or more deficits in neurocognition and in self-regulation plus two or more deficits in adaptive functioning, with at least 1 in communication or social communication and interaction.

concepts.label: BN2 diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that is categorized as BN2 with high probability by the LymphGen algorithm. This is based on a combination of genetic features and BN2 DLBCLs often, but do not always, have a translocation involving the BCL6 locus and/or some combination of mutations affecting NOTC...

concepts.label: EZB diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that is categorized as EZB with high probability by the LymphGen algorithm. This is based on a combination of genetic features and EZB DLBCLs often, but do not always, have hot spot mutations in EZH2 and/or a BCL2 translocation. This class can be further subdivided...

concepts.label: MCD diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that is categorized as MCD with high probability by the LymphGen algorithm. This is based on a combination of genetic features and MCD DLBCLs often, but do not always, have the most common hot spot mutation in MYD88 (L265P) and/or activating mutations in CD79B. Thi...

concepts.label: N1 diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that is categorized as N1 with high probability by the LymphGen algorithm. This is based on a combination of genetic features. Although N1 DLBCLs always have an activating mutation affecting NOTCH1, LymphGen can assign cases with this mutation to other classes, dep...

concepts.label: ST2 diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that is categorized as ST2 with high probability by the LymphGen algorithm. This is based on a combination of genetic features and ST2 DLBCLs often, but do not always, have missense or nonsense mutations affecting TET2 and NFKBIA. This subgroup also commonly has mu...

concepts.label: A53 diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that is characterized by aneuploidy with TP53 inactivation.

concepts.label: acute myeloid leukemia, t(8;21)(q22; q22.1)
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia associated with t(8;21)(q22;q22) resulting in RUNX1-RUNX1T1 fusion protein expression. The bone marrow and the peripheral blood show large myeloblasts with abundant basophilic cytoplasm, often containing azurophilic granules.

concepts.label: acute myeloid leukemia, t(1;22)(p13;q13)
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia typically showing megakaryocytic maturation and associated with t(1;22)(p13;q13), resulting in the expression of RBM15-MKL1 fusion protein.

concepts.label: inclusion body myopathy and brain white matter abnormalities
tetrahydrobiopterin (BH4)-deficient hyperphenylalaninemia
concepts.description: An amino acid metabolic disorder that are characterized phenotypically by hyperphenylalaninemia, depletion of the neurotransmitters dopamine and serotonin, and progressive cognitive and motor deficits and that has material basis in autosomal recessive mutations in the genes encoding enzymes invol...

concepts.label: injection anthrax
concepts.description: An anthrax disease that is characterized by infection at the injection site or deep under the skin or in the muscle where the drug was injected and is caused by heroin contaminated with anthrax spores.

concepts.label: dendritic cell deficiency
concepts.description: A primary immunodeficiency disease characterized by impaired function or reduced numbers of dendritic cells.

concepts.label: pituitary blastoma
concepts.description: A pituitary cancer that is characterized by features of Cushing disease, with elevated blood ACTH levels and hypercortisolism arising within the fetal anterior pituitary and associated with DICER1 mutations.

concepts.label: diffuse pediatric-type high-grade glioma, H3-wildtype and IDH-wildtype
concepts.description: A high grade glioma that is characterized by the absence of histone H3, IDH1, and IDH2 mutations.

concepts.label: infant-type hemispheric glioma
concepts.description: A malignant astrocytoma that is characterized by receptor tyrosine kinase fusions in the NTRK family, ROS1, ALK, or MET genes, that arises in the cerebral hemisphere and occurs in early childhood.

concepts.label: high-grade astrocytoma with piloid features
concepts.description: An anaplastic astrocytoma that is characterized by high-grade piloid and/or glioblastoma-like histological features. It may occur anywhere in the central nervous system but most often arises in the posterior fossa.

concepts.label: spindle cell oncocytoma
concepts.description: A posterior pituitary benign neoplasm that is characterized by the presence of spindle cells with eosinophilic, granular cytoplasm forming fascicles.

concepts.label: central nervous system tumor with bcor internal tandem duplication
concepts.description: A central nervous system embryonal tumor that is characterized by the presence of uniform oval or spindle-shaped cells with round or oval nuclei, pseudorosette formation, and heterozygous internal tandem duplication in exon 15 of the BCOR gene.

concepts.label: primary intracranial sarcoma, DICER1-mutant
concepts.description: A brain sarcoma that is composed of malignant pleomorphic or spindle neoplastic cells typically demonstrating myogenic and/or chondroid differentiation. Cytoplasmic eosinophilic globules and myxoid stroma formation are usually present. It is associated with mutations in the DICER1 gene.

SLC12A2-related developmental delay-intellectual disability-sensorineural deafness syndrome

concepts.description: An inborn disorder of purine metabolism characterized by multiple congenital anomalies/dysmorphic features including craniofacial dysmorphism especially of the midface with flat face, low set ears, nasal hypoplasia, low nasal bridge, choanal atresia/stenosis and hypertelorism. concepts.label: thrombophilia, X-linked, due to factor 8 defect

concepts.label: diffuse low-grade glioma, MAPK pathway–altered

concepts.label: diffuse astrocytoma, MYB- or MYBL1-altered
concepts.description: A diffuse astrocytoma that is a diffusely infiltrative astroglial neoplasm composed of monomorphic cells with genetic alterations in MYB or MYBL1.

concepts.label: grade I lymphomatoid granulomatosis
concepts.description: A lymphomatoid granulomatosis that is characterized by the presence of a polymorphous lymphoid infiltrate without cytologic atypia. Large lymphocytes are absent or rare. By in situ hybridization, EBV-positive cells are infrequently seen.

concepts.label: grade II lymphomatoid granulomatosis
concepts.description: A lymphomatoid granulomatosis that is characterized by the presence of occasional large lymphoid cells or immunoblasts in a polymorphous background. Necrosis is more commonly seen as compared to grade I lymphomatoid granulomatosis. By in situ hybridization, EBV-positive cells are readily seen.

concepts.label: grade III lymphomatoid granulomatosis
concepts.description: A lymphomatoid granulomatosis that is characterized by the presence of aggregates of neoplastic large B-lymphocytes, usually admixed with pleomorphic and Hodgkin-like cells, in a background of chronic inflammation. Necrotic changes are present and are usually extensive.

concepts.label: benign teratoma
concepts.description: A germ cell benign neoplasm that derives from mature tissue elements or a limited amount of immature tissue elements.

concepts.label: medulloblastoma SHH activated and TP53 mutant
concepts.description: A medulloblastoma SHH activated that is characterized as a molecular subtype by activation of the sonic hedgehog (SHH) pathway and the presence of TP53 mutations.

concepts.label: medulloblastoma SHH activated and TP53 wild-type
concepts.description: A medulloblastoma SHH activated that is characterized as a molecular subtype by activation of the sonic hedgehog (SHH) pathway and the absence of TP53 mutations.

concepts.label: medulloblastoma non-WNT/non-SHH group 3
concepts.description: A medulloblastoma non-WNT/non-SHH that is characterized as a molecular subtype by absent TP53 mutations and MYC amplifications that may be present.

concepts.label: medulloblastoma non-WNT/non-SHH group 4
concepts.description: A medulloblastoma non-WNT/non-SHH that is characterized as a molecular subtype by the absence of MYC amplifications and TP53 mutations, while chromosome 17 abnormalities may be present.

concepts.label: astrocytoma, IDH-mutant, grade 4

The term glioblastoma no longer applies to central nervous system WHO grade 4 IDH-mutant astrocytomas.

concepts.label: ischemic stroke
concepts.description: A stroke disorder caused by obstruction of blood flow to the brain, due to thrombotic (local blood clot formation) or embolic (due to a blood clot or other material traveling from another site) event.

concepts.label: hemorrhagic stroke
concepts.description: A stroke disorder caused by bleeding into the brain parenchyma or surrounding spaces. Hemorrhagic stroke includes intracerebral hemorrhage (bleeding within the brain tissue) and subarachnoid hemorrhage (bleeding in the space between the brain and the surrounding membrane).

concepts.label: primary hyperthyroidism
concepts.description: A form of hyperthyroidism caused by overproduction of thyroid hormones (T3 and T4) due to pathology within the thyroid gland itself. Primary hyperthyroidism is characterized by low TSH levels and elevated T3/T4 levels.

concepts.label: secondary hyperthyroidism
concepts.description: A form of hyperthyroidism caused by overproduction of thyroid hormones (T3 and T4) due to pathology outside of the thyroid gland, namely in the hypothalamus or pituitary gland. Secondary hyperthyroidism is characterized by elevated TSH levels and elevated T3/T4 levels.

concepts.label: toxic thyroid adenoma
concepts.description: A condition in which a single benign adenoma on the thyroid gland  autonomously secretes excessive thyroid hormone, leading to primary hyperthyroidism.

concepts.label: menstrual disorder
concepts.description: A disorder of the female reproductive system characterized by abnormalities in the menstrual cycle, including disturbances in timing, flow, or associated pain.

concepts.label: NR5A1-related sex development disorder
concepts.description: A reproductive system disorder caused by a variation in the NR5A1 gene, and characterized by varying phenotypes, including partial or complete gonadal dysgenesis, ambiguous genitalia, and spermatogenic failure in the male, and premature ovarian failure and ovarian dysgenesis in the female.

concepts.label: CRYAB-related myofibrillar myopathy-cataract-cardiomyopathy spectrum disorder
concepts.description: A syndromic disease caused by a variation in the CRYAB gene, and characterized by a spectrum of phenotypes including cardiomyopathy, cataract, and/or myopathy.

concepts.label: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
concepts.description: An infertility disorder caused by variation in the SYCE1 gene. Affected males may present with non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure, while affected females may present with primary ovarian insufficiency.

concepts.label: split cord malformation type I
concepts.description: A rare subtype of split cord malformation characterized by each hemicord contained in its own dural sac, typically with an intervening bony or cartilaginous septum.

concepts.label: split cord malformation type II
concepts.description: A rare subtype of split cord malformation characterized by both hemicords included in the same single dural sac. An intradural intervening mesenchymal septum may be present.

concepts.label: split cord malformation, composite type
concepts.description: A rare intermediate form of split cord malformation characterized by both hemichords encapsulated in a single dural sac with presence of an incomplete ventral or dorsal bony spur.
